title: Multi-View Video Diffusion Policy: A 3D Spatio-Temporal-Aware Video Action Model
summary: Robotic manipulation requires understanding both the 3D spatial structure of the environment and its temporal evolution, yet most existing policies overlook one or both. They typically rely on 2D visual observations and backbones pretrained on static image--text pairs, resulting in high data requirements and limited understanding of environment dynamics. To address this, we introduce MV-VDP, a multi-view video diffusion policy that jointly models the 3D spatio-temporal state of the environment. The core idea is to simultaneously predict multi-view heatmap videos and RGB videos, which 1) align the representation format of video pretraining with action finetuning, and 2) specify not only what actions the robot should take, but also how the environment is expected to evolve in response to those actions. Extensive experiments show that MV-VDP enables data-efficient, robust, generalizable, and interpretable manipulation. With only ten demonstration trajectories and without additional pretraining, MV-VDP successfully performs complex real-world tasks, demonstrates strong robustness across a range of model hyperparameters, generalizes to out-of-distribution settings, and predicts realistic future videos. Experiments on Meta-World and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that MV-VDP consistently outperforms video-prediction--based, 3D-based, and vision--language--action models, establishing a new state of the art in data-efficient multi-task manipulation.
tldr: This paper introduces MV-VDP, a multi-view video diffusion policy for robotic manipulation that jointly models 3D spatio-temporal states by predicting heatmap and RGB videos, enabling data-efficient, robust, and generalizable manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MV-VDP，一种用于机器人操作的多视角视频扩散策略，通过预测热图和RGB视频共同建模3D时空状态，实现了数据高效、鲁棒且可泛化的操作。
summary_zh: 机器人操作需要同时理解环境的三维空间结构及其时间演化，然而现有的大多数策略往往忽视了其中一者或两者。这些策略通常依赖于二维视觉观测以及在静态图像-文本对上进行预训练的骨干网络，导致数据需求高且对环境动态的理解有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MV-VDP——一种多视角视频扩散策略，能够联合建模环境的三维时空状态。其核心思想是同步预测多视角热图视频和RGB视频，这既实现了视频预训练与动作微调的表征格式对齐，又不仅明确了机器人应执行何种动作，还预测了环境在响应这些动作时的预期演化过程。大量实验表明，MV-VDP能够实现数据高效、鲁棒、可泛化且可解释的机器人操作。仅需十条演示轨迹且无需额外预训练，MV-VDP即可成功执行复杂的真实世界任务，在不同模型超参数范围内展现出强鲁棒性，泛化至分布外场景，并预测逼真的未来视频。在Meta-World仿真平台和真实机器人平台上的实验证明，MV-VDP在基于视频预测、三维建模以及视觉-语言-动作的各类模型中均表现优异，为数据高效的多任务操作确立了新的技术标杆。

title: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
summary: Model predictive control (MPC) with learned world models has emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied control, particularly for its ability to generalize zero-shot when deployed in new environments. However, learned world models often struggle with long-horizon control due to the accumulation of prediction errors and the exponentially growing search space. In this work, we address these challenges by learning latent world models at multiple temporal scales and performing hierarchical planning across these scales, enabling long-horizon reasoning while substantially reducing inference-time planning complexity. Our approach serves as a modular planning abstraction that applies across diverse latent world-model architectures and domains. We demonstrate that this hierarchical approach enables zero-shot control on real-world non-greedy robotic tasks, achieving a 70% success rate on pick-&-place using only a final goal specification, compared to 0% for a single-level world model. In addition, across physics-based simulated environments including push manipulation and maze navigation, hierarchical planning achieves higher success while requiring up to 4x less planning-time compute.
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical planning method using learned latent world models at multiple temporal scales for long-horizon, zero-shot robotic control, demonstrating success on real-world manipulation and simulated tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用多时间尺度潜在世界模型进行分层规划的方法，用于长时域、零样本的机器人控制，在真实世界操作和模拟任务中取得了成功。
summary_zh: 基于学习世界模型的模型预测控制（MPC）已成为具身控制领域一种前景广阔的研究范式，尤其因其在新环境中部署时具备零样本泛化能力而备受关注。然而，学习型世界模型在长时序控制任务中常面临预测误差累积和搜索空间指数级增长的双重挑战。本研究通过构建多时间尺度的潜在世界模型，并在这些尺度上进行分层规划，从而在显著降低推理时规划复杂度的同时，实现了长时序推理能力。该方法作为一种模块化规划抽象框架，可广泛应用于不同潜在世界模型架构与任务领域。实验表明，这种分层规划策略能够在真实世界非贪婪型机器人任务中实现零样本控制——在仅给定最终目标指令的情况下，抓取放置任务的成功率达到70%，而单层世界模型成功率仅为0%。此外，在包括推动操作与迷宫导航在内的多个物理仿真环境中，分层规划在取得更高成功率的同时，将规划计算时间最高降低了4倍。

title: The Compression Gap: Why Discrete Tokenization Limits Vision-Language-Action Model Scaling
summary: Scaling Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by upgrading the vision encoder is expected to improve downstream manipulation performance--as it does in vision-language modeling. We show that this expectation fails when actions are represented as discrete tokens, and explain why through an information-theoretic principle we call the Compression Gap: in any visuomotor pipeline, scaling behavior is governed by the location of the tightest information bottleneck. When actions are continuous (e.g., Diffusion Policy), the vision encoder is the binding constraint, and upgrading it directly improves performance. When actions are discretized through a fixed-capacity codebook (e.g., OAT), the codebook becomes the binding constraint, and encoder improvements cannot propagate past it--regardless of how rich the upstream representation is. We validate this principle on the LIBERO benchmark with three lines of evidence: a factorial experiment showing that encoder upgrades improve Diffusion Policy by over 21 percentage points while OAT gains are substantially attenuated across model scales; an encoder quality gradient across four encoders confirming that Diffusion Policy tracks encoder quality monotonically while OAT remains flat; and a codebook size experiment demonstrating that relaxing codebook capacity partially recovers encoder sensitivity, providing causal evidence for the bottleneck hypothesis. Our findings reveal that scaling in Physical AI requires identifying where information bottlenecks lie in the pipeline, rather than uniformly increasing model or data size.
tldr: The paper identifies a critical information bottleneck in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models when actions are represented as discrete tokens, showing that scaling the vision encoder fails to improve robot manipulation performance, unlike with continuous action policies, and validates this on the LIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文发现，在动作表示为离散token的视觉-语言-动作模型中，信息瓶颈位于离散码本，导致扩大视觉编码器规模无法提升机器人操作性能；该结论在LIBERO基准上通过实验验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：
通过提升视觉编码器来扩展视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，有望改善下游操作性能——正如在视觉-语言建模中的表现那样。然而，当动作被表示为离散标记时，这种预期却未能实现。我们通过一个称为“压缩间隙”的信息论原理解释了这一现象：在任何视觉-运动流程中，扩展行为的规模受制于信息瓶颈最窄的位置。当动作为连续值（如扩散策略）时，视觉编码器是主要约束，升级它可直接提升性能；而当动作用固定容量的码本进行离散化（如OAT）时，码本则成为主要约束，编码器的改进无法突破其限制——无论上游表示如何丰富。我们在LIBERO基准上通过三条证据验证了该原理：一项析因实验表明，编码器升级使扩散策略提升超过21个百分点，而OAT的性能增益在各模型规模上均大幅减弱；四种编码器质量梯度实验证实，扩散策略性能随编码器质量单调提升，而OAT则保持平缓；码本容量实验证明，放宽码本容量可部分恢复编码器的敏感性，为瓶颈假设提供了因果证据。我们的研究结果表明，物理AI的扩展需识别流程中的信息瓶颈位置，而非简单地增加模型或数据规模。

title: Open-Loop Planning, Closed-Loop Verification: Speculative Verification for VLA
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, as large foundation models for embodied control, have shown strong performance in manipulation tasks. However, their performance comes at high inference cost. To improve efficiency, recent methods adopt action chunking, which predicts a sequence of future actions for open-loop execution. Although effective for reducing computation, open-loop execution is sensitive to environmental changes and prone to error accumulation due to the lack of close-loop feedback. To address this limitation, we propose Speculative Verification for VLA Control (SV-VLA), a framework that combines efficient open-loop long-horizon planning with lightweight closed-loop online verification. Specifically, SV-VLA uses a heavy VLA as a low-frequency macro-planner to generate an action chunk together with a planning context, while a lightweight verifier continuously monitors execution based on the latest observations. Conditioned on both the current observation and the planning context, the verifier compares the planned action against a closed-loop reference action and triggers replanning only when necessary. Experiments demonstrate that SV-VLA combines the efficiency of chunked prediction with the robustness of closed-loop control, enabling efficient and reliable VLA-based control in dynamic environments. Code is available: https://github.com/edsad122/SV-VLA.
tldr: This paper introduces SV-VLA, a framework that combines efficient open-loop action chunking for long-horizon planning with a lightweight closed-loop verifier to monitor and correct execution in real-time, improving the robustness and efficiency of VLA models for robot control in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SV-VLA框架，结合了用于长时规划的高效开环动作分块预测与轻量级闭环验证器，以实时监控和校正执行，提升了VLA模型在动态环境中进行机器人控制的鲁棒性和效率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为具身控制的大型基础模型，在操作任务中展现出强大性能。然而，其优越性能伴随着高昂的推理成本。为提升效率，近期方法采用动作分块预测技术，通过预测未来动作序列进行开环执行。尽管开环执行能有效降低计算量，但由于缺乏闭环反馈，其对环境变化敏感且易产生误差累积。针对这一局限，我们提出面向VLA控制的推测性验证框架（SV-VLA），该框架将高效的开环长程规划与轻量级闭环在线验证相结合。具体而言，SV-VLA采用重型VLA模型作为低频宏规划器，生成包含规划上下文信息的动作序列，同时由轻量级验证器基于最新观测持续监控执行过程。验证器结合当前观测与规划上下文，将规划动作与闭环参考动作进行比对，仅在必要时触发重新规划。实验表明，SV-VLA融合了分块预测的效率与闭环控制的鲁棒性，在动态环境中实现了高效可靠的VLA控制。代码已开源：https://github.com/edsad122/SV-VLA。

title: Learning Task-Invariant Properties via Dreamer: Enabling Efficient Policy Transfer for Quadruped Robots
summary: Achieving quadruped robot locomotion across diverse and dynamic terrains presents significant challenges, primarily due to the discrepancies between simulation environments and real-world conditions. Traditional sim-to-real transfer methods often rely on manual feature design or costly real-world fine-tuning. To address these limitations, this paper proposes the DreamTIP framework, which incorporates Task-Invariant Properties learning within the Dreamer world model architecture to enhance sim-to-real transfer capabilities. Guided by large language models, DreamTIP identifies and leverages Task-Invariant Properties, such as contact stability and terrain clearance, which exhibit robustness to dynamic variations and strong transferability across tasks. These properties are integrated into the world model as auxiliary prediction targets, enabling the policy to learn representations that are insensitive to underlying dynamic changes. Furthermore, an efficient adaptation strategy is designed, employing a mixed replay buffer and regularization constraints to rapidly calibrate to real-world dynamics while effectively mitigating representation collapse and catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments on complex terrains, including Stair, Climb, Tilt, and Crawl, demonstrate that DreamTIP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both simulated and real-world environments. Our method achieves an average performance improvement of 28.1% across eight distinct simulated transfer tasks. In the real-world Climb task, the baseline method achieved only a 10\ success rate, whereas our method attained a 100% success rate. These results indicate that incorporating Task-Invariant Properties into Dreamer learning offers a novel solution for achieving robust and transferable robot locomotion.
tldr: Proposes DreamTIP, a framework that integrates Task-Invariant Properties learning within the Dreamer world model to improve sim-to-real transfer for quadruped robot locomotion, guided by LLMs and demonstrating strong performance on complex terrains.
tldr_zh: 提出DreamTIP框架，将任务不变属性学习集成到Dreamer世界模型中，以改进四足机器人运动控制的模拟到真实迁移，通过大语言模型指导，在复杂地形上表现出强大性能。
summary_zh: 实现四足机器人在多样化和动态地形上的移动面临着巨大挑战，这主要源于仿真环境与真实条件之间的差异。传统的仿真到现实迁移方法通常依赖于人工特征设计或昂贵的真实世界微调。为克服这些限制，本文提出DreamTIP框架，该框架在Dreamer世界模型架构中融入任务不变属性学习，以增强仿真到现实迁移能力。在大型语言模型引导下，DreamTIP识别并利用任务不变属性（如接触稳定性与离地间隙），这些属性对动态变化具有鲁棒性且在任务间具备强迁移性。通过将这些属性作为辅助预测目标整合到世界模型中，使策略能够学习对底层动态变化不敏感的表征。此外，本文设计了一种高效适应策略，采用混合经验回放池与正则化约束，在有效缓解表征崩溃和灾难性遗忘的同时，快速校准至真实世界动态。在楼梯、攀爬、倾斜、爬行等复杂地形上的大量实验表明，DreamTIP在仿真和真实环境中均显著优于当前最先进的基线方法。本方法在八种不同的仿真迁移任务中平均性能提升达28.1%。在真实世界攀爬任务中，基线方法成功率仅为10%，而本文方法实现了100%的成功率。这些结果表明，将任务不变属性融入Dreamer学习为获得鲁棒且可迁移的机器人移动能力提供了一种创新解决方案。

title: Learning Structured Robot Policies from Vision-Language Models via Synthetic Neuro-Symbolic Supervision
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in mapping multimodal observations to robot behaviors. However, most current approaches rely on end-to-end visuomotor policies that remain opaque and difficult to analyze, limiting their use in safety-critical robotic applications. In contrast, classical robotic systems often rely on structured policy representations that provide interpretability, modularity, and reactive execution. This work investigates how foundation models can be specialized to generate structured robot policies grounded in multimodal perception, bridging high-dimensional learning and symbolic control. We propose a neuro-symbolic approach in which a VLM synthesizes executable Behavior Tree policies from visual observations, natural language instructions, and structured system specifications. To enable scalable supervision without manual annotation, we introduce an automated pipeline that generates a synthetic multimodal dataset of domain-randomized scenes paired with instruction-policy examples produced by a foundation model. Real-world experiments on two robotic manipulators show that structured policies learned entirely from synthetic supervision transfer successfully to physical systems. The results indicate that foundation models can be adapted to produce interpretable and structured robot policies, providing an alternative to opaque end-to-end approaches for multimodal robot decision making.
tldr: This paper proposes using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate synthetic neuro-symbolic supervision for learning structured, interpretable Behavior Tree policies for robot manipulation, which successfully transfer to real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出利用视觉语言模型生成合成的神经符号监督数据，用于学习机器人操作的结构化、可解释的行为树策略，并成功迁移至真实机器人系统。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型近来在将多模态观测映射到机器人行为方面展现出强大的能力。然而，当前大多数方法依赖于端到端的视觉运动策略，这些策略仍不透明且难以分析，限制了其在安全关键机器人应用中的使用。相比之下，传统机器人系统通常依赖于结构化的策略表示，以提供可解释性、模块化和反应式执行能力。本研究探讨了如何利用基础模型生成基于多模态感知的结构化机器人策略，以桥接高维学习与符号控制。我们提出了一种神经符号方法，其中视觉-语言模型根据视觉观测、自然语言指令和结构化系统规范，合成可执行的行为树策略。为实现无需手动标注的可扩展监督，我们引入了一种自动化流程，该流程生成一个合成多模态数据集，其中包含通过领域随机化生成的场景与由基础模型生成的指令-策略示例。在两个机械臂机器人上进行的真实世界实验表明，完全通过合成监督学习到的结构化策略能够成功迁移到物理系统中。结果表明，基础模型可以被适配以生成可解释且结构化的机器人策略，为多模态机器人决策提供了一种替代不透明端到端方法的新途径。

title: QuadAgent: A Responsive Agent System for Vision-Language Guided Quadrotor Agile Flight
summary: We present QuadAgent, a training-free agent system for agile quadrotor flight guided by vision-language inputs. Unlike prior end-to-end or serial agent approaches, QuadAgent decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control using an asynchronous multi-agent architecture: Foreground Workflow Agents handle active tasks and user commands, while Background Agents perform look-ahead reasoning. The system maintains scene memory via the Impression Graph, a lightweight topological map built from sparse keyframes, and ensures safe flight with a vision-based obstacle avoidance network. Simulation results show that QuadAgent outperforms baseline methods in efficiency and responsiveness. Real-world experiments demonstrate that it can interpret complex instructions, reason about its surroundings, and navigate cluttered indoor spaces at speeds up to 5 m/s.
tldr: QuadAgent is a training-free, asynchronous multi-agent system for vision-language-guided agile quadrotor flight. It decouples reasoning from control, uses a scene memory graph, and demonstrates high-speed navigation in cluttered indoor spaces.
tldr_zh: QuadAgent 是一个无需训练的异步多智能体系统，用于视觉语言引导的敏捷四旋翼飞行。它将高层推理与底层控制解耦，使用场景记忆图，并在杂乱室内环境中演示了高速导航能力。
summary_zh: 本文提出QuadAgent，一种无需训练、基于视觉语言输入的敏捷四旋翼飞行智能体系统。与传统端到端或串行智能体方案不同，QuadAgent通过异步多智能体架构将高层推理与底层控制解耦：前景工作流智能体负责主动任务与用户指令处理，而背景智能体执行前瞻性推理。该系统通过"印象图"——一种基于稀疏关键帧构建的轻量化拓扑地图——维持场景记忆，并借助基于视觉的避障网络确保飞行安全。仿真结果表明QuadAgent在效率与响应性上优于基准方法。实际飞行实验验证了该系统能解析复杂指令、对周围环境进行推理，并以最高5米/秒的速度在杂乱室内空间自主导航。

title: Learning Locomotion on Complex Terrain for Quadrupedal Robots with Foot Position Maps and Stability Rewards
summary: Quadrupedal locomotion over complex terrain has been a long-standing research topic in robotics. While recent reinforcement learning-based locomotion methods improve generalizability and foot-placement precision, they rely on implicit inference of foot positions from joint angles, lacking the explicit precision and stability guarantees of optimization-based approaches. To address this, we introduce a foot position map integrated into the heightmap, and a dynamic locomotion-stability reward within an attention-based framework to achieve locomotion on complex terrain. We validate our method extensively on terrains seen during training as well as out-of-domain (OOD) terrains. Our results demonstrate that the proposed method enables precise and stable movement, resulting in improved locomotion success rates on both in-domain and OOD terrains.
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning method for quadrupedal robot locomotion on complex terrain, using a foot position map and a stability reward within an attention-based framework to improve precision and stability over in-domain and out-of-domain terrains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于四足机器人在复杂地形上运动的强化学习方法，通过引入足部位置图和在注意力框架内的动态稳定性奖励，提高了在训练域内和域外地形上的运动精度和稳定性。
summary_zh: 四足机器人在复杂地形上的运动一直是机器人学中一个长期的研究课题。尽管近年来基于强化学习的运动方法提升了泛化能力和足部落点精度，但它们依赖于从关节角度隐式推断足部位置，缺乏基于优化的方法所具有的显式精度和稳定性保证。为此，我们提出了一种集成到高度图中的足部位置映射，以及一种基于注意力框架下的动态运动-稳定性奖励机制，以实现在复杂地形上的运动。我们不仅在对训练地形进行了广泛验证，还在域外（OOD）地形上进行了测试。实验结果表明，该方法能够实现精确稳定的运动，从而在训练域内及域外地形上均提高了运动成功率。

title: A Rapid Instrument Exchange System for Humanoid Robots in Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Humanoid robot technologies have demonstrated immense potential for minimally invasive surgery (MIS). Unlike dedicated multi-arm surgical platforms, the inherent dual-arm configuration of humanoid robots necessitates an efficient instrument exchange capability to perform complex procedures, mimicking the natural workflow where surgeons manually switch instruments. To address this, this paper proposes an immersive teleoperated rapid instrument exchange system. The system utilizes a low-latency mechanism based on single-axis compliant docking and environmental constraint release. Integrated with real-time first-person view (FPV) perception via a head-mounted display (HMD), this framework significantly reduces operational complexity and cognitive load during the docking process. Comparative evaluations between experts and novices demonstrate high operational robustness and a rapidly converging learning curve; novice performance in instrument attachment and detachment improved substantially after brief training. While long-distance spatial alignment still presents challenges in time cost and collaborative stability, this study successfully validates the technical feasibility of humanoid robots executing stable instrument exchanges within constrained clinical environments.
tldr: Proposes an immersive teleoperated rapid instrument exchange system for humanoid robots in surgery, using compliant docking and first-person view to reduce complexity and cognitive load.
tldr_zh: 为手术人形机器人提出了一种沉浸式遥操作快速器械交换系统，利用顺从对接和第一人称视角，降低了操作复杂性和认知负担。
summary_zh: 人形机器人技术在微创手术领域展现出巨大潜力。与专用多臂手术平台不同，人形机器人固有的双臂结构需要高效的器械交换能力，以执行复杂手术流程，模拟外科医生手动切换器械的自然工作模式。为此，本文提出一种沉浸式遥操作快速器械交换系统。该系统采用基于单轴顺应性对接与环境约束释放的低延迟机制，结合头戴式显示器提供的实时第一人称视角感知，显著降低了对接过程中的操作复杂性与认知负荷。专家与新手的对比实验表明，该系统具有高度操作鲁棒性及快速收敛的学习曲线；新手经过短期训练后器械装拆性能显著提升。尽管远距离空间对准在时间成本与协作稳定性方面仍存在挑战，本研究成功验证了人形机器人在受限临床环境中执行稳定器械交换的技术可行性。

title: Differentiable SpaTiaL: Symbolic Learning and Reasoning with Geometric Temporal Logic for Manipulation Tasks
summary: Executing complex manipulation in cluttered environments requires satisfying coupled geometric and temporal constraints. Although Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL) offers a principled specification framework, its use in gradient-based optimization is limited by non-differentiable geometric operations. Existing differentiable temporal logics focus on the robot's internal state and neglect interactive object-environment relations, while spatial logic approaches that capture such interactions rely on discrete geometry engines that break the computational graph and preclude exact gradient propagation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Differentiable SpaTiaL, a fully tensorized toolbox that constructs smooth, autograd-compatible geometric primitives directly over polygonal sets. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end differentiable symbolic spatio-temporal logic toolbox. By analytically deriving differentiable relaxations of key spatial predicates--including signed distance, intersection, containment, and directional relations--we enable an end-to-end differentiable mapping from high-level semantic specifications to low-level geometric configurations, without invoking external discrete solvers. This fully differentiable formulation unlocks two core capabilities: (i) massively parallel trajectory optimization under rigorous spatio-temporal constraints, and (ii) direct learning of spatial logic parameters from demonstrations via backpropagation. Experimental results validate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed framework.Code Available: https://github.com/plen1lune/DiffSpaTiaL
tldr: Proposes Differentiable SpaTiaL, a fully tensorized toolbox for end-to-end differentiable spatio-temporal logic, enabling gradient-based optimization and learning for manipulation tasks with geometric and temporal constraints.
tldr_zh: 提出Differentiable SpaTiaL，一个完全张量化的端到端可微分时空逻辑工具箱，用于实现具有几何和时序约束的机器人操作任务的梯度优化与学习。
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中执行复杂操作需要同时满足耦合的几何与时间约束。尽管时空逻辑（SpaTiaL）为规范描述提供了理论框架，但其在基于梯度的优化中的应用受限于不可微的几何运算。现有可微时间逻辑主要关注机器人内部状态，忽略了交互物体与环境间的关联；而能够捕捉此类交互的空间逻辑方法则依赖于离散几何引擎，这会中断计算图并阻碍精确梯度传播。为突破这一局限，我们提出了可微时空逻辑（Differentiable SpaTiaL）——一个完全张量化的工具箱，可直接在多边形集合上构建平滑的、兼容自动求导机制的几何基元。据我们所知，这是首个端到端可微的符号化时空逻辑工具箱。通过解析推导关键空间谓词（包括有向距离、相交、包含及方向关系）的可微松弛形式，我们实现了从高层语义规范到底层几何配置的端到端可微映射，且无需调用外部离散求解器。这种完全可微的表述解锁了两项核心能力：（1）在严格时空约束下的大规模并行轨迹优化；（2）通过反向传播从演示数据中直接学习空间逻辑参数。实验结果验证了所提框架的有效性与可扩展性。代码已开源：https://github.com/plen1lune/DiffSpaTiaL

title: From Impact to Insight: Dynamics-Aware Proprioceptive Terrain Sensing on Granular Media
summary: Robots that traverse natural terrain must interpret contact forces generated under highly dynamic conditions. However, most terrain characterization approaches rely on quasi-static assumptions that neglect velocity- and acceleration-dependent effects arising during impact and rapid stance transitions. In this work, we investigate granular terrain interaction during high-speed hopping and develop a physics-based framework for dynamic terrain characterization using proprioceptive sensing alone. Through controlled hopping experiments with systematically varied impact speed and leg compliance, our measurements reveal that quasi-static based assumptions lead to large discrepancies in granular terrain property estimation during high-speed hopping, particularly upon touchdown and controller-induced stiffness transitions. Velocity-dependent drag alone cannot explain these discrepancies. Instead, acceleration-dependent added-mass effects-associated with grain entrainment beneath the foot-dominate transient force responses. We integrate this force decomposition with a momentum-observer-based estimator that compensates for rigid-body inertia and gravity, and introduce an acceleration-aware weighted regression to account for increased force variance during high-acceleration events. Together, these methods enable consistent recovery of granular stiffness parameters across locomotion conditions, closely matching linear-actuator ground truth. Our results demonstrate that accurate terrain inference during high-speed locomotion requires explicit treatment of acceleration-dependent granular effects, and provide a foundation for robots to characterize complex deformable terrain during dynamic exploration of terrestrial and planetary environments.
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-based framework for dynamic terrain characterization using proprioceptive sensing during high-speed robotic hopping, addressing acceleration-dependent granular effects neglected by quasi-static assumptions.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一个基于物理的框架，利用本体感知在高速度机器人跳跃过程中进行动态地形表征，解决了准静态假设忽略的加速度依赖型颗粒效应。
summary_zh: 在自然地形中穿行的机器人必须解读高度动态条件下产生的接触力。然而，大多数地形表征方法依赖准静态假设，忽略了撞击和快速姿态转换过程中产生的速度与加速度相关效应。本研究通过高速跳跃过程中的颗粒地形交互实验，开发了一种仅依靠本体感知的动力学地形表征物理框架。通过系统改变冲击速度与腿部刚度的受控跳跃实验，测量结果显示准静态假设会导致高速跳跃过程中颗粒地形特性估计出现显著偏差，尤其是在触地阶段和控制器引发的刚度转换过程中。仅靠速度相关的阻力无法解释这些偏差，相反，加速度相关的附加质量效应——由足部下方颗粒裹挟运动引起——主导了瞬态力响应。我们将这种力分解与基于动量观测器的估计器相结合，补偿刚体惯性和重力影响，并引入加速度感知加权回归方法以处理高加速度事件中增大的力方差。这些方法共同实现了在不同运动条件下对颗粒刚度参数的一致性重构，与线性执行器的基准测试结果高度吻合。研究表明，高速运动过程中实现精确地形推断需要显式处理加速度相关的颗粒效应，为机器人在陆地及行星环境的动态探索中表征复杂可变形地形奠定了理论基础。

title: Tune to Learn: How Controller Gains Shape Robot Policy Learning
summary: Position controllers have become the dominant interface for executing learned manipulation policies. Yet a critical design decision remains understudied: how should we choose controller gains for policy learning? The conventional wisdom is to select gains based on desired task compliance or stiffness. However, this logic breaks down when controllers are paired with state-conditioned policies: effective stiffness emerges from the interplay between learned reactions and control dynamics, not from gains alone. We argue that gain selection should instead be guided by learnability: how amenable different gain settings are to the learning algorithm in use. In this work, we systematically investigate how position controller gains affect three core components of modern robot learning pipelines: behavior cloning, reinforcement learning from scratch, and sim-to-real transfer. Through extensive experiments across multiple tasks and robot embodiments, we find that: (1) behavior cloning benefits from compliant and overdamped gain regimes, (2) reinforcement learning can succeed across all gain regimes given compatible hyperparameter tuning, and (3) sim-to-real transfer is harmed by stiff and overdamped gain regimes. These findings reveal that optimal gain selection depends not on the desired task behavior, but on the learning paradigm employed. Project website: https://younghyopark.me/tune-to-learn
tldr: This paper systematically studies how the choice of position controller gains affects the learning of robot manipulation policies, focusing on behavior cloning, reinforcement learning, and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文系统性地研究了位置控制器增益的选择如何影响机器人操作策略的学习，重点关注行为克隆、强化学习和仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 位置控制器已成为执行习得操作策略的主导接口。然而，一个关键的设计决策仍未得到充分研究：我们应如何为策略学习选择控制器增益？传统观点是根据期望的任务顺应性或刚度来选择增益。然而，当控制器与状态条件策略结合使用时，这一逻辑便失效了：有效刚度源于习得反应与控制动力学之间的相互作用，而非仅由增益决定。我们认为，增益选择应转而以可学习性为指导：即不同增益设置对当前所用学习算法的适应程度。本研究系统性地探讨了位置控制器增益如何影响现代机器人学习流程的三个核心组成部分：行为克隆、从零开始的强化学习以及仿真到现实的迁移。通过跨多个任务与机器人实体的广泛实验，我们发现：（1）行为克隆受益于顺应性和过阻尼增益机制，（2）在适当的超参数调优下，强化学习能在所有增益机制中取得成功，（3）刚性与过阻尼增益机制会损害仿真到现实的迁移效果。这些研究结果表明，最优增益选择并非取决于期望的任务行为，而是取决于所采用的学习范式。项目网址：https://younghyopark.me/tune-to-learn

title: Mitigating Data Scarcity in Spaceflight Applications for Offline Reinforcement Learning Using Physics-Informed Deep Generative Models
summary: The deployment of reinforcement learning (RL)-based controllers on physical systems is often limited by poor generalization to real-world scenarios, known as the simulation-to-reality (sim-to-real) gap. This gap is particularly challenging in spaceflight, where real-world training data are scarce due to high cost and limited planetary exploration data. Traditional approaches, such as system identification and synthetic data generation, depend on sufficient data and often fail due to modeling assumptions or lack of physics-based constraints. We propose addressing this data scarcity by introducing physics-based learning bias in a generative model. Specifically, we develop the Mutual Information-based Split Variational Autoencoder (MI-VAE), a physics-informed VAE that learns differences between observed system trajectories and those predicted by physics-based models. The latent space of the MI-VAE enables generation of synthetic datasets that respect physical constraints. We evaluate MI-VAE on a planetary lander problem, focusing on limited real-world data and offline RL training. Results show that augmenting datasets with MI-VAE samples significantly improves downstream RL performance, outperforming standard VAEs in statistical fidelity, sample diversity, and policy success rate. This work demonstrates a scalable strategy for enhancing autonomous controller robustness in complex, data-constrained environments.
tldr: This paper proposes a physics-informed VAE (MI-VAE) to generate synthetic, physically-constrained data for offline RL in planetary lander control, mitigating data scarcity and improving sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于物理信息的变分自编码器（MI-VAE），用于为行星着陆器控制的离线强化学习生成符合物理约束的合成数据，以缓解数据稀缺问题并提升仿真到现实的迁移性能。
summary_zh: 基于强化学习（RL）的控制器在物理系统上的部署常因其在真实场景中泛化能力不足而受限，即所谓的模拟到现实（sim-to-real）差异。这一差异在航天领域尤为突出，由于成本高昂和行星探测数据有限，真实世界训练数据极其稀缺。传统方法（如系统辨识和合成数据生成）依赖充足的数据，且常因建模假设或缺乏物理约束而失效。我们提出通过为生成模型引入基于物理学的学习偏置来解决数据稀缺问题。具体而言，我们开发了基于互信息的分割变分自编码器（MI-VAE），这是一种物理信息嵌入的变分自编码器，能够学习观测系统轨迹与基于物理模型预测轨迹之间的差异。MI-VAE的潜在空间可生成符合物理约束的合成数据集。我们在行星着陆器问题上对MI-VAE进行评估，重点关注有限真实数据与离线强化学习训练的场景。结果表明，使用MI-VAE生成的样本增强数据集能显著提升下游强化学习的性能，在统计保真度、样本多样性和策略成功率上均优于标准变分自编码器。本研究为在复杂、数据受限的环境中提升自主控制器的鲁棒性提供了一种可扩展的策略。

title: Safety-Critical Centralized Nonlinear MPC for Cooperative Payload Transportation by Two Quadrupedal Robots
summary: This paper presents a safety-critical centralized nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for cooperative payload transportation by two quadrupedal robots. The interconnected robot-payload system is modeled as a discrete-time nonlinear differential-algebraic system, capturing the coupled dynamics through holonomic constraints and interaction wrenches. To ensure safety in complex environments, we develop a control barrier function (CBF)-based NMPC formulation that enforces collision avoidance constraints for both the robots and the payload. The proposed approach retains the interaction wrenches as decision variables, resulting in a structured DAE-constrained optimal control problem that enables efficient real-time implementation. The effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through extensive hardware experiments on two Unitree Go2 platforms performing cooperative payload transportation in cluttered environments under mass and inertia uncertainty and external push disturbances.
tldr: This paper presents a centralized safety-critical Nonlinear Model Predictive Control framework using Control Barrier Functions for cooperative payload transportation by two quadruped robots, validated on hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于控制屏障函数的集中式安全关键非线性模型预测控制框架，用于两个四足机器人的协作载荷运输，并在硬件平台上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于四足机器人协同载荷运输的安全关键型集中式非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）框架。该机器人-载荷互联系统被建模为离散时间非线性微分代数系统，通过完整约束和相互作用力/力矩捕捉耦合动力学特性。为确保复杂环境中的安全性，我们开发了一种基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的NMPC框架，对机器人和载荷同时强制执行避障约束。所提方法将相互作用力/力矩保留为决策变量，构建出具有结构化微分代数约束的最优控制问题，从而实现了高效的实时计算。该算法的有效性通过在两个Unitree Go2平台上开展的广泛硬件实验得到验证，实验场景涉及质量与惯性参数不确定及外部推力干扰下，机器人在杂乱环境中执行协同载荷运输任务。

title: FSUNav: A Cerebrum-Cerebellum Architecture for Fast, Safe, and Universal Zero-Shot Goal-Oriented Navigation
summary: Current vision-language navigation methods face substantial bottlenecks regarding heterogeneous robot compatibility, real-time performance, and navigation safety. Furthermore, they struggle to support open-vocabulary semantic generalization and multimodal task inputs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes FSUNav: a Cerebrum-Cerebellum architecture for fast, safe, and universal zero-shot goal-oriented navigation, which innovatively integrates vision-language models (VLMs) with the proposed architecture. The cerebellum module, a high-frequency end-to-end module, develops a universal local planner based on deep reinforcement learning, enabling unified navigation across heterogeneous platforms (e.g., humanoid, quadruped, wheeled robots) to improve navigation efficiency while significantly reducing collision risk. The cerebrum module constructs a three-layer reasoning model and leverages VLMs to build an end-to-end detection and verification mechanism, enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary goal navigation without predefined IDs and improving task success rates in both simulation and real-world environments. Additionally, the framework supports multimodal inputs (e.g., text, target descriptions, and images), further enhancing generalization, real-time performance, safety, and robustness. Experimental results on MP3D, HM3D, and OVON benchmarks demonstrate that FSUNav achieves state-of-the-art performance on object, instance image, and task navigation, significantly outperforming existing methods. Real-world deployments on diverse robotic platforms further validate its robustness and practical applicability.
tldr: This paper introduces FSUNav, a novel 'Cerebrum-Cerebellum' architecture for zero-shot vision-language navigation that combines a reinforcement learning-based local planner for universal robot control with VLM-based high-level reasoning, aiming to improve speed, safety, and generalization on diverse platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FSUNav，一种用于零样本视觉语言导航的'大脑-小脑'架构，结合基于强化学习的通用局部规划器与基于VLM的高层推理模块，旨在提升不同机器人平台上的导航速度、安全性和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 当前视觉-语言导航方法在异构机器人兼容性、实时性能与导航安全性方面面临显著瓶颈，且难以支持开放词汇语义泛化及多模态任务输入。为应对这些挑战，本文提出FSUNav：一种基于大脑-小脑架构的快速、安全、通用零样本目标导航系统，创新性地将视觉-语言模型与所提架构深度融合。小脑模块作为高频端到端模块，开发了基于深度强化学习的通用局部规划器，可实现跨异构平台（如人形、四足、轮式机器人）的统一导航，在提升导航效率的同时显著降低碰撞风险。大脑模块构建三层推理模型，利用视觉-语言模型建立端到端检测与验证机制，无需预定义标识即可实现零样本开放词汇目标导航，在仿真与真实场景中均提升了任务成功率。此外，该框架支持多模态输入（如文本、目标描述与图像），进一步增强了泛化能力、实时性、安全性与鲁棒性。在MP3D、HM3D及OVON基准测试中的实验结果表明，FSUNav在物体导航、实例图像导航及任务导航方面均达到先进水平，显著优于现有方法。在多样化机器人平台上的实际部署进一步验证了其鲁棒性与实用价值。

title: An Open-Source LiDAR and Monocular Off-Road Autonomous Navigation Stack
summary: Off-road autonomous navigation demands reliable 3D perception for robust obstacle detection in challenging unstructured terrain. While LiDAR is accurate, it is costly and power-intensive. Monocular depth estimation using foundation models offers a lightweight alternative, but its integration into outdoor navigation stacks remains underexplored. We present an open-source off-road navigation stack supporting both LiDAR and monocular 3D perception without task-specific training. For the monocular setup, we combine zero-shot depth prediction (Depth Anything V2) with metric depth rescaling using sparse SLAM measurements (VINS-Mono). Two key enhancements improve robustness: edge-masking to reduce obstacle hallucination and temporal smoothing to mitigate the impact of SLAM instability. The resulting point cloud is used to generate a robot-centric 2.5D elevation map for costmap-based planning. Evaluated in photorealistic simulations (Isaac Sim) and real-world unstructured environments, the monocular configuration matches high-resolution LiDAR performance in most scenarios, demonstrating that foundation-model-based monocular depth estimation is a viable LiDAR alternative for robust off-road navigation. By open-sourcing the navigation stack and the simulation environment, we provide a complete pipeline for off-road navigation as well as a reproducible benchmark. Code available at https://github.com/LARIAD/Offroad-Nav.
tldr: This paper presents an open-source off-road navigation stack that uses foundation models for monocular depth estimation as a lightweight alternative to LiDAR, integrating it with SLAM for robust 3D perception and planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种开源越野导航栈，使用基础模型进行单目深度估计作为激光雷达的轻量级替代方案，并将其与SLAM集成以实现鲁棒的3D感知和规划。
summary_zh: 野外自主导航需要在具有挑战性的非结构化地形中实现可靠的3D感知以进行鲁棒的障碍物检测。虽然激光雷达精度高，但成本昂贵且功耗大。基于基础模型的单目深度估计提供了一种轻量级替代方案，但其在户外导航系统中的集成应用仍缺乏深入探索。本文提出一个支持激光雷达与单目3D感知的开放式野外导航系统，无需针对特定任务进行训练。对于单目感知方案，我们融合零样本深度预测模型（Depth Anything V2）与基于稀疏SLAM测量（VINS-Mono）的度量深度重标定技术。通过两项关键增强提升系统鲁棒性：采用边缘掩蔽技术降低障碍物虚影，通过时序平滑抑制SLAM不稳定的影响。生成的点云用于构建以机器人为中心的2.5D高程地图，进而实现基于代价地图的路径规划。在真实感仿真环境（Isaac Sim）和真实非结构化场景中的评估表明，单目感知方案在多数场景下可达到高分辨率激光雷达的性能水平，证明基于基础模型的单目深度估计是鲁棒野外导航中可行的激光雷达替代方案。通过开源导航系统与仿真环境，我们为野外导航提供了完整的技术流程与可复现的基准测试平台。代码发布于https://github.com/LARIAD/Offroad-Nav。

title: Joint Prediction of Human Motions and Actions in Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: Fluent human--robot collaboration requires robots to continuously estimate human behaviour and anticipate future intentions. This entails reasoning jointly about \emph{continuous movements} and \emph{discrete actions}, which are still largely modelled in isolation. In this paper, we introduce \textsf{MA-HERP}, a hierarchical and recursive probabilistic framework for the \emph{joint estimation and prediction} of human movements and actions. The model combines: (i) a hierarchical representation in which movements compose into actions through admissible Allen interval relations, (ii) a unified probabilistic factorisation coupling continuous dynamics, discrete labels, and durations, and (iii) a recursive inference scheme inspired by Bayesian filtering, alternating top-down action prediction with bottom-up sensory evidence. We present a preliminary experimental evaluation based on neural models trained on musculoskeletal simulations of reaching movements, showing accurate motion prediction, robust action inference under noise, and computational performance compatible with on-line human--robot collaboration.
tldr: This paper presents MA-HERP, a hierarchical probabilistic framework for jointly estimating and predicting human movements and actions, with the goal of enabling fluent human-robot collaboration. A preliminary evaluation on simulated reaching movements shows promising results for motion prediction and action inference.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MA-HERP，一个用于联合估计和预测人类动作和运动的层次化概率框架，旨在实现流畅的人机协作。基于模拟伸手运动的初步实验评估显示了其在运动预测和动作推断方面的良好效果。
summary_zh: 流畅的人机协作要求机器人能够持续估计人类行为并预测其未来意图。这需要对**连续动作**与**离散行为**进行联合推理，而目前这两类要素大多仍被孤立建模。本文提出一种层次化递归概率框架——**MA-HERP**，用于对人类动作与行为进行**联合估计与预测**。该模型整合了三个核心要素：（一）采用层次化表征，将连续动作通过可容许的艾伦区间关系组合为行为；（二）建立统一的概率分解框架，耦合连续动态、离散标签及持续时间；（三）设计受贝叶斯滤波启发的递归推理机制，交替执行自上而下的行为预测与自下而上的感知证据融合。基于人体抓取动作的肌肉骨骼仿真数据训练神经模型，我们开展了初步实验评估，结果表明该框架能够实现精准的运动预测，在噪声干扰下保持鲁棒的行为推断能力，且其计算性能满足在线人机协作的实时性要求。

title: Enhancing Multi-Robot Exploration Using Probabilistic Frontier Prioritization with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Multi-agent autonomous exploration is essential for applications such as environmental monitoring, search and rescue, and industrial-scale surveillance. However, effective coordination under communication constraints remains a significant challenge. Frontier exploration algorithms analyze the boundary between the known and unknown regions to determine the next-best view that maximizes exploratory gain. This article proposes an enhancement to existing frontier-based exploration algorithms by introducing a probabilistic approach to frontier prioritization. By leveraging Dirichlet process Gaussian mixture model (DP-GMM) and a probabilistic formulation of information gain, the method improves the quality of frontier prioritization. The proposed enhancement, integrated into two state-of-the-art multi-agent exploration algorithms, consistently improves performance across environments of varying clutter, communication constraints, and team sizes. Simulations showcase an average gain of $10\%$ and $14\%$ for the two algorithms across all combinations. Successful deployment in real-world experiments with a dual-drone system further corroborates these findings.
tldr: This paper proposes a probabilistic frontier prioritization method using Dirichlet process Gaussian mixture models to enhance multi-agent autonomous exploration, demonstrating improved performance in simulations and real-world tests with a dual-drone system.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型的概率前沿优先级方法，用于增强多智能体自主探索，在模拟和双无人机系统的真实世界实验中展示了性能提升。
summary_zh: 多智能体自主探索在环境监测、搜救及工业级监控等领域具有关键作用。然而，在通信受限条件下的有效协调仍面临重大挑战。前沿探索算法通过分析已知与未知区域间的边界，以确定能最大化探索收益的最佳观测点。本文提出了一种基于概率前沿优先级排序的改进方法，以增强现有前沿探索算法。该方法利用狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型以及信息增益的概率化表述，提升了前沿优先级排序的质量。将这一改进整合至两种先进的多智能体探索算法后，在不同杂乱程度、通信限制和团队规模的环境下均实现了性能的持续提升。模拟实验表明，在全部组合场景中，两种算法的平均收益分别提高了$10\%$和$14\%$。通过双无人机系统的实地部署实验，进一步验证了该方法的有效性。

title: ARM: Advantage Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation remains challenging for reinforcement learning (RL) because sparse rewards provide limited guidance for credit assignment. Practical policy improvement thus relies on richer intermediate supervision, such as dense progress rewards, which are costly to obtain and ill-suited to non-monotonic behaviors such as backtracking and recovery. To address this, we propose Advantage Reward Modeling (ARM), a framework that shifts from hard-to-quantify absolute progress to estimating relative advantage. We introduce a cost-effective tri-state labeling strategy -- Progressive, Regressive, and Stagnant -- that reduces human cognitive overhead while ensuring high cross-annotator consistency. By training on these intuitive signals, ARM enables automated progress annotation for both complete demonstrations and fragmented DAgger-style data. Integrating ARM into an offline RL pipeline allows for adaptive action-reward reweighting, effectively filtering suboptimal samples. Our approach achieves a 99.4% success rate on a challenging long-horizon towel-folding task, demonstrating improved stability and data efficiency over current VLA baselines with near-zero human intervention during policy training.
tldr: This paper introduces Advantage Reward Modeling (ARM), a method using tri-state human labeling to generate relative advantage rewards for long-horizon robot manipulation tasks, which are then integrated into an offline RL pipeline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出优势奖励建模（ARM），该方法使用三态人工标注为长视界机器人操作任务生成相对优势奖励，并将其集成到离线强化学习流程中。
summary_zh: 长时程机器人操作对强化学习而言仍具挑战性，因为稀疏奖励在信用分配上提供的指导有限。因此，实际策略改进依赖于更丰富的中间监督，如稠密进度奖励，但这些奖励获取成本高昂，且不适用于回溯、恢复等非单调行为。为解决此问题，我们提出优势奖励建模（ARM）框架，该框架从难以量化的绝对进度评估转向相对优势估计。我们引入一种低成本的三态标注策略——前进、后退与停滞，在降低人工认知负荷的同时保证较高的标注者间一致性。通过基于这些直观信号进行训练，ARM能够对完整示范数据与碎片化的DAgger风格数据实现自动进度标注。将ARM整合至离线强化学习流程中，可实现自适应动作奖励重加权，有效过滤次优样本。我们的方法在具有挑战性的长时程毛巾折叠任务中取得了99.4%的成功率，在策略训练阶段近乎零人工干预的情况下，展现出比当前视觉语言行动基准更强的稳定性和数据效率。

title: Behavior-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Receding-Horizon Credit Assignment for High-Performance Control
summary: Learning high-performance control policies that remain consistent with expert behavior is a fundamental challenge in robotics. Reinforcement learning can discover high-performing strategies but often departs from desirable human behavior, whereas imitation learning is limited by demonstration quality and struggles to improve beyond expert data. We propose a behavior-constrained reinforcement learning framework that improves beyond demonstrations while explicitly controlling deviation from expert behavior. Because expert-consistent behavior in dynamic control is inherently trajectory-level, we introduce a receding-horizon predictive mechanism that models short-term future trajectories and provides look-ahead rewards during training. To account for the natural variability of human behavior under disturbances and changing conditions, we further condition the policy on reference trajectories, allowing it to represent a distribution of expert-consistent behaviors rather than a single deterministic target. Empirically, we evaluate the approach in high-fidelity race car simulation using data from professional drivers, a domain characterized by extreme dynamics and narrow performance margins. The learned policies achieve competitive lap times while maintaining close alignment with expert driving behavior, outperforming baseline methods in both performance and imitation quality. Beyond standard benchmarks, we conduct human-grounded evaluation in a driver-in-the-loop simulator and show that the learned policies reproduce setup-dependent driving characteristics consistent with the feedback of top-class professional race drivers. These results demonstrate that our method enables learning high-performance control policies that are both optimal and behavior-consistent, and can serve as reliable surrogates for human decision-making in complex control systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a behavior-constrained RL method with receding-horizon credit assignment for high-performance control tasks, such as autonomous racing, aiming to improve beyond expert demonstrations while controlling deviation from expert behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种行为约束的强化学习方法，结合滚动时域信用分配，用于高性能控制任务（如自动驾驶赛车），旨在超越专家示范的同时控制与专家行为的偏离。
summary_zh: 学习高性能且与专家行为一致的控制策略是机器人学中的核心挑战。强化学习能够发现高性能策略，但往往偏离理想的人类行为；而模仿学习受限于演示质量，难以超越专家数据。我们提出一种行为约束的强化学习框架，该框架在明确控制与专家行为偏差的同时，能够超越演示数据性能。由于动态控制中与专家一致的行为本质上具有轨迹级特性，我们引入一种滚动时域预测机制，该机制建模短期未来轨迹并在训练期间提供前瞻性奖励。考虑到人类行为在干扰和变化条件下天然具有变异性，我们进一步将策略条件化于参考轨迹，使其能够表示专家一致行为的分布而非单一确定性目标。通过实证研究，我们在高保真赛车仿真环境中使用专业驾驶员数据评估该方法，该领域以极端动力学特性和狭窄性能边界为特征。学习到的策略在保持与专家驾驶行为高度一致的同时取得了具有竞争力的圈速成绩，在性能与模仿质量上均超越基线方法。除标准基准测试外，我们在驾驶员在环仿真器中进行了人本评估，结果表明学习到的策略能够复现与顶级职业赛车手反馈一致、依赖于车辆设定的驾驶特性。这些结果证明，我们的方法能够学习既具备高性能又保持行为一致性的控制策略，并可作为复杂控制系统中人类决策的可靠替代方案。

title: Asymptotically-Bounded 3D Frontier Exploration enhanced with Bayesian Information Gain
summary: Robotic exploration in large-scale environments is computationally demanding due to the high overhead of processing extensive frontiers. This article presents an OctoMap-based frontier exploration algorithm with predictable, asymptotically bounded performance. Unlike conventional methods whose complexity scales with environment size, our approach maintains a complexity of $\mathcal{O}(|\mathcal{F}|)$, where $|\mathcal{F}|$ is the number of frontiers. This is achieved through strategic forward and inverse sensor modeling, which enables approximate yet efficient frontier detection and maintenance. To further enhance performance, we integrate a Bayesian regressor to estimate information gain, circumventing the need to explicitly count unknown voxels when prioritizing viewpoints. Simulations show the proposed method is more computationally efficient than the existing OctoMap-based methods and achieves computational efficiency comparable to baselines that are independent of OctoMap. Specifically, the Bayesian-enhanced framework achieves up to a $54\%$ improvement in total exploration time compared to standard deterministic frontier-based baselines across varying spatial scales, while guaranteeing task completion. Real-world experiments confirm the computational bounds as well as the effectiveness of the proposed enhancement.
tldr: Presents an OctoMap-based 3D robotic exploration algorithm with asymptotically-bounded computational complexity, enhanced with Bayesian information gain estimation for more efficient frontier selection and exploration.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于OctoMap的、具有渐进有界计算复杂度的3D机器人探索算法，并集成贝叶斯信息增益估计，以实现更高效的边界点选择和探索。
summary_zh: 在大规模环境中进行机器人探索时，由于需要处理大量前沿区域的较高计算开销，对计算资源提出了较高要求。本文提出一种基于八叉树地图的前沿探索算法，其性能可预测且具有渐近上界。与传统方法复杂度随环境规模增长不同，本方法保持复杂度为$\mathcal{O}(|\mathcal{F}|)$，其中$|\mathcal{F}|$为前沿区域数量。该特性通过战略性的前向与逆向传感器建模实现，能够在保证近似精度的前提下高效完成前沿检测与维护。为进一步提升性能，我们引入贝叶斯回归器估计信息增益，从而在视点优先级排序时避免显式统计未知体素。仿真实验表明，所提方法比现有基于八叉树地图的算法具有更高计算效率，且达到与独立于八叉树地图的基线方法相当的计算效率。具体而言，在不同空间尺度下，这种贝叶斯增强框架相比标准确定性前沿基线方法的总探索时间最多可缩短$54\%$，同时保证任务完成。真实环境实验验证了计算上界的有效性以及所提增强策略的实用性。

title: A Flow Matching Framework for Soft-Robot Inverse Dynamics
summary: Learning the inverse dynamics of soft continuum robots remains challenging due to high-dimensional nonlinearities and complex actuation coupling. Conventional feedback-based controllers often suffer from control chattering due to corrective oscillations, while deterministic regression-based learners struggle to capture the complex nonlinear mappings required for accurate dynamic tracking. Motivated by these limitations, we propose an inverse-dynamics framework for open-loop feedforward control that learns the system's differential dynamics as a generative transport map. Specifically, inverse dynamics is reformulated as a conditional flow-matching problem, and Rectified Flow (RF) is adopted as a lightweight instance to generate physically consistent control inputs rather than conditional averages. Two variants are introduced to further enhance physical consistency: RF-Physical, utilizing a physics-based prior for residual modeling; and RF-FWD, integrating a forward-dynamics consistency loss during flow matching. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework reduces trajectory tracking RMSE by over 50% compared to standard regression baselines (MLP, LSTM, Transformer). The system sustains stable open-loop execution at a peak end-effector velocity of 1.14 m/s with sub-millisecond inference latency (0.995 ms). This work demonstrates flow matching as a robust, high-performance paradigm for learning differential inverse dynamics in soft robotic systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a flow-matching framework for learning inverse dynamics of soft continuum robots, demonstrating improved trajectory tracking and stable open-loop control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于学习软体连续机器人逆动力学的流匹配框架，显著提高了轨迹跟踪精度并实现了稳定的开环控制。
summary_zh: 学习软体连续机器人的逆动力学仍然面临挑战，这主要源于高维非线性特性和复杂的驱动耦合。传统的基于反馈的控制器常因修正性振荡而出现控制抖振，而基于确定性回归的学习方法难以捕捉精确动态跟踪所需的复杂非线性映射关系。受这些局限性的启发，我们提出了一种用于开环前馈控制的逆动力学框架，该框架将系统的微分动力学作为生成式传输映射进行学习。具体而言，逆动力学被重新表述为条件流匹配问题，并采用整流流（RF）作为轻量级实例来生成物理一致的控制输入，而非条件平均值。我们还引入了两种变体以进一步增强物理一致性：RF-Physical利用基于物理的先验知识进行残差建模；RF-FWD则在流匹配过程中整合了前向动力学一致性损失。大量实验评估表明，与标准回归基线方法（MLP、LSTM、Transformer）相比，本框架将轨迹跟踪均方根误差降低了50%以上。该系统在末端执行器峰值速度达到1.14米/秒时仍能保持稳定的开环执行，且推理延迟低于亚毫秒级（0.995毫秒）。本研究证明流匹配可作为学习软体机器人系统微分逆动力学的一种稳健、高性能范式。

title: STRNet: Visual Navigation with Spatio-Temporal Representation through Dynamic Graph Aggregation
summary: Visual navigation requires the robot to reach a specified goal such as an image, based on a sequence of first-person visual observations. While recent learning-based approaches have made significant progress, they often focus on improving policy heads or decision strategies while relying on simplistic feature encoders and temporal pooling to represent visual input. This leads to the loss of fine-grained spatial and temporal structure, ultimately limiting accurate action prediction and progress estimation. In this paper, we propose a unified spatio-temporal representation framework that enhances visual encoding for robotic navigation. Our approach extracts features from both image sequences and goal observations, and fuses them using the designed spatio-temporal fusion module. This module performs spatial graph reasoning within each frame and models temporal dynamics using a hybrid temporal shift module combined with multi-resolution difference-aware convolution. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach consistently improves navigation performance and offers a generalizable visual backbone for goal-conditioned control. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/hren20/STRNet}{https://github.com/hren20/STRNet}.
tldr: Proposes a spatio-temporal representation framework for visual navigation that uses graph reasoning and temporal modules to improve feature encoding and action prediction for goal-conditioned robotic control.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于视觉导航的时空表示框架，通过图推理和时序模块来改进特征编码和动作预测，适用于目标驱动的机器人控制。
summary_zh: 视觉导航要求机器人基于第一人称视角的视觉观察序列，到达图像等指定目标。尽管近年来基于学习的方法取得了显著进展，但它们往往侧重于改进策略头或决策策略，而依赖于简化的特征编码器和时间池化来表示视觉输入。这导致细粒度时空结构的丢失，最终限制了动作预测和进度估计的准确性。本文提出一种统一的时空表征框架，以增强机器人导航的视觉编码能力。我们的方法从图像序列和目标观察中提取特征，并利用设计的时空融合模块进行融合。该模块在每帧内执行空间图推理，并使用混合时间移位模块结合多分辨率差分感知卷积来建模时序动态。实验结果表明，我们的方法持续提升了导航性能，并为目标条件控制提供了可泛化的视觉主干网络。代码发布于 \href{https://github.com/hren20/STRNet}{https://github.com/hren20/STRNet}。

title: Vision-Based End-to-End Learning for UAV Traversal of Irregular Gaps via Differentiable Simulation
summary: -Navigation through narrow and irregular gaps is an essential skill in autonomous drones for applications such as inspection, search-and-rescue, and disaster response. However, traditional planning and control methods rely on explicit gap extraction and measurement, while recent end-to-end approaches often assume regularly shaped gaps, leading to poor generalization and limited practicality. In this work, we present a fully vision-based, end-to-end framework that maps depth images directly to control commands, enabling drones to traverse complex gaps within unseen environments. Operating in the Special Euclidean group SE(3), where position and orientation are tightly coupled, the framework leverages differentiable simulation, a Stop-Gradient operator, and a Bimodal Initialization Distribution to achieve stable traversal through consecutive gaps. Two auxiliary prediction modules-a gap-crossing success classifier and a traversability predictor-further enhance continuous navigation and safety. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the approach's effectiveness, generalization capability, and practical robustness.
tldr: This paper presents a vision-based end-to-end learning framework for drones to autonomously navigate through irregular gaps using differentiable simulation and auxiliary prediction modules, achieving robustness in unseen environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于视觉的端到端学习框架，利用可微分模拟和辅助预测模块，使无人机能够在未知环境中自主穿越不规则间隙，展现出鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 摘要：穿越狭窄且不规则空隙是自主无人机在巡检、搜救与灾害响应等应用中的关键能力。传统规划与控制方法依赖于显式空隙提取与测量，而近期的端到端方法通常假设空隙形状规则，导致泛化能力不足且实用性受限。本研究提出一种完全基于视觉的端到端框架，将深度图像直接映射为控制指令，使无人机能够在未知环境中穿越复杂空隙。该框架在位置与姿态紧密耦合的特殊欧几里得群SE(3)空间中运行，通过可微分模拟、停止梯度算子及双模态初始化分布策略，实现了连续穿越多个空隙的稳定控制。此外，两个辅助预测模块——空隙穿越成功率分类器与可通过性预测器——进一步增强了持续导航能力与安全性。大量仿真与实物实验验证了该方法在有效性、泛化能力及实际鲁棒性方面的优势。

title: Elastomeric Strain Limitation for Design of Soft Pneumatic Actuators
summary:
Modern robots embody power and precision control. Yet, as robots undertake tasks that apply forces on humans, this power brings risk of injury. Soft robotic actuators use deformation to produce smooth, continuous motions and conform to delicate objects while imparting forces capable of safely pushing humans. This thesis presents strategies for the design, modeling, and strain-based control of human-safe elastomeric soft pneumatic actuators (SPA) for force generation, focusing on embodied mechanical response to simple pressure inputs.
  We investigate electroadhesive (EA) strain limiters for variable shape generation, rapid force application, and targeted inflation trajectories. We attach EA clutches to a concentrically strain-limited elastomeric membrane to alter the inflation trajectory and rapidly reorient the inflated shape. We expand the capabilities of EA for soft robots by encasing them in elastomeric sheaths and varying their activation in real time, demonstrating applications in variable trajectory inflation under identical pressure sweeps.
  We then address the problem of trajectory control in the presence of external forces by modeling the pressure-trajectory relationship for a concentrically strain-limited class of silicone actuators. We validate theoretical models based on material properties and energy minimization using active learning and automated testing. We apply our ensemble of neural networks for inverse membrane design, specifying quasi-static mass lift trajectories from a simple pressure sweep. Finally, we demonstrate the power of multiple pressure-linked actuators in a proof-of-concept mannequin leg lift.
tldr: Thesis presents design, modeling, and strain-based control strategies for human-safe soft pneumatic actuators, including electroadhesive strain limiters for variable shape/trajectory control, and demonstrates applications in controlled inflation and a leg lift.
tldr_zh: 本论文提出面向人机安全的软体气动执行器的设计、建模和应变控制策略，包括用于可变形状/轨迹控制的电粘附应变限制器，并展示了在可控膨胀和腿部抬起中的应用。
summary_zh:
现代机器人体现了力量与精准控制。然而，当机器人执行对人类施加力的任务时，这种力量也带来了伤害风险。软体机器人致动器通过形变实现平滑、连续的运动，并能贴合精细物体，同时施加的力足以安全地推动人类。本文提出了一种用于产生力的人体安全型弹性软体气动致动器（SPA）的设计、建模及基于应变控制的策略，重点关注其对于简单压力输入所体现的机械响应。

我们研究了用于可变形状生成、快速施力及目标充气轨迹的电吸附（EA）应变限制器。将电吸附离合器附着于同心应变限制的弹性膜上，以改变充气轨迹并快速调整充气形状的方向。通过将电吸附器件封装在弹性护套中并实时改变其激活状态，我们扩展了其在软体机器人中的应用能力，展示了在相同压力扫描下实现可变轨迹充气的应用实例。

接着，我们通过建立一类同心应变限制的硅胶致动器的压力-轨迹关系模型，解决了存在外力情况下的轨迹控制问题。我们利用主动学习和自动化测试，验证了基于材料特性与能量最小化的理论模型。应用神经网络集成进行逆膜设计，通过简单的压力扫描指定准静态质量提升轨迹。最后，我们在概念验证的人体模型腿部抬升实验中，展示了多个压力联动致动器的强大功能。

title: Aligning Progress and Feasibility: A Neuro-Symbolic Dual Memory Framework for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in long-horizon decision-making tasks, such as embodied manipulation and web interaction. However, agents frequently struggle with endless trial-and-error loops or deviate from the main objective in complex environments. We attribute these failures to two fundamental errors: global Progress Drift and local Feasibility Violation. Existing methods typically attempt to address both issues simultaneously using a single paradigm. However, these two challenges are fundamentally distinct: the former relies on fuzzy semantic planning, while the latter demands strict logical constraints and state validation. The inherent limitations of such a single-paradigm approach pose a fundamental challenge for existing models in handling long-horizon tasks. Motivated by this insight, we propose a Neuro-Symbolic Dual Memory Framework that explicitly decouples semantic progress guidance from logical feasibility verification. Specifically, during the inference phase, the framework invokes both memory mechanisms synchronously: on one hand, a neural-network-based Progress Memory extracts semantic blueprints from successful trajectories to guide global task advancement; on the other hand, a symbolic-logic-based Feasibility Memory utilizes executable Python verification functions synthesized from failed transitions to perform strict logical validation. Experiments demonstrate that this method significantly outperforms existing competitive baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and TextCraft, while drastically reducing the invalid action rate and average trajectory length.
tldr: A neuro-symbolic dual memory framework for LLM agents addresses progress drift and feasibility violations in long-horizon decision-making, improving performance on embodied manipulation and web interaction benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个神经符号双记忆框架，用于解决LLM智能体在长期决策任务中的进展漂移和可行性违规问题，显著提升了在ALFWorld等具身操作和交互基准上的性能。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在长时程决策任务（如实体化操作和网络交互）中展现出强大的潜力。然而，智能体在复杂环境中常陷入无休止的试错循环或偏离核心目标。我们将这些失败归因于两个根本性错误：全局进度漂移和局部可行性违例。现有方法通常尝试用单一范式同时解决这两个问题，但这两类挑战本质上截然不同：前者依赖于模糊语义规划，而后者要求严格的逻辑约束与状态验证。这种单一范式固有的局限性使现有模型在处理长时程任务时面临根本性挑战。基于此洞察，我们提出一种神经符号双记忆框架，将语义进度引导与逻辑可行性验证显式解耦。具体而言，在推理阶段，该框架同步调用两种记忆机制：一方面，基于神经网络的进度记忆从成功轨迹中提取语义蓝图，以引导全局任务推进；另一方面，基于符号逻辑的可行性记忆利用从失败转移中合成的可执行Python验证函数，执行严格的逻辑校验。实验表明，该方法在ALFWorld、WebShop和TextCraft任务上显著优于现有竞争基线，同时大幅降低了无效动作率与平均轨迹长度。

title: THOM: Generating Physically Plausible Hand-Object Meshes From Text
summary: The generation of 3D hand-object interactions (HOIs) from text is crucial for dexterous robotic grasping and VR/AR content generation, requiring both high visual fidelity and physical plausibility. Nevertheless, the ill-posed problem of mesh extraction from text-generated Gaussians, and physics-based optimization on the erroneous meshes pose challenges. To address these issues, we introduce THOM, a training-free framework that generates photorealistic, physically plausible 3D HOI meshes without the need for a template object mesh. THOM employs a two-stage pipeline, initially generating the hand and object Gaussians, followed by physics-based HOI optimization. Our new mesh extraction method and vertex-to-Gaussian mapping explicitly assign Gaussian elements to mesh vertices, allowing topology-aware regularization. Furthermore, we improve the physical plausibility of interactions by VLM-guided translation refinement and contact-aware optimization. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that THOM consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods in terms of text alignment, visual realism, and interaction plausibility.
tldr: A training-free framework that generates physically plausible 3D hand-object interaction meshes from text, aiming to aid dexterous robotic grasping and content generation.
tldr_zh: 一种免训练框架，可从文本生成物理上合理的3D手-物体交互网格，旨在辅助灵巧机器人抓取和内容生成。
summary_zh: 基于文本生成三维手物交互（HOI）模型对于灵巧机器人抓取和VR/AR内容生成至关重要，其需同时满足高视觉保真度与物理合理性。然而，从文本生成的高斯分布中提取网格这一不适定问题，以及基于错误网格进行物理优化均带来巨大挑战。为此，我们提出THOM框架——一种无需模板物体网格、免训练即可生成高真实感物理合理三维HOI网格的解决方案。THOM采用两阶段流程：首先生成手部与物体的高斯分布，继而进行基于物理的HOI优化。我们提出的新型网格提取方法及顶点-高斯映射技术，显式地将高斯元素分配给网格顶点，实现了拓扑感知正则化。此外，通过视觉语言模型引导的位姿优化和接触感知优化策略，显著提升了交互的物理合理性。综合实验表明，THOM在文本对齐度、视觉真实感与交互合理性方面均持续超越现有先进方法。

title: Goal-Conditioned Neural ODEs with Guaranteed Safety and Stability for Learning-Based All-Pairs Motion Planning
summary: This paper presents a learning-based approach for all-pairs motion planning, where the initial and goal states are allowed to be arbitrary points in a safe set. We construct smooth goal-conditioned neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs) via bi-Lipschitz diffeomorphisms. Theoretical results show that the proposed model can provide guarantees of global exponential stability and safety (safe set forward invariance) regardless of goal location. Moreover, explicit bounds on convergence rate, tracking error, and vector field magnitude are established. Our approach admits a tractable learning implementation using bi-Lipschitz neural networks and can incorporate demonstration data. We illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method on a 2D corridor navigation task.
tldr: This paper introduces a learning-based method for all-pairs motion planning using goal-conditioned Neural ODEs, providing theoretical guarantees for safety and stability in navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于学习的目标条件神经常微分方程方法，用于全对运动规划，在导航任务中提供了安全性和稳定性的理论保证。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于学习的目标运动规划方法，其初始状态与目标状态可为安全集内的任意点。我们通过双利普希茨微分同胚构建了平滑的目标条件神经常微分方程。理论结果表明，无论目标位置如何变化，所提模型均能保证全局指数稳定性与安全性（安全集前向不变性），并建立了收敛速率、跟踪误差及向量场幅值的显式边界。该方法采用双利普希茨神经网络实现可处理的学习框架，并能融合演示数据。我们在二维走廊导航任务中验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: MFE: A Multimodal Hand Exoskeleton with Interactive Force, Pressure and Thermo-haptic Feedback
summary: Recent advancements in virtual reality and robotic teleoperation have greatly increased the variety of haptic information that must be conveyed to users. While existing haptic devices typically provide unimodal feedback to enhance situational awareness, a gap remains in their ability to deliver rich, multimodal sensory feedback encompassing force, pressure, and thermal sensations. To address this limitation, we present the Multimodal Feedback Exoskeleton (MFE), a hand exoskeleton designed to deliver hybrid haptic feedback. The MFE features 20 degrees of freedom for capturing hand pose. For force feedback, it employs an active mechanism capable of generating 3.5-8.1 N of pushing and pulling forces at the fingers' resting pose, enabling realistic interaction with deformable objects. The fingertips are equipped with flat actuators based on the electro-osmotic principle, providing pressure and vibration stimuli and achieving up to 2.47 kPa of contact pressure to render tactile sensations. For thermal feedback, the MFE integrates thermoelectric heat pumps capable of rendering temperatures from 10 to 55 degrees Celsius. We validated the MFE by integrating it into a robotic teleoperation system using the X-Arm 6 and Inspire Hand manipulator. In user studies, participants successfully recognized and manipulated deformable objects and differentiated remote objects with varying temperatures. These results demonstrate that the MFE enhances situational awareness, as well as the usability and transparency of robotic teleoperation systems.
tldr: This paper introduces a hand exoskeleton providing multimodal haptic feedback (force, pressure, thermal) for enhanced robotic teleoperation, validated with a user study on object manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种提供多模态触觉反馈（力、压力、热感）的手部外骨骼，用于增强机器人遥操作系统，并通过物体操作任务的用户研究进行了验证。
summary_zh: 虚拟现实与机器人遥操作技术的最新进展极大地丰富了需向用户传递的触觉信息类型。现有触觉设备通常仅提供单模态反馈以增强情境感知，但在传递涵盖力、压力与热感应的丰富多模态感官反馈方面仍存在不足。为突破此局限，我们提出多模态反馈外骨骼——一种能够提供混合触觉反馈的手部外骨骼装置。该设备具备20个自由度以捕捉手部姿态：在力反馈方面采用主动机制，可在手指自然姿态下产生3.5-8.1N的推拉力，实现与可变形物体的拟真交互；指尖配备基于电渗原理的平面致动器，可提供压力与振动刺激，最高产生2.47kPa接触压力以再现触觉感知；热反馈方面则集成热电热泵，可实现10-55℃的温度渲染。通过将装置集成至基于X-Arm 6与Inspire Hand机械臂的遥操作系统进行验证，用户实验表明参与者能成功识别并操控可变形物体，区分不同温度的远端物体。实验结果证明该多模态反馈外骨骼能有效增强情境感知，并提升机器人遥操作系统的可用性与操作透明度。

title: OMNI-PoseX: A Fast Vision Model for 6D Object Pose Estimation in Embodied Tasks
summary: Accurate 6D object pose estimation is a fundamental capability for embodied agents, yet remains highly challenging in open-world environments. Many existing methods often rely on closed-set assumptions or geometry-agnostic regression schemes, limiting their generalization, stability, and real-time applicability in robotic systems. We present OMNI-PoseX, a vision foundation model that introduces a novel network architecture unifying open-vocabulary perception with an SO(3)-aware reflected flow matching pose predictor. The architecture decouples object-level understanding from geometry-consistent rotation inference, and employs a lightweight multi-modal fusion strategy that conditions rotation-sensitive geometric features on compact semantic embeddings, enabling efficient and stable 6D pose estimation. To enhance robustness and generalization, the model is trained on large-scale 6D pose datasets, leveraging broad object diversity, viewpoint variation, and scene complexity to build a scalable open-world pose backbone. Comprehensive evaluations across benchmark pose estimation, ablation studies, zero-shot generalization, and system-level robotic grasping integration demonstrate the effectiveness of OMNI-PoseX. The OMNI-PoseX achieves SOTA pose accuracy and real-time efficiency, while delivering geometrically consistent predictions that enable reliable grasping of diverse, previously unseen objects.
tldr: OMNI-PoseX is a fast vision foundation model for 6D object pose estimation, designed to improve generalization and stability for open-world robotic grasping and other embodied tasks.
tldr_zh: OMNI-PoseX是一个用于6D物体位姿估计的快速视觉基础模型，旨在提高开放世界机器人抓取等具身任务中的泛化性和稳定性。
summary_zh: 精确的6D物体位姿估计是具身智能体的基础能力，但在开放世界环境中仍极具挑战。现有方法大多依赖闭集假设或几何无关的回归方案，限制了其在机器人系统中的泛化性、稳定性与实时应用性。本文提出OMNI-PoseX视觉基础模型，其创新网络架构将开放词汇感知与SO(3)敏感的反射流匹配位姿预测器相融合。该架构将物体级理解与几何一致的旋转推断解耦，并采用轻量化多模态融合策略——在紧凑语义嵌入基础上构建旋转敏感的几何特征，从而实现高效稳定的6D位姿估计。为增强鲁棒性与泛化能力，模型通过大规模6D位姿数据集进行训练，利用广泛的物体多样性、视角变化和场景复杂性构建可扩展的开放世界位姿主干网络。在基准位姿估计、消融实验、零样本泛化及系统级机器人抓取集成等方面的综合评估验证了OMNI-PoseX的有效性。该模型在实现实时推理的同时达到了当前最优的位姿精度，其几何一致性预测能力可支持对各类未知物体的可靠抓取。

title: VBGS-SLAM: Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown promising results for 3D scene modeling using mixtures of Gaussians, yet its existing simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) variants typically rely on direct, deterministic pose optimization against the splat map, making them sensitive to initialization and susceptible to catastrophic forgetting as map evolves. We propose Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting SLAM (VBGS-SLAM), a novel framework that couples the splat map refinement and camera pose tracking in a generative probabilistic form. By leveraging conjugate properties of multivariate Gaussians and variational inference, our method admits efficient closed-form updates and explicitly maintains posterior uncertainty over both poses and scene parameters. This uncertainty-aware method mitigates drift and enhances robustness in challenging conditions, while preserving the efficiency and rendering quality of existing 3DGS. Our experiments demonstrate superior tracking performance and robustness in long sequence prediction, alongside efficient, high-quality novel view synthesis across diverse synthetic and real-world scenes.
tldr: This paper introduces VBGS-SLAM, a novel probabilistic SLAM framework that uses variational Bayesian inference to jointly optimize 3D Gaussian Splatting maps and camera poses, improving robustness and mitigating drift.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的变分贝叶斯高斯喷溅SLAM框架，通过变分推理联合优化地图和相机位姿，提升了鲁棒性并减轻了漂移问题。
summary_zh: 三维高斯溅射（3DGS）在使用高斯混合模型进行三维场景建模方面已展现出良好的效果，然而其现有的同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）变体通常依赖于直接对溅射图进行确定性位姿优化，这使得它们对初始化敏感且易受地图更新过程中灾难性遗忘的影响。我们提出变分贝叶斯高斯溅射SLAM（VBGS-SLAM），这是一种新颖的框架，以生成式概率形式耦合了溅射图优化与相机位姿跟踪。通过利用多元高斯分布的共轭性质和变分推断，我们的方法实现了高效的闭式更新，并显式地维护了位姿与场景参数的后验不确定性。这种不确定性感知机制减轻了漂移现象，增强了在复杂环境下的鲁棒性，同时保持了现有3DGS的高效性与渲染质量。实验表明，该方法在长序列预测中具有优越的跟踪性能与鲁棒性，并能在多种合成与真实场景中实现高效、高质量的新视图合成。

title: TrackerSplat: Exploiting Point Tracking for Fast and Robust Dynamic 3D Gaussians Reconstruction
summary: Recent advancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated its potential for efficient and photorealistic 3D reconstructions, which is crucial for diverse applications such as robotics and immersive media. However, current Gaussian-based methods for dynamic scene reconstruction struggle with large inter-frame displacements, leading to artifacts and temporal inconsistencies under fast object motions. To address this, we introduce \textit{TrackerSplat}, a novel method that integrates advanced point tracking methods to enhance the robustness and scalability of 3DGS for dynamic scene reconstruction. TrackerSplat utilizes off-the-shelf point tracking models to extract pixel trajectories and triangulate per-view pixel trajectories onto 3D Gaussians to guide the relocation, rotation, and scaling of Gaussians before training. This strategy effectively handles large displacements between frames, dramatically reducing the fading and recoloring artifacts prevalent in prior methods. By accurately positioning Gaussians prior to gradient-based optimization, TrackerSplat overcomes the quality degradation associated with large frame gaps when processing multiple adjacent frames in parallel across multiple devices, thereby boosting reconstruction throughput while preserving rendering quality. Experiments on real-world datasets confirm the robustness of TrackerSplat in challenging scenarios with significant displacements, achieving superior throughput under parallel settings and maintaining visual quality compared to baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/yindaheng98/TrackerSplat.
tldr: TrackerSplat improves dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting for fast-moving scenes by using point tracking to pre-position Gaussians, reducing artifacts and boosting parallel training throughput.
tldr_zh: TrackerSplat通过集成点跟踪模型来引导3D高斯分布的重定位，提升了动态场景重建对大幅位移的鲁棒性，减少了伪影并提高了并行处理的训练吞吐量。
summary_zh: 三维高斯溅射（3DGS）技术的最新进展证明了其在实现高效、逼真三维重建方面的潜力，这对于机器人、沉浸式媒体等多样化应用至关重要。然而，当前基于高斯方法的动态场景重建技术在处理大帧间位移时存在困难，导致在快速物体运动下出现伪影和时间不一致性问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 \textit{TrackerSplat}，这是一种新颖的方法，通过集成先进的点跟踪技术来增强3DGS在动态场景重建中的鲁棒性和可扩展性。TrackerSplat利用现成的点跟踪模型提取像素轨迹，并将各视角的像素轨迹三角化到三维高斯模型上，以指导训练前高斯模型的重定位、旋转和缩放。该策略有效处理了帧间的大位移，显著减少了先前方法中常见的颜色褪色和重着色伪影。通过在基于梯度的优化前准确放置高斯模型，TrackerSplat克服了在多设备并行处理多帧相邻图像时因大帧间隔导致的质量下降问题，从而在保持渲染质量的同时提高了重建吞吐量。在真实世界数据集上的实验证实，TrackerSplat在具有显著位移的挑战性场景中表现出鲁棒性，在并行设置下实现了优于基准方法的吞吐量，并保持了视觉质量。代码可在 https://github.com/yindaheng98/TrackerSplat 获取。

title: Coupled Control, Structured Memory, and Verifiable Action in Agentic AI (SCRAT -- Stochastic Control with Retrieval and Auditable Trajectories): A Comparative Perspective from Squirrel Locomotion and Scatter-Hoarding
summary: Agentic AI is increasingly judged not by fluent output alone but by whether it can act, remember, and verify under partial observability, delay, and strategic observation. Existing research often studies these demands separately: robotics emphasizes control, retrieval systems emphasize memory, and alignment or assurance work emphasizes checking and oversight. This article argues that squirrel ecology offers a sharp comparative case because arboreal locomotion, scatter-hoarding, and audience-sensitive caching couple all three demands in one organism. We synthesize evidence from fox, eastern gray, and, in one field comparison, red squirrels, and impose an explicit inference ladder: empirical observation, minimal computational inference, and AI design conjecture. We introduce a minimal hierarchical partially observed control model with latent dynamics, structured episodic memory, observer-belief state, option-level actions, and delayed verifier signals. This motivates three hypotheses: (H1) fast local feedback plus predictive compensation improves robustness under hidden dynamics shifts; (H2) memory organized for future control improves delayed retrieval under cue conflict and load; and (H3) verifiers and observer models inside the action-memory loop reduce silent failure and information leakage while remaining vulnerable to misspecification. A downstream conjecture is that role-differentiated proposer/executor/checker/adversary systems may reduce correlated error under asymmetric information and verification burden. The contribution is a comparative perspective and benchmark agenda: a disciplined program of falsifiable claims about the coupling of control, memory, and verifiable action.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel agentic AI framework, SCRAT, inspired by squirrel ecology, which integrates hierarchical control, structured episodic memory, and verification mechanisms for robust action under partial observability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种名为SCRAT的新型智能体AI框架，受松鼠生态启发，整合了分层控制、结构化情景记忆和验证机制，以在部分可观测性下实现稳健的行动。
summary_zh: 主动性人工智能的评价标准日益不再仅凭流畅的输出，而是其能否在部分可观测性、延迟及策略性观察条件下实施行动、记忆与验证。现有研究往往分别探讨这些需求：机器人学强调控制，检索系统注重记忆，而对齐或保障工作则聚焦核查与监督。本文认为，松鼠生态学提供了一个鲜明的比较案例，因为树栖移动、分散贮食及对观众敏感的贮藏行为将这三类需求耦合于同一生物体内。我们综合了灰狐、东部灰松鼠及一项田野对照中的红松鼠证据，并构建了一个明确的推理阶梯：经验观察、最小化计算推断与人工智能设计猜想。我们提出一个具有隐式动态、结构化情景记忆、观察者信念状态、选项级行动及延迟验证信号的最小化分层部分可观测控制模型。由此推导出三个假设：（H1）快速局部反馈与预测性补偿能提升隐式动态变化下的鲁棒性；（H2）为未来控制组织的记忆可改善线索冲突与负荷下的延迟检索；（H3）行动-记忆循环内的验证器与观察者模型能减少静默故障与信息泄漏，但仍易受错误设定影响。一个衍生猜想是：在信息不对称与验证负担下，角色分化的提议者/执行者/检查者/对抗者系统可降低关联性错误。本文的贡献在于提供了一个比较视角与基准框架：一套关于控制、记忆与可验证行动耦合关系的可证伪主张的规范研究计划。

title: Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Advantage Sign Robustness
summary: Reward models (RMs) used in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) are vulnerable to reward hacking: as the policy maximizes a learned proxy reward, true quality plateaus or degrades. We make the assumption that reward hacking is often caused by flipped advantage signs: instead of reducing the likelihood of a bad response, a flipped sign causes the update to increase it. By considering an adversarial perturbation in the RM parameter space, we can derive a certified sign-preservation radius, which is the smallest perturbation that can flip the advantage sign during policy optimization. Based on this formulation, we propose Sign-Certified Policy Optimization (SignCert-PO), down-weighting non-robust completions in the policy gradient update. Unlike prior approaches that require multiple RMs or access to the RM training data, SignCert-PO is lightweight and operates purely at the policy optimization stage using only the RM parameters and on-policy completions. On TL;DR summarization and AlpacaFarm benchmarks, SignCert-PO consistently achieves a better win rate than baselines and reduces reward hacking.
tldr: This paper proposes a method to mitigate reward hacking in RLHF by certifying sign-preservation of the reward model's advantage function, down-weighting non-robust policy updates during optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种缓解RLHF中奖励黑客攻击的方法，通过认证奖励模型优势函数的符号不变性，在策略优化阶段对非鲁棒更新进行降权处理。
summary_zh: 摘要：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）中所使用的奖励模型（RMs）易受奖励攻击的影响：当策略不断优化学习到的代理奖励时，真实性能往往停滞不前甚至下降。我们假设奖励攻击通常源于优势符号的翻转：原本应降低不良响应概率的更新，由于符号翻转反而增大了其概率。通过考虑奖励模型参数空间中的对抗性扰动，我们可推导出经认证的符号保持半径，即策略优化过程中能翻转优势符号的最小扰动。基于此框架，我们提出符号认证策略优化（SignCert-PO），在策略梯度更新中降低非稳健补全结果的权重。不同于先前需要多个奖励模型或访问奖励模型训练数据的方法，SignCert-PO作为一种轻量级方案，仅需利用奖励模型参数和在线策略生成的补全数据，即可在策略优化阶段独立运行。在TL;DR摘要生成和AlpacaFarm基准测试中，SignCert-PO持续取得优于基线方法的胜率，并有效减少了奖励攻击现象。

title: Analysis of Optimality of Large Language Models on Planning Problems
summary: Classic AI planning problems have been revisited in the Large Language Model (LLM) era, with a focus of recent benchmarks on success rates rather than plan efficiency. We examine the degree to which frontier models reason optimally versus relying on simple, heuristic, and possibly inefficient strategies. We focus on the Blocksworld domain involving towers of labeled blocks which have to be moved from an initial to a goal configuration via a set of primitive actions. We also study a formally equivalent task, the generalized Path-Star ($P^*$) graph, in order to isolate true topological reasoning from semantic priors. We systematically manipulate problem depth (the height of block towers), width (the number of towers), and compositionality (the number of goal blocks). Reasoning-enhanced LLMs significantly outperform traditional satisficing planners (e.g., LAMA) in complex, multi-goal configurations. Although classical search algorithms hit a wall as the search space expands, LLMs track theoretical optimality limits with near-perfect precision, even when domain-specific semantic hints are stripped away. To explain these surprising findings, we consider (and find evidence to support) two hypotheses: an active Algorithmic Simulation executed via reasoning tokens and a Geometric Memory that allows models to represent the $P^*$ topology as a navigable global geometry, effectively bypassing exponential combinatorial complexity.
tldr: The paper evaluates LLMs' ability to reason optimally on classic AI planning problems (Blocksworld and P* graphs), finding they outperform traditional planners and track theoretical optimality limits, even without semantic hints.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估大语言模型在经典AI规划问题（如积木世界和P*图）上的最优推理能力，发现它们优于传统规划器并能追踪理论最优极限，即使在没有语义提示的情况下。
summary_zh: 经典人工智能规划问题在大语言模型时代被重新审视，近期研究重点已从规划效率转向成功率评估。本文探究前沿模型在多大程度上进行最优推理，而非依赖简单启发式且可能低效的策略。我们聚焦于积木世界领域——该领域涉及通过基本操作将标注积木塔从初始状态移动到目标状态。同时，我们研究形式等价任务——广义路径星形图，以剥离语义先验的影响，探究真实拓扑推理能力。我们系统性地操控问题深度、宽度和组合性三个维度：分别对应积木塔高度、塔楼数量及目标积木数量。研究显示，在复杂多目标配置中，增强推理能力的大语言模型显著优于传统满意型规划器（如LAMA）。当搜索空间扩展时，传统搜索算法会遭遇瓶颈，而大语言模型却能以近乎完美的精度逼近理论最优极限，即便剥离领域特定语义提示后仍保持该特性。为解释这些意外发现，我们提出（并找到证据支持）两种假设：通过推理标记执行的活动算法模拟，以及允许模型将路径星形图拓扑表示为可导航全局几何结构的几何记忆机制，该机制能有效规避指数级组合复杂度。

title: Poison Once, Exploit Forever: Environment-Injected Memory Poisoning Attacks on Web Agents
summary: Memory makes LLM-based web agents personalized, powerful, yet exploitable. By storing past interactions to personalize future tasks, agents inadvertently create a persistent attack surface that spans websites and sessions. While existing security research on memory assumes attackers can directly inject into memory storage or exploit shared memory across users, we present a more realistic threat model: contamination through environmental observation alone. We introduce Environment-injected Trajectory-based Agent Memory Poisoning (eTAMP), the first attack to achieve cross-session, cross-site compromise without requiring direct memory access. A single contaminated observation (e.g., viewing a manipulated product page) silently poisons an agent's memory and activates during future tasks on different websites, bypassing permission-based defenses. Our experiments on (Visual)WebArena reveal two key findings. First, eTAMP achieves substantial attack success rates: up to 32.5% on GPT-5-mini, 23.4% on GPT-5.2, and 19.5% on GPT-OSS-120B. Second, we discover Frustration Exploitation: agents under environmental stress become dramatically more susceptible, with ASR increasing up to 8 times when agents struggle with dropped clicks or garbled text. Notably, more capable models are not more secure. GPT-5.2 shows substantial vulnerability despite superior task performance. With the rise of AI browsers like OpenClaw, ChatGPT Atlas, and Perplexity Comet, our findings underscore the urgent need for defenses against environment-injected memory poisoning.
tldr: This paper introduces an environment-injected memory poisoning attack (eTAMP) on LLM-based web agents, demonstrating cross-session and cross-site compromise without direct memory access, highlighting a significant security vulnerability in autonomous web browsing agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对基于LLM的网页智能体的环境注入记忆污染攻击（eTAMP），该攻击无需直接内存访问即可实现跨会话、跨网站的渗透，揭示了自主网页浏览智能体中存在严重的安全漏洞。
