summary_zh: 记忆使基于大型语言模型的网页智能体具备个性化能力且强大，却也易受攻击。通过存储历史交互以实现未来任务的个性化定制，智能体无意中创建了一个跨越网站和会话的持续性攻击面。现有关于记忆安全的研究通常假设攻击者能直接向记忆存储注入信息或利用跨用户共享记忆，而本文提出了一种更现实的威胁模型：仅通过环境观察即可实现污染。我们提出了环境注入式轨迹驱动的智能体记忆污染攻击（eTAMP），这是首个无需直接内存访问即可实现跨会话、跨网站危害的攻击方式。单次受污染的环境观察（例如查看被篡改的产品页面）即可静默污染智能体记忆，并在未来不同网站的任务中激活，从而绕过基于权限的防御机制。我们在（视觉）网页交互测试平台WebArena上的实验揭示了两个关键发现。首先，eTAMP实现了显著攻击成功率：在GPT-5-mini模型上最高达32.5%，在GPT-5.2模型上达23.4%，在GPT-OSS-120B模型上达19.5%。其次，我们发现了“挫折利用”现象：处于环境压力下的智能体（如遭遇点击失效或乱码文本时）攻击敏感度急剧上升，攻击成功率最高可提升至8倍。值得注意的是，性能更强的模型并未表现出更高的安全性：GPT-5.2虽然在任务执行上表现优异，却仍存在显著安全漏洞。随着OpenClaw、ChatGPT Atlas及Perplexity Comet等AI浏览器的兴起，我们的研究结果凸显了构建防御环境注入式记忆污染攻击机制的紧迫性。

title: AIVV: Neuro-Symbolic LLM Agent-Integrated Verification and Validation for Trustworthy Autonomous Systems
summary: Deep learning models excel at detecting anomaly patterns in normal data. However, they do not provide a direct solution for anomaly classification and scalability across diverse control systems, frequently failing to distinguish genuine faults from nuisance faults caused by noise or the control system's large transient response. Consequently, because algorithmic fault validation remains unscalable, full Verification and Validation (V\&V) operations are still managed by Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) analysis, resulting in an unsustainable manual workload. To automate this essential oversight, we propose Agent-Integrated Verification and Validation (AIVV), a hybrid framework that deploys Large Language Models (LLMs) as a deliberative outer loop. Because rigorous system verification strictly depends on accurate validation, AIVV escalates mathematically flagged anomalies to a role-specialized LLM council. The council agents perform collaborative validation by semantically validating nuisance and true failures based on natural-language (NL) requirements to secure a high-fidelity system-verification baseline. Building on this foundation, the council then performs system verification by assessing post-fault responses against NL operational tolerances, ultimately generating actionable V\&V artifacts, such as gain-tuning proposals. Experiments on a time-series simulator for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) demonstrate that AIVV successfully digitizes the HITL V\&V process, overcoming the limitations of rule-based fault classification and offering a scalable blueprint for LLM-mediated oversight in time-series data domains.
tldr: The paper proposes AIVV, a hybrid framework that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) as a deliberative council to automate Verification and Validation (V&V) for autonomous systems, specifically demonstrated on a time-series simulator for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AIVV，一个混合框架，利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为审议式外循环，以自动化无人水下航行器（UUV）时间序列模拟器中的自主系统验证与确认（V&V）。
summary_zh: 深度学习模型在检测正常数据中的异常模式方面表现优异。然而，它们无法为异常分类及跨不同控制系统的可扩展性提供直接解决方案，常常难以区分真实故障与由噪声或控制系统大瞬态响应引起的伪故障。因此，由于算法故障验证仍难以扩展，完整的验证与确认（V\&V）工作仍需依赖人工介入（HITL）分析，导致手动工作量不可持续。为实现这一关键监督环节的自动化，我们提出了智能体集成验证与确认（AIVV）——一种部署大语言模型作为审慎外循环的混合框架。由于严格的系统验证高度依赖准确的确认过程，AIVV将数学标记的异常升级至角色专业化的大语言模型委员会。该委员会代理通过基于自然语言需求对伪故障与真实故障进行语义验证，实现协同确认，从而建立高保真度的系统验证基线。在此基础上，委员会进一步通过对比故障后响应与自然语言操作容限来执行系统验证，最终生成可操作的V\&V成果（如增益调优建议）。在无人水下航行器（UUV）时间序列模拟器上的实验表明，AIVV成功实现了HITL V\&V流程的数字化，克服了基于规则的故障分类的局限性，为时间序列数据领域中大语言模型介导的监督提供了可扩展的蓝图。

title: SparseSplat: Towards Applicable Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Pixel-Unaligned Prediction
summary: Recent progress in feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has notably improved rendering quality. However, the spatially uniform and highly redundant 3DGS map generated by previous feed-forward 3DGS methods limits their integration into downstream reconstruction tasks. We propose SparseSplat, the first feed-forward 3DGS model that adaptively adjusts Gaussian density according to scene structure and information richness of local regions, yielding highly compact 3DGS maps. To achieve this, we propose entropy-based probabilistic sampling, generating large, sparse Gaussians in textureless areas and assigning small, dense Gaussians to regions with rich information. Additionally, we designed a specialized point cloud network that efficiently encodes local context and decodes it into 3DGS attributes, addressing the receptive field mismatch between the general 3DGS optimization pipeline and feed-forward models. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that SparseSplat can achieve state-of-the-art rendering quality with only 22% of the Gaussians and maintain reasonable rendering quality with only 1.5% of the Gaussians. Project page: https://victkk.github.io/SparseSplat-page/.
tldr: A novel feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting method that produces sparse, compact 3D maps by adaptively adjusting Gaussian density based on scene information, significantly reducing the number of Gaussians needed.
tldr_zh: 一种新颖的前馈式3D高斯泼溅方法，通过根据场景信息自适应调整高斯密度，生成稀疏紧凑的3D地图，显著减少了所需的高斯数量。
summary_zh: 前馈式三维高斯溅射（3DGS）的最新进展显著提升了渲染质量。然而，先前的前馈3DGS方法生成的空间均匀且高度冗余的3DGS地图，限制了其在下游重建任务中的应用。我们提出了SparseSplat，这是首个能够根据场景结构及局部区域信息丰富度自适应调整高斯密度的前馈3DGS模型，从而生成高度紧凑的3DGS地图。为实现这一目标，我们提出了基于熵的概率采样方法：在纹理稀疏区域生成大而稀疏的高斯分布，而在信息丰富区域则分配小而密集的高斯分布。此外，我们设计了一种专门的点云网络，能够高效编码局部上下文信息并将其解码为3DGS属性，解决了通用3DGS优化流程与前馈模型之间的感受野失配问题。大量实验结果表明，SparseSplat仅需22%的高斯元素即可实现最先进的渲染质量，而仅使用1.5%的高斯元素仍能保持合理的渲染效果。项目页面：https://victkk.github.io/SparseSplat-page/。

title: Deformation-based In-Context Learning for Point Cloud Understanding
summary: Recent advances in point cloud In-Context Learning (ICL) have demonstrated strong multitask capabilities. Existing approaches typically adopt a Masked Point Modeling (MPM)-based paradigm for point cloud ICL. However, MPM-based methods directly predict the target point cloud from masked tokens without leveraging geometric priors, requiring the model to infer spatial structure and geometric details solely from token-level correlations via transformers. Additionally, these methods suffer from a training-inference objective mismatch, as the model learns to predict the target point cloud using target-side information that is unavailable at inference time. To address these challenges, we propose DeformPIC, a deformation-based framework for point cloud ICL. Unlike existing approaches that rely on masked reconstruction, DeformPIC learns to deform the query point cloud under task-specific guidance from prompts, enabling explicit geometric reasoning and consistent objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeformPIC consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods, achieving reductions of 1.6, 1.8, and 4.7 points in average Chamfer Distance on reconstruction, denoising, and registration tasks, respectively. Furthermore, we introduce a new out-of-domain benchmark to evaluate generalization across unseen data distributions, where DeformPIC achieves state-of-the-art performance.
tldr: Proposes DeformPIC, a deformation-based framework for point cloud in-context learning, which outperforms masked modeling methods on tasks like reconstruction, denoising, and registration by learning to deform the query point cloud.
tldr_zh: 提出了DeformPIC，一种基于变形的点云上下文学习框架，通过学习在特定任务指导下变形查询点云，在重建、去噪和配准等任务上超越了掩码建模方法。
summary_zh: 点云情境学习（ICL）的最新进展已展现出强大的多任务处理能力。现有方法通常采用基于掩码点建模（MPM）的范式实现点云ICL。然而，基于MPM的方法直接从掩码标记中预测目标点云，而未能利用几何先验知识，迫使模型仅通过变换器的标记级相关性来推断空间结构和几何细节。此外，这些方法存在训练与推理目标不匹配的问题，因为模型在训练时使用了推理阶段无法获取的目标侧信息来预测目标点云。为解决这些问题，本文提出DeformPIC——一种基于变形的点云ICL框架。与依赖掩码重建的现有方法不同，DeformPIC通过学习在提示信息的任务特定指导下对查询点云进行形变，实现了显式的几何推理和一致的目标函数。大量实验表明，DeformPIC在各项任务中均优于先前最先进的方法，在重建、去噪和配准任务上的平均倒角距离分别降低了1.6、1.8和4.7个点。此外，本文还引入了一个新的跨域基准测试来评估模型在未见数据分布上的泛化能力，DeformPIC在该测试中同样取得了领先性能。

title: ExploreVLA: Dense World Modeling and Exploration for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving models based on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures have shown promising results by learning driving policies through behavior cloning on expert demonstrations. However, imitation learning inherently limits the model to replicating observed behaviors without exploring diverse driving strategies, leaving it brittle in novel or out-of-distribution scenarios. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural remedy by enabling policy exploration beyond the expert distribution. Yet VLA models, typically trained on offline datasets, lack directly observable state transitions, necessitating a learned world model to anticipate action consequences. In this work, we propose a unified understanding-and-generation framework that leverages world modeling to simultaneously enable meaningful exploration and provide dense supervision. Specifically, we augment trajectory prediction with future RGB and depth image generation as dense world modeling objectives, requiring the model to learn fine-grained visual and geometric representations that substantially enrich the planning backbone. Beyond serving as a supervisory signal, the world model further acts as a source of intrinsic reward for policy exploration: its image prediction uncertainty naturally measures a trajectory's novelty relative to the training distribution, where high uncertainty indicates out-of-distribution scenarios that, if safe, represent valuable learning opportunities. We incorporate this exploration signal into a safety-gated reward and optimize the policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experiments on the NAVSIM and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving a state-of-the-art PDMS score of 93.7 and an EPDMS of 88.8 on NAVSIM. The code and demo will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/ExploreVLA/.
tldr: This paper proposes a world modeling and exploration framework for end-to-end autonomous driving using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, leveraging future image generation for dense supervision and novelty-driven policy exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的世界建模和探索框架，利用未来图像生成进行密集监督和基于新奇度的策略探索。
summary_zh: 基于视觉-语言-动作架构的端到端自动驾驶模型通过专家示范数据的行为克隆学习驾驶策略，已展现出良好效果。然而，模仿学习本质上限制了模型仅能复制已观测到的行为，无法探索多样化的驾驶策略，导致其在未见过或分布外场景中表现脆弱。强化学习通过支持超越专家数据分布的策略探索，提供了自然的解决方案。但通常在离线数据集上训练的视觉-语言-动作模型缺乏可直接观测的状态转移信息，需要借助学习得到的世界模型来预测动作后果。本研究提出一种统一的理解与生成框架，利用世界建模同时实现有意义的探索并提供密集监督。具体而言，我们在轨迹预测中融入未来RGB图像与深度图像生成作为密集世界建模目标，使模型必须学习细粒度的视觉与几何表征，从而显著增强规划主干网络的能力。除作为监督信号外，该世界模型进一步作为策略探索的内在奖励来源：其图像预测不确定性可自然度量轨迹相对于训练分布的新颖程度——高不确定性标志着分布外场景，若该场景处于安全状态，则代表宝贵的学习机会。我们将此探索信号整合至安全门控奖励机制中，并通过组相对策略优化算法进行策略优化。在NAVSIM和nuScenes基准测试上的实验验证了本方法的有效性，在NAVSIM上取得了93.7的PDMS分数和88.8的EPDMS分数，达到当前最优性能。代码与演示将在https://zihaosheng.github.io/ExploreVLA/公开提供。

title: Contrastive Language-Colored Pointmap Pretraining for Unified 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Pretraining 3D encoders by aligning with Contrastive Language Image Pretraining (CLIP) has emerged as a promising direction to learn generalizable representations for 3D scene understanding. In this paper, we propose UniScene3D, a transformer-based encoder that learns unified scene representations from multi-view colored pointmaps, jointly modeling image appearance and geometry. For robust colored pointmap representation learning, we introduce novel cross-view geometric alignment and grounded view alignment to enforce cross-view geometry and semantic consistency. Extensive low-shot and task-specific fine-tuning evaluations on viewpoint grounding, scene retrieval, scene type classification, and 3D VQA demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance. These results highlight the effectiveness of our approach for unified 3D scene understanding. https://yebulabula.github.io/UniScene3D/
tldr: Proposes UniScene3D, a transformer-based encoder for unified 3D scene understanding by learning from multi-view colored pointmaps, aligning with CLIP. It is evaluated on tasks like viewpoint grounding and 3D VQA.
tldr_zh: 提出 UniScene3D，一种基于变压器的编码器，通过从多视图彩色点图中学习并与 CLIP 对齐，实现统一的 3D 场景理解，并在视角定位和 3D VQA 等任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh:
摘要：
通过将三维编码器与对比性语言-图像预训练模型（CLIP）进行对齐，已成为三维场景理解中学习泛化表征的有效方法。本文提出了UniScene3D，一种基于Transformer的编码器，它能够从多视角彩色点云图学习统一的场景表征，并联合建模图像外观和几何结构。为实现鲁棒的彩色点云表征学习，我们引入了新颖的跨视角几何对齐与基于视觉接地的视角对齐方法，以增强跨视角的几何一致性和语义一致性。在视觉定位、场景检索、场景类型分类以及三维视觉问答等任务中，我们通过大量少样本学习与任务特定微调评估验证了模型的最优性能。这些结果凸显了我们方法在统一三维场景理解方面的有效性。

title: Minimal Information Control Invariance via Vector Quantization
summary: Safety-critical autonomous systems must satisfy hard state constraints under tight computational and sensing budgets, yet learning-based controllers are often far more complex than safe operation requires. To formalize this gap, we study how many distinct control signals are needed to render a compact set forward invariant under sampled-data control, connecting the question to the information-theoretic notion of invariance entropy. We propose a vector-quantized autoencoder that jointly learns a state-space partition and a finite control codebook, and develop an iterative forward certification algorithm that uses Lipschitz-based reachable-set enclosures and sum-of-squares programming. On a 12-dimensional nonlinear quadrotor model, the learned controller achieves a $157\times$ reduction in codebook size over a uniform grid baseline while preserving invariance, and we empirically characterize the minimum sensing resolution compatible with safe operation.
tldr: This paper proposes a method using vector quantization and reachability analysis to learn a minimal finite control codebook for guaranteeing set invariance in safety-critical autonomous systems, demonstrating results on a 12D quadrotor model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，利用矢量量化和可达性分析，为安全关键自主系统学习一个最小的有限控制码本以确保集合不变性，并在12维四旋翼模型上验证了结果。
summary_zh: 摘要：在严格的计算与感知预算约束下，安全攸关的自主动系统必须满足硬性状态约束，然而基于学习的控制器往往比安全运行所需的复杂度高得多。为量化这一差距，我们研究了在采样数据控制下，需要多少种不同的控制信号才能使紧集保持前向不变性，并将该问题与信息论中的不变性熵概念联系起来。我们提出了一种向量量化自编码器，能联合学习状态空间划分和有限控制码本，并开发了一种基于迭代前向验证的算法，该算法利用李普希茨可达集包络和平方和规划进行验证。在12维非线性四旋翼模型上，学习得到的控制器在保持不变性的前提下，实现了相较于均匀网格基线$157\times$的码本规模缩减，并通过实验实证了与安全运行兼容的最小感知分辨率。

title: Orientation Matters: Learning Radiation Patterns of Multi-Rotor UAVs In-Flight to Enhance Communication Availability Modeling
summary: The paper presents an approach for learning antenna Radiation Patterns (RPs) of a pair of heterogeneous quadrotor Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) by calibration flight data. RPs are modeled either as a Spherical Harmonics series or as a weighted average over inducing samples. Linear regression of polynomial coefficients simultaneously decouples the two independent UAVs' RPs. A joint calibration trajectory exploits available flight time in an obstacle-free anechoic altitude. Evaluation on a real-world dataset demonstrates the feasibility of learning both radiation patterns, achieving 3.6 dB RMS error, the measurement noise level. The proposed RP learning and decoupling can be exploited in rapid recalibration upon payload changes, thereby enabling precise autonomous path planning and swarm control in real-world applications where setup changes are expected.
tldr: This paper learns antenna radiation patterns for heterogeneous UAVs using in-flight calibration data to improve communication models for autonomous path planning and swarm control.
tldr_zh: 本文利用飞行校准数据学习异构无人机天线辐射模式，以改进用于自主路径规划和集群控制的通信模型。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通过校准飞行数据学习一对异构四旋翼无人机构成天线辐射模式的方法。该方法将辐射模式建模为球谐函数级数或诱导样本的加权平均值。通过多项式系数的线性回归，同时解耦两个独立无人机的辐射模式。联合校准轨迹在无障碍吸波测试高度内充分利用了可用飞行时间。在真实数据集上的评估验证了学习双辐射模式的可行性，实现了3.6分贝的均方根误差（达到测量噪声水平）。所提出的辐射模式学习与解耦方法可用于有效载荷变更后的快速重新校准，从而在可能发生配置变化的实际应用场景中，实现精确的自主路径规划和集群控制。

title: Geometrically-Constrained Radar-Inertial Odometry via Continuous Point-Pose Uncertainty Modeling
summary: Radar odometry is crucial for robust localization in challenging environments; however, the sparsity of reliable returns and distinctive noise characteristics impede its performance. This paper introduces geometrically-constrained radar-inertial odometry and mapping that jointly consolidates point and pose uncertainty. We employ the continuous trajectory model to estimate the pose uncertainty at any arbitrary timestamp by propagating uncertainties of the control points. These pose uncertainties are continuously integrated with heteroscedastic measurement uncertainty during point projection, thereby enabling dynamic evaluation of observation confidence and adaptive down-weighting of uninformative radar points. By leveraging quantified uncertainties in radar mapping, we construct a high-fidelity map that improves odometry accuracy under imprecise radar measurements. Moreover, we reveal the effectiveness of explicit geometrical constraints in radar-inertial odometry when incorporated with the proposed uncertainty-aware mapping framework. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method, yielding substantial performance improvements in both accuracy and efficiency compared to existing baselines.
tldr: This paper introduces a radar-inertial odometry and mapping method that jointly models point and pose uncertainty using a continuous trajectory model, improving localization accuracy in challenging environments through adaptive weighting of radar measurements and geometric constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种雷达-惯性里程计与建图方法，通过连续轨迹模型联合建模点与位姿的不确定性，利用自适应加权雷达测量和几何约束，在复杂环境中提高了定位精度。
summary_zh: 雷达里程计在复杂环境下实现稳健定位至关重要，但可靠回波的稀疏性及独特的噪声特性制约了其性能。本文提出一种几何约束的雷达-惯性里程计与建图方法，通过联合优化点云与位姿不确定性实现系统增强。我们采用连续轨迹模型，通过控制点的不确定性传播来估计任意时间戳的位姿不确定度。在点云投影过程中，这些位姿不确定度与异方差测量不确定度持续融合，从而实现对观测置信度的动态评估与非信息性雷达点的自适应降权处理。通过量化雷达建图过程中的不确定性，我们构建了高保真度地图，在雷达测量存在误差的情况下显著提升了里程计精度。此外，我们揭示了显式几何约束在雷达-惯性里程计中的有效性，特别是与所提出的不确定性感知建图框架结合时具有显著优势。基于多样化真实场景数据集的大量实验表明，本方法相较于现有基准模型在精度与效率上均取得显著提升，展现出优越性能。

title: ALIVE-LIO: Degeneracy-Aware Learning of Inertial Velocity for Enhancing ESKF-Based LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
summary: Odometry estimation using light detection and ranging (LiDAR) and an inertial measurement unit (IMU), known as LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO), often suffers from performance degradation in degenerate environments, such as long corridors or single-wall scenarios with narrow field-of-view LiDAR. To address this limitation, we propose ALIVE-LIO, a degeneracy-aware LiDAR-inertial odometry framework that explicitly enhances state estimation in degenerate directions. The key contribution of ALIVE-LIO is the strategic integration of a deep neural network into a classical error-state Kalman filter (ESKF) to compensate for the loss of LiDAR observability. Specifically, ALIVE-LIO employs a neural network to predict the body-frame velocity and selectively fuses this prediction into the ESKF only when degeneracy is detected, providing effective state updates along degenerate directions. This design enables ALIVE-LIO to utilize the probabilistic structure and consistency of the ESKF while benefiting from learning-based motion estimation. The proposed method was evaluated on publicly available datasets exhibiting degeneracy, as well as on our own collected data. Experimental results demonstrate that ALIVE-LIO substantially reduces pose drift in degenerate environments, yielding the most competitive results in 22 out of 32 sequences. The implementation of ALIVE-LIO will be publicly available.
tldr: This paper introduces ALIVE-LIO, a method that integrates a neural network into a LiDAR-inertial odometry framework to predict body-frame velocity and selectively updates the state estimator in geometrically degenerate environments, improving robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ALIVE-LIO方法，通过将神经网络集成到LiDAR-惯性里程计框架中，在几何退化环境下预测机体速度并选择性地更新状态估计器，从而提高了鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 利用激光雷达（LiDAR）与惯性测量单元（IMU）进行里程计估计（即LiDAR-惯性里程计，简称LIO）在退化环境中常出现性能下降问题，例如长走廊场景或采用窄视场LiDAR的单面墙场景。为解决这一局限性，本文提出了ALIVE-LIO——一种退化感知的LiDAR-惯性里程计框架，通过显式增强退化方向上的状态估计来提升性能。该框架的核心贡献在于将深度神经网络策略性地融入经典误差状态卡尔曼滤波器（ESKF）中，以补偿LiDAR可观测性的损失。具体而言，ALIVE-LIO采用神经网络预测载体坐标系下的速度，并在检测到退化时选择性地将该预测结果融合至ESKF中，从而为退化方向提供有效的状态更新。这一设计使得ALIVE-LIO既能利用ESKF的概率结构框架与一致性，又能受益于基于学习的运动估计能力。我们在公开的退化数据集及自主采集数据上对所提方法进行了评估。实验结果表明，ALIVE-LIO在退化环境中显著降低了位姿漂移，在32组数据序列中的22组取得了最具竞争力的结果。ALIVE-LIO的实现代码将公开提供。

title: Reflective Context Learning: Studying the Optimization Primitives of Context Space
summary: Generally capable agents must learn from experience in ways that generalize across tasks and environments. The fundamental problems of learning, including credit assignment, overfitting, forgetting, local optima, and high-variance learning signals, persist whether the learned object lies in parameter space or context space. While these challenges are well understood in classical machine learning optimization, they remain underexplored in context space, leading current methods to be fragmented and ad hoc. We present Reflective Context Learning (RCL), a unified framework for agents that learn through repeated interaction, reflection on behavior and failure modes, and iterative updates to context. In RCL, reflection converts trajectories and current context into a directional update signal analogous to gradients, while mutation applies that signal to improve future behavior in context space. We recast recent context-optimization approaches as instances of this shared learning problem and systematically extend them with classical optimization primitives, including batching, improved credit-assignment signal, auxiliary losses, failure replay, and grouped rollouts for variance reduction. On AppWorld, BrowseComp+, and RewardBench2, these primitives improve over strong baselines, with their relative importance shifting across task regimes. We further analyze robustness to initialization, the effects of batch size, sampling and curriculum strategy, optimizer-state variants, and the impact of allocating stronger or weaker models to different optimization components. Our results suggest that learning through context updates should be treated not as a set of isolated algorithms, but as an optimization problem whose mechanisms can be studied systematically and improved through transferable principles.
tldr: This paper presents Reflective Context Learning (RCL), a unified framework for agents that learn by iteratively updating their context based on reflection on past behavior, treating context optimization as a systematic learning problem analogous to parameter optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了反思式上下文学习（RCL）框架，将上下文优化视为一个系统性的学习问题，通过反思行为轨迹和迭代更新上下文来提升智能体的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 通用智能体必须通过能够跨任务和环境泛化的经验进行学习。无论是针对参数空间还是上下文空间的学习对象，信用分配、过拟合、遗忘、局部最优以及高方差学习信号等基本学习问题始终存在。尽管这些挑战在经典机器学习优化领域已得到深入理解，但在上下文空间中的研究仍显不足，导致当前方法呈现碎片化与临时性。我们提出反射式上下文学习（RCL）框架，为通过重复交互、行为与失败模式反思、上下文迭代更新进行学习的智能体提供统一范式。在RCL中，反思机制将轨迹与当前上下文转化为类似于梯度的方向性更新信号，而变异机制则利用该信号在上下文空间内改进未来行为。我们将近期上下文优化方法重新诠释为这一共性学习问题的实例，并系统性地引入经典优化原语加以扩展，包括批处理、改进的信用分配信号、辅助损失函数、失败案例重放以及用于降低方差的组并行采样。在AppWorld、BrowseComp+和RewardBench2实验中，这些优化原语显著超越了强基线方法，其相对重要性随任务类型变化而动态调整。我们进一步分析了算法对初始化的鲁棒性、批量大小的影响、采样与课程策略的效应、优化器状态变体，以及为不同优化组件分配不同能力模型产生的效果。研究结果表明，通过上下文更新的学习不应被视为孤立算法集合，而应作为可系统研究其机制、并通过可迁移原则持续优化的计算问题。

title: Co-Evolution of Policy and Internal Reward for Language Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents learn by interacting with environments, but long-horizon training remains fundamentally bottlenecked by sparse and delayed rewards. Existing methods typically address this challenge through post-hoc credit assignment or external reward models, which provide limited guidance at inference time and often separate reward improvement from policy improvement. We propose Self-Guide, a self-generated internal reward for language agents that supports both inference-time guidance and training-time supervision. Specifically, the agent uses Self-Guide as a short self-guidance signal to steer the next action during inference, and converts the same signal into step-level internal reward for denser policy optimization during training. This creates a co-evolving loop: better policy produces better guidance, and better guidance further improves policy as internal reward. Across three agent benchmarks, inference-time self-guidance already yields clear gains, while jointly evolving policy and internal reward with GRPO brings further improvements (8\%) over baselines trained solely with environment reward. Overall, our results suggest that language agents can improve not only by collecting more experience, but also by learning to generate and refine their own internal reward during acting and learning.
tldr: Proposes Self-Guide, a method for LLM agents to generate and use internal reward signals for both inference-time guidance and training-time policy optimization, co-evolving policy and internal reward to tackle sparse reward problems in long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出Self-Guide方法，使LLM智能体能够生成内部奖励信号，用于推理时的行动引导和训练时的策略优化，通过共同进化策略和内部奖励来解决长时程任务中的稀疏奖励问题。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过与环境的交互进行学习，但由于稀疏且延迟的奖励机制，其长期训练效率始终面临根本性瓶颈。现有方法通常通过后验信用分配或外部奖励模型应对这一挑战，然而这些方法在推理阶段提供的指导有限，且往往将奖励优化与策略改进割裂开来。本文提出Self-Guide方法，这是一种为语言智能体生成的自驱内部奖励机制，可同时支持推理阶段的引导与训练阶段的监督。具体而言，智能体在推理过程中将Self-Guide作为即时的自引导信号来调整下一行动，并将同一信号转化为训练过程中更密集的步骤级内部奖励以实现策略优化。这形成了协同演进的闭环：更优策略产生更佳引导，而更优引导作为内部奖励进一步推动策略改进。在三个智能体基准测试中，推理阶段的自引导机制已展现出显著增益，而通过GRPO联合演化策略与内部奖励的方法，相较于仅依赖环境奖励训练的基线模型，进一步实现了8%的性能提升。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，语言智能体不仅能通过积累更多经验实现进步，还能在行动与学习过程中通过生成和优化自驱内部奖励机制获得提升。

title: Supply-Chain Poisoning Attacks Against LLM Coding Agent Skill Ecosystems
summary: LLM-based coding agents extend their capabilities via third-party agent skills distributed through open marketplaces without mandatory security review. Unlike traditional packages, these skills are executed as operational directives with system-level privileges, so a single malicious skill can compromise the host. Prior work has not examined whether supply-chain attacks can directly hijack an agent's action space, such as file writes, shell commands, and network requests, despite existing safeguards. We introduce Document-Driven Implicit Payload Execution (DDIPE), which embeds malicious logic in code examples and configuration templates within skill documentation. Because agents reuse these examples during normal tasks, the payload executes without explicit prompts. Using an LLM-driven pipeline, we generate 1,070 adversarial skills from 81 seeds across 15 MITRE ATTACK categories. Across four frameworks and five models, DDIPE achieves 11.6% to 33.5% bypass rates, while explicit instruction attacks achieve 0% under strong defenses. Static analysis detects most cases, but 2.5% evade both detection and alignment. Responsible disclosure led to four confirmed vulnerabilities and two fixes.
tldr: The paper introduces a supply-chain attack (DDIPE) against LLM-based coding agents by embedding malicious code in skill documentation, allowing execution without explicit prompts, bypassing defenses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对基于LLM的编码智能体的供应链攻击（DDIPE），通过将恶意代码嵌入技能文档中，使其无需明确指令即可执行，从而绕过防御措施。
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的代码代理通过开放市场中的第三方智能体技能拓展其能力，这些技能无需经过强制性安全审查。与传统软件包不同，这些技能以系统级权限作为操作指令执行，因此单个恶意技能即可危害主机。尽管存在现有防护机制，先前研究尚未探讨供应链攻击是否能够直接劫持代理的操作空间，例如文件写入、shell命令和网络请求等。我们提出文档驱动式隐式载荷执行攻击方法，通过将恶意逻辑嵌入技能文档中的代码示例与配置模板实现攻击。由于代理在常规任务中会复用这些示例，恶意载荷可在无显式指令触发的情况下执行。利用大语言模型驱动的自动化流程，我们从81个种子技能出发，针对15个MITRE ATTACK攻击类别生成了1,070个对抗性技能。在四个主流框架与五个模型上的测试表明，该方法实现了11.6%至33.5%的防御绕过率，而显式指令攻击在强防御机制下成功率仅为0%。静态分析虽能检测大部分攻击案例，但仍有2.5%的样本能够同时规避检测机制与对齐约束。通过负责任披露，我们已确认四个相关漏洞并推动完成两项修复措施。

title: AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents extend language models from text generation to persistent action over tools, files, and execution environments. Unlike chat systems, they maintain state across interactions and translate intermediate outputs into concrete actions. This creates a distinct safety challenge in that harmful behavior may emerge through sequences of individually plausible steps, including intermediate actions that appear locally acceptable but collectively lead to unauthorized actions. We present \textbf{AgentHazard}, a benchmark for evaluating harmful behavior in computer-use agents. AgentHazard contains \textbf{2,653} instances spanning diverse risk categories and attack strategies. Each instance pairs a harmful objective with a sequence of operational steps that are locally legitimate but jointly induce unsafe behavior. The benchmark evaluates whether agents can recognize and interrupt harm arising from accumulated context, repeated tool use, intermediate actions, and dependencies across steps. We evaluate AgentHazard on Claude Code, OpenClaw, and IFlow using mostly open or openly deployable models from the Qwen3, Kimi, GLM, and DeepSeek families. Our experimental results indicate that current systems remain highly vulnerable. In particular, when powered by Qwen3-Coder, Claude Code exhibits an attack success rate of \textbf{73.63\%}, suggesting that model alignment alone does not reliably guarantee the safety of autonomous agents.
tldr: This paper introduces AgentHazard, a benchmark for evaluating harmful behavior in computer-use agents that execute persistent actions over tools and files, showing current systems are highly vulnerable to attacks that exploit sequences of locally legitimate steps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AgentHazard，这是一个用于评估计算机使用智能体中危险行为的基准。该基准显示，当前系统极易受到利用一系列局部合法步骤的攻击，表明仅模型对齐不足以保证自主智能体的安全。
summary_zh: 计算机使用智能体将语言模型从文本生成扩展至对工具、文件及执行环境的持续操作。与聊天系统不同，它们能在多次交互中保持状态，并将中间输出转化为具体行动。这引发了一项独特的安全挑战：有害行为可能通过一系列各自看似合理的步骤产生，其中包括局部可接受但整体导致未授权操作的中间行为。本文提出\textbf{AgentHazard}——一个评估计算机使用智能体有害行为的基准测试集。AgentHazard包含\textbf{2,653}个实例，涵盖多种风险类别与攻击策略。每个实例均将有害目标与一系列局部合法但共同引发不安全行为的操作步骤相结合。该基准通过累积上下文、重复工具使用、中间行为及跨步骤依赖等维度，评估智能体识别并阻断潜在危害的能力。我们基于Claude Code、OpenClaw和IFlow系统，主要采用来自Qwen3、Kimi、GLM和DeepSeek系列的开源或可公开部署模型对AgentHazard进行测试。实验结果表明，现有系统仍存在显著安全漏洞。特别地，当搭载Qwen3-Coder模型时，Claude Code的攻击成功率高达\textbf{73.63\%}，这说明仅靠模型对齐无法可靠保障自主智能体的安全性。

title: RayMamba: Ray-Aligned Serialization for Long-Range 3D Object Detection
summary: Long-range 3D object detection remains challenging because LiDAR observations become highly sparse and fragmented in the far field, making reliable context modeling difficult for existing detectors. To address this issue, recent state space model (SSM)-based methods have improved long-range modeling efficiency. However, their effectiveness is still limited by generic serialization strategies that fail to preserve meaningful contextual neighborhoods in sparse scenes. To address this issue, we propose RayMamba, a geometry-aware plug-and-play enhancement for voxel-based 3D detectors. RayMamba organizes sparse voxels into sector-wise ordered sequences through a ray-aligned serialization strategy, which preserves directional continuity and occlusion-related context for subsequent Mamba-based modeling. It is compatible with both LiDAR-only and multimodal detectors, while introducing only modest overhead. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate consistent improvements across strong baselines. In particular, RayMamba achieves up to 2.49 mAP and 1.59 NDS gain in the challenging 40--50 m range on nuScenes, and further improves VoxelNeXt on Argoverse 2 from 30.3 to 31.2 mAP.
tldr: Proposes RayMamba, a geometry-aware serialization method for long-range 3D object detection using a ray-aligned strategy and Mamba SSM, showing improvements on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出了RayMamba，一种用于长距离3D物体检测的几何感知序列化方法，通过射线对齐策略和Mamba状态空间模型，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上取得了改进。
summary_zh:
摘要：
远距离三维物体检测面临严峻挑战，原因是激光雷达在远场区域的观测数据高度稀疏且碎片化，这导致现有检测器难以进行可靠的上下文建模。为解决此问题，近期基于状态空间模型（SSM）的方法提升了远距离建模效率。然而，通用的序列化策略在稀疏场景中难以保持有效的上下文邻域关系，限制了其性能提升。针对此问题，我们提出了RayMamba——一种面向体素三维检测器的几何感知即插即用增强模块。该模块通过射线对齐序列化策略，将稀疏体素组织为扇区有序序列，在后续基于Mamba的建模过程中保持了方向连续性与遮挡关联上下文。RayMamba兼容纯激光雷达与多模态检测器，且仅引入少量计算开销。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在多个强基线模型上均能带来稳定提升。特别地，在nuScenes数据集最具挑战性的40-50米距离范围内，RayMamba实现了最高2.49 mAP与1.59 NDS的显著增益；在Argoverse 2数据集上，VoxelNeXt模型的性能从30.3 mAP提升至31.2 mAP。

title: NavCrafter: Exploring 3D Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Creating flexible 3D scenes from a single image is vital when direct 3D data acquisition is costly or impractical. We introduce NavCrafter, a novel framework that explores 3D scenes from a single image by synthesizing novel-view video sequences with camera controllability and temporal-spatial consistency. NavCrafter leverages video diffusion models to capture rich 3D priors and adopts a geometry-aware expansion strategy to progressively extend scene coverage. To enable controllable multi-view synthesis, we introduce a multi-stage camera control mechanism that conditions diffusion models with diverse trajectories via dual-branch camera injection and attention modulation. We further propose a collision-aware camera trajectory planner and an enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipeline with depth-aligned supervision, structural regularization and refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NavCrafter achieves state-of-the-art novel-view synthesis under large viewpoint shifts and substantially improves 3D reconstruction fidelity.
tldr: NavCrafter is a framework for generating controllable, novel-view video sequences from a single image, leveraging video diffusion models and 3D Gaussian Splatting for improved 3D scene synthesis and reconstruction.
tldr_zh: NavCrafter 是一个从单张图像生成可控新视角视频序列的框架，利用视频扩散模型和3D高斯溅射技术，提升3D场景合成和重建的保真度。
summary_zh: 当直接获取三维数据成本高昂或不切实际时，从单张图像创建灵活的三维场景至关重要。本文提出NavCrafter框架，该框架通过合成具有相机可控性与时空一致性的新视角视频序列，实现从单张图像探索三维场景。NavCrafter利用视频扩散模型捕获丰富的三维先验知识，并采用几何感知的扩展策略逐步扩大场景覆盖范围。为实现可控的多视角合成，我们提出多阶段相机控制机制，通过双分支相机注入与注意力调制技术，将多样化轨迹信息融入扩散模型的条件约束中。此外，我们设计了碰撞感知的相机轨迹规划器，以及结合深度对齐监督、结构正则化与精细化处理的增强型三维高斯溅射（3DGS）流程。大量实验表明，NavCrafter在大视角偏移条件下实现了最优的新视角合成效果，并显著提升了三维重建的保真度。

title: Let's Have a Conversation: Designing and Evaluating LLM Agents for Interactive Optimization
summary: Optimization is as much about modeling the right problem as solving it. Identifying the right objectives, constraints, and trade-offs demands extensive interaction between researchers and stakeholders. Large language models can empower decision-makers with optimization capabilities through interactive optimization agents that can propose, interpret and refine solutions. However, it is fundamentally harder to evaluate a conversation-based interaction than traditional one-shot approaches. This paper proposes a scalable and replicable methodology for evaluating optimization agents through conversations. We build LLM-powered decision agents that role-play diverse stakeholders, each governed by an internal utility function but communicating like a real decision-maker. We generate thousands of conversations in a school scheduling case study. Results show that one-shot evaluation is severely limiting: the same optimization agent converges to much higher-quality solutions through conversations. Then, this paper uses this methodology to demonstrate that tailored optimization agents, endowed with domain-specific prompts and structured tools, can lead to significant improvements in solution quality in fewer interactions, as compared to general-purpose chatbots. These findings provide evidence of the benefits of emerging solutions at the AI-optimization interface to expand the reach of optimization technologies in practice. They also uncover the impact of operations research expertise to facilitate interactive deployments through the design of effective and reliable optimization agents.
tldr: The paper proposes a method for evaluating LLM-powered interactive optimization agents that converse with simulated stakeholders to iteratively refine solutions in complex domains like school scheduling, showing conversation improves outcomes over one-shot approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，用于评估基于LLM的交互式优化智能体，其通过模拟利益相关者进行对话，迭代优化学校排课等复杂问题的解决方案，研究表明对话方式显著优于单次求解。
summary_zh: 优化工作的关键不仅在于求解问题，更在于对正确问题进行建模。确立恰当的目标、约束与权衡取舍，需要研究者与利益相关方之间进行大量互动。大型语言模型能够通过交互式优化智能体——这些智能体能够提出、解释并完善解决方案——赋予决策者优化能力。然而，基于对话的交互评估本质上比传统的一步式评估方法更为困难。本文提出了一种可扩展、可复现的方法，用于通过对话评估优化智能体。我们构建了由大语言模型驱动的决策代理，模拟扮演具有多样性的利益相关者，每个代理均受内部效用函数控制，但其沟通方式与真实决策者无异。在学校排课案例研究中，我们生成了数千条对话记录。结果表明，一步式评估具有严重局限性：同一个优化智能体通过对话能够收敛到质量更高的解决方案。随后，本文运用该方法证明，相较于通用聊天机器人，配备领域特定提示和结构化工具的定制化优化智能体能够以更少的交互次数显著提升解决方案质量。这些发现为人工智能与优化交叉领域的新兴解决方案提供了实证，证明其能够拓展优化技术在实践中的应用范围，同时也揭示了运筹学专业知识在通过设计有效可靠的优化智能体以促进交互式部署方面的重要作用。

title: Smart Transfer: Leveraging Vision Foundation Model for Rapid Building Damage Mapping with Post-Earthquake VHR Imagery
summary: Living in a changing climate, human society now faces more frequent and severe natural disasters than ever before. As a consequence, rapid disaster response during the "Golden 72 Hours" of search and rescue becomes a vital humanitarian necessity and community concern. However, traditional disaster damage surveys routinely fail to generalize across distinct urban morphologies and new disaster events. Effective damage mapping typically requires exhaustive and time-consuming manual data annotation. To address this issue, we introduce Smart Transfer, a novel Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) framework, leveraging state-of-the-art vision Foundation Models (FMs) for rapid building damage mapping with post-earthquake Very High Resolution (VHR) imagery. Specifically, we design two novel model transfer strategies: first, Pixel-wise Clustering (PC), ensuring robust prototype-level global feature alignment; second, a Distance-Penalized Triplet (DPT), integrating patch-level spatial autocorrelation patterns by assigning stronger penalties to semantically inconsistent yet spatially adjacent patches. Extensive experiments and ablations from the recent 2023 Turkiye-Syria earthquake show promising performance in multiple cross-region transfer settings, namely Leave One Domain Out (LODO) and Specific Source Domain Combination (SSDC). Moreover, Smart Transfer provides a scalable, automated GeoAI solution to accelerate building damage mapping and support rapid disaster response, offering new opportunities to enhance disaster resilience in climate-vulnerable regions and communities. The data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/ai4city-hkust/SmartTransfer.
tldr: A GeoAI framework using vision foundation models for rapid building damage mapping from post-earthquake VHR imagery, featuring novel transfer strategies for cross-region generalization.
tldr_zh: 利用视觉基础模型，提出一种用于震后超高分辨率影像快速建筑损伤制图的GeoAI框架，包含新颖的模型迁移策略以实现跨区域泛化。
summary_zh: 随着气候变化的影响日益显著，人类社会正面临比以往更频繁、更严重的自然灾害。因此，在搜救“黄金72小时”期间进行快速灾害响应，已成为至关重要的人道主义需求和社区关切议题。然而，传统的灾害损失评估方法往往难以跨越不同的城市形态和新型灾害事件实现普适性推广。有效的灾害损失制图通常需要大量耗时的人工数据标注。为解决这一问题，本研究提出了“智能迁移”（Smart Transfer）——一种新型地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）框架，利用最先进的视觉基础模型（FMs）结合震后超高分辨率（VHR）影像，实现快速建筑物损毁制图。具体而言，我们设计了两种创新模型迁移策略：其一，像素级聚类（PC）方法，确保原型级全局特征对齐的鲁棒性；其二，距离惩罚三元组（DPT）方法，通过向语义不一致但空间相邻的图斑施加更强惩罚，整合图斑级空间自相关模式。基于2023年土耳其-叙利亚地震的大量实验与消融研究表明，该框架在跨区域迁移场景（包括留一域外评估和特定源域组合策略）中均表现出优越性能。此外，“智能迁移”提供了一种可扩展的自动化GeoAI解决方案，能够加速建筑物损毁制图进程、支持快速灾害响应，为增强气候脆弱区域和社区的灾害韧性提供了新机遇。相关数据与代码已公开于https://github.com/ai4city-hkust/SmartTransfer。

title: Jump Start or False Start? A Theoretical and Empirical Evaluation of LLM-initialized Bandits
summary: The recent advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers new opportunities to generate user preference data to warm-start bandits. Recent studies on contextual bandits with LLM initialization (CBLI) have shown that these synthetic priors can significantly lower early regret. However, these findings assume that LLM-generated choices are reasonably aligned with actual user preferences. In this paper, we systematically examine how LLM-generated preferences perform when random and label-flipping noise is injected into the synthetic training data. For aligned domains, we find that warm-starting remains effective up to 30% corruption, loses its advantage around 40%, and degrades performance beyond 50%. When there is systematic misalignment, even without added noise, LLM-generated priors can lead to higher regret than a cold-start bandit. To explain these behaviors, we develop a theoretical analysis that decomposes the effect of random label noise and systematic misalignment on the prior error driving the bandit's regret, and derive a sufficient condition under which LLM-based warm starts are provably better than a cold-start bandit. We validate these results across multiple conjoint datasets and LLMs, showing that estimated alignment reliably tracks when warm-starting improves or degrades recommendation quality.
tldr: This paper provides a theoretical and empirical evaluation of using LLM-generated synthetic data to warm-start contextual bandits, examining the impact of noise and misalignment on performance.
tldr_zh: 本研究对利用LLM生成的合成数据预热上下文赌博机进行了理论和实证评估，分析了噪声和未对齐对性能的影响。
summary_zh: 大语言模型的近期发展为生成用户偏好数据以预热启动多臂老虎机提供了新的机遇。近期关于大语言模型初始化的上下文老虎机研究显示，这种合成先验信息能显著降低早期遗憾度。然而，这些发现基于一个假设：大语言模型生成的选择与实际用户偏好基本一致。本文系统研究了当合成训练数据被注入随机噪声和标签翻转噪声时，大语言模型生成的偏好表现如何。在对齐领域中，我们发现预热启动机制在噪声污染程度达30%时仍保持有效，在40%左右丧失优势，超过50%时则会导致性能下降。当存在系统性偏差时，即使未添加额外噪声，大语言模型生成的先验信息也可能导致比冷启动老虎机更高的遗憾度。为解释这些现象，我们构建了理论分析框架，将随机标签噪声与系统性偏差对驱动老虎机遗憾度的先验误差的影响进行分解，并推导出大语言模型预热启动机制可证明优于冷启动老虎机的充分条件。通过在多个联合分析数据集和大语言模型上的验证，我们证明了估计对齐度能可靠地预测预热启动机制何时提升或降低推荐质量。

title: Explicit Time-Frequency Dynamics for Skeleton-Based Gait Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based gait recognizers excel at modeling spatial configurations but often underuse explicit motion dynamics that are crucial under appearance changes. We introduce a plug-and-play Wavelet Feature Stream that augments any skeleton backbone with time-frequency dynamics of joint velocities. Concretely, per-joint velocity sequences are transformed by the continuous wavelet transform (CWT) into multi-scale scalograms, from which a lightweight multi-scale CNN learns discriminative dynamic cues. The resulting descriptor is fused with the backbone representation for classification, requiring no changes to the backbone architecture or additional supervision. Across CASIA-B, the proposed stream delivers consistent gains on strong skeleton backbones (e.g., GaitMixer, GaitFormer, GaitGraph) and establishes a new skeleton-based state of the art when attached to GaitMixer. The improvements are especially pronounced under covariate shifts such as carrying bags (BG) and wearing coats (CL), highlighting the complementarity of explicit time-frequency modeling and standard spatio-temporal encoders.
tldr: This paper proposes a plug-and-play module using wavelet transforms to capture time-frequency dynamics of joint velocities for skeleton-based gait recognition, improving performance on datasets with appearance changes like carrying bags or wearing coats.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种即插即用模块，利用小波变换捕捉关节速度的时频动态，以提升基于骨架的步态识别性能，在携带包裹或穿着外套等外观变化下效果显著。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于骨架的步态识别方法在建模空间构型方面表现出色，但往往未能充分利用显式的运动动态信息，而这些动态信息在外观变化时至关重要。本文提出一种即插即用的**小波特征流**，通过关节速度的时频动态特征增强任意骨架骨干网络。具体而言，我们将每个关节的速度序列通过连续小波变换（CWT）转换为多尺度尺度图，并利用轻量级多尺度卷积网络从中学习判别性动态特征。所生成的描述符与骨干网络表示融合用于分类，无需修改骨干网络结构或增加额外监督。在CASIA-B数据集上的实验表明，该特征流在多种强骨架骨干网络（如GaitMixer、GaitFormer、GaitGraph）上均带来稳定性能提升，当与GaitMixer结合时更达到了基于骨架方法的最高水平。尤其在携带背包（BG）和穿着外套（CL）等协变量变化场景下，改进效果尤为显著，这凸显了显式时频建模与标准时空编码器的互补性。

title: Collaborative Multi-Mode Pruning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly within the unified Transformer architecture, yet their deployment on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to high computational complexity. While pruning has emerged as an effective technique for compressing VLMs, existing approaches predominantly focus on a single mode by pruning either parameters or tokens, neglecting fully exploring the inherent redundancy in each mode, which leads to substantial performance degradation at high pruning ratios. To address the above limitations, we propose Collaborative Multi-Mode Pruning (CoMP), a novel framework tailored for VLMs by performing joint parameter and token pruning. Specifically, we first design a Collaborative Importance Metric (CIM) that investigates the mutual interference between the coupled parameters and tokens. It incorporates distinct significance of tokens into the computation of parameter importance scores, while simultaneously mitigating the affect of pruned parameters on token importance scores. Moreover, we develop a Multi-Mode Pruning Strategy (MPS) that decomposes the overall pruning process into a sequence of pruning stages, while in each stage we estimate the priory of different pruning modes based on their pruning cost and adaptively shift to the optimal one. Additionally, MPS integrates the historical cost and random exploration, in order to achieve a stable pruning process and avoid local optimum. Extensive experiments across various vision-language tasks and models demonstrate that our method effectively promotes the performance under high pruning ratios by comparing to the state-of-the-art approaches. The source code is available at https://github.com/Wuzimeng/CoMP.git.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework (CoMP) for joint parameter and token pruning in Vision-Language Models to improve efficiency at high pruning ratios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于视觉语言模型的新型协作多模式剪枝框架（CoMP），通过联合参数与令牌剪枝来提高高剪枝率下的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在统一的Transformer架构中快速发展，但因其较高的计算复杂度，在资源受限设备上的部署仍面临挑战。剪枝作为一种有效的视觉语言模型压缩技术已受到关注，但现有方法主要集中在单一维度上，即剪枝参数或剪枝令牌，未能充分挖掘各自维度内部的冗余性，导致在高剪枝率下性能显著下降。为应对上述局限性，我们提出了协同多模态剪枝框架，该框架专为视觉语言模型设计，通过联合参数与令牌剪枝实现压缩。具体而言，我们首先设计了协同重要性度量方法，用于探究参数与令牌间的相互干扰。该方法将令牌的差异化重要性纳入参数重要性计算，同时减轻已剪枝参数对令牌重要性评估的影响。此外，我们开发了多模态剪枝策略，将整体剪枝过程分解为多个阶段，每个阶段根据剪枝成本评估不同剪枝模式的优先级并自适应切换至最优模式。该策略同时结合历史成本与随机探索机制，以维持剪枝过程稳定性并避免局部最优。在多种视觉语言任务和模型上的大量实验表明，相较于现有先进方法，本方法在高剪枝率下能有效提升模型性能。源代码公开于：https://github.com/Wuzimeng/CoMP.git。

title: UniSpector: Towards Universal Open-set Defect Recognition via Spectral-Contrastive Visual Prompting
summary: Although industrial inspection systems should be capable of recognizing unprecedented defects, most existing approaches operate under a closed-set assumption, which prevents them from detecting novel anomalies. While visual prompting offers a scalable alternative for industrial inspection, existing methods often suffer from prompt embedding collapse due to high intra-class variance and subtle inter-class differences. To resolve this, we propose UniSpector, which shifts the focus from naive prompt-to-region matching to the principled design of a semantically structured and transferable prompt topology. UniSpector employs the Spatial-Spectral Prompt Encoder to extract orientation-invariant, fine-grained representations; these serve as a solid basis for the Contrastive Prompt Encoder to explicitly regularize the prompt space into a semantically organized angular manifold. Additionally, Prompt-guided Query Selection generates adaptive object queries aligned with the prompt. We introduce Inspect Anything, the first benchmark for visual-prompt-based open-set defect localization, where UniSpector significantly outperforms baselines by at least 19.7% and 15.8% in AP50b and AP50m, respectively. These results show that our method enable a scalable, retraining-free inspection paradigm for continuously evolving industrial environments, while offering critical insights into the design of generic visual prompting.
tldr: This paper proposes a visual prompting method for open-set defect recognition in industrial inspection, using spectral-contrastive techniques to improve generalizability to unseen anomalies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于光谱对比视觉提示的通用开放集缺陷识别方法，用于工业检测，以提升对未知异常的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 尽管工业检测系统本应具备识别未知缺陷的能力，但现有方法大多基于封闭集假设运行，导致其无法有效检测新型异常。视觉提示技术虽为工业检测提供了可扩展的替代方案，但现有方法常因类内差异大、类间差异细微而面临提示嵌入坍缩的问题。为解决这一难题，我们提出UniSpector方法，将重心从简单的提示-区域匹配转向具有语义结构且可迁移的提示拓扑原理设计。UniSpector采用空间-光谱提示编码器提取方向无关的细粒度表征，为对比提示编码器提供坚实基础，从而将提示空间显式规整为语义化组织的角度流形。此外，通过提示引导的查询选择机制，系统能生成与提示对齐的自适应目标查询。我们构建了首个基于视觉提示的开集缺陷定位基准测试集"Inspect Anything"，在该基准上UniSpector以AP50b和AP50m指标分别超过基线至少19.7%和15.8%的显著优势。实验结果表明，该方法能为持续演进的工业环境提供可扩展、免重训练的检测范式，同时为通用视觉提示设计提供了关键见解。

title: Generalized Small Object Detection:A Point-Prompted Paradigm and Benchmark
summary: Small object detection (SOD) remains challenging due to extremely limited pixels and ambiguous object boundaries. These characteristics lead to challenging annotation, limited availability of large-scale high-quality datasets, and inherently weak semantic representations for small objects. In this work, we first address the data limitation by introducing TinySet-9M, the first large-scale, multi-domain dataset for small object detection. Beyond filling the gap in large-scale datasets, we establish a benchmark to evaluate the effectiveness of existing label-efficient detection methods for small objects. Our evaluation reveals that weak visual cues further exacerbate the performance degradation of label-efficient methods in small object detection, highlighting a critical challenge in label-efficient SOD. Secondly, to tackle the limitation of insufficient semantic representation, we move beyond training-time feature enhancement and propose a new paradigm termed Point-Prompt Small Object Detection (P2SOD). This paradigm introduces sparse point prompts at inference time as an efficient information bridge for category-level localization, enabling semantic augmentation. Building upon the P2SOD paradigm and the large-scale TinySet-9M dataset, we further develop DEAL (DEtect Any smalL object), a scalable and transferable point-prompted detection framework that learns robust, prompt-conditioned representations from large-scale data. With only a single click at inference time, DEAL achieves a 31.4% relative improvement over fully supervised baselines under strict localization metrics (e.g., AP75) on TinySet-9M, while generalizing effectively to unseen categories and unseen datasets. Our project is available at https://zhuhaoraneis.github.io/TinySet-9M/.
tldr: This paper introduces TinySet-9M, a large-scale dataset for small object detection, and proposes a point-prompted detection paradigm (P2SOD) with a framework called DEAL to improve performance on small, ambiguous objects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个大规模小目标检测数据集TinySet-9M，并设计了一种名为P2SOD的点提示检测范式及DEAL框架，用于提升对小目标物体的检测性能。
summary_zh: 小目标检测因像素极其有限且物体边界模糊而持续面临挑战。这些特性导致标注困难、大规模高质量数据集稀缺，以及小目标固有的语义表征薄弱。本文首先通过引入首个面向小目标检测的大规模多领域数据集TinySet-9M，以应对数据稀缺问题。在填补大规模数据集空白的同时，我们建立了评估现有标签高效检测方法在小目标检测中有效性的基准。评估结果表明，微弱的视觉线索会进一步加剧标签高效方法在小目标检测中的性能衰减，这凸显了标签高效小目标检测领域的关键挑战。其次，为克服语义表征不足的局限，我们突破训练时特征增强的框架，提出了一种称为"点提示小目标检测"的新范式。该范式在推理阶段引入稀疏点提示作为类别级定位的高效信息桥梁，从而实现语义增强。基于P2SOD范式与大规模TinySet-9M数据集，我们进一步开发了DEAL框架——一种可扩展、可迁移的点提示检测框架，能够从大规模数据中学习到稳健的提示条件表征。在推理阶段仅需单次点击，DEAL在TinySet-9M数据集上基于严格定位指标（如AP75）相比全监督基线实现了31.4%的相对性能提升，同时能有效泛化至未见过的类别和数据集。项目地址：https://zhuhaoraneis.github.io/TinySet-9M/。

title: DeCo-DETR: Decoupled Cognition DETR for efficient Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary Object Detection (OVOD) enables models to recognize objects beyond predefined categories, but existing approaches remain limited in practical deployment. On the one hand, multimodal designs often incur substantial computational overhead due to their reliance on text encoders at inference time. On the other hand, tightly coupled training objectives introduce a trade-off between closed-set detection accuracy and open-world generalization. Thus, we propose Decoupled Cognition DETR (DeCo-DETR), a vision-centric framework that addresses these challenges through a unified decoupling paradigm. Instead of depending on online text encoding, DeCo-DETR constructs a hierarchical semantic prototype space from region-level descriptions generated by pre-trained LVLMs and aligned via CLIP, enabling efficient and reusable semantic representation. Building upon this representation, the framework further disentangles semantic reasoning from localization through a decoupled training strategy, which separates alignment and detection into parallel optimization streams. Extensive experiments on standard OVOD benchmarks demonstrate that DeCo-DETR achieves competitive zero-shot detection performance while significantly improving inference efficiency. These results highlight the effectiveness of decoupling semantic cognition from detection, offering a practical direction for scalable OVOD systems.
tldr: DeCo-DETR is a vision-centric framework for efficient Open-Vocabulary Object Detection (OVOD) that decouples semantic representation and localization to improve inference speed and maintain competitive zero-shot detection performance.
tldr_zh: DeCo-DETR 是一个用于高效开放词汇目标检测的视觉中心框架，通过解耦语义表示和定位来提高推理速度，同时保持有竞争力的零样本检测性能。
summary_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVOD）使模型能够识别超出预定义类别的物体，但现有方法在实际部署中仍存在局限。一方面，多模态设计因在推理时依赖文本编码器，常导致显著的计算开销；另一方面，紧密耦合的训练目标在封闭集检测精度与开放世界泛化能力之间形成了权衡。为此，我们提出解耦认知DETR（DeCo-DETR），这是一个以视觉为中心的框架，通过统一的解耦范式应对上述挑战。DeCo-DETR不依赖在线文本编码，而是利用预训练LVLMs生成的区域级描述构建层次化语义原型空间，并借助CLIP进行对齐，从而实现高效且可复用的语义表示。基于这一表示，框架进一步通过解耦训练策略将语义推理与定位分离，将对齐和检测任务拆分为并行优化流。在标准OVOD基准上的大量实验表明，DeCo-DETR在实现竞争力的零样本检测性能的同时，显著提升了推理效率。这些结果彰显了将语义认知与检测解耦的有效性，为可扩展的OVOD系统提供了实用方向。

title: Rascene: High-Fidelity 3D Scene Imaging with mmWave Communication Signals
summary: Robust 3D environmental perception is critical for applications such as autonomous driving and robot navigation. However, optical sensors such as cameras and LiDAR often fail under adverse conditions, including smoke, fog, and non-ideal lighting. Although specialized radar systems can operate in these environments, their reliance on bespoke hardware and licensed spectrum limits scalability and cost-effectiveness. This paper introduces Rascene, an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that leverages ubiquitous mmWave OFDM communication signals for 3D scene imaging. To overcome the sparse and multipath-ambiguous nature of individual radio frames, Rascene performs multi-frame, spatially adaptive fusion with confidence-weighted forward projection, enabling the recovery of geometric consensus across arbitrary poses. Experimental results demonstrate that our method reconstructs 3D scenes with high precision, offering a new pathway toward low-cost, scalable, and robust 3D perception.
tldr: Proposes an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework called Rascene that uses ubiquitous mmWave OFDM communication signals for high-fidelity 3D scene imaging, designed to be robust to adverse conditions like smoke and fog.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种名为Rascene的集成感知与通信（ISAC）框架，利用普遍存在的毫米波OFDM通信信号进行高保真3D场景成像，旨在应对烟雾、雾霾等恶劣条件。
summary_zh: 稳健的三维环境感知对于自动驾驶和机器人导航等应用至关重要。然而，相机和激光雷达等光学传感器在烟雾、雾霾及非理想光照等恶劣条件下常常失效。尽管专用雷达系统能够在这些环境中运行，但其对定制硬件和授权频谱的依赖限制了可扩展性与成本效益。本文提出Rascene——一种集成传感与通信（ISAC）框架，该框架利用普遍存在的毫米波正交频分复用通信信号实现三维场景成像。为克服单个无线电帧的稀疏性与多径模糊性，Rascene通过置信度加权前向投影实现多帧空间自适应融合，从而能够在任意视角下恢复几何一致性。实验结果表明，该方法能以高精度重建三维场景，为低成本、可扩展且鲁棒的三维感知提供了新路径。

title: STDDN: A Physics-Guided Deep Learning Framework for Crowd Simulation
summary: Accurate crowd simulation is crucial for public safety management, emergency evacuation planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, existing methods, which typically model crowds as a collection of independent individual trajectories, are limited in their ability to capture macroscopic physical laws. This microscopic approach often leads to error accumulation and compromises simulation stability. Furthermore, deep learning-driven methods tend to suffer from low inference efficiency and high computational overhead, making them impractical for large-scale, efficient simulations. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatio-Temporal Decoupled Differential Equation Network (STDDN), a novel framework that guides microscopic trajectory prediction with macroscopic physics. We innovatively introduce the continuity equation from fluid dynamics as a strong physical constraint. A Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE) is employed to model the macroscopic density evolution driven by individual movements, thereby physically regularizing the microscopic trajectory prediction model. We design a density-velocity coupled dynamic graph learning module to formulate the derivative of the density field within the Neural ODE, effectively mitigating error accumulation. We also propose a differentiable density mapping module to eliminate discontinuous gradients caused by discretization and introduce a cross-grid detection module to accurately model the impact of individual cross-grid movements on local density changes. The proposed STDDN method has demonstrated significantly superior simulation performance compared to state-of-the-art methods on long-term tasks across four real-world datasets, as well as a major reduction in inference latency.
tldr: A physics-guided deep learning framework for crowd simulation uses fluid dynamics continuity equations to regularize microscopic trajectory predictions via a Neural ODE, improving long-term accuracy and inference efficiency.
tldr_zh: 一个用于人群模拟的物理引导深度学习框架，利用流体力学连续性方程通过神经微分方程来正则化微观轨迹预测，提高了长期精度和推理效率。
summary_zh: 精准的人群模拟对于公共安全管理、应急疏散规划和智能交通系统至关重要。然而，现有方法通常将人群建模为独立个体轨迹的集合，其在捕捉宏观物理规律方面存在局限。这种微观视角常导致误差积累并损害模拟稳定性。此外，深度学习驱动的方法往往存在推理效率低、计算开销大的问题，难以适用于大规模高效模拟场景。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出时空解耦微分方程网络（STDDN），该创新框架通过宏观物理规律指导微观轨迹预测。我们创新性地引入流体动力学中的连续性方程作为强物理约束，采用神经常微分方程对个体运动驱动的宏观密度演化进行建模，从而从物理层面规范微观轨迹预测模型。设计了一个密度-速度耦合动态图学习模块，在神经常微分方程内构建密度场的导数形式，有效缓解误差累积问题。同时提出可微分密度映射模块以消除离散化导致的梯度不连续，并引入跨网格检测模块来精确建模个体跨网格运动对局部密度变化的影响。在四个真实场景数据集上的长期任务测试表明，所提出的STDDN方法在模拟性能上显著优于当前先进技术，同时实现了推理延迟的大幅降低。

title: Complex-Valued GNNs for Distributed Basis-Invariant Control of Planar Systems
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a well-regarded tool for learned control of networked dynamical systems due to their ability to be deployed in a distributed manner. However, current distributed GNN architectures assume that all nodes in the network collect geometric observations in compatible bases, which limits the usefulness of such controllers in GPS-denied and compass-denied environments. This paper presents a GNN parametrization that is globally invariant to choice of local basis. 2D geometric features and transformations between bases are expressed in the complex domain. Inside each GNN layer, complex-valued linear layers with phase-equivariant activation functions are used. When viewed from a fixed global frame, all policies learned by this architecture are strictly invariant to choice of local frames. This architecture is shown to increase the data efficiency, tracking performance, and generalization of learned control when compared to a real-valued baseline on an imitation learning flocking task.
tldr: The paper proposes a complex-valued GNN architecture for distributed control of networked planar systems, which is invariant to local coordinate frame choices, and shows improved data efficiency and performance on an imitation learning flocking task.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种复值图神经网络架构，用于网络化平面系统的分布式控制，该架构对局部坐标系选择具有不变性，并在模仿学习集群任务中显示出更高的数据效率与性能。
summary_zh: 图神经网络因其可分布式部署的特性，已成为学习控制网络化动力系统的有力工具。然而，当前分布式图神经网络架构假设网络中所有节点在兼容的坐标系下收集几何观测数据，这限制了此类控制器在无GPS与无罗盘环境中的实用性。本文提出一种对局部坐标系选择具有全局不变性的图神经网络参数化方法。二维几何特征与坐标系间的变换通过复数域表示。在每个图神经网络层内部，采用具有相位等变激活函数的复数值线性层。从固定全局坐标系视角观察，该架构学习的所有策略均严格保持对局部坐标系选择的不变性。实验表明，在一项模仿学习集群任务中，与实数基线模型相比，该架构显著提升了数据效率、跟踪性能及泛化能力。

title: SCC-Loc: A Unified Semantic Cascade Consensus Framework for UAV Thermal Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-modal Thermal Geo-localization (TG) provides a robust, all-weather solution for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied environments. However, profound thermal-visible modality gaps introduce severe feature ambiguity, systematically corrupting conventional coarse-to-fine registration. To dismantle this bottleneck, we propose SCC-Loc, a unified Semantic-Cascade-Consensus localization framework. By sharing a single DINOv2 backbone across global retrieval and MINIMA$_{\text{RoMa}}$ matching, it minimizes memory footprint and achieves zero-shot, highly accurate absolute position estimation. Specifically, we tackle modality ambiguity by introducing three cohesive components. First, we design the Semantic-Guided Viewport Alignment (SGVA) module to adaptively optimize satellite crop regions, effectively correcting initial spatial deviations. Second, we develop the Cascaded Spatial-Adaptive Texture-Structure Filtering (C-SATSF) mechanism to explicitly enforce geometric consistency, thereby eradicating dense cross-modal outliers. Finally, we propose the Consensus-Driven Reliability-Aware Position Selection (CD-RAPS) strategy to derive the optimal solution through a synergy of physically constrained pose optimization. To address data scarcity, we construct Thermal-UAV, a comprehensive dataset providing 11,890 diverse thermal queries referenced against a large-scale satellite ortho-photo and corresponding spatially aligned Digital Surface Model (DSM). Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCC-Loc establishes a new state-of-the-art, suppressing the mean localization error to 9.37 m and providing a 7.6-fold accuracy improvement within a strict 5-m threshold over the strongest baseline. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/FloralHercules/SCC-Loc.
tldr: Proposes SCC-Loc, a unified semantic cascade consensus framework for cross-modal thermal geo-localization of UAVs, using a single DINOv2 backbone for retrieval and matching to achieve accurate positioning without GNSS.
tldr_zh: 提出SCC-Loc，一个用于无人机跨模态热地理定位的统一语义级联共识框架，使用单个DINOv2骨干网进行检索和匹配，以实现无GNSS的准确定位。
summary_zh: 跨模态热地理定位（TG）为全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）拒止环境下的无人机（UAV）提供了一种鲁棒的全天候解决方案。然而，显著的热-可见光模态差异导致严重的特征模糊性，系统性干扰了传统的由粗到精配准流程。为突破此瓶颈，本文提出SCC-Loc，一个统一的语义-级联-共识定位框架。该框架通过在全局检索与MINIMA$_{\text{RoMa}}$匹配中共享单个DINOv2主干网络，显著降低内存占用，实现零样本高精度绝对位置估计。具体而言，我们通过三个紧密协同的组件应对模态模糊性问题：首先，设计语义引导视口对齐（SGVA）模块，自适应优化卫星图像裁剪区域，有效校正初始空间偏差；其次，提出级联空间自适应纹理-结构滤波（C-SATSF）机制，显式增强几何一致性，从而消除密集跨模态异常匹配；最后，构建共识驱动的可靠性感知位置选择（CD-RAPS）策略，通过物理约束姿态优化的协同推导最优解。针对数据稀缺问题，我们构建了Thermal-UAV综合数据集，包含11,890组多样化热红外查询图像，并配准大规模卫星正射影像及对应空间对齐的数字表面模型（DSM）。大量实验表明，SCC-Loc取得了最新的先进性能，将平均定位误差降至9.37米，在5米严格阈值范围内较最强基线实现7.6倍的精度提升。代码与数据集已开源：https://github.com/FloralHercules/SCC-Loc。

title: Flash-Mono: Feed-Forward Accelerated Gaussian Splatting Monocular SLAM
summary: Monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM suffers from critical limitations in time efficiency, geometric accuracy, and multi-view consistency. These issues stem from the time-consuming $\textit{Train-from-Scratch}$ optimization and the lack of inter-frame scale consistency from single-frame geometry priors. We contend that a feed-forward paradigm, leveraging multi-frame context to predict Gaussian attributes directly, is crucial for addressing these challenges. We present Flash-Mono, a system composed of three core modules: a feed-forward prediction frontend, a 2D Gaussian Splatting mapping backend, and an efficient hidden-state-based loop closure module. We trained a recurrent feed-forward frontend model that progressively aggregates multi-frame visual features into a hidden state via cross attention and jointly predicts camera poses and per-pixel Gaussian properties. By directly predicting Gaussian attributes, our method bypasses the burdensome per-frame optimization required in optimization-based GS-SLAM, achieving a $\textbf{10x}$ speedup while ensuring high-quality rendering. The power of our recurrent architecture extends beyond efficient prediction. The hidden states act as compact submap descriptors, facilitating efficient loop closure and global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ optimization to mitigate the long-standing challenge of drift. For enhanced geometric fidelity, we replace conventional 3D Gaussian ellipsoids with 2D Gaussian surfels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Flash-Mono achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tracking and mapping quality, highlighting its potential for embodied perception and real-time reconstruction applications. Project page: https://victkk.github.io/flash-mono.
tldr: Flash-Mono is a feed-forward monocular SLAM system that predicts 3D Gaussian attributes and camera poses directly, bypassing per-frame optimization for a 10x speedup, and enhances geometric accuracy with 2D Gaussian surfels and a loop closure module.
tldr_zh: Flash-Mono是一个前馈式单目SLAM系统，直接预测3D高斯属性和相机姿态，避免了每帧优化，实现10倍加速，并通过2D高斯面元和回环模块提升几何精度。
summary_zh: 单目三维高斯飞溅SLAM在时间效率、几何精度和多视图一致性方面存在严重局限。这些问题源于耗时的“从零开始训练”优化策略，以及单帧几何先验缺乏帧间尺度一致性。我们认为，利用多帧上下文信息直接预测高斯属性的前馈式范式对解决这些挑战至关重要。本文提出Flash-Mono系统，其包含三个核心模块：前馈预测前端、二维高斯飞溅建图后端，以及基于隐状态的高效回环检测模块。我们训练了一个循环式前馈前端模型，该模型通过交叉注意力逐步将多帧视觉特征聚合到隐状态中，并联合预测相机姿态与逐像素高斯属性。通过直接预测高斯属性，本方法绕过了基于优化的GS-SLAM中每帧所需的繁重优化过程，在保证高质量渲染的同时实现了十倍的速度提升。我们的循环架构优势不仅限于高效预测：隐状态可作为紧凑的子地图描述符，促进高效回环检测与全局Sim(3)优化，从而缓解长期存在的漂移问题。为提升几何保真度，我们使用二维高斯面元替代传统三维高斯椭球体。大量实验表明，Flash-Mono在跟踪与建图质量上均达到最先进性能，彰显了其在具身感知与实时重建应用中的潜力。项目页面：https://victkk.github.io/flash-mono。

title: RAGE: A Tightly Coupled Radar-Aided Grip Estimator For Autonomous Race Cars
summary: Real-time estimation of vehicle-tire-road friction is critical for allowing autonomous race cars to safely and effectively operate at their physical limits. Traditional approaches to measure tire grip often depend on costly, specialized sensors that require custom installation, limiting scalability and deployment. In this work, we introduce RAGE, a novel real-time estimator that simultaneously infers the vehicle velocity, slip angles of the tires and the lateral forces that act on them, using only standard sensors, such as IMUs and RADARs, which are commonly available on most of modern autonomous platforms. We validate our approach through both high-fidelity simulations and real-world experiments conducted on the EAV-24 autonomous race car, demonstrating the accuracy and effectiveness of our method in estimating the vehicle lateral dynamics.
tldr: The paper introduces RAGE, a real-time grip estimator for autonomous race cars using standard sensors to infer vehicle dynamics, validated on a race car platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RAGE，一种用于自动驾驶赛车的实时抓地力估计器，使用标准传感器推断车辆动力学，并在赛车平台上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 车辆-轮胎-道路摩擦力的实时估计对于实现自主赛车在物理极限下安全高效运行至关重要。传统测量轮胎抓地力的方法通常依赖昂贵且需定制安装的专用传感器，限制了其可扩展性和部署范围。本研究提出了一种名为RAGE的新型实时估计器，仅使用惯性测量单元和雷达等现代自主平台普遍配置的标准传感器，即可同步推断车辆速度、轮胎侧偏角及作用于轮胎的侧向力。我们通过高保真仿真实验以及在EAV-24自主赛车上进行的实际测试，验证了该方法的有效性，证明了其在车辆侧向动力学估计方面的准确性与实用性。

title: V2X-QA: A Comprehensive Reasoning Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Autonomous Driving Across Ego, Infrastructure, and Cooperative Views
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for autonomous driving, yet existing benchmarks remain largely ego-centric and therefore cannot systematically assess model performance in infrastructure-centric and cooperative driving conditions. In this work, we introduce V2X-QA, a real-world dataset and benchmark for evaluating MLLMs across vehicle-side, infrastructure-side, and cooperative viewpoints. V2X-QA is built around a view-decoupled evaluation protocol that enables controlled comparison under vehicle-only, infrastructure-only, and cooperative driving conditions within a unified multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) framework. The benchmark is organized into a twelve-task taxonomy spanning perception, prediction, and reasoning and planning, and is constructed through expert-verified MCQA annotation to enable fine-grained diagnosis of viewpoint-dependent capabilities. Benchmark results across ten representative state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models show that viewpoint accessibility substantially affects performance, and infrastructure-side reasoning supports meaningful macroscopic traffic understanding. Results also indicate that cooperative reasoning remains challenging since it requires cross-view alignment and evidence integration rather than simply additional visual input. To address these challenges, we introduce V2X-MoE, a benchmark-aligned baseline with explicit view routing and viewpoint-specific LoRA experts. The strong performance of V2X-MoE further suggests that explicit viewpoint specialization is a promising direction for multi-view reasoning in autonomous driving. Overall, V2X-QA provides a foundation for studying multi-perspective reasoning, reliability, and cooperative physical intelligence in connected autonomous driving. The dataset and V2X-MoE resources are publicly available at: https://github.com/junwei0001/V2X-QA.
tldr: This paper introduces V2X-QA, a multi-view multimodal reasoning dataset and benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in autonomous driving scenarios across ego, infrastructure, and cooperative viewpoints, along with a baseline model V2X-MoE.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了V2X-QA，这是一个用于评估自动驾驶场景中多模态大语言模型在自身、基础设施和协同视角下性能的多视图推理数据集和基准，并提供了一个基线模型V2X-MoE。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在自动驾驶领域展现出巨大潜力，但现有基准测试主要聚焦于车辆自身视角，难以系统评估模型在路侧设施视角及协同驾驶场景下的性能。本研究提出V2X-QA——一个基于真实场景的数据集与基准测试框架，用于评估车辆视角、路侧设施视角及协同视角下的多模态大语言模型性能。该框架采用视角解耦的评估机制，在统一的单选题问答架构下，实现对纯车辆视角、纯路侧设施视角及协同驾驶场景的受控对比。基准测试涵盖感知、预测、推理与规划三大领域的十二项任务分类体系，通过专家验证的单选题标注构建，支持对视角相关能力的细粒度诊断。针对十种具有代表性的前沿闭源与开源模型的测试结果表明：视角可及性显著影响模型性能，且路侧设施视角的推理能有效支持宏观交通态势理解。研究同时发现协同推理仍面临挑战，因其需要跨视角对齐与证据融合，而非简单增加视觉输入。为应对这些挑战，我们提出V2X-MoE基准对齐基线模型，该模型采用显式视角路由机制与针对特定视角的LoRA专家模块。V2X-MoE的优异表现进一步证明，显式的视角专业化处理是自动驾驶多视角推理的可行方向。总体而言，V2X-QA为研究网联自动驾驶中的多视角推理、系统可靠性及协同实体智能提供了基础平台。数据集与V2X-MoE相关资源已开源：https://github.com/junwei0001/V2X-QA。

title: Adaptive Learned State Estimation based on KalmanNet
summary: Hybrid state estimators that combine model-based Kalman filtering with learned components have shown promise on simulated data, yet their performance on real-world automotive data remains insufficient. In this work we present Adaptive Multi-modal KalmanNet (AM-KNet), an advancement of KalmanNet tailored to the multi-sensor autonomous driving setting. AM-KNet introduces sensor-specific measurement modules that enable the network to learn the distinct noise characteristics of radar, lidar, and camera independently. A hypernetwork with context modulation conditions the filter on target type, motion state, and relative pose, allowing adaptation to diverse traffic scenarios. We further incorporate a covariance estimation branch based on the Josephs form and supervise it through negative log-likelihood losses on both the estimation error and the innovation. A comprehensive, component-wise loss function encodes physical priors on sensor reliability, target class, motion state, and measurement flow consistency. AM-KNet is trained and evaluated on the nuScenes and View-of-Delft datasets. The results demonstrate improved estimation accuracy and tracking stability compared to the base KalmanNet, narrowing the performance gap with classical Bayesian filters on real-world automotive data.
tldr: This paper introduces AM-KNet, a hybrid state estimator combining Kalman filtering with learned components, tailored for multi-sensor autonomous driving. It adapts to sensor noise and driving context, showing improved accuracy and tracking on real-world automotive datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AM-KNet，一种结合卡尔曼滤波与学习组件的混合状态估计器，专为多传感器自动驾驶设计。它能适应传感器噪声和驾驶场景，在真实汽车数据集上展示了更高的准确性和跟踪稳定性。
summary_zh: 结合基于模型的卡尔曼滤波与学习组件的混合状态估计器在模拟数据上已展现出潜力，但在真实世界汽车数据上的表现仍显不足。本研究提出自适应多模态卡尔曼网络（AM-KNet），作为卡尔曼网络在多传感器自动驾驶场景下的改进版本。AM-KNet引入了传感器专属的测量模块，使网络能够独立学习雷达、激光雷达和摄像头的不同噪声特性。通过上下文调制机制的超网络使滤波器能够根据目标类型、运动状态和相对位姿进行自适应调整，从而适应多样化的交通场景。我们进一步加入了基于约瑟夫形式的协方差估计分支，并通过对估计误差与新息项的负对数似然损失进行监督训练。一个全面的、模块化的损失函数编码了关于传感器可靠性、目标类别、运动状态和测量流一致性的物理先验知识。AM-KNet在nuScenes和View-of-Delft数据集上进行了训练与评估。结果表明，相较于基础卡尔曼网络，该方法在估计精度与跟踪稳定性上均有提升，缩小了真实世界汽车数据上与传统贝叶斯滤波器的性能差距。

title: Gradient Boosting within a Single Attention Layer
summary: Transformer attention computes a single softmax-weighted average over values -- a one-pass estimate that cannot correct its own errors. We introduce \emph{gradient-boosted attention}, which applies the principle of gradient boosting \emph{within} a single attention layer: a second attention pass, with its own learned projections, attends to the prediction error of the first and applies a gated correction. Under a squared reconstruction objective, the construction maps onto Friedman's gradient boosting machine, with each attention pass as a base learner and the per-dimension gate as the shrinkage parameter. We show that a single Hopfield-style update erases all query information orthogonal to the stored-pattern subspace, and that further iteration under local contraction can collapse distinct queries in the same region to the same fixed point. We also show that separate projections for the correction pass can recover residual information inaccessible to the shared-projection approach of Tukey's twicing. On a 10M-token subset of WikiText-103, gradient-boosted attention achieves a test perplexity of $67.9$ compared to $72.2$ for standard attention, $69.6$ for Twicing Attention, and $69.0$ for a parameter-matched wider baseline, with two rounds capturing most of the benefit.
tldr: The paper introduces gradient-boosted attention, which applies gradient boosting within a single transformer attention layer to correct errors from the first pass, improving language modeling performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出梯度增强注意力机制，在单个Transformer注意力层内应用梯度提升来纠正第一轮的误差，从而提升了语言建模性能。
summary_zh: Transformer注意力机制通过计算一个单一的、基于softmax加权平均的值来执行操作——这是一种单次估计，无法修正其自身误差。我们引入一种名为梯度提升注意力的方法，该方法将梯度提升原理应用于单个注意力层内部：通过第二轮的注意力计算，使用其自身学习到的投影，关注于第一轮注意力的预测误差，并应用门控机制进行修正。在平方重构目标下，该结构映射到Friedman的梯度提升机，其中每一轮注意力计算作为一个基学习器，而每个维度的门控则作为收缩参数。我们证明，单次的Hopfield风格更新会消除所有查询信息中与存储模式子空间正交的部分，并且在局部收缩条件下进一步迭代，可能将同一区域内的不同查询收敛到同一固定点。我们还发现，修正轮次采用独立投影能够恢复共享投影方法（如Tukey's twicing）所无法获取的残差信息。在WikiText-103的1000万令牌子集上，梯度提升注意力在测试集上达到了67.9的困惑度，而标准注意力为72.2，Twicing Attention为69.6，参数匹配的加宽基线模型为69.0，且两轮提升已能获得大部分增益效果。

title: Chart-RL: Policy Optimization Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced Visual Reasoning in Chart Question Answering with Vision Language Models
summary: The recent advancements in Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated progress toward true intelligence requiring robust reasoning capabilities. Beyond pattern recognition, linguistic reasoning must integrate with visual comprehension, particularly for Chart Question Answering (CQA) tasks involving complex data visualizations. Current VLMs face significant limitations in CQA, including imprecise numerical extraction, difficulty interpreting implicit visual relationships, and inadequate attention mechanisms for capturing spatial relationships in charts. In this work, we address these challenges by presenting Chart-RL, a novel reinforcement learning framework that enhances VLMs chart understanding through feedback-driven policy optimization of visual perception and logical inference. Our key innovation includes a comprehensive framework integrating Reinforcement Learning (RL) from Policy Optimization techniques along with adaptive reward functions, that demonstrates superior performance compared to baseline foundation models and competitive results against larger state-of-the-art architectures. We also integrated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in the RL framework that only requires single GPU configurations while preserving performance integrity. We conducted extensive benchmarking across open-source, proprietary, and state-of-the-art closed-source models utilizing the ChartQAPro dataset. The RL fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct model achieved an answer accuracy of 0.634, surpassing the 0.580 accuracy of the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct foundation model despite utilizing half the parameter count, while simultaneously reducing inference latency from 31 seconds to 9 seconds.
tldr: This paper introduces Chart-RL, a reinforcement learning framework for fine-tuning vision-language models to improve their reasoning and accuracy on chart question answering tasks, using policy optimization and LoRA.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Chart-RL，一个用于微调视觉语言模型的强化学习框架，旨在通过策略优化和LoRA技术提升模型在图表问答任务中的推理能力和准确性。
summary_zh: 近期，视觉语言模型的进展为实现需要强大推理能力的真正智能展现了前景。在图表问答任务中，仅依靠模式识别已不足够，语言推理必须与视觉理解深度融合，尤其当面对涉及复杂数据可视化的场景时。现有视觉语言模型在图表问答任务中仍存在显著局限：数值提取不够精确，隐含视觉关系解析困难，以及用于捕捉图表空间关系的注意力机制尚不完善。本研究提出Chart-RL强化学习框架以应对这些挑战，该框架通过基于反馈的视觉感知与逻辑推理策略优化，提升视觉语言模型的图表理解能力。我们的核心创新在于构建了融合策略优化强化学习与自适应奖励函数的完整框架，该框架在基础模型对比中表现优越，与当前更大规模先进架构相比也具备竞争力。同时，我们在强化学习框架中集成了基于低秩自适应的参数高效微调技术，仅需单GPU配置即可保持性能完整性。基于ChartQAPro数据集，我们对开源模型、专有模型及前沿闭源模型进行了全面性能评估。经过强化学习微调的Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct模型实现了0.634的答案准确率，在参数量减半的情况下超越了基础模型Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 0.580的准确率，同时将推理延迟从31秒降低至9秒。

title: Valence-Arousal Subspace in LLMs: Circular Emotion Geometry and Multi-Behavioral Control
summary: We present a method to identify a valence-arousal (VA) subspace within large language model representations. From 211k emotion-labeled texts, we derive emotion steering vectors, then learn VA axes as linear combinations of their top PCA components via ridge regression on the model's self-reported valence-arousal scores. The resulting VA subspace exhibits circular geometry consistent with established models of human emotion perception. Projections along our recovered VA subspace correlate with human-crowdsourced VA ratings across 44k lexical items. Furthermore, steering generation along these axes produces monotonic shifts in the corresponding affective dimensions of model outputs. Steering along these directions also induces near-monotonic bidirectional control over refusal and sycophancy: increasing arousal decreases refusal and increases sycophancy, and vice versa. These effects replicate across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-14B, demonstrating cross-architecture generality. We provide a mechanistic account for these effects and prior emotionally-framed controls: refusal-associated tokens ("I can't," "sorry") occupy low-arousal, negative-valence regions, so VA steering directly modulates their emission probability.
tldr: This paper presents a method to identify a valence-arousal emotional subspace in LLM representations and demonstrates control over behaviors like refusal and sycophancy by steering along these axes. It is a mechanistic study of LLM behavior, not a robotics or embodied AI application.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种在LLM表示中识别效价-唤醒情绪子空间的方法，并展示了通过沿这些轴引导来控制拒绝和谄媚等行为。这是一项关于LLM行为机制的研究，而非机器人或具身AI应用。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种识别大型语言模型表征中效价-唤醒度（VA）子空间的方法。基于21.1万条情感标注文本，我们推导出情感导向向量，进而通过对模型自报告的效价-唤醒度评分进行岭回归，将主成分分析的前沿成分线性组合为VA坐标轴。所得VA子空间呈现出符合人类情感感知经典模型的环形几何结构。在4.4万个词汇单元上，沿我们重构的VA子空间的投影结果与人类众包VA评分具有显著相关性。此外，沿这些坐标轴引导文本生成时，模型输出的相应情感维度会产生单调偏移。沿这些方向的调控还能实现对拒绝性和迎合行为的近单调双向控制：提升唤醒度会降低拒绝性并增强迎合性，反之亦然。这些效应在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B模型上均得到复现，证明了跨架构的普适性。我们为这些效应及先前情感框架控制机制提供了解释：与拒绝行为相关的词汇（如“我不能”、“抱歉”）位于低唤醒度、负效价区域，因此VA调控可直接调节这些词汇的生成概率。

title: InCoder-32B-Thinking: Industrial Code World Model for Thinking
summary: Industrial software development across chip design, GPU optimization, and embedded systems lacks expert reasoning traces showing how engineers reason about hardware constraints and timing semantics. In this work, we propose InCoder-32B-Thinking, trained on the data from the Error-driven Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) synthesis framework with an industrial code world model (ICWM) to generate reasoning traces. Specifically, ECoT generates reasoning chains by synthesizing the thinking content from multi-turn dialogue with environmental error feedback, explicitly modeling the error-correction process. ICWM is trained on domain-specific execution traces from Verilog simulation, GPU profiling, etc., learns the causal dynamics of how code affects hardware behavior, and enables self-verification by predicting execution outcomes before actual compilation. All synthesized reasoning traces are validated through domain toolchains, creating training data matching the natural reasoning depth distribution of industrial tasks. Evaluation on 14 general (81.3% on LiveCodeBench v5) and 9 industrial benchmarks (84.0% in CAD-Coder and 38.0% on KernelBench) shows InCoder-32B-Thinking achieves top-tier open-source results across all domains.GPU Optimization
tldr: A large language model specialized for industrial code generation and reasoning about hardware constraints, using error-driven chain-of-thought synthesis and a domain-specific world model for self-verification.
tldr_zh: 一个专注于工业代码生成和硬件约束推理的大语言模型，通过错误驱动的思维链合成和领域特定世界模型进行自我验证。
summary_zh: 在芯片设计、GPU优化和嵌入式系统等工业软件开发领域，普遍缺乏能够展现工程师如何针对硬件约束与时序语义进行推理的专家级推理轨迹。为此，本研究提出InCoder-32B-Thinking模型，该模型基于工业代码世界模型（ICWM）的误差驱动思维链（ECoT）合成框架所生成的数据进行训练，以构建推理轨迹生成能力。具体而言，ECoT通过合成多轮对话中的思维内容，并结合环境误差反馈来生成推理链条，从而显式地模拟了错误修正过程。ICWM则利用Verilog仿真、GPU性能分析等特定领域的执行轨迹进行训练，学习代码如何影响硬件行为的因果动态，并能够通过在实际编译前预测执行结果来实现自我验证。所有合成的推理轨迹均通过领域工具链进行验证，从而生成与工业任务自然推理深度分布相匹配的训练数据。在14个通用基准测试（LiveCodeBench v5得分81.3%）和9个工业基准测试（CAD-Coder得分84.0%、KernelBench得分38.0%）上的评估结果表明，InCoder-32B-Thinking在所有领域均取得了顶尖的开源模型性能。

title: Can VLMs Truly Forget? Benchmarking Training-Free Visual Concept Unlearning
summary:
VLMs trained on web-scale data retain sensitive and copyrighted visual concepts that deployment may require removing. Training-based unlearning methods share a structural flaw: fine-tuning on a narrow forget set degrades general capabilities before unlearning begins, making it impossible to attribute subsequent performance drops to the unlearning procedure itself.
