Training-free approaches sidestep this by suppressing concepts through prompts or system instructions, but no rigorous benchmark exists for evaluating them on visual tasks.
  We introduce VLM-UnBench, the first benchmark for training-free visual concept unlearning in VLMs. It covers four forgetting levels, 7 source datasets, and 11 concept axes, and pairs a three-level probe taxonomy with five evaluation conditions to separate genuine forgetting from instruction compliance. Across 8 evaluation settings and 13 VLM configurations, realistic unlearning prompts leave forget accuracy near the no-instruction baseline; meaningful reductions appear only under oracle conditions that disclose the target concept to the model. Object and scene concepts are the most resistant to suppression, and stronger instruction-tuned models remain capable despite explicit forget instructions. These results expose a clear gap between prompt-level suppression and true visual concept erasure.
tldr: Proposes a benchmark for evaluating training-free visual concept unlearning in VLMs, finding that prompt-based suppression is largely ineffective and does not achieve true concept erasure.
tldr_zh: 提出一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）中免训练视觉概念遗忘的基准测试，发现基于提示的抑制方法基本无效，无法实现真正的概念消除。
summary_zh:
在大规模网络数据上训练得到的视觉语言模型保留了敏感及受版权保护的视觉概念，部署时可能需将其移除。基于训练的去学习方法存在结构性缺陷：在狭窄遗忘集上的微调会在去学习开始前便削弱模型的通用能力，导致无法将后续性能下降归因于去学习过程本身。免训练方法通过提示或系统指令抑制概念以规避此问题，但目前缺乏针对视觉任务评估此类方法的严谨基准。

我们提出VLM-UnBench——首个面向视觉语言模型的免训练视觉概念去学习基准。该基准涵盖四个遗忘层级、七个源数据集和十一个概念轴，并采用三级探测分类法与五种评估条件相结合的设计，以区分真实遗忘与指令依从性。通过对八种评估场景和十三种视觉语言模型配置的测试，现实场景下的去学习提示仅能使遗忘准确率接近无指令基线水平；仅在向模型明确透露目标概念的神谕条件下才出现显著降低。物体与场景概念对抑制的抵抗性最强，经过强化指令调优的模型即使接收到显式遗忘指令仍能保持原有能力。这些结果揭示了提示级抑制与真实视觉概念擦除之间存在明显差距。

title: JoyAI-LLM Flash: Advancing Mid-Scale LLMs with Token Efficiency
summary: We introduce JoyAI-LLM Flash, an efficient Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model designed to redefine the trade-off between strong performance and token efficiency in the sub-50B parameter regime. JoyAI-LLM Flash is pretrained on a massive corpus of 20 trillion tokens and further optimized through a rigorous post-training pipeline, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) across diverse environments. To improve token efficiency, JoyAI-LLM Flash strategically balances \emph{thinking} and \emph{non-thinking} cognitive modes and introduces FiberPO, a novel RL algorithm inspired by fibration theory that decomposes trust-region maintenance into global and local components, providing unified multi-scale stability control for LLM policy optimization. To enhance architectural sparsity, the model comprises 48B total parameters while activating only 2.7B parameters per forward pass, achieving a substantially higher sparsity ratio than contemporary industry leading models of comparable scale. To further improve inference throughput, we adopt a joint training-inference co-design that incorporates dense Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Quantization-Aware Training (QAT). We release the checkpoints for both JoyAI-LLM-48B-A3B Base and its post-trained variants on Hugging Face to support the open-source community.
tldr: Introduces JoyAI-LLM Flash, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model emphasizing token efficiency, architectural sparsity, and optimized inference throughput, but without direct application to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 介绍JoyAI-LLM Flash，一种强调token效率、架构稀疏性和优化推理吞吐量的MoE语言模型，但未直接应用于机器人或具身AI。
summary_zh: 我们推出JoyAI-LLM Flash，这是一款高效的混合专家（MoE）语言模型，旨在重新定义50B参数以下模型中强性能与计算效率之间的平衡关系。该模型基于20万亿令牌的大规模语料库进行预训练，并通过严谨的后训练流程进一步优化，包括监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）以及跨多样化环境的大规模强化学习（RL）。为提升计算效率，JoyAI-LLM Flash通过策略性地平衡“思考”与“非思考”认知模式，并引入受纤维化理论启发的创新强化学习算法FiberPO——该算法将信任区域维护分解为全局与局部组件，为语言模型策略优化提供统一的多尺度稳定性控制。在架构稀疏性方面，模型共包含480亿参数，而每次前向传播仅激活27亿参数，其稀疏率显著高于当前同规模的主流工业模型。为提升推理吞吐量，我们采用训练-推理协同设计机制，融合了密集多令牌预测（MTP）与量化感知训练（QAT）技术。我们在Hugging Face平台开源了JoyAI-LLM-48B-A3B基础模型及其后训练变体的权重检查点，以支持开源社区的发展。

title: Agentic-MME: What Agentic Capability Really Brings to Multimodal Intelligence?
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are evolving from passive observers into active agents, solving problems through Visual Expansion (invoking visual tools) and Knowledge Expansion (open-web search). However, existing evaluations fall short: they lack flexible tool integration, test visual and search tools separately, and evaluate primarily by final answers. Consequently, they cannot verify if tools were actually invoked, applied correctly, or used efficiently. To address this, we introduce Agentic-MME, a process-verified benchmark for Multimodal Agentic Capabilities. It contains 418 real-world tasks across 6 domains and 3 difficulty levels to evaluate capability synergy, featuring over 2,000 stepwise checkpoints that average 10+ person-hours of manual annotation per task. Each task includes a unified evaluation framework supporting sandboxed code and APIs, alongside a human reference trajectory annotated with stepwise checkpoints along dual-axis: S-axis and V-axis. To enable true process-level verification, we audit fine-grained intermediate states rather than just final answers, and quantify efficiency via an overthinking metric relative to human trajectories. Experimental results show the best model, Gemini3-pro, achieves 56.3% overall accuracy, which falls significantly to 23.0% on Level-3 tasks, underscoring the difficulty of real-world multimodal agentic problem solving.
tldr: This paper introduces Agentic-MME, a process-verified benchmark for evaluating the active problem-solving capabilities (e.g., using visual tools and web search) of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as agents, moving beyond passive observation to measure fine-grained intermediate steps and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Agentic-MME，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型作为智能体主动解决问题能力的基准测试，强调过程验证，超越了传统的最终答案评估，以测量细粒度中间步骤和效率。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正从被动观察者演变为主动智能体，通过视觉扩展（调用视觉工具）与知识扩展（开放网络搜索）解决问题。然而，现有评估体系存在明显不足：缺乏灵活的工具集成机制，将视觉与搜索工具割裂测试，且主要依赖最终答案进行评价。这导致无法验证工具是否实际被调用、是否正确应用或是否高效使用。为此，我们提出了Agentic-MME——一个面向多模态智能体能力的流程验证基准。该基准包含涵盖6个领域、3个难度等级的418项现实任务，用于评估能力协同效果，并设立了超过2000个分步检查点，平均每项任务需耗费10+人工小时进行标注。每项任务均配备支持沙盒代码与API的统一评估框架，以及包含双轴（S轴与V轴）分步检查点的人类参考轨迹标注。为实现真正的流程级验证，我们不仅审核最终答案，更对细粒度中间状态进行审计，并通过相对于人类轨迹的"过度思考"指标量化效率。实验结果显示，最佳模型Gemini3-pro总体准确率为56.3%，在三级难度任务上骤降至23.0%，凸显了现实世界多模态智能体问题求解的挑战性。

title: FedSQ: Optimized Weight Averaging via Fixed Gating
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training across organizations without sharing raw data, but it is hindered by statistical heterogeneity (non-i.i.d.\ client data) and by instability of naive weight averaging under client drift. In many cross-silo deployments, FL is warm-started from a strong pretrained backbone (e.g., ImageNet-1K) and then adapted to local domains. Motivated by recent evidence that ReLU-like gating regimes (structural knowledge) stabilize earlier than the remaining parameter values (quantitative knowledge), we propose FedSQ (Federated Structural-Quantitative learning), a transfer-initialized neural federated procedure based on a DualCopy, piecewise-linear view of deep networks. FedSQ freezes a structural copy of the pretrained model to induce fixed binary gating masks during federated fine-tuning, while only a quantitative copy is optimized locally and aggregated across rounds. Fixing the gating reduces learning to within-regime affine refinements, which stabilizes aggregation under heterogeneous partitions. Experiments on two convolutional neural network backbones under i.i.d.\ and Dirichlet splits show that FedSQ improves robustness and can reduce rounds-to-best validation performance relative to standard baselines while preserving accuracy in the transfer setting.
tldr: FedSQ is a federated learning method that freezes a structural copy of a pretrained model to create fixed gating masks during fine-tuning, improving aggregation stability under non-i.i.d. data.
tldr_zh: FedSQ是一种联邦学习方法，通过冻结预训练模型的结构副本以在微调期间创建固定门控掩码，提高在非i.i.d.数据下聚合的稳定性。
summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）支持跨机构协同训练而无需共享原始数据，但其发展受到统计异质性（客户端数据非独立同分布）以及客户端漂移下简单权重平均不稳定的制约。在许多跨机构部署场景中，联邦学习通常基于强预训练主干网络（如ImageNet-1K）进行热启动，随后针对本地领域进行适配。受近期研究启发——类ReLU门控机制（结构性知识）的稳定早于其余参数值（量化知识），本文提出FedSQ（联邦结构-量化学习）：一种基于深度网络双副本分段线性视角的迁移初始化神经联邦学习方法。FedSQ冻结预训练模型的结构副本以在联邦微调期间维持固定的二值门控掩码，同时仅对量化副本进行本地优化与跨轮次聚合。固定门控机制可将学习过程转化为域内仿射优化，从而增强异质数据分布下聚合过程的稳定性。在独立同分布与狄利克雷分布划分的两种卷积神经网络主干上的实验表明，FedSQ提升了鲁棒性，在迁移场景保持精度的同时，相较于标准基线方法能够减少达到最佳验证性能所需的训练轮次。

title: One Model to Translate Them All? A Journey to Mount Doom for Multilingual Model Merging
summary: Weight-space model merging combines independently fine-tuned models without accessing original training data, offering a practical alternative to joint training. While merging succeeds in multitask settings, its behavior in multilingual contexts remains poorly understood. We systematically study weight-space merging for multilingual machine translation by fully fine-tuning language model on large-scale bilingual corpora and evaluating standard merging strategies. Our experiments reveal that merging degrades performance, especially when target languages differ. To explain this failure, we analyze internal representations using span-conditioned neuron selectivity and layer-wise centered kernel alignment. We find that language-specific neurons concentrate in embedding layers and upper transformer blocks, while intermediate layers remain largely shared across languages. Critically, fine-tuning redistributes rather than sharpens language selectivity: neurons for supervised and related languages become less exclusive, while those for unsupervised languages grow more isolated. This redistribution increases representational divergence in higher layers that govern generation. These findings suggest that multilingual fine-tuning may reshape geometry in ways that reduce compatibility with standard weight-space merging assumptions. Our work thus provides an explanation for why merging fails in multilingual translation scenarios.
tldr: This paper investigates why standard weight-space model merging techniques fail for multilingual machine translation models, analyzing representational divergence caused by language-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了为什么标准权重空间模型合并技术在多语言机器翻译模型中会失败，分析了由语言特定微调引起的表征分歧。
summary_zh: 权重空间模型融合可将独立微调的模型结合而无需原始训练数据，为联合训练提供了实用替代方案。虽然在多任务场景中融合已取得成功，但其在多语言环境中的行为机制仍不明确。本研究通过在大规模双语语料库上对语言模型进行全参数微调，并评估标准融合策略，系统探讨了多语言机器翻译中的权重空间融合问题。实验表明融合会降低模型性能，尤其在目标语言差异较大时更为明显。为解释这一现象，我们运用跨度条件神经元选择性和层级中心核对齐方法分析内部表征。研究发现语言特异性神经元主要集中于嵌入层和上层Transformer模块，而中间层仍保持跨语言共享特征。关键发现显示，微调过程重新分配而非强化了语言选择性：监督语言及相关语言的神经元专属性降低，而未监督语言的神经元则更为孤立。这种重新分配导致控制生成任务的高层表征差异性增大。研究结果表明，多语言微调可能通过重塑几何结构的方式，降低了模型与标准权重空间融合假设的兼容性。本工作由此为多语言翻译场景中融合失败的现象提供了理论解释。

title: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Tool-Calling Agents with Iterative Reward Calibration
summary: Training tool-calling agents with reinforcement learning on multi-turn tasks remains challenging due to sparse outcome rewards and difficult credit assignment across conversation turns. We present the first application of MT-GRPO (Multi-Turn Group Relative Policy Optimization) combined with GTPO (Generalized Token-level Policy Optimization) for training a tool-calling agent on realistic customer service tasks with an LLM-based user simulator. Through systematic analysis of training rollouts, we discover that naively designed dense per-turn rewards degrade performance by up to 14 percentage points due to misalignment between reward discriminativeness and advantage direction. We introduce Iterative Reward Calibration, a methodology for designing per-turn rewards using empirical discriminative analysis of rollout data, and show that our GTPO hybrid advantage formulation eliminates the advantage misalignment problem. Applied to the Tau-Bench airline benchmark, our approach improves Qwen3.5-4B from 63.8 percent to 66.7 percent (+2.9pp) and Qwen3-30B-A3B from 58.0 percent to 69.5 percent (+11.5pp) -- with the trained 4B model exceeding GPT-4.1 (49.4 percent) and GPT-4o (42.8 percent) despite being 50 times smaller, and the 30.5B MoE model approaching Claude Sonnet 4.5 (70.0 percent). To our knowledge, these are the first published RL training results on Tau-Bench. We release our code, reward calibration analysis, and training recipes.
tldr: The paper introduces a new RL method, MT-GRPO combined with GTPO, and an iterative reward calibration technique for training tool-calling agents, achieving state-of-the-art results on a customer service benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的RL方法，结合了MT-GRPO与GTPO以及迭代奖励校准技术，用于训练工具调用智能体，在客户服务基准测试上取得了先进的结果。
summary_zh: 在多轮任务中训练工具调用智能体仍面临挑战，主要原因在于结果奖励稀疏且对话轮次间的贡献度分配困难。本文首次将MT-GRPO（多轮组相对策略优化）与GTPO（广义令牌级策略优化）结合，基于LLM用户模拟器在真实客服任务中训练工具调用智能体。通过对训练过程展开系统分析，我们发现：由于奖励区分度与优势方向错位，简单设计的密集轮次奖励会使性能下降高达14个百分点。我们提出迭代奖励校准方法——通过对训练数据展开经验性区分分析来设计轮次奖励，并证明GTPO混合优势公式可完全消除优势错位问题。在Tau-Bench航空基准测试中，我们的方法将Qwen3.5-4B模型从63.8%提升至66.7%（+2.9pp），将Qwen3-30B-A3B模型从58.0%提升至69.5%（+11.5pp）——训练后的4B模型在参数量仅为1/50的情况下超越GPT-4.1（49.4%）和GPT-4o（42.8%），而30.5B混合专家模型已接近Claude Sonnet 4.5水平（70.0%）。据我们所知，这是Tau-Bench上首次公布的强化学习训练成果。我们已公开相关代码、奖励校准分析及训练方案。

title: EMS: Multi-Agent Voting via Efficient Majority-then-Stopping
summary: Majority voting is the standard for aggregating multi-agent responses into a final decision. However, traditional methods typically require all agents to complete their reasoning before aggregation begins, leading to significant computational overhead, as many responses become redundant once a majority consensus is achieved. In this work, we formulate the multi-agent voting as a reliability-aware agent scheduling problem, and propose an Efficient Majority-then-Stopping (EMS) to improve reasoning efficiency. EMS prioritizes agents based on task-aware reliability and terminates the reasoning pipeline the moment a majority is achieved from the following three critical components. Specifically, we introduce Agent Confidence Modeling (ACM) to estimate agent reliability using historical performance and semantic similarity, Adaptive Incremental Voting (AIV) to sequentially select agents with early stopping, and Individual Confidence Updating (ICU) to dynamically update the reliability of each contributing agent. Extensive evaluations across six benchmarks demonstrate that EMS consistently reduces the average number of invoked agents by 32%.
tldr: This paper proposes EMS, an efficient majority-then-stopping method for multi-agent voting that prioritizes reliable agents and stops early once a majority is reached, reducing computational costs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了EMS，一种高效的多智能体投票方法，通过优先调度可靠智能体并在达成多数共识后提前停止，以减少计算开销。
summary_zh: 多数投票是将多智能体响应整合为最终决策的标准方法。然而，传统方法通常要求所有智能体完成推理后才能开始聚合，这会带来显著的计算开销，因为一旦达成多数共识，许多响应便成为冗余。本研究将多智能体投票问题构建为可靠性感知的智能体调度问题，并提出一种高效多数即停（EMS）方法来提升推理效率。EMS通过任务感知的可靠性对智能体进行优先级排序，并在达成多数共识时立即终止推理流程，其核心包含以下三个关键组成部分：首先，我们引入智能体置信度建模（ACM），利用历史表现和语义相似度来估计智能体可靠性；其次，采用自适应增量投票（AIV）实现智能体的顺序选择与早期终止机制；最后，通过个体置信度更新（ICU）动态调整各贡献智能体的可靠性评估。在六个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，EMS能够持续将平均调用智能体数量降低32%。

title: Towards Secure Agent Skills: Architecture, Threat Taxonomy, and Security Analysis
summary: Agent Skills is an emerging open standard that defines a modular, filesystem-based packaging format enabling LLM-based agents to acquire domain-specific expertise on demand. Despite rapid adoption across multiple agentic platforms and the emergence of large community marketplaces, the security properties of Agent Skills have not been systematically studied. This paper presents the first comprehensive security analysis of the Agent Skills framework. We define the full lifecycle of an Agent Skill across four phases -- Creation, Distribution, Deployment, and Execution -- and identify the structural attack surface each phase introduces. Building on this lifecycle analysis, we construct a threat taxonomy comprising seven categories and seventeen scenarios organized across three attack layers, grounded in both architectural analysis and real-world evidence. We validate the taxonomy through analysis of five confirmed security incidents in the Agent Skills ecosystem. Based on these findings, we discuss defense directions for each threat category, identify open research challenges, and provide actionable recommendations for stakeholders. Our analysis reveals that the most severe threats arise from structural properties of the framework itself, including the absence of a data-instruction boundary, a single-approval persistent trust model, and the lack of mandatory marketplace security review, and cannot be addressed through incremental mitigations alone.
tldr: This paper presents a security analysis of the Agent Skills framework, an open standard for packaging LLM agent capabilities, identifying threats and proposing defenses across its lifecycle phases.
tldr_zh: 本文对Agent Skills框架（一种用于打包LLM智能体能力的开放标准）进行了安全分析，识别了其生命周期各阶段的安全威胁并提出了防御方案。
summary_zh: 智能体技能是一种新兴的开放标准，其定义了基于模块化文件系统的封装格式，使基于大语言模型的智能体能够按需获取领域专业知识。尽管该标准已在多个智能体平台快速普及并催生出大型社区市场，但其安全特性尚未得到系统研究。本文首次对智能体技能框架进行全面的安全分析。我们定义了智能体技能在创建、分发、部署、执行四个阶段的完整生命周期，并识别各阶段引发的结构性攻击面。基于此生命周期分析，我们构建了包含七大类、十七种场景的威胁分类体系，覆盖三个攻击层级，并基于架构分析和现实证据进行验证。通过分析智能体技能生态中五个已确认的安全事件，我们验证了该分类体系的有效性。基于研究结果，我们针对各类威胁提出防护方向，指出开放研究挑战，并为相关利益方提供可操作建议。分析表明，最严重的威胁源于框架本身的结构性特性，包括数据与指令边界缺失、单次审批持久信任模型以及强制性市场安全审查机制的缺位，这些问题无法仅通过渐进式缓解措施得到解决。

title: Improving Role Consistency in Multi-Agent Collaboration via Quantitative Role Clarity
summary: In large language model (LLM)-driven multi-agent systems, disobey role specification (failure to adhere to the defined responsibilities and constraints of an assigned role, potentially leading to an agent behaving like another) is a major failure mode \cite{DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2503-13657}. To address this issue, in the present paper, we propose a quantitative role clarity to improve role consistency. Firstly, we construct a role assignment matrix $S(φ)=[s_{ij}(φ)]$, where $s_{ij}(φ)$ is the semantic similarity between the $i$-th agent's behavior trajectory and the $j$-th agent's role description. Then we define role clarity matrix $M(φ)$ as $\text{softmax}(S(φ))-I$, where $\text{softmax}(S(φ))$ is a row-wise softmax of $S(φ)$ and $I$ is the identity matrix. The Frobenius norm of $M(φ)$ quantifies the alignment between agents' role descriptions and their behaviors trajectory. Moreover, we employ the role clarity matrix as a regularizer during lightweight fine-tuning to improve role consistency, thereby improving end-to-end task performance. Experiments on the ChatDev multi-agent system show that our method substantially improves role consistency and task performance: with Qwen and Llama, the role overstepping rate decreases from $46.4\%$ to $8.4\%$ and from $43.4\%$ to $0.2\%$, respectively, and the role clarity score increases from $0.5328$ to $0.9097$ and from $0.5007$ to $0.8530$, respectively, the task success rate increases from $0.6769$ to $0.6909$ and from $0.6174$ to $0.6763$, respectively.
tldr: This paper proposes a method to improve role consistency in LLM-driven multi-agent systems by introducing a quantitative role clarity metric and using it as a regularization term during fine-tuning, showing improved task performance in the ChatDev system.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过引入定量的角色清晰度指标并将其作为微调时的正则化项，来提高LLM驱动的多智能体系统中的角色一致性，并在ChatDev系统中展示了任务性能的提升。
summary_zh: 在大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统中，违背角色规范（即未遵守所分配角色的职责与约束，可能导致智能体表现出其他角色的行为）是一个主要的失效模式。为应对此问题，本文提出一种定量的角色清晰度度量方法以提升角色一致性。首先，我们构建角色分配矩阵 \( S(\phi) = [s_{ij}(\phi)] \)，其中 \( s_{ij}(\phi) \) 表示第 \( i \) 个智能体的行为轨迹与第 \( j \) 个智能体的角色描述之间的语义相似度。随后，将角色清晰度矩阵 \( M(\phi) \) 定义为 \( \text{softmax}(S(\phi)) - I \)，其中 \( \text{softmax}(S(\phi)) \) 是 \( S(\phi) \) 按行进行softmax运算的结果，\( I \) 为单位矩阵。通过计算 \( M(\phi) \) 的弗罗贝尼乌斯范数，可量化智能体角色描述与其行为轨迹之间的匹配程度。此外，我们将角色清晰度矩阵作为正则化项，在轻量级微调过程中使用，以增强角色一致性，从而提升端到端任务性能。在ChatDev多智能体系统上的实验表明，本方法显著提升了角色一致性与任务完成效果：使用Qwen和Llama模型时，角色越界率分别从 \( 46.4\% \) 降至 \( 8.4\% \) 和从 \( 43.4\% \) 降至 \( 0.2\% \)，角色清晰度得分分别从 \( 0.5328 \) 提升至 \( 0.9097 \) 和从 \( 0.5007 \) 提升至 \( 0.8530 \)，任务成功率分别从 \( 0.6769 \) 提升至 \( 0.6909 \) 和从 \( 0.6174 \) 提升至 \( 0.6763 \)。

title: Efficient3D: A Unified Framework for Adaptive and Debiased Token Reduction in 3D MLLMs
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have expanded reasoning capabilities into 3D domains, enabling fine-grained spatial understanding. However, the substantial size of 3D MLLMs and the high dimensionality of input features introduce considerable inference overhead, which limits practical deployment on resource constrained platforms. To overcome this limitation, this paper presents Efficient3D, a unified framework for visual token pruning that accelerates 3D MLLMs while maintaining competitive accuracy. The proposed framework introduces a Debiased Visual Token Importance Estimator (DVTIE) module, which considers the influence of shallow initial layers during attention aggregation, thereby producing more reliable importance predictions for visual tokens. In addition, an Adaptive Token Rebalancing (ATR) strategy is developed to dynamically adjust pruning strength based on scene complexity, preserving semantic completeness and maintaining balanced attention across layers. Together, they enable context-aware token reduction that maintains essential semantics with lower computation. Comprehensive experiments conducted on five representative 3D vision and language benchmarks, including ScanRefer, Multi3DRefer, Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and SQA3D, demonstrate that Efficient3D achieves superior performance compared with unpruned baselines, with a +2.57% CIDEr improvement on the Scan2Cap dataset. Therefore, Efficient3D provides a scalable and effective solution for efficient inference in 3D MLLMs. The code is released at: https://github.com/sol924/Efficient3D
tldr: Efficient3D is a framework for reducing visual tokens in 3D Multimodal LLMs to accelerate inference, using a debiased importance estimator and adaptive token rebalancing. It shows improved performance on 3D vision-language benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Efficient3D是一个用于加速3D多模态大语言模型推理的框架，通过去偏视觉令牌重要性估计器和自适应令牌重平衡策略来减少视觉令牌数量，在多个3D视觉语言基准上取得了性能提升。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的最新进展已将推理能力扩展至三维领域，实现了细粒度空间理解。然而，三维多模态大语言模型的庞大规模与输入特征的高维度带来了显著的推理开销，限制了其在资源受限平台上的实际部署。为克服这一局限，本文提出Efficient3D——一种统一的视觉令牌剪枝框架，在保持竞争性精度的同时加速三维多模态大语言模型推理。该框架引入了去偏视觉令牌重要性估计器（DVTIE）模块，该模块在注意力聚合过程中考虑浅层初始层的影响，从而为视觉令牌生成更可靠的重要性预测。此外，还开发了自适应令牌再平衡（ATR）策略，可根据场景复杂度动态调整剪枝强度，以保持语义完整性及跨层注意力的均衡性。二者的协同作用实现了上下文感知的令牌精简，在降低计算量的同时保留了关键语义信息。在ScanRefer、Multi3DRefer、Scan2Cap、ScanQA及SQA3D等五个代表性三维视觉与语言基准数据集上的综合实验表明，Efficient3D相比未剪枝基线模型取得了更优性能，其中在Scan2Cap数据集上实现了CIDEr指标+2.57%的提升。因此，Efficient3D为三维多模态大语言模型的高效推理提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。代码发布于：https://github.com/sol924/Efficient3D

title: Finding Belief Geometries with Sparse Autoencoders
summary:
Understanding the geometric structure of internal representations is a central goal of mechanistic interpretability. Prior work has shown that transformers trained on sequences generated by hidden Markov models encode probabilistic belief states as simplex-shaped geometries in their residual stream, with vertices corresponding to latent generative states. Whether large language models trained on naturalistic text develop analogous geometric representations remains an open question.
  We introduce a pipeline for discovering candidate simplex-structured subspaces in transformer representations, combining sparse autoencoders (SAEs), $k$-subspace clustering of SAE features, and simplex fitting using AANet. We validate the pipeline on a transformer trained on a multipartite hidden Markov model with known belief-state geometry. Applied to Gemma-2-9B, we identify 13 priority clusters exhibiting candidate simplex geometry ($K \geq 3$).
  A key challenge is distinguishing genuine belief-state encoding from tiling artifacts: latents can span a simplex-shaped subspace without the mixture coordinates carrying predictive signal beyond any individual feature. We therefore adopt barycentric prediction as our primary discriminating test. Among the 13 priority clusters, 3 exhibit a highly significant advantage on near-vertex samples (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-14}$) and 4 on simplex-interior samples. Together 5 distinct real clusters pass at least one split, while no null cluster passes either. One cluster, 768_596, additionally achieves the highest causal steering score in the dataset. This is the only case where passive prediction and active intervention converge. We present these findings as preliminary evidence that genuine belief-like geometry exists in Gemma-2-9B's representation space, and identify the structured evaluation that would be required to confirm this interpretation.
tldr: The paper introduces a pipeline using sparse autoencoders and subspace clustering to identify simplex-shaped belief-state representations in the residual stream of large language models, with preliminary evidence for such structures in Gemma-2-9B.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种利用稀疏自动编码器和子空间聚类的方法，旨在大型语言模型的残差流中识别单纯形结构的信念状态表征，并在Gemma-2-9B中找到了初步证据。
summary_zh:
摘要：理解内部表示的几何结构是机制可解释性研究的核心目标。已有研究表明，在隐马尔可夫模型生成的序列上训练的Transformer模型，会将其残差流中的概率信念状态编码为单纯形几何结构，其顶点对应于潜在的生成状态。然而，在自然文本上训练的大型语言模型是否发展出类似的几何表示，仍是一个未解之谜。

我们提出了一种从Transformer表示中发现候选单纯形结构子空间的流程，该流程结合了稀疏自编码器（SAE）、SAE特征的$k$子空间聚类以及利用AANet进行单纯形拟合。我们首先在一个基于已知信念状态几何结构的多部隐马尔可夫模型上训练的Transformer上验证了该流程的有效性。将这一方法应用于Gemma-2-9B模型，我们识别出13个展现出候选单纯形几何结构（$K \geq 3$）的优先聚类。

一个关键挑战在于区分真正的信念状态编码与“平铺假象”：潜在变量可以张成一个单纯形形状的子空间，但其混合坐标却不具备超越任何单个特征的预测信号。因此，我们采用重心预测作为主要的判别性测试。在这13个优先聚类中，有3个在近顶点样本上表现出高度显著的优势（Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-14}$），4个在单纯形内部样本上表现出优势。总计有5个不同的真实聚类至少通过了一种样本划分的测试，而零假设聚类则无一通过。其中一个聚类（768_596）还在数据集中获得了最高的因果干预得分。这是唯一一个被动预测与主动干预结果相吻合的案例。我们提出这些发现作为初步证据，表明Gemma-2-9B的表示空间中存在真实的类信念几何结构，并明确了确证这一解释所需的结构化评估框架。

title: Do Agent Societies Develop Intellectual Elites? The Hidden Power Laws of Collective Cognition in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed as interacting agent societies, yet scaling these systems often yields diminishing or unstable returns, the causes of which remain poorly understood. We present the first large-scale empirical study of coordination dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, introducing an atomic event-level formulation that reconstructs reasoning as cascades of coordination. Analyzing over 1.5 Million interactions across tasks, topologies, and scales, we uncover three coupled laws: coordination follows heavy-tailed cascades, concentrates via preferential attachment into intellectual elites, and produces increasingly frequent extreme events as system size grows. We show that these effects are coupled through a single structural mechanism: an integration bottleneck, in which coordination expansion scales with system size while consolidation does not, producing large but weakly integrated reasoning processes. To test this mechanism, we introduce Deficit-Triggered Integration (DTI), which selectively increases integration under imbalance. DTI improves performance precisely where coordination fails, without suppressing large-scale reasoning. Together, our results establish quantitative laws of collective cognition and identify coordination structure as a fundamental, previously unmeasured axis for understanding and improving scalable multi-agent intelligence.
tldr: This paper discovers universal power-law scaling and the emergence of intellectual elites in the coordination dynamics of LLM-based multi-agent systems, attributing performance bottlenecks to an integration deficit and proposing a targeted intervention.
tldr_zh: 本文发现了基于LLM的多智能体系统协调动态中的普适幂律缩放和智力精英涌现现象，将性能瓶颈归因于整合缺陷，并提出了针对性干预措施。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）多智能体系统正日益以交互式智能体社会形态部署，然而此类系统的规模化扩展往往带来收益递减或性能不稳定现象，其根本原因仍不甚明晰。本研究首次对基于LLM的多智能体系统协调动力学展开大规模实证分析，通过原子事件级建模将推理过程重构为协调级联序列。通过分析涵盖不同任务、拓扑结构和规模体系的超过150万次交互，我们揭示了三大耦合定律：协调遵循重尾分布级联模式，通过偏好依附机制向智力精英集中，且随着系统规模扩大产生日益频繁的极端事件。研究表明这些效应通过单一结构机制耦合实现：即整合瓶颈机制——在此机制下协调扩展随系统规模增长，而协调整合却未同步增强，导致形成规模庞大但弱整合的推理过程。为验证该机制，我们提出赤字触发整合（DTI）方法，能在系统失衡时选择性增强整合。DTI精准改善了协调失效场景下的性能表现，同时不抑制大规模推理能力。综合而言，本研究确立了集体认知的量化定律，并论证了协调结构作为理解和改进可扩展多智能体智能的基础性、先前未被度量的关键维度。

title: Speaking of Language: Reflections on Metalanguage Research in NLP
summary: This work aims to shine a spotlight on the topic of metalanguage. We first define metalanguage, link it to NLP and LLMs, and then discuss our two labs' metalanguage-centered efforts. Finally, we discuss four dimensions of metalanguage and metalinguistic tasks, offering a list of understudied future research directions.
tldr: This paper discusses metalanguage, its definition, and its connections to NLP and LLMs, highlighting research efforts and future directions in metalinguistic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了元语言的定义、其与自然语言处理和大型语言模型的关系，并介绍了相关研究及未来方向。
summary_zh: 本研究旨在聚焦元语言这一主题。我们首先界定了元语言的定义，将其与自然语言处理及大语言模型相关联，随后阐述了我们两个实验室以元语言为核心的研究工作。最后，我们探讨了元语言与元语言任务的四个维度，并梳理出一系列尚未充分探索的未来研究方向。

title: Cross-Vehicle 3D Geometric Consistency for Self-Supervised Surround Depth Estimation on Articulated Vehicles
summary: Surround depth estimation provides a cost-effective alternative to LiDAR for 3D perception in autonomous driving. While recent self-supervised methods explore multi-camera settings to improve scale awareness and scene coverage, they are primarily designed for passenger vehicles and rarely consider articulated vehicles or robotics platforms. The articulated structure introduces complex cross-segment geometry and motion coupling, making consistent depth reasoning across views more challenging. In this work, we propose \textbf{ArticuSurDepth}, a self-supervised framework for surround-view depth estimation on articulated vehicles that enhances depth learning through cross-view and cross-vehicle geometric consistency guided by structural priors from vision foundation model. Specifically, we introduce multi-view spatial context enrichment strategy and a cross-view surface normal constraint to improve structural coherence across spatial and temporal contexts. We further incorporate camera height regularization with ground plane-awareness to encourage metric depth estimation, together with cross-vehicle pose consistency that bridges motion estimation between articulated segments. To validate our proposed method, an articulated vehicle experiment platform was established with a dataset collected over it. Experiment results demonstrate state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance of depth estimation on our self-collected dataset as well as on DDAD, nuScenes, and KITTI benchmarks.
tldr: Proposes a self-supervised framework for surround-view depth estimation on articulated vehicles, using cross-view and cross-vehicle geometric consistency.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于铰接式车辆环视深度估计的自监督框架，利用跨视图和跨车辆的几何一致性。
summary_zh: 环绕深度估计为自动驾驶中的三维感知提供了经济高效的激光雷达替代方案。尽管当前的自监督方法探索多摄像头配置以提升尺度感知与场景覆盖能力，但这些方法主要面向乘用车设计，极少考虑铰接式车辆或机器人平台。铰接结构会引发复杂的跨段几何与运动耦合问题，使得跨视角的深度推理一致性面临更大挑战。本研究提出\textbf{ArticuSurDepth}——一种面向铰接式车辆的环视深度估计自监督框架，该框架通过视觉基础模型的结构先验引导跨视角与跨车辆的几何一致性，从而增强深度学习能力。具体而言，我们引入多视角空间上下文增强策略与跨视角表面法向约束，以提升空间与时间上下文中的结构连贯性；同时结合具备地面感知能力的相机高度正则化机制来促进度量深度估计，并配以跨车辆位姿一致性模块来弥合铰接段间的运动估计。为验证所提方法，我们搭建了铰接车辆实验平台并采集了专用数据集。实验结果表明，该方法不仅在自采集数据集上取得深度估计的先进性能，在DDAD、nuScenes和KITTI基准测试中同样达到最优水平。

title: Analytic Drift Resister for Non-Exemplar Continual Graph Learning
summary: Non-Exemplar Continual Graph Learning (NECGL) seeks to eliminate the privacy risks intrinsic to rehearsal-based paradigms by retaining solely class-level prototype representations rather than raw graph examples for mitigating catastrophic forgetting. However, this design choice inevitably precipitates feature drift. As a nascent alternative, Analytic Continual Learning (ACL) capitalizes on the intrinsic generalization properties of frozen pre-trained models to bolster continual learning performance. Nonetheless, a key drawback resides in the pronounced attenuation of model plasticity. To surmount these challenges, we propose Analytic Drift Resister (ADR), a novel and theoretically grounded NECGL framework. ADR exploits iterative backpropagation to break free from the frozen pre-trained constraint, adapting to evolving task graph distributions and fortifying model plasticity. Since parameter updates trigger feature drift, we further propose Hierarchical Analytic Merging (HAM), performing layer-wise merging of linear transformations in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) via ridge regression, thereby ensuring absolute resistance to feature drift. On this basis, Analytic Classifier Reconstruction (ACR) enables theoretically zero-forgetting class-incremental learning. Empirical evaluation on four node classification benchmarks demonstrates that ADR maintains strong competitiveness against existing state-of-the-art methods.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel non-exemplar continual learning framework for graph neural networks, focusing on mitigating catastrophic forgetting and feature drift in class-incremental node classification tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的非范例持续图学习框架，专注于在类增量节点分类任务中缓解灾难性遗忘和特征漂移问题。
summary_zh:
摘要：
非样本持续图学习旨在通过仅保留类级别原型表示而非原始图样本来缓解灾难性遗忘，从而消除基于复现范式的内在隐私风险。然而，这种设计选择不可避免地导致特征漂移。作为一种新兴替代方案，分析式持续学习利用冻结预训练模型固有的泛化特性来增强持续学习性能，但其关键缺陷在于模型可塑性的显著衰减。为克服这些挑战，我们提出分析式漂移抵抗器——一种新颖且具有理论依据的非样本持续图学习框架。该框架通过迭代反向传播突破冻结预训练模型的限制，适应动态演进的任务图分布并强化模型可塑性。鉴于参数更新会引发特征漂移，我们进一步提出层次化分析融合机制，通过岭回归对图神经网络中的线性变换进行逐层融合，从而实现对特征漂移的绝对抑制。在此基础上，分析式分类器重构实现了理论零遗忘的类增量学习。在四个节点分类基准数据集上的实验评估表明，该框架相对于现有先进方法保持了强大的竞争力。

title: AutoVerifier: An Agentic Automated Verification Framework Using Large Language Models
summary: Scientific and Technical Intelligence (S&TI) analysis requires verifying complex technical claims across rapidly growing literature, where existing approaches fail to bridge the verification gap between surface-level accuracy and deeper methodological validity. We present AutoVerifier, an LLM-based agentic framework that automates end-to-end verification of technical claims without requiring domain expertise. AutoVerifier decomposes every technical assertion into structured claim triples of the form (Subject, Predicate, Object), constructing knowledge graphs that enable structured reasoning across six progressively enriching layers: corpus construction and ingestion, entity and claim extraction, intra-document verification, cross-source verification, external signal corroboration, and final hypothesis matrix generation. We demonstrate AutoVerifier on a contested quantum computing claim, where the framework, operated by analysts with no quantum expertise, automatically identified overclaims and metric inconsistencies within the target paper, traced cross-source contradictions, uncovered undisclosed commercial conflicts of interest, and produced a final assessment. These results show that structured LLM verification can reliably evaluate the validity and maturity of emerging technologies, turning raw technical documents into traceable, evidence-backed intelligence assessments.
tldr: AutoVerifier is an LLM-based agentic framework for automated verification of technical claims, decomposing assertions into structured triples and performing multi-layer reasoning to produce evidence-backed assessments.
tldr_zh: AutoVerifier 是一个基于LLM的智能体框架，用于自动化验证技术声明，将断言分解为结构化三元组，并进行多层推理，以产生基于证据的评估。
summary_zh: 科学与技术情报（S&TI）分析需在快速增长的技术文献中验证复杂的技术主张，而现有方法难以弥合表层准确性判断与深层方法论有效性核查之间的差距。本文提出AutoVerifier——一种基于大语言模型的智能体框架，可在无需领域专业知识的情况下实现技术主张的端到端自动化验证。该框架将每个技术主张分解为（主体，谓词，客体）三元组结构，通过构建知识图谱实现六层渐进式增强的结构化推理：文献库构建与内容获取、实体与主张提取、文档内验证、跨源验证、外部信号佐证以及最终假设矩阵生成。我们在争议性量子计算主张案例中验证了AutoVerifier的效能：由不具备量子专业知识的分析人员操作该框架，系统自动识别出目标论文中的过度宣称与指标不一致问题，追踪到跨文献矛盾，发现未披露的商业利益冲突，并生成最终评估报告。研究表明，结构化大语言模型验证能够可靠评估新兴技术的有效性与成熟度，将原始技术文档转化为可追溯、有证据支撑的情报评估。

title: Do Audio-Visual Large Language Models Really See and Hear?
summary: Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AVLLMs) are emerging as unified interfaces to multimodal perception. We present the first mechanistic interpretability study of AVLLMs, analyzing how audio and visual features evolve and fuse through different layers of an AVLLM to produce the final text outputs. We find that although AVLLMs encode rich audio semantics at intermediate layers, these capabilities largely fail to surface in the final text generation when audio conflicts with vision. Probing analyses show that useful latent audio information is present, but deeper fusion layers disproportionately privilege visual representations that tend to suppress audio cues. We further trace this imbalance to training: the AVLLM's audio behavior strongly matches its vision-language base model, indicating limited additional alignment to audio supervision. Our findings reveal a fundamental modality bias in AVLLMs and provide new mechanistic insights into how multimodal LLMs integrate audio and vision.
tldr: This paper is a mechanistic interpretability study of Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AVLLMs), analyzing how they integrate audio and visual features, and finds a fundamental bias favoring vision over audio in the final text generation.
tldr_zh: 本文是对视听大语言模型（AVLLM）的机制可解释性研究，分析了模型如何整合音频和视觉特征，并发现在最终文本生成中存在偏重视觉、压制音频的根本性偏见。
summary_zh: 视听大语言模型（AVLLMs）正在成为多模态感知的统一接口。我们首次对AVLLMs进行机制可解释性研究，分析音频和视觉特征如何通过模型的不同层级演进与融合，最终生成文本输出。研究发现，尽管AVLLMs在中间层编码了丰富的音频语义，但当音频与视觉信息冲突时，这些能力大多无法体现在最终文本生成中。探测分析表明，潜在的可用音频信息实际存在，但更深层的融合模块会过度偏向视觉表征，从而抑制音频线索。我们进一步追溯这种不平衡到训练过程：该AVLLM的音频行为与其视觉语言基础模型高度吻合，表明其对音频监督的额外对齐有限。我们的研究揭示了AVLLMs中存在根本性的模态偏见，并为多模态大语言模型如何整合音频与视觉提供了新的机制性见解。

title: Moondream Segmentation: From Words to Masks
summary: We present Moondream Segmentation, a referring image segmentation extension of Moondream 3, a vision-language model. Given an image and a referring expression, the model autoregressively decodes a vector path and iteratively refines the rasterized mask into a final detailed mask. We introduce a reinforcement learning stage that resolves ambiguity in the supervised signal by directly optimizing mask quality. Rollouts from this stage produce coarse-to-ground-truth targets for the refiner. To mitigate evaluation noise from polygon annotations, we release RefCOCO-M, a cleaned RefCOCO validation split with boundary-accurate masks. Moondream Segmentation achieves a cIoU of 80.2% on RefCOCO (val) and 62.6% mIoU on LVIS (val).
tldr: Moondream Segmentation is a vision-language model for referring image segmentation, using autoregressive vector path decoding and iterative refinement, with a reinforcement learning stage to improve mask quality.
tldr_zh: Moondream Segmentation 是一个用于指代图像分割的视觉语言模型，采用自回归向量路径解码和迭代细化，通过强化学习阶段提升掩码质量。
summary_zh: 本文提出Moondream分割模型，这是Moondream 3视觉语言模型在指代图像分割领域的扩展。该模型接收图像和指代表达式作为输入，通过自回归解码向量路径，并将光栅化掩模迭代优化为最终精细化掩模。我们引入强化学习阶段，通过直接优化掩模质量来解决监督信号中的歧义问题。该阶段生成的训练轨迹可为细化器提供从粗糙标注到真实标注的优化目标。为减少多边形标注带来的评估噪声，我们发布了RefCOCO-M数据集——这是RefCOCO验证集的清洗版本，包含边界精确的掩模标注。Moondream分割模型在RefCOCO（验证集）上达到80.2%的cIoU指标，在LVIS（验证集）上获得62.6%的mIoU评分。

title: Mitigating LLM biases toward spurious social contexts using direct preference optimization
summary: LLMs are increasingly used for high-stakes decision-making, yet their sensitivity to spurious contextual information can introduce harmful biases. This is a critical concern when models are deployed for tasks like evaluating teachers' instructional quality, where biased assessment can affect teachers' professional development and career trajectories. We investigate model robustness to spurious social contexts using the largest publicly available dataset of U.S. classroom transcripts (NCTE) paired with expert rubric scores. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight models across seven categories of spurious contexts -- including teacher experience, education level, demographic identity, and sycophancy-inducing framings -- we find that irrelevant contextual information can shift model predictions by up to 1.48 points on a 7-point scale, with larger models sometimes exhibiting greater sensitivity despite higher predictive accuracy. Mitigations using prompts and standard direct preference optimization (DPO) prove largely insufficient. We propose **Debiasing-DPO**,, a self-supervised training method that pairs neutral reasoning generated from the query alone, with the model's biased reasoning generated with both the query and additional spurious context. We further combine this objective with supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth labels to prevent losses in predictive accuracy. Applied to Llama 3B \& 8B and Qwen 3B \& 7B Instruct models, Debiasing-DPO reduces bias by 84\% and improves predictive accuracy by 52\% on average. Our findings from the educational case study highlight that robustness to spurious context is not a natural byproduct of model scaling and that our proposed method can yield substantial gains in both accuracy and robustness for prompt-based prediction tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces Debiasing-DPO, a method to mitigate large language models' sensitivity to spurious contextual biases, improving accuracy and robustness in a specific application.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Debiasing-DPO方法，用于减轻大语言模型对虚假上下文偏差的敏感性，在特定应用场景中提高了准确性和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 大语言模型正日益被用于高风险的决策场景，然而其对虚假上下文信息的敏感性可能引入有害偏见。当模型被部署用于评估教师教学质量等任务时，这种带有偏见的评估会影响教师的专业发展和职业轨迹，因此这一问题尤为关键。我们利用美国最大的公开课堂实录数据集（NCTE）及其配套的专家评分标准，研究了模型在虚假社会背景信息下的鲁棒性。通过对七种前沿及开放权重模型在七类虚假背景下的评估——包括教师经验、教育水平、人口身份特征以及诱导性奉承框架——我们发现无关的上下文信息可使模型预测在7分量表上产生高达1.48分的偏移。尽管大型模型通常具有更高的预测准确性，但有时却表现出更强的敏感性。使用提示词和标准直接偏好优化的缓解措施被证明基本无效。我们提出了一种自监督训练方法**Debiasing-DPO**，该方法将仅基于查询生成的中立推理与模型在查询和附加虚假上下文共同作用下生成的偏见推理进行配对训练。我们进一步将该目标与基于真实标签的监督微调相结合，以避免预测准确性的损失。在Llama 3B和8B以及Qwen 3B和7B Instruct模型上的实验表明，Debiasing-DPO平均降低84%的偏见并提升52%的预测准确性。这项教育案例研究的结果表明，对虚假上下文的鲁棒性并非模型规模扩大的自然产物，而我们提出的方法能够在基于提示的预测任务中同时实现准确性与鲁棒性的显著提升。

title: Understanding the Effects of Safety Unalignment on Large Language Models
summary: Safety alignment has become a critical step to ensure LLMs refuse harmful requests while providing helpful and harmless responses. However, despite the ubiquity of safety alignment for deployed frontier models, two separate lines of recent work--jailbreak-tuning (JT) and weight orthogonalization (WO)--have shown that safety guardrails may be largely disabled, resulting in LLMs which comply with harmful requests they would normally refuse. In spite of far-reaching safety implications, analysis has largely been limited to refusal rates of each unalignment method in isolation, leaving their relative effects on adversarial LLM capabilities unknown. To fill this gap, we study the impact of unaligning six popular LLMs of various sizes across a large number of malicious and benign tasks, using both JT and WO. Across the evaluated models, we show that while refusal degradation is split between the two methods, WO produces LLMs far more capable of aiding in malicious activity; in contrast to JT, the majority of WO unaligned models are far less prone to hallucinations, better retain their original natural-language performance, and are more effective at state-of-the-art adversarial and cyber attacks. To thus help mitigate the malicious risks of WO unalignment, we conclude by showing that supervised fine-tuning effectively limits the adversarial attack abilities enabled by WO, without drastically affecting hallucination rates or natural language performance.
tldr: This paper studies how safety unalignment via jailbreak-tuning and weight orthogonalization affects LLMs' refusal rates and capabilities for malicious tasks, finding WO creates more capable and harmful models, and proposes SFT as a mitigation.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了通过越狱微调和权重正交化对大型语言模型进行安全非对齐的影响，发现权重正交化方法产生的模型更具恶意能力，并提出监督微调作为缓解措施。
summary_zh: 安全对齐已成为确保大语言模型在提供有益且无害回应的同时拒绝有害请求的关键步骤。然而，尽管前沿部署模型普遍采用安全对齐技术，近期两项独立研究——越狱调优与权重正交化——表明安全防护措施可能被大幅削弱，导致大语言模型会顺从处理其通常应拒绝的有害请求。尽管这一发现具有深远的安全影响，现有分析大多局限于单独评估每种去对齐方法的拒绝率，尚未明确它们对对抗性大语言模型能力的相对影响。为填补这一空白，我们通过越狱调优和权重正交化两种方法，系统研究了六种不同规模的流行大语言模型在大量恶意与良性任务上的去对齐效果。在所有评估模型中，我们发现：虽然两种方法均会降低模型拒绝能力，但权重正交化方法产生的模型在辅助恶意活动方面表现出更强能力；与越狱调优相比，绝大多数权重正交化去对齐模型更不易产生幻觉，能更好保持原有自然语言性能，且在实施前沿对抗性攻击和网络攻击时更为有效。为缓解权重正交化去对齐带来的恶意风险，我们最终证明监督微调能有效限制该方法所增强的对抗攻击能力，同时不会显著影响幻觉率或自然语言性能。

title: Feature Attribution Stability Suite: How Stable Are Post-Hoc Attributions?
summary: Post-hoc feature attribution methods are widely deployed in safety-critical vision systems, yet their stability under realistic input perturbations remains poorly characterized. Existing metrics evaluate explanations primarily under additive noise, collapse stability to a single scalar, and fail to condition on prediction preservation, conflating explanation fragility with model sensitivity. We introduce the Feature Attribution Stability Suite (FASS), a benchmark that enforces prediction-invariance filtering, decomposes stability into three complementary metrics: structural similarity, rank correlation, and top-k Jaccard overlap-and evaluates across geometric, photometric, and compression perturbations. Evaluating four attribution methods (Integrated Gradients, GradientSHAP, Grad-CAM, LIME) across four architectures and three datasets-ImageNet-1K, MS COCO, and CIFAR-10, FASS shows that stability estimates depend critically on perturbation family and prediction-invariance filtering. Geometric perturbations expose substantially greater attribution instability than photometric changes, and without conditioning on prediction preservation, up to 99% of evaluated pairs involve changed predictions. Under this controlled evaluation, we observe consistent method-level trends, with Grad-CAM achieving the highest stability across datasets.
tldr: The paper introduces a new benchmark suite (FASS) to evaluate the stability of post-hoc feature attribution methods for vision models under various realistic perturbations, finding that stability depends heavily on perturbation type and that prediction-invariance filtering is critical for valid assessment.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个新的基准套件（FASS），用于评估视觉模型在多种现实扰动下事后特征归因方法的稳定性，发现稳定性严重依赖于扰动类型，且预测不变性过滤对于有效评估至关重要。
summary_zh: 事后特征归因方法在安全关键型视觉系统中被广泛部署，然而它们在现实输入扰动下的稳定性仍未得到充分表征。现有评估指标主要在加性噪声下评估解释，将稳定性简化为单一标量，且未考虑预测保持的条件，导致解释脆弱性与模型敏感性被混为一谈。本文提出特征归因稳定性测试套件（FASS），该基准强制执行预测不变性过滤，将稳定性分解为三个互补指标：结构相似性、秩相关性和top-k杰卡德重叠度，并在几何、光度和压缩扰动下进行评估。通过对四种架构、三个数据集（ImageNet-1K、MS COCO和CIFAR-10）上的四种归因方法（积分梯度、GradientSHAP、Grad-CAM、LIME）进行测试，FASS表明稳定性评估结果高度依赖于扰动类型和预测不变性过滤条件。几何扰动暴露出的归因不稳定性远高于光度变化，而在未要求预测保持的条件下，高达99%的评估样本对涉及预测结果改变。在此受控评估框架下，我们观察到一致的方法层面趋势，其中Grad-CAM在所有数据集上均表现出最高的稳定性。

title: VERTIGO: Visual Preference Optimization for Cinematic Camera Trajectory Generation
summary: Cinematic camera control relies on a tight feedback loop between director and cinematographer, where camera motion and framing are continuously reviewed and refined. Recent generative camera systems can produce diverse, text-conditioned trajectories, but they lack this "director in the loop" and have no explicit supervision of whether a shot is visually desirable. This results in in-distribution camera motion but poor framing, off-screen characters, and undesirable visual aesthetics. In this paper, we introduce VERTIGO, the first framework for visual preference optimization of camera trajectory generators. Our framework leverages a real-time graphics engine (Unity) to render 2D visual previews from generated camera motion. A cinematically fine-tuned vision-language model then scores these previews using our proposed cyclic semantic similarity mechanism, which aligns renders with text prompts. This process provides the visual preference signals for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) post-training. Both quantitative evaluations and user studies on Unity renders and diffusion-based Camera-to-Video pipelines show consistent gains in condition adherence, framing quality, and perceptual realism. Notably, VERTIGO reduces the character off-screen rate from 38% to nearly 0% while preserving the geometric fidelity of camera motion. User study participants further prefer VERTIGO over baselines across composition, consistency, prompt adherence, and aesthetic quality, confirming the perceptual benefits of our visual preference post-training.
tldr: The paper introduces VERTIGO, a framework for visual preference optimization of camera trajectory generators using a graphics engine and a fine-tuned vision-language model to improve cinematic shot framing and aesthetics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了VERTIGO框架，通过图形引擎和微调后的视觉-语言模型对相机轨迹生成器进行视觉偏好优化，旨在提升电影镜头的构图和美学质量。
summary_zh: 电影摄像机控制依赖于导演与摄影师之间的紧密反馈循环，其中摄像机运动与构图需持续审视与调整。当前生成式摄像机系统虽能生成多样化、基于文本条件描述的轨迹，但缺乏这种"循环中的导演"参与，且未对镜头视觉吸引力进行显式监督。这导致生成结果虽符合运动分布规律，却存在构图拙劣、角色出画及视觉美感不足等问题。本文提出VERTIGO框架——首个面向摄像机轨迹生成器的视觉偏好优化方案。该框架利用实时图形引擎（Unity）将生成的摄像机运动渲染为二维视觉预览，再通过电影领域微调的视觉-语言模型，采用我们提出的循环语义相似度机制对这些预览画面进行评分，实现渲染画面与文本提示的对齐。此过程为直接偏好优化后训练提供视觉偏好信号。在Unity渲染与基于扩散的摄像机到视频流程上进行的定量评估和用户研究表明，该方法在条件遵循度、构图质量与感知真实感方面均取得持续提升。值得注意的是，VERTIGO将角色出画率从38%降至接近0%，同时保持摄像机运动的几何保真度。用户研究进一步表明，在构图、一致性、提示遵循度与美学品质等维度上，参与者对VERTIGO的偏好度均超过基线方法，印证了视觉偏好后训练带来的感知优势。

title: PlayGen-MoG: Framework for Diverse Multi-Agent Play Generation via Mixture-of-Gaussians Trajectory Prediction
summary: Multi-agent trajectory generation in team sports requires models that capture both the diversity of possible plays and realistic spatial coordination between players on plays. Standard generative approaches such as Conditional Variational Autoencoders (CVAE) and diffusion models struggle with this task, exhibiting posterior collapse or convergence to the dataset mean. Moreover, most trajectory prediction methods operate in a forecasting regime that requires multiple frames of observed history, limiting their use for play design where only the initial formation is available. We present PlayGen-MoG, an extensible framework for formation-conditioned play generation that addresses these challenges through three design choices: 1/ a Mixture-of-Gaussians (MoG) output head with shared mixture weights across all agents, where a single set of weights selects a play scenario that couples all players' trajectories, 2/ relative spatial attention that encodes pairwise player positions and distances as learned attention biases, and 3/ non-autoregressive prediction of absolute displacements from the initial formation, eliminating cumulative error drift and removing the dependence on observed trajectory history, enabling realistic play generation from a single static formation alone. On American football tracking data, PlayGen-MoG achieves 1.68 yard ADE and 3.98 yard FDE while maintaining full utilization of all 8 mixture components with entropy of 2.06 out of 2.08, and qualitatively confirming diverse generation without mode collapse.
tldr: Proposes PlayGen-MoG, a framework for generating diverse multi-agent trajectories (e.g., in sports plays) from a static initial formation, using a Mixture-of-Gaussians output head and relative spatial attention to avoid mode collapse and history dependence.
tldr_zh: 提出了PlayGen-MoG框架，用于从静态初始阵型生成多样的多智能体轨迹（如体育比赛战术），通过混合高斯输出头和相对空间注意力机制来避免模式崩溃和依赖历史观测。
summary_zh: 团体运动中的多智能体轨迹生成需要既能捕捉战术多样性、又能实现球员间空间协调的模型。传统生成方法如条件变分自编码器（CVAE）和扩散模型在此任务上存在局限，常出现后验坍塌或收敛至数据集均值的问题。此外，多数轨迹预测方法依赖于需观测多帧历史数据的预测范式，这限制了其在仅掌握初始阵型情况下的战术设计应用。为此，我们提出PlayGen-MoG这一可扩展的阵型条件战术生成框架，通过三项设计突破上述挑战：1/采用混合高斯（MoG）输出头，所有智能体共享混合权重，通过单一权重集合选择耦合所有球员轨迹的战术场景；2/引入相对空间注意力机制，将球员间配对位置与距离编码为可学习的注意力偏置；3/通过非自回归方式直接预测初始阵型的绝对位移，避免累积误差漂移，摆脱对观测轨迹历史的依赖，实现仅凭静态阵型生成真实战术。在美国橄榄球追踪数据上，PlayGen-MoG取得1.68码的平均位移误差与3.98码的最终位移误差，同时确保全部8个混合成分得到充分使用（熵值达2.06/2.08），并定性地证实了无模式坍塌的多样化生成能力。

title: Compositional Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
summary: We study structured abstraction-based reasoning for the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) and compare its generalization to test-time approaches. Purely neural architectures lack reliable combinatorial generalization, while strictly symbolic systems struggle with perceptual grounding. We therefore propose a neuro-symbolic architecture that extracts object-level structure from grids, uses neural priors to propose candidate transformations from a fixed domain-specific language (DSL) of atomic patterns, and filters hypotheses using cross-example consistency. Instantiated as a compositional reasoning framework based on unit patterns inspired by human visual abstraction, the system augments large language models (LLMs) with object representations and transformation proposals. On ARC-AGI-2, it improves base LLM performance from 16% to 24.4% on the public evaluation set, and to 30.8% when combined with ARC Lang Solver via a meta-classifier. These results demonstrate that separating perception, neural-guided transformation proposal, and symbolic consistency filtering improves generalization without task-specific finetuning or reinforcement learning, while reducing reliance on brute-force search and sampling-based test-time scaling. We open-source the ARC-AGI-2 Reasoner code (https://github.com/CoreThink-AI/arc-agi-2-reasoner).
tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic architecture for solving the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC), combining object extraction, neural priors, and symbolic consistency filtering to improve generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经符号架构，用于解决抽象推理语料库（ARC），结合了对象提取、神经先验和符号一致性过滤以提高泛化能力。
summary_zh: 本文研究针对抽象与推理语料库（ARC）的结构化抽象推理方法，并比较其与测试时泛化方法的性能。纯神经架构缺乏可靠的可组合泛化能力，而严格的符号系统则难以实现感知层面的基础表征。因此，我们提出一种神经符号架构：该架构从网格中提取对象级结构，利用神经先验从特定领域的原子模式固定语言（DSL）中生成候选变换，并通过跨示例一致性对假设进行筛选。该框架以受人类视觉抽象启发的单元模式为基础，构建组合式推理系统，通过对象表征与变换建议增强大语言模型（LLM）的能力。在ARC-AGI-2数据集上，该方法将基础LLM在公开评估集上的性能从16%提升至24.4%；与ARC Lang Solver通过元分类器结合后，性能进一步提升至30.8%。实验结果表明，通过分离感知、神经引导的变换生成和符号一致性过滤三个模块，系统能在不依赖任务特定微调或强化学习的情况下提升泛化能力，同时减少对暴力搜索和基于采样的测试时扩展的依赖。我们已开源ARC-AGI-2推理器代码（https://github.com/CoreThink-AI/arc-agi-2-reasoner）。

title: CoME-VL: Scaling Complementary Multi-Encoder Vision-Language Learning
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) typically rely on a single vision encoder trained with contrastive image-text objectives, such as CLIP-style pretraining. While contrastive encoders are effective for cross-modal alignment and retrieval, self-supervised visual encoders often capture richer dense semantics and exhibit stronger robustness on recognition and understanding tasks. In this work, we investigate how to scale the fusion of these complementary visual representations for vision-language modeling. We propose CoME-VL: Complementary Multi-Encoder Vision-Language, a modular fusion framework that integrates a contrastively trained vision encoder with a self-supervised DINO encoder. Our approach performs representation-level fusion by (i) entropy-guided multi-layer aggregation with orthogonality-constrained projections to reduce redundancy, and (ii) RoPE-enhanced cross-attention to align heterogeneous token grids and produce compact fused visual tokens. The fused tokens can be injected into a decoder-only LLM with minimal changes to standard VLM pipelines. Extensive experiments across diverse vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that CoME-VL consistently outperforms single-encoder baselines. In particular, we observe an average improvement of 4.9% on visual understanding tasks and 5.4% on grounding tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on RefCOCO for detection while improving over the baseline by a large margin. Finally, we conduct ablation studies on layer merging, non-redundant feature mixing, and fusion capacity to evaluate how complementary contrastive and self-supervised signals affect VLM performance.
tldr: A vision-language model framework that fuses contrastive and self-supervised visual encoders to improve performance on vision-language benchmarks like visual understanding and grounding.
tldr_zh: 一个融合对比学习和自监督视觉编码器的视觉语言模型框架，提升了在视觉理解和指代等任务上的性能。
summary_zh: 近期的视觉语言模型通常依赖于采用对比式图文目标训练的单一视觉编码器，例如CLIP风格的预训练。虽然对比式编码器在跨模态对齐与检索任务上表现优异，但自监督视觉编码器往往能捕捉更丰富的密集语义，并在识别与理解任务上展现出更强的鲁棒性。本文研究如何扩展这两种互补视觉表征的融合以应用于视觉语言建模。我们提出CoME-VL：互补多编码器视觉语言模型，这是一个模块化的融合框架，通过整合对比训练视觉编码器与自监督DINO编码器实现。我们的方法通过以下方式实现表征级融合：(1) 采用熵导向的多层聚合配合正交约束投影以降低冗余；(2) 通过RoPE增强的交叉注意力机制对齐异构令牌网格，生成紧凑的融合视觉令牌。该融合令牌可注入仅解码器架构的大语言模型，且对标准视觉语言模型流程改动极小。在多样化的视觉语言基准测试中，大量实验表明CoME-VL始终优于单编码器基线模型。特别值得注意的是，在视觉理解任务上平均提升4.9%，在定位任务上平均提升5.4%。我们的方法在RefCOCO检测任务上取得了最先进的性能，同时较基线模型实现显著提升。最后，我们通过层融合、非冗余特征混合及融合能力消融实验，评估了对比式与自监督信号的互补性如何影响视觉语言模型性能。

title: VOSR: A Vision-Only Generative Model for Image Super-Resolution
summary: Most of the recent generative image super-resolution (SR) methods rely on adapting large text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models pretrained on web-scale text-image data. While effective, this paradigm starts from a generic T2I generator, despite that SR is fundamentally a low-resolution (LR) input-conditioned image restoration task. In this work, we investigate whether an SR model trained purely on visual data can rival T2I-based ones. To this end, we propose VOSR, a Vision-Only generative framework for SR. We first extract semantically rich and spatially grounded features from the LR input using a pretrained vision encoder as visual semantic guidance. We then revisit classifier-free guidance for training generative models and show that the standard unconditional branch is ill-suited to restoration models trained from scratch. We therefore replace it with a restoration-oriented guidance strategy that preserves weak LR anchors. Built upon these designs, we first train a multi-step VOSR model from scratch and then distill it into a one-step model for efficient inference. VOSR requires less than one-tenth of the training cost of representative T2I-based SR methods, yet in both multi-step and one-step settings, it achieves competitive or even better perceptual quality and efficiency, while producing more faithful structures with fewer hallucinations on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Our results, for the first time, show that high-quality generative SR can be achieved without multimodal pretraining. The code and models can be found at https://github.com/cswry/VOSR.
tldr: Proposes VOSR, a generative image super-resolution model trained purely on visual data without multimodal pretraining, achieving competitive results with lower training cost and more faithful structures.
tldr_zh: 提出 VOSR，一种仅使用视觉数据训练、无需多模态预训练的生成式图像超分辨率模型，以更低训练成本取得竞争性结果，并生成更忠实、更少幻觉的图像结构。
summary_zh: 近期大多数生成式图像超分辨率方法依赖于对海量网络图文数据进行预训练的大型文生图扩散模型。尽管此类方法有效，但其本质是从通用文生图生成器出发，而超分辨率任务归根结底是以低分辨率输入为条件的图像复原任务。本研究探讨了仅基于视觉数据训练的SR模型能否与基于文生图的模型相媲美。为此，我们提出VOSR——一种纯视觉的生成式超分辨率框架。我们首先通过预训练的视觉编码器从低分辨率输入中提取语义丰富且空间基础的特征作为视觉语义引导，继而重新审视用于训练生成模型的无分类器引导策略，发现标准无条件分支不适用于从头训练的复原模型。因此，我们将其替换为一种保留弱低分辨率锚点的复原导向引导策略。基于这些设计，我们首先从头训练多步式VOSR模型，随后将其蒸馏为单步模型以实现高效推理。VOSR所需的训练成本不到主流文生图SR方法的十分之一，但在多步与单步设置下均能实现具有竞争力甚至更优的感知质量与效率，同时在合成与真实世界基准测试中生成更真实的结构并减少幻觉。本研究首次证明：无需多模态预训练即可实现高质量生成式超分辨率。代码与模型可通过 https://github.com/cswry/VOSR 获取。

title: ProtoFlow: Mitigating Forgetting in Class-Incremental Remote Sensing Segmentation via Low-Curvature Prototype Flow
summary: Remote sensing segmentation in real deployment is inherently continual: new semantic categories emerge, and acquisition conditions shift across seasons, cities, and sensors. Despite recent progress, many incremental approaches still treat training steps as isolated updates, which leaves representation drift and forgetting insufficiently controlled. We present ProtoFlow, a time-aware prototype dynamics framework that models class prototypes as trajectories and learns their evolution with an explicit temporal vector field. By jointly enforcing low-curvature motion and inter-class separation, ProtoFlow stabilizes prototype geometry throughout incremental learning. Experiments on standard class- and domain-incremental remote sensing benchmarks show consistent gains over strong baselines, including up to 1.5-2.0 points improvement in mIoUall, together with reduced forgetting. These results suggest that explicitly modeling temporal prototype evolution is a practical and interpretable strategy for robust continual remote sensing segmentation.
tldr: Proposes ProtoFlow, a method for continual learning in remote sensing image segmentation by modeling class prototypes as low-curvature trajectories over time to mitigate forgetting.
tldr_zh: 提出了ProtoFlow方法，通过将类别原型建模为低曲率的时间轨迹，用于遥感图像分割中的持续学习，以缓解遗忘问题。
summary_zh: 实际部署中的遥感分割本质上是持续演进的：新的语义类别不断涌现，采集条件也会随季节、城市和传感器而变化。尽管已有显著进展，但现有的增量学习方法仍多将训练步骤视为孤立更新，导致表征漂移和灾难性遗忘问题未能得到有效控制。我们提出ProtoFlow——一种时间感知的原型动态框架，将类别原型建模为轨迹，并通过显式时间向量场学习其演化过程。该框架通过联合实施低曲率运动约束与类间分离策略，在持续学习过程中稳定原型几何结构。在标准的类别增量与域增量遥感基准测试上的实验表明，相比现有强基线方法，ProtoFlow实现了性能的持续提升（mIoUall指标最高提升1.5-2.0个百分点），同时显著降低了遗忘程度。这些结果证明，显式建模原型的时间演化过程是一种切实可行且具备可解释性的策略，能够有效提升持续遥感分割的鲁棒性。

title: SFFNet: Synergistic Feature Fusion Network With Dual-Domain Edge Enhancement for UAV Image Object Detection
summary: Object detection in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images remains a highly challenging task, primarily caused by the complexity of background noise and the imbalance of target scales. Traditional methods easily struggle to effectively separate objects from intricate backgrounds and fail to fully leverage the rich multi-scale information contained within images. To address these issues, we have developed a synergistic feature fusion network (SFFNet) with dual-domain edge enhancement specifically tailored for object detection in UAV images. Firstly, the multi-scale dynamic dual-domain coupling (MDDC) module is designed. This component introduces a dual-driven edge extraction architecture that operates in both the frequency and spatial domains, enabling effective decoupling of multi-scale object edges from background noise. Secondly, to further enhance the representation capability of the model's neck in terms of both geometric and semantic information, a synergistic feature pyramid network (SFPN) is proposed. SFPN leverages linear deformable convolutions to adaptively capture irregular object shapes and establishes long-range contextual associations around targets through the designed wide-area perception module (WPM). Moreover, to adapt to the various applications or resource-constrained scenarios, six detectors of different scales (N/S/M/B/L/X) are designed. Experiments on two challenging aerial datasets (VisDrone and UAVDT) demonstrate the outstanding performance of SFFNet-X, achieving 36.8 AP and 20.6 AP, respectively. The lightweight models (N/S) also maintain a balance between detection accuracy and parameter efficiency. The code will be available at https://github.com/CQNU-ZhangLab/SFFNet.
tldr: This paper introduces SFFNet, a new neural network architecture with dual-domain edge enhancement and synergistic feature fusion, designed specifically for object detection in UAV images. It demonstrates performance on aerial datasets and offers models of varying scales.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SFFNet，一种专为无人机图像目标检测设计的、具有双域边缘增强和协同特征融合功能的新型神经网络架构。它在多个航空数据集上展示了性能，并提供了不同尺度的模型。
summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）图像中的目标检测仍然是一项极具挑战性的任务，这主要由背景噪声的复杂性和目标尺度的不平衡性所导致。传统方法难以有效从复杂背景中分离出目标，且未能充分利用图像中蕴含的丰富多尺度信息。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种专为无人机图像目标检测设计的、具备双域边缘增强的协同特征融合网络（SFFNet）。首先，设计了多尺度动态双域耦合（MDDC）模块。该模块引入一种在频域和空间域双驱动的边缘提取架构，能够有效地将多尺度目标边缘从背景噪声中解耦出来。其次，为进一步增强模型颈部在几何信息和语义信息上的表征能力，提出了协同特征金字塔网络（SFPN）。SFPN利用线性可变形卷积自适应地捕捉不规则物体形状，并通过所设计的广域感知模块（WPM）在目标周围建立长程上下文关联。此外，为适应不同应用场景或资源受限环境，设计了六个不同规模的检测器（N/S/M/B/L/X）。在两个具有挑战性的航空数据集（VisDrone和UAVDT）上的实验表明，SFFNet-X取得了优异性能，分别达到36.8 AP和20.6 AP。轻量化模型（N/S）也在检测精度与参数量效率之间保持了平衡。代码将发布于https://github.com/CQNU-ZhangLab/SFFNet。

title: Salt: Self-Consistent Distribution Matching with Cache-Aware Training for Fast Video Generation
summary: Distilling video generation models to extremely low inference budgets (e.g., 2--4 NFEs) is crucial for real-time deployment, yet remains challenging. Trajectory-style consistency distillation often becomes conservative under complex video dynamics, yielding an over-smoothed appearance and weak motion. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) can recover sharp, mode-seeking samples, but its local training signals do not explicitly regularize how denoising updates compose across timesteps, making composed rollouts prone to drift. To overcome this challenge, we propose Self-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (SC-DMD), which explicitly regularizes the endpoint-consistent composition of consecutive denoising updates. For real-time autoregressive video generation, we further treat the KV cache as a quality parameterized condition and propose Cache-Distribution-Aware training. This training scheme applies SC-DMD over multi-step rollouts and introduces a cache-conditioned feature alignment objective that steers low-quality outputs toward high-quality references. Across extensive experiments on both non-autoregressive backbones (e.g., Wan~2.1) and autoregressive real-time paradigms (e.g., Self Forcing), our method, dubbed \textbf{Salt}, consistently improves low-NFE video generation quality while remaining compatible with diverse KV-cache memory mechanisms. Source code will be released at \href{https://github.com/XingtongGe/Salt}{https://github.com/XingtongGe/Salt}.
tldr: This paper introduces a method to distill video generation models for extremely low inference budgets, focusing on improving image quality and motion consistency in fast autoregressive video generation, but it does not mention any application to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于将视频生成模型蒸馏至极低的推理预算，专注于提升快速自回归视频生成的图像质量和运动一致性，但未提及任何机器人或具身AI的应用。
summary_zh: 摘要：将视频生成模型蒸馏至极低推理预算（例如2-4次NFE）对实时部署至关重要，但仍是当前面临的挑战。轨迹式一致性蒸馏在复杂视频动态下常趋于保守，导致生成结果过度平滑且运动表现微弱。分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）能够恢复清晰且具有模式聚焦特性的样本，但其局部训练信号未显式规范去噪更新在时间步间的组合方式，使得组合生成过程易出现漂移。为克服此难题，我们提出自一致分布匹配蒸馏（SC-DMD），该方法显式规范了连续去噪更新的端点一致性组合。针对实时自回归视频生成，我们进一步将KV缓存视为质量参数化条件，并提出缓存分布感知训练。该训练方案在多步生成过程中应用SC-DMD，并引入一种以缓存为条件的特征对齐目标，将低质量输出导向高质量参考。通过对非自回归主干网络（如Wan~2.1）和自回归实时范式（如Self Forcing）的大量实验，我们的方法（命名为\textbf{Salt}）在低NFE设置下持续提升视频生成质量，同时保持与多种KV缓存内存机制的兼容性。源代码将在\href{https://github.com/XingtongGe/Salt}{https://github.com/XingtongGe/Salt}发布。

title: Revealing Physical-World Semantic Vulnerabilities: Universal Adversarial Patches for Infrared Vision-Language Models
summary: Infrared vision-language models (IR-VLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for multimodal perception in low-visibility environments, yet their robustness to adversarial attacks remains largely unexplored. Existing adversarial patch methods are mainly designed for RGB-based models in closed-set settings and are not readily applicable to the open-ended semantic understanding and physical deployment requirements of infrared VLMs. To bridge this gap, we propose Universal Curved-Grid Patch (UCGP), a universal physical adversarial patch framework for IR-VLMs. UCGP integrates Curved-Grid Mesh (CGM) parameterization for continuous, low-frequency, and deployable patch generation with a unified representation-driven objective that promotes subspace departure, topology disruption, and stealth. To improve robustness under real-world deployment and domain shift, we further incorporate Meta Differential Evolution and EOT-augmented TPS deformation modeling. Rather than manipulating labels or prompts, UCGP directly disrupts the visual representation space, weakening cross-modal semantic alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UCGP consistently compromises semantic understanding across diverse IR-VLM architectures while maintaining cross-model transferability, cross-dataset generalization, real-world physical effectiveness, and robustness against defenses. These findings reveal a previously overlooked robustness vulnerability in current infrared multimodal systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a universal physical adversarial patch framework designed to disrupt the semantic understanding of infrared vision-language models, highlighting robustness vulnerabilities in multimodal perception systems for low-visibility environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对红外视觉语言模型的通用物理对抗性补丁框架，旨在破坏其语义理解，揭示了当前低能见度环境下多模态感知系统的鲁棒性脆弱性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
红外视觉语言模型（IR-VLMs）已成为低能见度环境中多模态感知的一种有前景的范式，但其对抗攻击的鲁棒性尚待深入探索。现有对抗性斑块方法主要针对封闭环境下的RGB模型设计，难以直接适用于红外VLM的开放式语义理解和实际部署需求。为填补这一空白，本文提出通用曲网格斑块（UCGP）——一种针对红外VLM的通用物理对抗性斑块框架。UCGP融合了曲网格参数化方法，通过连续、低频且可部署的斑块生成技术，结合统一表征驱动目标，实现了表征子空间偏离、拓扑结构破坏与隐蔽性增强。为提升实际部署和域偏移场景下的鲁棒性，我们进一步引入元差分进化算法和EOT增强的TPS形变建模。相较于操纵标签或提示词，UCGP直接扰乱视觉表征空间，削弱跨模态语义对齐。大量实验表明，UCGP能在不同红外VLM架构中持续破坏语义理解能力，同时保持跨模型可迁移性、跨数据集泛化性、真实世界物理有效性及对抗防御的鲁棒性。这些发现揭示了当前红外多模态系统中先前被忽视的鲁棒性漏洞。

title: MI-Pruner: Crossmodal Mutual Information-guided Token Pruner for Efficient MLLMs
summary: For multimodal large language models (MLLMs), visual information is relatively sparse compared with text. As a result, research on visual pruning emerges for efficient inference. Current approaches typically measure token importance based on the attention scores in the visual encoder or in the LLM decoder, then select visual tokens with high attention scores while pruning others. In this paper, we pursue a different and more surgical approach. Instead of relying on mechanism-specific signals, we directly compute Mutual Information (MI) between visual and textual features themselves, prior to their interaction. This allows us to explicitly measure crossmodal dependency at the feature levels. Our MI-Pruner is simple, efficient and non-intrusive, requiring no access to internal attention maps or architectural modifications. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms previous attention-based pruning methods with minimal latency.
tldr: Proposes MI-Pruner, a method using mutual information between visual and textual features to prune sparse visual tokens in Multimodal Large Language Models for more efficient inference.
tldr_zh: 提出MI-Pruner方法，利用视觉和文本特征间的互信息来修剪多模态大语言模型中稀疏的视觉令牌，以实现更高效的推理。
summary_zh: 对于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）而言，视觉信息相比于文本相对稀疏。因此，为提升推理效率，针对视觉剪枝的研究应运而生。现有方法通常基于视觉编码器或大语言模型解码器中的注意力分数来评估令牌重要性，随后选择注意力分数较高的视觉令牌并剪除其余部分。本文提出一种不同且更为精细的方法：我们不依赖特定机制信号，而是直接在视觉与文本特征交互之前计算两者之间的互信息（MI），从而在特征层面显式衡量跨模态依赖关系。所提出的互信息剪枝器（MI-Pruner）简洁高效且无需侵入模型内部，既不依赖注意力图获取也无需修改模型架构。实验结果表明，该方法以极低的延迟超越了先前基于注意力的剪枝方法。

title: STEAR: Layer-Aware Spatiotemporal Evidence Intervention for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) remain prone to spatiotemporal hallucinations, often generating visually unsupported details or incorrect temporal relations. Existing mitigation methods typically treat hallucination as a uniform decoding failure, applying globally shared correction rules. We instead observe that decoder layers contribute differently to visual grounding and later linguistic composition, indicating that intervention must be layer-aware. Based on this insight, we propose STEAR, a layer-aware spatiotemporal evidence intervention framework. STEAR identifies high-risk decoding steps and selects token-conditioned visual evidence from grounding-sensitive middle layers. It uses this shared evidence for two coupled purposes: restoring missing local grounding in middle layers, and constructing temporally perturbed patch-level counterfactuals to falsify inconsistent reasoning during late-layer decoding. Consequently, STEAR mitigates both spatial and temporal hallucinations within an efficient single-encode inference framework. Experiments across representative Video-LLM backbones and challenging benchmarks demonstrate that STEAR consistently reduces hallucinations while improving faithfulness, temporal consistency, and robustness. Our results confirm that reliable video decoding relies on intervening on precise evidence at the right layer, rather than enforcing a global penalty. The code is provided in the Supplementary Material.
tldr: The paper introduces STEAR, a layer-aware intervention framework to mitigate spatiotemporal hallucinations in Video Large Language Models by using token-conditioned visual evidence from specific decoder layers, improving faithfulness and temporal consistency during video decoding.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出STEAR，一个层感知的干预框架，通过从特定解码器层使用基于token的视觉证据来减轻视频大语言模型中的时空幻觉，从而提高视频解码过程中的忠实性和时间一致性。
summary_zh: 视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）仍易受时空幻觉影响，常生成缺乏视觉支持的细节或错误的时间关系。现有缓解方法通常将幻觉视为统一的解码失败问题，并采用全局共享的校正规则。相反，我们观察到解码器各层对视觉基础与后期语言组合的贡献存在差异，这表明干预必须具有层级感知性。基于此发现，我们提出STEAR——一种层级感知的时空证据干预框架。STEAR通过识别高风险解码步骤，从对基础敏感的中层选择词元条件化的视觉证据，并利用这些共享证据实现双重耦合目标：在中层恢复缺失的局部基础信息，同时构建时序扰动的区块级反事实样本，以在深层解码过程中证伪不一致的推理逻辑。因此，STEAR可在高效的单次编码推理框架内同时缓解时空幻觉。通过对代表性视频大语言模型架构及挑战性基准测试的广泛实验表明，STEAR能持续减少幻觉现象，同时提升输出的忠实度、时序一致性与鲁棒性。研究结果证实，可靠的视频解码依赖于在正确层级对精准证据进行干预，而非施加全局惩罚。相关代码已提供于补充材料中。

title: QVAD: A Question-Centric Agentic Framework for Efficient and Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, particularly due to the open-set nature of anomalies. While recent training-free approaches utilizing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise, they typically rely on massive, resource-intensive foundation models to compensate for the ambiguity of static prompts. We argue that the bottleneck in VAD is not necessarily model capacity, but rather the static nature of inquiry. We propose QVAD, a question-centric agentic framework that treats VLM-LLM interaction as a dynamic dialogue. By iteratively refining queries based on visual context, our LLM agent guides smaller VLMs to produce high-fidelity captions and precise semantic reasoning without parameter updates. This ``prompt-updating" mechanism effectively unlocks the latent capabilities of lightweight models, enabling state-of-the-art performance on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and UBNormal using a fraction of the parameters required by competing methods. We further demonstrate exceptional generalizability on the single-scene ComplexVAD dataset. Crucially, QVAD achieves high inference speeds with minimal memory footprints, making advanced VAD capabilities deployable on resource-constrained edge devices.
tldr: QVAD is a training-free video anomaly detection framework that uses an LLM agent to dynamically refine queries for a VLM, achieving state-of-the-art performance with lightweight models for efficient deployment.
tldr_zh: QVAD是一种无需训练的视频异常检测框架，通过LLM智能体动态优化对VLM的提问，利用轻量级模型实现先进性能，适合资源受限的边缘部署。
summary_zh: 视频异常检测（VAD）是计算机视觉领域的一项基础性挑战，其难点尤其在于异常本身的开放集特性。尽管最近基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的无训练方法展现出潜力，但它们通常依赖大规模、资源密集型的基础模型来弥补静态提示的模糊性。我们认为，VAD的瓶颈并非必然在于模型容量，而在于查询方式的静态性。本文提出QVAD，一种以问题为中心的智能体框架，将VLM与LLM的交互视为动态对话。通过基于视觉上下文迭代优化查询，我们的LLM智能体引导小型VLM在不更新参数的情况下生成高保真描述和精准语义推理。这种“提示更新”机制有效释放了轻量级模型的潜力，在UCF-Crime、XD-Violence和UBNormal数据集上以远少于对比方法所需的参数量实现了最先进的性能。我们进一步在单场景ComplexVAD数据集上展示了卓越的泛化能力。至关重要的是，QVAD在极小内存占用下实现了高推理速度，使得先进的VAD能力能够部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。

title: Rendering Multi-Human and Multi-Object with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Reconstructing dynamic scenes with multiple interacting humans and objects from sparse-view inputs is a critical yet challenging task, essential for creating high-fidelity digital twins for robotics and VR/AR. This problem, which we term Multi-Human Multi-Object (MHMO) rendering, presents two significant obstacles: achieving view-consistent representations for individual instances under severe mutual occlusion, and explicitly modeling the complex and combinatorial dependencies that arise from their interactions. To overcome these challenges, we propose MM-GS, a novel hierarchical framework built upon 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method first employs a Per-Instance Multi-View Fusion module to establish a robust and consistent representation for each instance by aggregating visual information across all available views. Subsequently, a Scene-Level Instance Interaction module operates on a global scene graph to reason about relationships between all participants, refining their attributes to capture subtle interaction effects. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms strong baselines, producing state-of-the-art results with high-fidelity details and plausible inter-instance contacts.
tldr: This paper introduces a method for high-fidelity dynamic scene reconstruction of multiple humans and objects from sparse views, using a 3D Gaussian Splatting-based framework with per-instance and scene-level modeling. It is presented as a tool for creating digital twins for robotics and VR/AR.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的新方法，用于从稀疏视角输入中重建多人多物体交互的动态场景，其核心是实例级表示和场景级交互建模，旨在为机器人和VR/AR创建高保真数字孪生体。
summary_zh: 摘要：从稀疏视角输入中重建具有多个交互人体与物体的动态场景，是一项关键且富有挑战性的任务，对于为机器人与VR/AR创建高保真数字孪生至关重要。我们将该问题定义为"多人体-多物体"渲染，其面临两大核心难题：在严重相互遮挡条件下实现个体实例的视角一致性表征，以及显式建模由交互产生的复杂组合依赖关系。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了MM-GS——一个基于3D高斯溅射构建的新型分层框架。该方法首先通过"实例级多视角融合"模块，聚合所有可用视角的视觉信息，为每个实例建立鲁棒且一致的表征；随后，"场景级实例交互"模块在全局场景图上推理所有参与者间的关系，通过优化其属性来捕捉细微的交互效应。在多个挑战性数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著超越现有基线，能够生成具有高保真细节和合理实例间接触状态的先进渲染结果。

title: Exploring Motion-Language Alignment for Text-driven Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven human motion generation aims to synthesize realistic motion sequences that follow textual descriptions. Despite recent advances, accurately aligning motion dynamics with textual semantics remains a fundamental challenge. In this paper, we revisit text-to-motion generation from the perspective of motion-language alignment and propose MLA-Gen, a framework that integrates global motion priors with fine-grained local conditioning. This design enables the model to capture common motion patterns, while establishing detailed alignment between texts and motions. Furthermore, we identify a previously overlooked attention sink phenomenon in human motion generation, where attention disproportionately concentrates on the start text token, limiting the utilization of informative textual cues and leading to degraded semantic grounding. To analyze this issue, we introduce SinkRatio, a metric for measuring attention concentration, and develop alignment-aware masking and control strategies to regulate attention during generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently improves both motion quality and motion-language alignment over strong baselines. Code will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for text-driven human motion generation, focusing on motion-language alignment and addressing an attention sink issue, but it does not involve robots or physical control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于文本驱动人体运动生成的框架，专注于运动-语言对齐并解决注意力聚集问题，但未涉及机器人或物理控制。
summary_zh: 文本驱动的人体动作生成旨在合成符合文本描述的真实动作序列。尽管研究已取得进展，但准确对齐动作动态与文本语义仍是一项根本性挑战。本文从动作-语言对齐的视角重新审视文本到动作生成问题，提出MLA-Gen框架，该框架将全局动作先验与细粒度局部条件相结合。该设计使模型既能捕捉常见动作模式，又能建立文本与动作之间的精细对齐。此外，我们发现人体动作生成中普遍存在先前被忽视的注意力沉没现象——注意力过度集中于起始文本标记，限制了信息性文本线索的利用，导致语义基础弱化。为分析此问题，我们引入SinkRatio指标以量化注意力集中程度，并开发了基于对齐感知的掩蔽与控制策略，在生成过程中调控注意力分布。大量实验表明，相较于现有强基线模型，我们的方法能持续提升动作质量与动作-语言对齐效果。代码将在论文录用后公开发布。

title: Visual Prototype Conditioned Focal Region Generation for UAV-Based Object Detection
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) based object detection is a critical but challenging task, when applied in dynamically changing scenarios with limited annotated training data. Layout-to-image generation approaches have proved effective in promoting detection accuracy by synthesizing labeled images based on diffusion models. However, they suffer from frequently producing artifacts, especially near layout boundaries of tiny objects, thus substantially limiting their performance. To address these issues, we propose UAVGen, a novel layout-to-image generation framework tailored for UAV-based object detection. Specifically, UAVGen designs a Visual Prototype Conditioned Diffusion Model (VPC-DM) that constructs representative instances for each class and integrates them into latent embeddings for high-fidelity object generation. Moreover, a Focal Region Enhanced Data Pipeline (FRE-DP) is introduced to emphasize object-concentrated foreground regions in synthesis, combined with a label refinement to correct missing, extra and misaligned generations. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, and consistently promotes accuracy when integrated with distinct detectors. The source code is available at https://github.com/Sirius-Li/UAVGen.
tldr: The paper proposes a novel layout-to-image generation framework for UAV-based object detection, focusing on improving generation fidelity and accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的面向无人机目标检测的布局到图像生成框架，旨在提高生成图像的保真度和检测精度。
summary_zh: 摘要：基于无人机的目标检测在动态变化场景及标注训练数据有限的情况下，是一项关键而具有挑战性的任务。基于扩散模型的布局到图像生成方法已通过合成标注图像被证明能有效提升检测精度，但此类方法常产生伪影，尤其在微小目标布局边界附近，从而严重限制了其性能。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种专为无人机目标检测设计的新型布局到图像生成框架UAVGen。具体而言，UAVGen设计了视觉原型条件扩散模型（VPC-DM），该模型为每个类别构建代表性实例并将其融入潜在嵌入中，以实现高保真度的目标生成。此外，本研究引入聚焦区域增强数据管道（FRE-DP），在合成过程中强化目标集中的前景区域，并结合标签细化机制以修正生成结果中缺失、冗余及错位的问题。大量实验结果表明，该方法显著优于现有先进技术，且与不同检测器集成时能持续提升检测精度。源代码已公开于https://github.com/Sirius-Li/UAVGen。

title: CrossWeaver: Cross-modal Weaving for Arbitrary-Modality Semantic Segmentation
summary: Multimodal semantic segmentation has shown great potential in leveraging complementary information across diverse sensing modalities.
