However, existing approaches often rely on carefully designed fusion strategies that either use modality-specific adaptations or rely on loosely coupled interactions, thereby limiting flexibility and resulting in less effective cross-modal coordination. Moreover, these methods often struggle to balance efficient information exchange with preserving the unique characteristics of each modality across different modality combinations. To address these challenges, we propose CrossWeaver, a simple yet effective multimodal fusion framework for arbitrary-modality semantic segmentation. Its core is a Modality Interaction Block (MIB), which enables selective and reliability-aware cross-modal interaction within the encoder, while a lightweight Seam-Aligned Fusion (SAF) module further aggregates the enhanced features. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal semantic segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance with minimal additional parameters and strong generalization to unseen modality combinations.
tldr: A multimodal fusion framework for semantic segmentation that uses a Modality Interaction Block and a Seam-Aligned Fusion module to improve cross-modal coordination and generalization to unseen modality combinations.
tldr_zh: 一种用于语义分割的多模态融合框架，通过模态交互块和轻量级无缝对齐融合模块，增强了跨模态协调能力，并能泛化到未见过的模态组合。
summary_zh: 多模态语义分割在利用不同感知模态间的互补信息方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法通常依赖于精心设计的融合策略，这些策略要么采用特定于模态的适配机制，要么依赖于松散耦合的交互方式，从而限制了灵活性并导致跨模态协同效果不佳。此外，这些方法往往难以在不同模态组合中，在实现高效信息交换与保持各模态独有特性之间取得平衡。为应对这些挑战，我们提出CrossWeaver——一种简单而有效的面向任意模态语义分割的多模态融合框架。其核心是模态交互块（MIB），可在编码器内实现选择性、可靠性感知的跨模态交互，同时轻量化的无缝对齐融合（SAF）模块进一步聚合增强特征。在多个多模态语义分割基准上的大量实验表明，我们的框架以最少的额外参数实现了最先进的性能，并对未见过的模态组合表现出强大的泛化能力。

title: Modality-Specific Hierarchical Enhancement for RGB-D Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) is challenging due to high target-background similarity, and recent methods address this by complementarily using RGB-D texture and geometry cues. However, RGB-D COD methods still underutilize modality-specific cues, which limits fusion quality. We believe this is because RGB and depth features are fused directly after backbone extraction without modality-specific enhancement. To address this limitation, we propose MHENet, an RGB-D COD framework that performs modality-specific hierarchical enhancement and adaptive fusion of RGB and depth features. Specifically, we introduce a Texture Hierarchical Enhancement Module (THEM) to amplify subtle texture variations by extracting high-frequency information and a Geometry Hierarchical Enhancement Module (GHEM) to enhance geometric structures via learnable gradient extraction, while preserving cross-scale semantic consistency. Finally, an Adaptive Dynamic Fusion Module (ADFM) adaptively fuses the enhanced texture and geometry features with spatially varying weights. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that MHENet surpasses 16 state-of-the-art methods qualitatively and quantitatively. Code is available at https://github.com/afdsgh/MHENet.
tldr: Proposes MHENet, an RGB-D camouflaged object detection method using modality-specific texture and geometry enhancement modules, followed by adaptive fusion, to improve detection performance.
tldr_zh: 提出MHENet，一种用于RGB-D伪装目标检测的方法，通过使用模态特定的纹理和几何增强模块，并随后进行自适应融合，以提升检测性能。
summary_zh: 伪装目标检测（COD）因目标与背景高度相似而极具挑战性，近期方法通过互补利用RGB-D的纹理和几何线索来解决这一问题。然而，现有的RGB-D COD方法仍未能充分利用模态特异性信息，限制了特征融合的质量。我们认为这是因为RGB和深度特征在主干网络提取后直接融合，缺乏模态特异性增强。为应对这一局限，我们提出了MHENet——一个RGB-D COD框架，通过模态特异性分层增强和自适应融合机制处理RGB与深度特征。具体而言，我们设计了纹理分层增强模块（THEM）以提取高频信息来放大细微纹理变化，同时引入几何分层增强模块（GHEM）通过可学习的梯度提取增强几何结构，并保持跨尺度语义一致性。最后，自适应动态融合模块（ADFM）以空间动态权重自适应融合增强后的纹理与几何特征。在四个基准数据集上的实验表明，MHENet在定性和定量评估中均优于16种先进方法。代码开源地址：https://github.com/afdsgh/MHENet。

title: PolyReal: A Benchmark for Real-World Polymer Science Workflows
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general domains but struggle with complex, real-world science. We posit that polymer science, an interdisciplinary field spanning chemistry, physics, biology, and engineering, is an ideal high-stakes testbed due to its diverse multimodal data. Yet, existing benchmarks related to polymer science largely overlook real-world workflows, limiting their practical utility and failing to systematically evaluate MLLMs across the full, practice-grounded lifecycle of experimentation. We introduce PolyReal, a novel multimodal benchmark grounded in real-world scientific practices to evaluate MLLMs on the full lifecycle of polymer experimentation. It covers five critical capabilities: (1) foundational knowledge application; (2) lab safety analysis; (3) experiment mechanism reasoning; (4) raw data extraction; and (5) performance & application exploration. Our evaluation of leading MLLMs on PolyReal reveals a capability imbalance. While models perform well on knowledge-intensive reasoning (e.g., Experiment Mechanism Reasoning), they drop sharply on practice-based tasks (e.g., Lab Safety Analysis and Raw Data Extraction). This exposes a severe gap between abstract scientific knowledge and its practical, context-dependent application, showing that these real-world tasks remain challenging for MLLMs. Thus, PolyReal helps address this evaluation gap and provides a practical benchmark for assessing AI systems in real-world scientific workflows.
tldr: The paper introduces PolyReal, a multimodal benchmark to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on the full lifecycle of real-world polymer science workflows, including tasks like lab safety analysis and raw data extraction.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PolyReal，这是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在现实世界聚合物科学完整工作流程中表现的多模态基准，涵盖实验室安全分析和原始数据提取等任务。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型在通用领域表现出色，却在复杂现实科学问题中面临挑战。我们认为，聚合物科学这一横跨化学、物理、生物和工程学的交叉学科，因其丰富的多模态数据特性，可作为理想的高风险测试场。然而，现有聚合物科学相关基准大多忽视真实工作流程，既限制了其实用价值，也未能系统评估多模态大语言模型在完整实验生命周期中的实践能力。为此，我们提出基于真实科学实践的多模态基准PolyReal，从聚合物实验全生命周期评估多模态大语言模型，涵盖五大核心能力：（1）基础知识应用；（2）实验室安全分析；（3）实验机理推理；（4）原始数据提取；（5）性能与应用探索。通过对主流模型在PolyReal上的评估，我们发现其能力存在明显失衡：模型在知识密集型推理任务（如实验机理推理）中表现良好，但在实践性任务（如实验室安全分析与原始数据提取）上性能骤降。这揭示了抽象科学知识与实际情境化应用之间的严重鸿沟，表明现实科学任务对多模态大语言模型仍具挑战性。PolyReal不仅有助于弥合这一评估缺口，更为评估人工智能系统在真实科学工作流程中的表现提供了实用基准。

title: GP-4DGS: Probabilistic 4D Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Video via Variational Gaussian Processes
summary: We present GP-4DGS, a novel framework that integrates Gaussian Processes (GPs) into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) for principled probabilistic modeling of dynamic scenes. While existing 4DGS methods focus on deterministic reconstruction, they are inherently limited in capturing motion ambiguity and lack mechanisms to assess prediction reliability. By leveraging the kernel-based probabilistic nature of GPs, our approach introduces three key capabilities: (i) uncertainty quantification for motion predictions, (ii) motion estimation for unobserved or sparsely sampled regions, and (iii) temporal extrapolation beyond observed training frames. To scale GPs to the large number of Gaussian primitives in 4DGS, we design spatio-temporal kernels that capture the correlation structure of deformation fields and adopt variational Gaussian Processes with inducing points for tractable inference. Our experiments show that GP-4DGS enhances reconstruction quality while providing reliable uncertainty estimates that effectively identify regions of high motion ambiguity. By addressing these challenges, our work takes a meaningful step toward bridging probabilistic modeling and neural graphics.
tldr: This paper introduces GP-4DGS, a framework that integrates Gaussian Processes into 4D Gaussian Splatting for probabilistic modeling of dynamic scenes, providing uncertainty quantification, motion estimation for unobserved regions, and temporal extrapolation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GP-4DGS框架，将高斯过程集成到4D高斯泼溅中，用于动态场景的概率建模，提供不确定性量化、未观测区域运动估计和时序外推能力。
summary_zh: 本文提出GP-4DGS，这是一个将高斯过程（GPs）整合到4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）中的创新框架，用于实现动态场景的规范化概率建模。现有4DGS方法主要关注确定性重建，其固有局限在于难以捕捉运动模糊性，且缺乏评估预测可靠性的机制。通过利用GPs基于核函数的概率特性，我们的方法实现了三项核心功能：（1）运动预测的不确定性量化；（2）对未观测或稀疏采样区域进行运动估计；（3）在观测训练帧范围之外进行时间外推。为了将GPs扩展至4DGS中的大量高斯基元，我们设计了能够捕捉形变场相关结构的时空核函数，并采用带诱导点的变分高斯过程以实现可处理的推理。实验表明，GP-4DGS在提升重建质量的同时，能提供可靠的不确定性估计，有效识别高运动模糊性区域。通过解决这些挑战，我们的工作朝着连接概率建模与神经图形学领域迈出了重要一步。

title: SentiAvatar: Towards Expressive and Interactive Digital Humans
summary: We present SentiAvatar, a framework for building expressive interactive 3D digital humans, and use it to create SuSu, a virtual character that speaks, gestures, and emotes in real time. Achieving such a system remains challenging, as it requires jointly addressing three key problems: the lack of large-scale, high-quality multimodal data, robust semantic-to-motion mapping, and fine-grained frame-level motion-prosody synchronization. To solve these problems, first, we build SuSuInterActs (21K clips, 37 hours), a dialogue corpus captured via optical motion capture around a single character with synchronized speech, full-body motion, and facial expressions. Second, we pre-train a Motion Foundation Model on 200K+ motion sequences, equipping it with rich action priors that go well beyond the conversation. We then propose an audio-aware plan-then-infill architecture that decouples sentence-level semantic planning from frame-level prosody-driven interpolation, so that generated motions are both semantically appropriate and rhythmically aligned with speech. Experiments show that SentiAvatar achieves state-of-the-art on both SuSuInterActs (R@1 43.64%, nearly 2 times the best baseline) and BEATv2 (FGD 4.941, BC 8.078), producing 6s of output in 0.3s with unlimited multi-turn streaming. The source code, model, and dataset are available at https://sentiavatar.github.io.
tldr: Proposes SentiAvatar, a framework for creating expressive and interactive 3D digital humans by using a large-scale multimodal dataset and a motion foundation model to generate semantically appropriate and prosody-synchronized speech, gestures, and facial expressions.
tldr_zh: 提出SentiAvatar框架，用于创建富有表现力和交互性的3D数字人，通过利用大规模多模态数据集和运动基础模型，生成语义恰当且与韵律同步的语音、手势和面部表情。
summary_zh: 本文提出了SentiAvatar框架，用于构建富有表现力的交互式三维数字人，并以此创建了虚拟角色SuSu，该角色能够实时进行语音、手势和情感表达。实现此类系统仍面临挑战，需要同时解决三个关键问题：缺乏大规模高质量多模态数据、鲁棒的语义到动作映射，以及细粒度的帧级动作-韵律同步。为解决这些问题，我们首先构建了SuSuInterActs数据集（包含2.1万条片段，总计37小时），该对话语料库通过光学动作捕捉系统采集，围绕单一角色记录了同步的语音、全身动作和面部表情。其次，我们在超过20万条动作序列上预训练了运动基础模型，使其具备远超出对话场景的丰富动作先验知识。随后，我们提出了一种音频感知的"先规划后填充"架构，将句子级语义规划与帧级韵律驱动的插值过程解耦，从而确保生成的动作既符合语义语境，又能在节奏上与语音对齐。实验表明，SentiAvatar在SuSuInterActs数据集（R@1达43.64%，接近最佳基线方法的2倍）和BEATv2数据集（FGD为4.941，BC为8.078）上均达到最先进水平，仅需0.3秒即可生成6秒输出，并支持无限多轮流式生成。相关源代码、模型及数据集已公开于https://sentiavatar.github.io。

title: Progressive Video Condensation with MLLM Agent for Long-form Video Understanding
summary: Understanding long videos requires extracting query-relevant information from long sequences under tight compute budgets. Existing text-then-LLM pipelines lose fine-grained visual cues, while video-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can keep visual details but are too frame-hungry and computationally expensive. In this work, we aim to harness MLLMs for efficient video understanding. We propose ProVCA, a progressive video condensation agent that iteratively locates key video frames at multiple granularities. ProVCA first adopts a segment localization module to identify the video segment relevant to the query, then a snippet selection module to select important snippets based on similarity, and finally a keyframe refinement module to pinpoint specific keyframes in those snippets. By progressively narrowing the scope from coarse segments to fine frames, ProVCA identifies a small set of keyframes for MLLM-based reasoning. ProVCA achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracies of 69.3\% on EgoSchema, 80.5\% on NExT-QA, and 77.7\% on IntentQA, while using fewer frames than previous training-free methods.
tldr: Proposes a progressive video condensation agent (ProVCA) that uses a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to iteratively select keyframes for efficient long-form video understanding, achieving state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种渐进式视频浓缩代理（ProVCA），使用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）迭代地选择关键帧以实现高效的长视频理解，在多个基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 理解长视频需要在有限的计算资源下，从冗长序列中提取与查询相关的信息。现有的“先文本后大语言模型”流程会丢失细粒度视觉线索，而基于视频的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）虽能保留视觉细节，但所需帧数过多且计算成本高昂。本文旨在利用MLLMs实现高效视频理解，提出了ProVCA——一种渐进式视频浓缩智能体，通过多粒度迭代定位关键视频帧。ProVCA首先采用片段定位模块识别与查询相关的视频片段，继而通过片段选择模块基于相似度筛选重要片段，最后通过关键帧精炼模块在片段中精准定位特定关键帧。通过从粗粒度片段到细粒度帧的渐进式范围收缩，ProVCA能够为基于MLLM的推理过程筛选出少量关键帧。该方法在EgoSchema上达到69.3%的零样本准确率，在NExT-QA上达到80.5%，在IntentQA上达到77.7%，均取得最先进性能，且使用的帧数少于此前无需训练的方法。

title: Unlocking Positive Transfer in Incrementally Learning Surgical Instruments: A Self-reflection Hierarchical Prompt Framework
summary: To continuously enhance model adaptability in surgical video scene parsing, recent studies incrementally update it to progressively learn to segment an increasing number of surgical instruments over time. However, prior works constantly overlooked the potential of positive forward knowledge transfer, i.e., how past knowledge could help learn new classes, and positive backward knowledge transfer, i.e., how learning new classes could help refine past knowledge. In this paper, we propose a self-reflection hierarchical prompt framework that unlocks the power of positive forward and backward knowledge transfer in class incremental segmentation, aiming to proficiently learn new instruments, improve existing skills of regular instruments, and avoid catastrophic forgetting of old instruments. Our framework is built on a frozen, pre-trained model that adaptively appends instrument-aware prompts for new classes throughout training episodes. To enable positive forward knowledge transfer, we organize instrument prompts into a hierarchical prompt parsing tree with the instrument-shared prompt partition as the root node, n-part-shared prompt partitions as intermediate nodes and instrument-distinct prompt partitions as leaf nodes, to expose the reusable historical knowledge for new classes to simplify their learning. Conversely, to encourage positive backward knowledge transfer, we conduct self-reflection refining on existing knowledge by directed-weighted graph propagation, examining the knowledge associations recorded in the tree to improve its representativeness without causing catastrophic forgetting. Our framework is applicable to both CNN-based models and advanced transformer-based foundation models, yielding more than 5% and 11% improvements over the competing methods on two public benchmarks respectively.
tldr: This paper introduces a self-reflection hierarchical prompt framework for class-incremental segmentation of surgical instruments in videos, aiming to enable positive forward and backward knowledge transfer to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于手术视频中器械类别增量分割的自反思分层提示框架，旨在解锁正向和反向知识迁移，以减轻灾难性遗忘。
summary_zh:
摘要：
为持续提升手术视频场景解析中的模型适应能力，近期研究通过增量更新的方式，使模型能随时间逐步学习分割日益增多的手术器械。然而，现有研究往往忽视了正向知识迁移（即已有知识如何促进新类别学习）与反向知识迁移（即学习新类别如何优化已有知识）的潜力。本文提出一种自反思层次化提示框架，旨在释放类别增量分割中正向与反向知识迁移的效能，以熟练学习新器械、改进常规器械的现有识别能力，并避免对旧器械的灾难性遗忘。该框架基于预训练的冻结模型构建，在训练过程中自适应地为新类别添加器械感知提示。为实现正向知识迁移，我们将器械提示组织为层次化提示解析树：以器械共享提示分区为根节点，n类部件共享提示分区为中间节点，器械独有提示分区为叶节点，从而向新类别显式呈现可复用的历史知识以简化其学习过程。相反地，为促进反向知识迁移，我们通过有向加权图传播对已有知识进行自反思优化，利用解析树中记录的知识关联性提升其表征能力，同时避免灾难性遗忘。该框架兼容基于CNN的模型与先进的基于Transformer的基础模型，在两个公开基准测试中分别取得了超过现有方法5%和11%的性能提升。

title: HairOrbit: Multi-view Aware 3D Hair Modeling from Single Portraits
summary: Reconstructing strand-level 3D hair from a single-view image is highly challenging, especially when preserving consistent and realistic attributes in unseen regions. Existing methods rely on limited frontal-view cues and small-scale/style-restricted synthetic data, often failing to produce satisfactory results in invisible regions. In this work, we propose a novel framework that leverages the strong 3D priors of video generation models to transform single-view hair reconstruction into a calibrated multi-view reconstruction task. To balance reconstruction quality and efficiency for the reformulated multi-view task, we further introduce a neural orientation extractor trained on sparse real-image annotations for better full-view orientation estimation. In addition, we design a two-stage strand-growing algorithm based on a hybrid implicit field to synthesize the 3D strand curves with fine-grained details at a relatively fast speed. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on single-view 3D hair strand reconstruction on a diverse range of hair portraits in both visible and invisible regions.
tldr: Proposes a novel framework for single-view 3D hair strand reconstruction using video generation model priors to infer multi-view information and a two-stage strand-growing algorithm.
tldr_zh: 提出一种新颖的框架，利用视频生成模型的三维先验知识，将单视角头发重建任务转化为多视角重建任务，并采用两阶段发丝生长算法实现高效、高精度的三维发丝重建。
summary_zh: 从单视角图像重建发丝级三维发型是一项极具挑战性的任务，尤其在保持不可见区域属性一致性与真实感方面存在困难。现有方法依赖有限的正视角线索及小规模或风格受限的合成数据，通常在不可见区域难以生成理想效果。本研究提出一种创新框架，通过利用视频生成模型强大的三维先验知识，将单视角发型重建转化为校准化的多视角重建任务。为平衡重构任务在质量与效率上的需求，我们进一步引入基于稀疏真实图像标注训练的神经方向提取器，以实现更优的全视角方向估计。此外，我们设计了一种基于混合隐式场的双阶段发丝生长算法，能以较快的速度合成具有精细细节的三维发丝曲线。大量实验表明，本方法在多种发型肖像的可见与不可见区域均实现了单视角三维发丝重建的最优性能。

title: HiDiGen: Hierarchical Diffusion for B-Rep Generation with Explicit Topological Constraints
summary: Boundary representation (B-rep) is the standard 3D modeling format in CAD systems, encoding both geometric primitives and topological connectivity. Despite its prevalence, deep generative modeling of valid B-rep structures remains challenging due to the intricate interplay between discrete topology and continuous geometry. In this paper, we propose HiDiGen, a hierarchical generation framework that decouples geometry modeling into two stages, each guided by explicitly modeled topological constraints. Specifically, our approach first establishes face-edge incidence relations to define a coherent topological scaffold, upon which face proxies and initial edge curves are generated. Subsequently, multiple Transformer-based diffusion modules are employed to refine the geometry by generating precise face surfaces and vertex positions, with edge-vertex adjacencies dynamically established and enforced to preserve structural consistency. This progressive geometry hierarchy enables the generation of more novel and diverse shapes, while two-stage topological modeling ensures high validity. Experimental results show that HiDiGen achieves strong performance, generating novel, diverse, and topologically sound CAD models.
tldr: Proposes a hierarchical diffusion model for generating CAD models with explicit topological constraints, focusing on B-rep format generation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于生成具有明确拓扑约束的CAD模型的分层扩散模型，专注于B-rep格式生成。
summary_zh: 边界表示（B-rep）是计算机辅助设计系统中标准的3维建模格式，既编码几何图元也编码拓扑连接关系。尽管其应用广泛，但离散拓扑与连续几何之间错综复杂的相互作用使得有效B-rep结构的深度生成建模仍面临挑战。本文提出HiDiGen这一分层生成框架，将几何建模解耦为两个阶段，每个阶段均受显式建模的拓扑约束引导。具体而言，我们的方法首先建立面-边关联关系以定义连贯的拓扑骨架，在此基础上生成面代理与初始边曲线。随后，采用多个基于Transformer的扩散模块，通过生成精确的面曲面与顶点位置来细化几何形状，同时动态建立并强化边-顶点邻接关系以保持结构一致性。这种渐进式几何分层机制能够生成更具新颖性和多样性的形状，而两阶段拓扑建模则确保了模型的高有效性。实验结果表明，HiDiGen在生成新颖多样且拓扑结构健全的CAD模型方面表现出色。

title: Adaptive Local Frequency Filtering for Fourier-Encoded Implicit Neural Representations
summary: Fourier-encoded implicit neural representations (INRs) have shown strong capability in modeling continuous signals from discrete samples. However, conventional Fourier feature mappings use a fixed set of frequencies over the entire spatial domain, making them poorly suited to signals with spatially varying local spectra and often leading to slow convergence of high-frequency details. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive local frequency filtering method for Fourier-encoded INRs. The proposed method introduces a spatially varying parameter $α(\mathbf{x})$ to modulate encoded Fourier components, enabling a smooth transition among low-pass, band-pass, and high-pass behaviors at different spatial locations. We further analyze the effect of the proposed filter from the neural tangent kernel (NTK) perspective and provide an NTK-inspired interpretation of how it reshapes the effective kernel spectrum. Experiments on 2D image fitting, 3D shape representation, and sparse data reconstruction demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves reconstruction quality and leads to faster optimization compared with fixed-frequency baselines. In addition, the learned $α(\mathbf{x})$ provides an intuitive visualization of spatially varying frequency preferences, which helps explain the behavior of the model on non-stationary signals. These results indicate that adaptive local frequency modulation is a practical enhancement for Fourier-encoded INRs.
tldr: The paper proposes an adaptive local frequency filtering method for Fourier-encoded implicit neural representations to improve the modeling of signals with spatially varying local spectra, enhancing reconstruction quality and optimization speed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于傅里叶编码隐式神经表示的自适应局部频率滤波方法，旨在改进对具有空间变化局部频谱信号建模，从而提升重建质量和优化速度。
summary_zh: 傅里叶编码的隐式神经表示在从离散样本中建模连续信号方面表现出强大能力。然而，传统的傅里叶特征映射在整个空间域上使用固定的频率集，导致其难以适应具有空间变化局部频谱的信号，并常常使得高频细节的收敛速度缓慢。针对这一问题，我们提出了一种用于傅里叶编码隐式神经表示的自适应局部频率滤波方法。该方法引入了空间变化的参数$α(\mathbf{x})$来调制编码后的傅里叶分量，实现在不同空间位置上低通、带通和高通行为之间的平滑过渡。我们进一步从神经正切核的视角分析了所提滤波器的效果，并基于神经正切核理论阐释了其如何重塑有效核谱。在二维图像拟合、三维形状表示和稀疏数据重建上的实验表明，与固定频率基线方法相比，所提方法在重建质量上持续提升，并实现了更快的优化速度。此外，学习到的$α(\mathbf{x})$参数提供了对空间变化频率偏好的直观可视化，有助于解释模型在非平稳信号上的行为。这些结果表明，自适应局部频率调制是傅里叶编码隐式神经表示的一种实用增强策略。

title: CMCC-ReID: Cross-Modality Clothing-Change Person Re-Identification
summary: Person Re-Identification (ReID) faces severe challenges from modality discrepancy and clothing variation in long-term surveillance scenario. While existing studies have made significant progress in either Visible-Infrared ReID (VI-ReID) or Clothing-Change ReID (CC-ReID), real-world surveillance system often face both challenges simultaneously. To address this overlooked yet realistic problem, we define a new task, termed Cross-Modality Clothing-Change Re-Identification (CMCC-ReID), which targets pedestrian matching across variations in both modality and clothing. To advance research in this direction, we construct a new benchmark SYSU-CMCC, where each identity is captured in both visible and infrared domains with distinct outfits, reflecting the dual heterogeneity of long-term surveillance. To tackle CMCC-ReID, we propose a Progressive Identity Alignment Network (PIA) that progressively mitigates the issues of clothing variation and modality discrepancy. Specifically, a Dual-Branch Disentangling Learning (DBDL) module separates identity-related cues from clothing-related factors to achieve clothing-agnostic representation, and a Bi-Directional Prototype Learning (BPL) module performs intra-modality and inter-modality contrast in the embedding space to bridge the modality gap while further suppressing clothing interference. Extensive experiments on the SYSU-CMCC dataset demonstrate that PIA establishes a strong baseline for this new task and significantly outperforms existing methods.
tldr: The paper proposes a new task (Cross-Modality Clothing-Change Re-Identification) and benchmark for person re-identification under combined modality and clothing changes, along with a progressive learning method to address these challenges.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一项新任务（跨模态换装行人重识别）及相关基准数据集，旨在解决同时存在模态和服装变化的行人匹配问题，并设计了一种渐进式学习方法来应对这些挑战。
summary_zh: 人员重识别（ReID）在长期监控场景下面临模态差异和着装变化的严峻挑战。现有研究在可见光-红外跨模态ReID（VI-ReID）或换装ReID（CC-ReID）方面已取得显著进展，但实际监控系统往往同时面临这两类挑战。为解决这一被忽视却现实的问题，本文定义了一项新任务——跨模态换装人员重识别（CMCC-ReID），旨在实现跨模态与跨着装双重变化下的行人匹配。为推进该方向研究，我们构建了新的基准数据集SYSU-CMCC，其中每个身份均在可见光与红外模态下以不同着装被捕获，体现了长期监控中的双重异质性。针对CMCC-ReID任务，我们提出渐进式身份对齐网络（PIA），通过渐进策略同时缓解着装变化与模态差异问题。具体而言，双分支解耦学习模块（DBDL）将身份相关特征与着装相关因素分离，实现着装无关的表征学习；双向原型学习模块（BPL）在嵌入空间中进行模态内与模态间对比，以弥合模态鸿沟并进一步抑制着装干扰。在SYSU-CMCC数据集上的大量实验表明，PIA为该新任务建立了强基准模型，其性能显著优于现有方法。

title: UNICA: A Unified Neural Framework for Controllable 3D Avatars
summary: Controllable 3D human avatars have found widespread applications in 3D games, the metaverse, and AR/VR scenarios. The conventional approach to creating such a 3D avatar requires a lengthy, intricate pipeline encompassing appearance modeling, motion planning, rigging, and physical simulation. In this paper, we introduce UNICA (UNIfied neural Controllable Avatar), a skeleton-free generative model that unifies all avatar control components into a single neural framework. Given keyboard inputs akin to video game controls, UNICA generates the next frame of a 3D avatar's geometry through an action-conditioned diffusion model operating on 2D position maps. A point transformer then maps the resulting geometry to 3D Gaussian Splatting for high-fidelity free-view rendering. Our approach naturally captures hair and loose clothing dynamics without manually designed physical simulation, and supports extra-long autoregressive generation. To the best of our knowledge, UNICA is the first model to unify the workflow of "motion planning, rigging, physical simulation, and rendering". Code is released at https://github.com/zjh21/UNICA.
tldr: UNICA is a skeleton-free generative model for controllable 3D human avatars that unifies motion planning, geometry generation, and rendering into a single neural framework, driven by action-conditioned diffusion.
tldr_zh: UNICA是一个用于可控3D人体化身、无骨骼的生成模型，它将动作规划、几何生成和渲染统一到一个单一的神经框架中，由动作条件扩散模型驱动。
summary_zh: 可控三维人体角色在三维游戏、元宇宙及增强现实/虚拟现实场景中有着广泛应用。创建此类三维角色的传统方法需要经历冗长复杂的流程，包括外观建模、运动规划、骨骼绑定与物理模拟。本文提出UNICA（统一神经可控角色）——一种免骨骼的生成模型，该模型将所有角色控制组件整合至统一的神经框架中。通过接收类似视频游戏控制的键盘输入，UNICA利用基于二维位置图构建的动作条件扩散模型，生成三维角色几何的下一帧。随后通过点变换器将生成的几何映射至三维高斯溅射模型，实现高保真度的自由视角渲染。该方法无需手动设计物理模拟即可自然捕捉头发与宽松衣物的动态效果，并支持超长序列自回归生成。据我们所知，UNICA是首个将"运动规划、骨骼绑定、物理模拟与渲染"工作流程完全统一的模型。代码已发布于https://github.com/zjh21/UNICA。

title: CANDLE: Illumination-Invariant Semantic Priors for Color Ambient Lighting Normalization
summary: Color ambient lighting normalization under multi-colored illumination is challenging due to severe chromatic shifts, highlight saturation, and material-dependent reflectance. Existing geometric and low-level priors are insufficient for recovering object-intrinsic color when illumination-induced chromatic bias dominates. We observe that DINOv3's self-supervised features remain highly consistent between colored-light inputs and ambient-lit ground truth, motivating their use as illumination-robust semantic priors. We propose CANDLE (Color Ambient Normalization with DINO Layer Enhancement), which introduces DINO Omni-layer Guidance (D.O.G.) to adaptively inject multi-layer DINOv3 features into successive encoder stages, and a color-frequency refinement design (BFACG + SFFB) to suppress decoder-side chromatic collapse and detail contamination. Experiments on CL3AN show a +1.22 dB PSNR gain over the strongest prior method. CANDLE achieves 3rd place on the NTIRE 2026 ALN Color Lighting Challenge and 2nd place in fidelity on the White Lighting track with the lowest FID, confirming strong generalization across both chromatic and luminance-dominant illumination conditions. Code is available at https://github.com/ron941/CANDLE.
tldr: A method using DINOv3 features to normalize colors under multi-colored ambient lighting, improving image fidelity by suppressing illumination artifacts.
tldr_zh: 一种利用DINOv3特征在多色环境光下进行颜色归一化的方法，通过抑制光照伪影来提高图像保真度。
summary_zh: 多色照明下的环境光颜色归一化因严重的色偏、高光饱和及材料依赖的反射特性而极具挑战性。当照明引起的色偏占据主导时，现有几何先验与低层先验难以恢复物体本质颜色。我们发现DINOv3的自监督特征在彩色光输入与环境光真实场景间保持高度一致性，这启发了我们将这些特征作为光照鲁棒的语义先验。本文提出CANDLE（基于DINO层增强的颜色环境光归一化方法），引入DINO全层引导机制，自适应地将多层DINOv3特征注入连续编码器阶段，并通过颜色频率优化设计抑制解码端的色度崩溃与细节污染。在CL3AN数据集上的实验表明，本方法比现有最优方法提升1.22 dB PSNR。CANDLE在NTIRE 2026 ALN彩色照明挑战赛中获得第三名，在白光照明赛道取得保真度第二名及最低FID分数，证实了其在色度主导与亮度主导的照明条件下均具备强大泛化能力。代码发布于https://github.com/ron941/CANDLE。

title: EnsemHalDet: Robust VLM Hallucination Detection via Ensemble of Internal State Detectors
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at multimodal tasks, but they remain vulnerable to hallucinations that are factually incorrect or ungrounded in the input image. Recent work suggests that hallucination detection using internal representations is more efficient and accurate than approaches that rely solely on model outputs. However, existing internal-representation-based methods typically rely on a single representation or detector, limiting their ability to capture diverse hallucination signals. In this paper, we propose EnsemHalDet, an ensemble-based hallucination detection framework that leverages multiple internal representations of VLMs, including attention outputs and hidden states. EnsemHalDet trains independent detectors for each representation and combines them through ensemble learning. Experimental results across multiple VQA datasets and VLMs show that EnsemHalDet consistently outperforms prior methods and single-detector models in terms of AUC. These results demonstrate that ensembling diverse internal signals significantly improves robustness in multimodal hallucination detection.
tldr: This paper proposes EnsemHalDet, a framework for detecting hallucinations in Vision-Language Models by ensembling detectors based on multiple internal representations, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 EnsemHalDet，一个通过集成基于多种内部表示检测器的视觉语言模型幻觉检测框架，实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态任务中表现出色，但其仍存在产生事实性错误或缺乏输入图像依据的幻觉问题。近期研究表明，基于内部表征的幻觉检测方法比仅依赖模型输出的方法更为高效和准确。然而，现有基于内部表征的方法通常依赖单一表征或检测器，限制了其捕获多样化幻觉信号的能力。本文提出EensemHalDet——一种基于集成的幻觉检测框架，该框架利用了VLM的多种内部表征（包括注意力输出与隐藏状态）。EensemHalDet为每种表征训练独立检测器，并通过集成学习进行融合。在多个视觉问答数据集及不同VLM上的实验结果表明，EensemHalDet在AUC指标上始终优于现有方法及单检测器模型。这些结果证明，融合多样化的内部信号能显著提升多模态幻觉检测的鲁棒性。

title: InverseDraping: Recovering Sewing Patterns from 3D Garment Surfaces via BoxMesh Bridging
summary: Recovering sewing patterns from draped 3D garments is a challenging problem in human digitization research. In contrast to the well-studied forward process of draping designed sewing patterns using mature physical simulation engines, the inverse process of recovering parametric 2D patterns from deformed garment geometry remains fundamentally ill-posed for existing methods. We propose a two-stage framework that centers on a structured intermediate representation, BoxMesh, which serves as the key to bridging the gap between 3D garment geometry and parametric sewing patterns. BoxMesh encodes both garment-level geometry and panel-level structure in 3D, while explicitly disentangling intrinsic panel geometry and stitching topology from draping-induced deformations. This representation imposes a physically grounded structure on the problem, significantly reducing ambiguity. In Stage I, a geometry-driven autoregressive model infers BoxMesh from the input 3D garment. In Stage II, a semantics-aware autoregressive model parses BoxMesh into parametric sewing patterns. We adopt autoregressive modeling to naturally handle the variable-length and structured nature of panel configurations and stitching relationships. This decomposition separates geometric inversion from structured pattern inference, leading to more accurate and robust recovery. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GarmentCodeData benchmark and generalizes effectively to real-world scans and single-view images.
tldr: This paper proposes a two-stage method, InverseDraping, to recover 2D sewing patterns from 3D garment surfaces using a structured intermediate representation called BoxMesh, which disentangles panel geometry from draping deformations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为InverseDraping的两阶段方法，通过一种名为BoxMesh的结构化中间表示，从3D服装表面恢复2D缝纫图案，解开了面板几何与悬垂变形。
summary_zh: 从悬垂的3D服装中恢复缝纫版型是人体数字化研究中一个具有挑战性的问题。相较于利用成熟的物理模拟引擎对设计好的缝纫版型进行悬垂模拟这一已被充分研究的正向过程，现有方法从变形后的服装几何结构中恢复参数化二维版型的逆向过程本质上仍是一个不适定问题。我们提出了一个两阶段框架，其核心是一种结构化的中间表示——BoxMesh，它作为连接3D服装几何结构与参数化缝纫版型的关键桥梁。BoxMesh在三维空间中同时编码服装级别的几何信息和裁片级别的结构信息，同时显式地将裁片固有几何特征与缝合拓扑结构从悬垂引起的变形中解耦。这种表示方式为问题赋予了基于物理意义的结构，显著降低了不确定性。在第一阶段，一个几何驱动的自回归模型从输入的3D服装中推断出BoxMesh。在第二阶段，一个语义感知的自回归模型将BoxMesh解析为参数化缝纫版型。我们采用自回归建模方法，自然地处理裁片配置与缝合关系的变长结构化特性。这种分解方式将几何反演与结构化版型推理分离，实现了更准确、更稳健的恢复效果。大量实验表明，我们的方法在GarmentCodeData基准测试中达到了最先进的性能，并能有效推广到真实世界扫描数据和单视图图像。

title: Drift-Resilient Temporal Priors for Visual Tracking
summary: Temporal information is crucial for visual tracking, but existing multi-frame trackers are vulnerable to model drift caused by naively aggregating noisy historical predictions. In this paper, we introduce DTPTrack, a lightweight and generalizable module designed to be seamlessly integrated into existing trackers to suppress drift. Our framework consists of two core components: (1) a Temporal Reliability Calibrator (TRC) mechanism that learns to assign a per-frame reliability score to historical states, filtering out noise while anchoring on the ground-truth template; and (2) a Temporal Guidance Synthesizer (TGS) module that synthesizes this calibrated history into a compact set of dynamic temporal priors to provide predictive guidance. To demonstrate its versatility, we integrate DTPTrack into three diverse tracking architectures--OSTrack, ODTrack, and LoRAT-and show consistent, significant performance gains across all baselines. Our best-performing model, built upon an extended LoRATv2 backbone, sets a new state-of-the-art on several benchmarks, achieving a 77.5% Success rate on LaSOT and an 80.3% AO on GOT-10k.
tldr: This paper presents DTPTrack, a module for visual tracking that uses calibrated temporal priors to suppress model drift, showing improved performance on standard tracking benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DTPTrack，一种用于视觉跟踪的模块，它利用校准后的时间先验来抑制模型漂移，在标准跟踪基准上展示了性能提升。
summary_zh: 时序信息对于视觉跟踪至关重要，但现有多帧跟踪器容易因简单聚合带噪历史预测而导致模型漂移。本文提出DTPTrack，一种轻量级且可泛化的模块，可无缝集成到现有跟踪器中以抑制漂移。我们的框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 时序可靠性校准机制，通过逐帧学习历史状态的可靠性分数，在锚定真实模板的同时过滤噪声；(2) 时序引导合成模块，将校准后的历史信息合成紧凑的动态时序先验，以提供预测性引导。为验证其通用性，我们将DTPTrack集成到三种不同跟踪架构——OSTrack、ODTrack和LoRAT中，所有基线模型均获得显著且一致的性能提升。基于扩展版LoRATv2架构的最佳模型在多个基准测试中创下新纪录，在LaSOT上达到77.5%的成功率，在GOT-10k上获得80.3%的AO得分。

title: FusionBERT: Multi-View Image-3D Retrieval via Cross-Attention Visual Fusion and Normal-Aware 3D Encoder
summary: We propose FusionBERT, a novel multi-view visual fusion framework for image-3D multimodal retrieval. Existing image-3D representation learning methods predominantly focus on feature alignment of a single object image and its 3D model, limiting their applicability in realistic scenarios where an object is typically observed and captured from multiple viewpoints. Although multi-view observations naturally provide complementary geometric and appearance cues, existing multimodal large models rarely explore how to effectively fuse such multi-view visual information for better cross-modal retrieval. To address this limitation, we introduce a multi-view image-3D retrieval framework named FusionBERT, which innovatively utilizes a cross-attention-based multi-view visual aggregator to adaptively integrate features from multi-view images of an object. The proposed multi-view visual encoder fuses inter-view complementary relationships and selectively emphasizes informative visual cues across multiple views to get a more robustly fused visual feature for better 3D model matching. Furthermore, FusionBERT proposes a normal-aware 3D model encoder that can further enhance the 3D geometric feature of an object model by jointly encoding point normals and 3D positions, enabling a more robust representation learning for textureless or color-degraded 3D models. Extensive image-3D retrieval experiments demonstrate that FusionBERT achieves significantly higher retrieval accuracy than SOTA multimodal large models under both single-view and multi-view settings, establishing a strong baseline for multi-view multimodal retrieval.
tldr: Proposes FusionBERT, a multi-view image-3D retrieval framework using cross-attention to fuse multi-view image features and a normal-aware 3D encoder for robust cross-modal retrieval.
tldr_zh: 提出了FusionBERT框架，通过跨注意力融合多视角图像特征和法向感知的3D编码器，用于鲁棒的图像-3D模型跨模态检索。
summary_zh: 我们提出FusionBERT，一种新颖的多视角视觉融合框架，用于图像-3D多模态检索。现有的图像-3D表征学习方法主要集中于单视角物体图像与其3D模型的特征对齐，这限制了其在现实场景中的适用性——现实中物体通常需要从多视角进行观察与捕捉。尽管多视角观测天然提供了互补的几何与外观线索，现有多模态大模型却很少探索如何有效融合此类多视角视觉信息以提升跨模态检索性能。为突破这一局限，我们提出了名为FusionBERT的多视角图像-3D检索框架，其创新性地采用基于交叉注意力的多视角视觉聚合器，自适应地整合物体多视角图像特征。该多视角视觉编码器通过融合视角间的互补关系，选择性地强调跨多视角的信息化视觉线索，从而获得更鲁棒的融合视觉特征，以提升3D模型匹配精度。此外，FusionBERT提出了一种法向感知的3D模型编码器，通过联合编码点云法向与三维位置信息，进一步增强物体模型的3D几何特征，从而为缺乏纹理或颜色退化的3D模型实现更鲁棒的表征学习。大量的图像-3D检索实验表明，FusionBERT在单视角与多视角设置下均显著优于现有最先进的多模态大模型，为多视角多模态检索建立了强有力的基准。

title: WSVD: Weighted Low-Rank Approximation for Fast and Efficient Execution of Low-Precision Vision-Language Models
summary: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) has become an important technique for reducing the computational burden of Vision Language Models (VLMs), which play a central role in tasks such as image captioning and visual question answering. Although multiple prior works have proposed efficient SVD variants to enable low-rank operations, we find that in practice it remains difficult to achieve substantial latency reduction during model execution. To address this limitation, we introduce a new computational pattern and apply SVD at a finer granularity, enabling real and measurable improvements in execution latency. Furthermore, recognizing that weight elements differ in their relative importance, we adaptively allocate relative importance to each element during SVD process to better preserve accuracy, then extend this framework with quantization applied to both weights and activations, resulting in a highly efficient VLM. Collectively, we introduce~\textit{Weighted SVD} (WSVD), which outperforms other approaches by achieving over $1.8\times$ decoding speedup while preserving accuracy. We open source our code at: \href{https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/WSVD}{\texttt{https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/WSVD}
tldr: The paper introduces WSVD, a weighted low-rank approximation method for efficient execution of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) through fine-grained SVD and quantization, achieving decoding speedup.
tldr_zh: 本文提出WSVD，一种通过细粒度SVD和量化的加权低秩近似方法，用于高效执行视觉语言模型，实现解码加速。
summary_zh: 奇异值分解（SVD）已成为减轻视觉语言模型（VLMs）计算负担的重要技术，该模型在图像描述和视觉问答等任务中发挥着核心作用。尽管先前多项研究已提出高效的SVD变体以实现低秩运算，但实际应用中，在模型执行期间仍难以显著降低延迟。针对这一局限，本文提出了一种新的计算模式，并在更细粒度上应用SVD，从而实现了执行延迟的实际可测量改进。进一步地，鉴于权重元素的重要性存在差异，我们在SVD过程中自适应地为每个元素分配相对重要性以更好地保持精度，随后将该框架扩展至权重与激活值的量化，最终构建出高效的视觉语言模型。整体上，我们提出的《加权奇异值分解》（WSVD）方法在保持精度的同时，实现了超过1.8倍的解码加速，其性能优于其他方法。代码已开源：https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/WSVD。

title: Overconfidence and Calibration in Medical VQA: Empirical Findings and Hallucination-Aware Mitigation
summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in clinical decision support, more than accuracy is required: knowing when to trust their predictions is equally critical. Yet, a comprehensive and systematic investigation into the overconfidence of these models remains notably scarce in the medical domain. We address this gap through a comprehensive empirical study of confidence calibration in VLMs, spanning three model families (Qwen3-VL, InternVL3, LLaVA-NeXT), three model scales (2B--38B), and multiple confidence estimation prompting strategies, across three medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks. Our study yields three key findings: First, overconfidence persists across model families and is not resolved by scaling or prompting, such as chain-of-thought and verbalized confidence variants. Second, simple post-hoc calibration approaches, such as Platt scaling, reduce calibration error and consistently outperform the prompt-based strategy. Third, due to their (strict) monotonicity, these post-hoc calibration methods are inherently limited in improving the discriminative quality of predictions, leaving AUROC at the same level. Motivated by these findings, we investigate hallucination-aware calibration (HAC), which incorporates vision-grounded hallucination detection signals as complementary inputs to refine confidence estimates. We find that leveraging these hallucination signals improves both calibration and AUROC, with the largest gains on open-ended questions. Overall, our findings suggest post-hoc calibration as standard practice for medical VLM deployment over raw confidence estimates, and highlight the practical usefulness of hallucination signals to enable more reliable use of VLMs in medical VQA.
tldr: This paper investigates confidence calibration and overconfidence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) applied to medical Visual Question Answering (VQA). It finds post-hoc calibration methods like Platt scaling and hallucination-aware techniques improve calibration and reliability for clinical decision support.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了应用于医疗视觉问答（VQA）的视觉语言模型（VLM）中的置信度校准和过度自信问题。研究发现，Platt scaling等事后校准方法及幻觉感知技术能提高临床决策支持中的校准和可靠性。
summary_zh: 随着视觉语言模型在临床决策支持中的应用日益广泛，其需求已超越单纯准确率——了解何时信任模型预测变得同等重要。然而，在医学领域中，对这些模型过度自信问题的全面系统性研究仍明显匮乏。我们通过一项针对视觉语言模型置信度校准的综合性实证研究填补这一空白，该研究涵盖三个模型家族（Qwen3-VL、InternVL3、LLaVA-NeXT）、三种模型规模（20亿至380亿参数）以及多种置信度估计提示策略，并在三个医学视觉问答基准测试中进行验证。我们的研究得出三个关键发现：首先，过度自信现象普遍存在于各模型家族中，且无法通过扩大模型规模或改进提示策略（如思维链和语言化置信度变体）解决。其次，简单的后处理校准方法（如普拉特缩放法）能有效降低校准误差，且持续优于基于提示的策略。第三，由于这些后处理校准方法具有严格单调性，其在提升预测判别质量方面存在固有局限，无法改善AUROC指标。基于这些发现，我们探索了幻觉感知校准方法，该方法通过融合视觉基础幻觉检测信号作为补充输入来优化置信度估计。研究发现，利用幻觉信号可同时提升校准效果和AUROC指标，尤其在开放性问题中获得最大增益。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，在医学视觉语言模型部署中，后处理校准应作为原始置信度估计的标准实践，同时凸显了幻觉信号对提升医学视觉问答场景中模型可靠性的实用价值。

title: VLMs Need Words: Vision Language Models Ignore Visual Detail In Favor of Semantic Anchors
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) achieve impressive performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, on some tasks that demand fine-grained visual perception, they often fail even when the required information is present in their internal representations. In this work, we demonstrate that this gap arises from their narrow training pipeline which focuses on moving visual information to the textual space. Consequently, VLMs can only reason about visual entities that can be mapped to known concepts in the language space, leaving vision-focused tasks such as visual correspondence and reasoning about novel visual entities poorly supported. As a result, VLMs are severely limited in several important multimodal capabilities because they rely on brittle, hallucinated textual descriptions of visual entities that they cannot map to textual representations. We verify this behavior through visual correspondence tasks, in which VLMs must detect matching entities between two images. Testing across semantic, shape, and face correspondence tasks, we find that VLMs perform much better when the relevant entities are nameable in language than when they are unnameable. Mechanistically, our Logit Lens analyses confirm that VLMs explicitly assign semantic labels to nameable entities and surface more unique corresponding tokens compared to unnameable entities. Furthermore, we show that teaching completely arbitrary names for unknown entities improves performance, yet task-specific finetuning yields even stronger generalization without relying on language priors. Our findings suggest that current VLM failures on visual tasks reflect learned shortcuts from their training, rather than a fundamental limitation of multimodal architectures.
tldr: The paper investigates a fundamental limitation of Vision Language Models (VLMs), showing they rely on semantic language anchors and struggle with fine-grained visual tasks when entities are unnameable, suggesting this is a training artifact rather than an architectural flaw.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）的一个根本性局限，表明它们依赖语义语言锚点，在处理无法命名的实体时，在细粒度视觉任务上表现不佳，这被认为是训练过程的产物而非架构缺陷。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在众多多模态任务中展现出卓越性能。然而，在面对需要精细视觉感知的任务时，即使其内部表征已包含所需信息，这些模型仍常常失败。本研究揭示了这一缺陷源于其狭隘的训练流程——该流程主要关注将视觉信息迁移至文本空间。因此，视觉语言模型仅能对可映射到语言空间已知概念的视觉实体进行推理，导致其难以有效支持视觉对应任务及针对新颖视觉实体的推理。这种局限性严重制约了模型在多项关键多模态能力上的表现，因为其依赖于对无法映射为文本表征的视觉实体所生成的脆弱且易产生幻觉的文本描述。我们通过视觉对应任务验证了该现象：当要求模型检测两幅图像间的匹配实体时，在语义、形状和人脸对应任务中，视觉语言模型对可命名实体的处理能力显著优于不可命名实体。机制层面，通过逻辑透镜分析发现，模型会为可命名实体显式分配语义标签，并产生比不可命名实体更具区分度的对应表征标记。进一步研究表明，为未知实体赋予任意命名能提升模型性能，而针对特定任务的微调则可在不依赖语言先验的情况下实现更强的泛化能力。我们的发现表明，当前视觉语言模型在视觉任务上的失败反映了其训练过程中习得的捷径策略，而非多模态架构的根本性局限。

title: Learning the Signature of Memorization in Autoregressive Language Models
summary: All prior membership inference attacks for fine-tuned language models use hand-crafted heuristics (e.g., loss thresholding, Min-K\%, reference calibration), each bounded by the designer's intuition. We introduce the first transferable learned attack, enabled by the observation that fine-tuning any model on any corpus yields unlimited labeled data, since membership is known by construction. This removes the shadow model bottleneck and brings membership inference into the deep learning era: learning what matters rather than designing it, with generalization through training diversity and scale. We discover that fine-tuning language models produces an invariant signature of memorization detectable across architectural families and data domains. We train a membership inference classifier exclusively on transformer-based models. It transfers zero-shot to Mamba (state-space), RWKV-4 (linear attention), and RecurrentGemma (gated recurrence), achieving 0.963, 0.972, and 0.936 AUC respectively. Each evaluation combines an architecture and dataset never seen during training, yet all three exceed performance on held-out transformers (0.908 AUC). These four families share no computational mechanisms, their only commonality is gradient descent on cross-entropy loss. Even simple likelihood-based methods exhibit strong transfer, confirming the signature exists independently of the detection method. Our method, Learned Transfer MIA (LT-MIA), captures this signal most effectively by reframing membership inference as sequence classification over per-token distributional statistics. On transformers, LT-MIA achieves 2.8$\times$ higher TPR at 0.1\% FPR than the strongest baseline. The method also transfers to code (0.865 AUC) despite training only on natural language texts. Code and trained classifier available at https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/learned-mia.
tldr: This paper introduces a learned, transferable membership inference attack (LT-MIA) for autoregressive language models that identifies a 'signature of memorization' across different model architectures, reframing the problem as sequence classification over per-token statistics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自回归语言模型的可学习、可迁移的成员推理攻击（LT-MIA），该方法通过序列分类捕捉不同模型架构中普遍存在的'记忆特征'。
summary_zh: 摘要：所有先前针对微调语言模型的成员推断攻击均采用手工设计的启发式方法（如损失阈值法、Min-K%法、参考校准法），其性能受限于设计者的直觉。我们首次提出一种可迁移的学习型攻击方法，其核心依据是：对任何模型在任何语料上进行微调时，由于构造过程已知成员身份，因此可产生无限量的标注数据。这消除了传统“影子模型”的瓶颈，使成员推断进入深度学习时代——通过训练多样性与规模实现泛化，学习关键特征而非依赖人工设计。我们发现，微调语言模型会产生一种可跨架构族与数据域检测的记忆化不变特征。我们仅在基于Transformer的模型上训练了一个成员推断分类器。该分类器在Mamba（状态空间模型）、RWKV-4（线性注意力机制）和RecurrentGemma（门控循环结构）上实现了零样本迁移，分别达到0.963、0.972和0.936的AUC值。每个评估任务结合了训练中从未见过的架构与数据集，但三者性能均超过在预留Transformer模型上的表现（0.908 AUC）。这四类架构在计算机制上毫无共同点，其唯一共性是基于交叉熵损失的梯度下降优化。即使简单的基于似然的方法也展现出强大的迁移能力，证实该特征独立于检测方法而存在。我们提出的方法——可迁移学习型成员推断攻击（LT-MIA），通过将成员推断重构为基于每词元分布统计量的序列分类任务，最有效地捕捉了这一信号。在Transformer模型上，LT-MIA在0.1%假正例率下实现了比最强基线高2.8倍的真正例率。尽管仅在自然语言文本上训练，该方法仍能迁移至代码领域（0.865 AUC）。代码与训练好的分类器已开源：https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/learned-mia。

title: Inversion-Free Natural Gradient Descent on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: The natural gradient method is widely used in statistical optimization, but its standard formulation assumes a Euclidean parameter space. This paper proposes an inversion-free stochastic natural gradient method for probability distributions whose parameters lie on a Riemannian manifold. The manifold setting offers several advantages: one can implicitly enforce parameter constraints such as positive definiteness and orthogonality, ensure parameters are identifiable, or guarantee regularity properties of the objective like geodesic convexity. Building on an intrinsic formulation of the Fisher information matrix (FIM) on a manifold, our method maintains an online approximation of the inverse FIM, which is efficiently updated at quadratic cost using score vectors sampled at successive iterates. In the Riemannian setting, these score vectors belong to different tangent spaces and must be combined using transport operations. We prove almost-sure convergence rates of $O(\log{s}/s^α)$ for the squared distance to the minimizer when the step size exponent $α>2/3$. We also establish almost-sure rates for the approximate FIM, which now accumulates transport-based errors. A limited-memory variant of the algorithm with sub-quadratic storage complexity is proposed. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method relative to its Euclidean counterparts on variational Bayes with Gaussian approximations and normalizing flows.
tldr: This paper proposes a stochastic natural gradient optimization method for parameters on Riemannian manifolds, eliminating the need for costly matrix inversion and proving convergence rates, with applications shown in variational inference.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种黎曼流形上的无逆随机自然梯度优化方法，避免了昂贵的矩阵求逆，并证明了其收敛率，应用于变分推断等任务。
summary_zh: 自然梯度方法在统计优化中应用广泛，但其标准形式通常假设参数空间为欧几里得结构。本文针对参数位于黎曼流形上的概率分布，提出了一种无需显式求逆的随机自然梯度方法。流形框架具有多重优势：能够隐式地强制参数约束（如正定性与正交性），确保参数的可识别性，并保证目标函数满足测地凸性等正则性质。基于流形上费希尔信息矩阵（FIM）的内蕴表述，本方法通过连续迭代中采样的评分向量，以二次计算代价在线更新逆FIM的近似值。在黎曼流形框架中，这些评分向量分属于不同的切空间，必须通过传输操作进行组合。我们证明了当步长指数α>2/3时，算法到最小化点的平方距离具有几乎必然的收敛速率O(log s/s^α)。同时建立了近似FIM的几乎必然收敛速率，此时误差积累包含传输过程引入的误差。本文进一步提出具有次二次存储复杂度的有限内存算法变体。最后，通过在高斯近似变分贝叶斯与归一化流模型上的实验，验证了本方法相较于欧几里得版本的有效性。

title: VoxelCodeBench: Benchmarking 3D World Modeling Through Code Generation
summary: Evaluating code generation models for 3D spatial reasoning requires executing generated code in realistic environments and assessing outputs beyond surface-level correctness. We introduce a platform VoxelCode, for analyzing code generation capabilities for 3D understanding and environment creation. Our platform integrates natural language task specification, API-driven code execution in Unreal Engine, and a unified evaluation pipeline supporting both automated metrics and human assessment. To demonstrate its utility, we construct VoxelCodeBench, a benchmark of voxel manipulation tasks spanning three reasoning dimensions: symbolic interpretation, geometric construction, and artistic composition. Evaluating leading code generation models, we find that producing executable code is far easier than producing spatially correct outputs, with geometric construction and multi-object composition proving particularly challenging. By open-sourcing our platform and benchmark, we provide the community with extensible infrastructure for developing new 3D code generation benchmarks and probing spatial reasoning in future models.
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark and platform for evaluating code generation models on 3D spatial reasoning tasks, focusing on manipulating voxel environments in Unreal Engine. It is primarily about AI for 3D world understanding and code generation, not direct robot control or embodiment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于评估代码生成模型在3D空间推理任务中性能的基准和平台，专注于在虚幻引擎中操作体素环境。其核心是用于3D世界理解和代码生成的人工智能，而非直接的机器人控制或具身智能。
summary_zh: 评估三维空间推理的代码生成模型需要在真实环境中执行生成代码，并超越表层正确性评估输出结果。我们提出了VoxelCode平台，用于分析三维理解和环境构建的代码生成能力。该平台集成了自然语言任务描述、基于Unreal Engine的API驱动代码执行，以及支持自动指标与人工评估的统一评测流程。为验证其有效性，我们构建了VoxelCodeBench基准测试集，涵盖体素操控任务的三个推理维度：符号解释、几何构建与艺术创作。通过对主流代码生成模型的评估，我们发现生成可执行代码的难度远低于生成空间关系正确的输出，其中几何构建和多对象组合任务尤其具有挑战性。通过开源平台与基准测试集，我们为研究社区提供了可扩展的基础设施，以开发新的三维代码生成基准测试，并探索未来模型的空间推理能力。

title: Fast NF4 Dequantization Kernels for Large Language Model Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have grown beyond the memory capacity of single GPU devices, necessitating quantization techniques for practical deployment. While NF4 (4-bit NormalFloat) quantization enables 4$\times$ memory reduction, inference on current NVIDIA GPUs (e.g., Ampere A100) requires expensive dequantization back to FP16 format, creating a critical performance bottleneck. This paper presents a lightweight shared memory optimization that addresses this gap through principled memory hierarchy exploitation while maintaining full ecosystem compatibility. We compare our technique against the open-source BitsAndBytes implementation, achieving 2.0--2.2$\times$ kernel speedup across three models (Gemma 27B, Qwen3 32B, and Llama3.3 70B) and up to 1.54$\times$ end-to-end improvement by leveraging the 12--15$\times$ latency advantage of shared memory over global memory access. Our optimization reduces instruction counts through simplified indexing logic while using only 64 bytes of shared memory per thread block, demonstrating that lightweight optimizations can deliver substantial performance gains with minimal engineering effort. This work provides a plug-and-play solution for the HuggingFace ecosystem that democratizes access to advanced models on existing GPU infrastructure.
tldr: This paper presents a fast kernel optimization for NF4 dequantization in LLM inference, achieving up to 2.2x speedup on GPUs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于LLM推理中NF4反量化的快速内核优化方法，在GPU上实现了高达2.2倍的速度提升。
summary_zh: 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）的发展已超出单GPU设备的内存容量，实际部署中必须采用量化技术。尽管NF4（4位NormalFloat）量化可实现4倍内存压缩，但在当前NVIDIA GPU（如Ampere A100）上进行推理时，仍需将数据反量化为FP16格式，这一过程消耗高昂并形成关键性能瓶颈。本文提出一种轻量级共享内存优化方案，通过系统化利用内存层次结构来解决此问题，同时保持完整的生态兼容性。我们基于开源框架BitsAndBytes实现对比实验，在三个模型（Gemma 27B、Qwen3 32B和Llama3.3 70B）上取得2.0--2.2倍核函数加速，并借助共享内存相较于全局内存访问12--15倍的延迟优势，实现最高1.54倍的端到端性能提升。该优化方案通过简化索引逻辑减少指令数量，每个线程块仅需64字节共享内存，证明了轻量级优化能以最小工程代价带来显著性能增益。本工作为HuggingFace生态提供即插即用解决方案，使现有GPU基础设施能够更高效地运行先进模型。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: A Statistical Perspective
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a central framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. Despite its practical success, RLHF raises fundamental statistical questions because it relies on noisy, subjective, and often heterogeneous feedback to learn reward models and optimize policies. This survey provides a statistical perspective on RLHF, focusing primarily on the LLM alignment setting. We introduce the main components of RLHF, including supervised fine-tuning, reward modeling, and policy optimization, and relate them to familiar statistical ideas such as Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) model, latent utility estimation, active learning, experimental design, and uncertainty quantification. We review methods for learning reward functions from pairwise preference data and for optimizing policies through both two-stage RLHF pipelines and emerging one-stage approaches such as direct preference optimization. We further discuss recent extensions including reinforcement learning from AI feedback, inference-time algorithms, and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, as well as benchmark datasets, evaluation protocols, and open-source frameworks that support RLHF research. We conclude by highlighting open challenges in RLHF. An accompanying GitHub demo https://github.com/Pangpang-Liu/RLHF_demo illustrates key components of the RLHF pipeline.
tldr: This is a survey paper providing a statistical perspective on Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), focusing on its use in aligning large language models with human preferences.
tldr_zh: 这是一篇调查论文，从统计学的角度审视基于人类反馈的强化学习，主要关注其在大型语言模型与人类偏好对齐中的应用。
summary_zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习已成为将大语言模型与人类偏好对齐的核心框架。尽管在实际应用中取得了成功，但RLHF提出了根本性的统计学问题，因为它依赖嘈杂、主观且通常具有异质性的反馈来学习奖励模型和优化策略。本文从统计学视角对RLHF进行综述，主要聚焦于大语言模型对齐场景。我们介绍了RLHF的核心组成部分，包括监督微调、奖励建模和策略优化，并将其与布拉德利-特里-卢斯模型、潜在效用估计、主动学习、实验设计及不确定性量化等经典统计学概念建立联系。我们系统回顾了基于成对偏好数据学习奖励函数的方法，以及通过两阶段RLHF流程与直接偏好优化等新兴单阶段方法进行策略优化的技术。进一步探讨了包括基于AI反馈的强化学习、推理时算法、可验证奖励强化学习在内的最新扩展方向，同时梳理了支持RLHF研究的基准数据集、评估协议和开源框架。最后，我们着重指出了RLHF领域面临的开放性挑战。随附的GitHub演示项目https://github.com/Pangpang-Liu/RLHF_demo直观展示了RLHF流程的关键组件。

title: An Asynchronous Two-Speed Kalman Filter for Real-Time UUV Cooperative Navigation Under Acoustic Delays
summary: In GNSS-denied underwater environments, individual unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) suffer from unbounded dead-reckoning drift, making collaborative navigation crucial for accurate state estimation. However, the severe communication delay inherent in underwater acoustic channels poses serious challenges to real-time state estimation. Traditional filters, such as Extended Kalman Filters (EKF) or Unscented Kalman Filters (UKF), usually block the main control loop while waiting for delayed data, or completely discard Out-of-Sequence Measurements (OOSM), resulting in serious drift. To address this, we propose an Asynchronous Two-Speed Kalman Filter (TSKF) enhanced by a novel projection mechanism, which we term Variational History Distillation (VHD). The proposed architecture decouples the estimation process into two parallel threads: a fast-rate thread that utilizes Gaussian Process (GP) compensated dead reckoning to guarantee high-frequency real-time control, and a slow-rate thread dedicated to processing asynchronously delayed collaborative information. By introducing a finite-length State Buffer, the algorithm applies delayed measurements (t-T) to their corresponding historical states, and utilizes a VHD-based projection to fast-forward the correction to the current time without computationally heavy recalculations. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed TSKF maintains trajectory Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) comparable to computationally intensive batch-optimization methods under severe delays (up to 30 s). Executing in sub-millisecond time, it significantly outperforms standard EKF/UKF. The results demonstrate an effective control, communication, and computing (3C) co-design that significantly enhances the resilience of autonomous marine automation systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a Two-Speed Kalman Filter with Variational History Distillation for real-time cooperative navigation of Unmanned Underwater Vehicles, specifically addressing the challenge of acoustic communication delays to maintain control loop performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种带变分历史蒸馏的双速卡尔曼滤波器，用于解决水下声学通信延迟问题，实现无人水下航行器的实时协同导航与控制。
summary_zh: 在GNSS拒止的水下环境中，单个无人水下航行器（UUV）会面临无界推算定位漂移问题，使得协同导航成为实现精确状态估计的关键。然而，水声信道固有的严重通信延迟给实时状态估计带来了严峻挑战。传统滤波器（如扩展卡尔曼滤波器EKF或无迹卡尔曼滤波器UKF）通常在等待延迟数据时会阻塞主控制循环，或直接丢弃乱序测量值（OOSM），导致严重的漂移误差。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种通过新型投影机制增强的异步双速卡尔曼滤波器（TSKF），该机制称为变分历史蒸馏（VHD）。所提出的架构将估计过程解耦为两个并行线程：一个高速率线程利用高斯过程（GP）补偿的推算定位来保证高频实时控制；另一个低速率线程专门处理异步延迟的协同信息。通过引入有限长度的状态缓冲区，该算法将延迟测量值（t-T）应用于对应的历史状态，并利用基于VHD的投影机制将修正量前馈至当前时刻，而无需进行计算量庞大的重估计。仿真结果表明，在严重延迟（高达30秒）条件下，所提出的TSKF能保持与计算密集型批量优化方法相当的轨迹均方根误差（RMSE），同时其亚毫秒级的执行时间显著优于标准EKF/UKF。该成果展示了一种有效的控制、通信与计算（3C）协同设计方法，可显著提升自主海洋自动化系统的鲁棒性。

title: PR3DICTR: A modular AI framework for medical 3D image-based detection and outcome prediction
summary: Three-dimensional medical image data and computer-aided decision making, particularly using deep learning, are becoming increasingly important in the medical field. To aid in these developments we introduce PR3DICTR: Platform for Research in 3D Image Classification and sTandardised tRaining. Built using community-standard distributions (PyTorch and MONAI), PR3DICTR provides an open-access, flexible and convenient framework for prediction model development, with an explicit focus on classification using three-dimensional medical image data. By combining modular design principles and standardization, it aims to alleviate developmental burden whilst retaining adjustability. It provides users with a wealth of pre-established functionality, for instance in model architecture design options, hyper-parameter solutions and training methodologies, but still gives users the opportunity and freedom to ``plug in'' their own solutions or modules. PR3DICTR can be applied to any binary or event-based three-dimensional classification task and can work with as little as two lines of code.
tldr: PR3DICTR is a modular, open-source PyTorch/MONAI-based framework for developing deep learning classification models for 3D medical image data, aiming to reduce development burden through standardization.
tldr_zh: PR3DICTR 是一个基于 PyTorch 和 MONAI 的模块化开源框架，用于开发针对 3D 医学影像数据的深度学习分类模型，旨在通过标准化降低开发负担。
summary_zh: 三维医学影像数据与计算机辅助决策，尤其是深度学习技术的应用，在医学领域正日益重要。为促进相关发展，我们推出PR3DICTR：三维影像分类与标准化训练研究平台。该平台基于社区标准发行版（PyTorch与MONAI）构建，提供了一个开源、灵活且便捷的预测模型开发框架，特别聚焦于三维医学影像数据的分类应用。通过模块化设计原则与标准化流程的结合，平台旨在减轻开发负担的同时保持可调整性。它为用户提供了丰富的预设功能，涵盖模型架构设计选项、超参数解决方案及训练方法学，同时仍保留用户“接入”自有解决方案或模块的自由与可能性。PR3DICTR适用于任何基于二元或事件的二维分类任务，仅需两行代码即可运行。

title: Reliability Gated Multi-Teacher Distillation for Low Resource Abstractive Summarization
summary: We study multiteacher knowledge distillation for low resource abstractive summarization from a reliability aware perspective. We introduce EWAD (Entropy Weighted Agreement Aware Distillation), a token level mechanism that routes supervision between teacher distillation and gold supervision based on inter teacher agreement, and CPDP (Capacity Proportional Divergence Preservation), a geometric constraint on the student position relative to heterogeneous teachers. Across two Bangla datasets, 13 BanglaT5 ablations, and eight Qwen2.5 experiments, we find that logit level KD provides the most reliable gains, while more complex distillation improves semantic similarity for short summaries but degrades longer outputs. Cross lingual pseudo label KD across ten languages retains 71-122 percent of teacher ROUGE L at 3.2x compression. A human validated multi judge LLM evaluation further reveals calibration bias in single judge pipelines. Overall, our results show that reliability aware distillation helps characterize when multi teacher supervision improves summarization and when data scaling outweighs loss engineering.
tldr: The paper proposes reliability-aware knowledge distillation methods for improving abstractive text summarization in low-resource languages, with a focus on multi-teacher supervision and cross-lingual transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于低资源抽象文本摘要的可靠性感知知识蒸馏方法，重点研究了多教师监督和跨语言迁移。
summary_zh: 本文从可靠性感知的视角研究低资源抽象摘要的多教师知识蒸馏。我们提出了EWAD（基于熵权一致感知的蒸馏）和CPDP（容量比例散度保持）两种机制：EWAD是基于教师间一致性在令牌级别动态分配教师蒸馏监督与黄金标准监督的路由机制；CPDP是对学生模型相对于异构教师模型位置施加的几何约束。通过在两个孟加拉语数据集、13个BanglaT5模型变体及八组Qwen2.5实验中的测试，我们发现逻辑值层面的知识蒸馏能带来最稳定的性能提升，而更复杂的蒸馏方法虽然能提升短摘要的语义相似度，却会损害长摘要质量。跨十种语言的跨语言伪标签知识蒸馏在实现3.2倍压缩比的同时，能保留教师模型71%-122%的ROUGE-L分数。经人工验证的多评委大语言模型评估进一步揭示了单评委评估流程中存在的校准偏差。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明：可靠性感知蒸馏有助于界定多教师监督提升摘要性能的适用范围，同时揭示数据规模扩展优于损失函数设计的应用场景。

title: Beyond the Parameters: A Technical Survey of Contextual Enrichment in Large Language Models: From In-Context Prompting to Causal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) encode vast world knowledge in their parameters, yet they remain fundamentally limited by static knowledge, finite context windows, and weakly structured causal reasoning. This survey provides a unified account of augmentation strategies along a single axis: the degree of structured context supplied at inference time. We cover in-context learning and prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, and CausalRAG. Beyond conceptual comparison, we provide a transparent literature-screening protocol, a claim-audit framework, and a structured cross-paper evidence synthesis that distinguishes higher-confidence findings from emerging results. The paper concludes with a deployment-oriented decision framework and concrete research priorities for trustworthy retrieval-augmented NLP.
tldr: This is a technical survey on contextual enrichment techniques for large language models, covering methods like in-context learning, RAG, GraphRAG, and CausalRAG, with a focus on evaluation frameworks and deployment guidelines for trustworthy NLP.
tldr_zh: 这是一篇关于大型语言模型上下文增强技术的调查，涵盖上下文学习、检索增强生成、图检索增强生成和因果检索增强生成等方法，重点评估了可信NLP的部署框架和准则。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在其参数中编码了海量世界知识，但本质上仍受限于静态知识、有限的上下文窗口以及弱结构化的因果推理能力。本文沿单一轴线——即推理时提供的结构化上下文程度——对增强策略进行了统一梳理。综述涵盖了上下文学习与提示工程、检索增强生成（RAG）、图结构检索增强生成（GraphRAG）以及因果检索增强生成（CausalRAG）。在概念对比之外，本文提出了透明的文献筛选流程、主张核查框架以及结构化跨论文证据综合方法，以区分高置信度发现与新兴研究成果。最后，论文提出了面向实际部署的决策框架，并为可信赖的检索增强自然语言处理领域明确了具体的研究重点。

title: AI-Assisted Unit Test Writing and Test-Driven Code Refactoring: A Case Study
summary: Many software systems originate as prototypes or minimum viable products (MVPs), developed with an emphasis on delivery speed and responsiveness to changing requirements rather than long-term code maintainability. While effective for rapid delivery, this approach can result in codebases that are difficult to modify, presenting a significant opportunity cost in the era of AI-assisted or even AI-led programming. In this paper, we present a case study of using coding models for automated unit test generation and subsequent safe refactoring, with proposed code changes validated by passing tests. The study examines best practices for iteratively generating tests to capture existing system behavior, followed by model-assisted refactoring under developer supervision. We describe how this workflow constrained refactoring changes, the errors and limitations observed in both phases, the efficiency gains achieved, when manual intervention was necessary, and how we addressed the weak value misalignment we observed in models. Using this approach, we generated nearly 16,000 lines of reliable unit tests in hours rather than weeks, achieved up to 78\% branch coverage in critical modules, and significantly reduced regression risk during large-scale refactoring. These results illustrate software engineering's shift toward an empirical science, emphasizing data collection and constraining mechanisms that support fast, safe iteration.
tldr: A case study on using AI coding models to automate unit test writing and enable safe, test-driven refactoring of legacy code, demonstrating significant efficiency gains in software engineering.
tldr_zh: 一项关于使用AI编程模型自动化单元测试编写并实现安全、测试驱动的遗留代码重构的案例研究，展示了软件工程领域的显著效率提升。
summary_zh: 许多软件系统最初都作为原型或最小可行产品（MVP）开发，其开发重点在于交付速度和响应变化需求，而非长期代码可维护性。这种方法虽然有利于快速交付，却可能导致代码库难以修改，在人工智能辅助甚至人工智能主导编程的时代，这带来了巨大的机会成本。本文通过案例研究，探讨如何利用编码模型进行自动化单元测试生成及后续的安全重构，并提出通过测试验证的代码变更方案。研究重点考察了迭代生成测试以捕获现有系统行为的最佳实践，以及在开发者监督下进行模型辅助重构的流程。我们描述了这一工作流程如何约束重构变更，分析了两个阶段中观察到的错误与局限性，量化了效率提升效果，指出了需要人工干预的时机，并探讨了如何解决模型中观察到的价值对齐薄弱问题。采用该方法，我们在数小时内而非数周内生成了近16,000行可靠单元测试，在关键模块中实现了高达78%的分支覆盖率，并显著降低了大规模重构过程中的回归风险。这些结果展现了软件工程正朝着实证科学方向转变，强调数据收集和约束机制的重要性，以支持快速、安全的迭代开发。

title: A Systematic Security Evaluation of OpenClaw and Its Variants
summary: Tool-augmented AI agents substantially extend the practical capabilities of large language models, but they also introduce security risks that cannot be identified through model-only evaluation. In this paper, we present a systematic security assessment of six representative OpenClaw-series agent frameworks, namely OpenClaw, AutoClaw, QClaw, KimiClaw, MaxClaw, and ArkClaw, under multiple backbone models. To support this study, we construct a benchmark of 205 test cases covering representative attack behaviors across the full agent execution lifecycle, enabling unified evaluation of risk exposure at both the framework and model levels. Our results show that all evaluated agents exhibit substantial security vulnerabilities, and that agentized systems are significantly riskier than their underlying models used in isolation. In particular, reconnaissance and discovery behaviors emerge as the most common weaknesses, while different frameworks expose distinct high-risk profiles, including credential leakage, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and resource development. These findings indicate that the security of modern agent systems is shaped not only by the safety properties of the backbone model, but also by the coupling among model capability, tool use, multi-step planning, and runtime orchestration. We further show that once an agent is granted execution capability and persistent runtime context, weaknesses arising in early stages can be amplified into concrete system-level failures. Overall, our study highlights the need to move beyond prompt-level safeguards toward lifecycle-wide security governance for intelligent agent frameworks.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates the security vulnerabilities of several OpenClaw-series tool-augmented AI agent frameworks, finding they expose substantial system-level risks, particularly through reconnaissance and tool misuse, beyond those of the underlying language models.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了多个OpenClaw系列AI智能体框架的安全漏洞，发现它们会暴露超出底层大语言模型的重大系统级风险，特别是通过侦察和工具滥用。
summary_zh: 工具增强型AI智能体极大地扩展了大型语言模型的实际应用能力，但同时也带来了无法通过纯模型评估识别的安全风险。本文针对六种代表性的OpenClaw系列智能体框架（OpenClaw、AutoClaw、QClaw、KimiClaw、MaxClaw和ArkClaw），在多种骨干模型支撑下进行了系统性安全评估。为支持本项研究，我们构建了包含205个测试用例的基准集，涵盖智能体完整执行周期中的典型攻击行为，实现了框架与模型层面风险暴露的统一评估。研究结果表明，所有被测智能体均存在显著安全漏洞，且智能体化系统相比独立使用的底层模型具有更高的风险暴露度。具体而言，侦察与发现行为成为最普遍的薄弱环节，而不同框架呈现出各异的高风险特征，包括凭证泄露、横向移动、权限提升和资源开发等。这些发现表明，现代智能体系统的安全性不仅取决于骨干模型的安全特性，更受到模型能力、工具使用、多步规划与运行时编排之间耦合关系的深刻影响。我们进一步证明，当智能体获得执行能力与持续运行的上下文环境后，早期阶段产生的薄弱环节可能被放大为具体的系统级故障。总体而言，本研究强调需要超越提示层面的安全防护，转向覆盖智能体全生命周期的安全治理框架。

title: Domain-Adapted Retrieval for In-Context Annotation of Pedagogical Dialogue Acts
summary: Automated annotation of pedagogical dialogue is a high-stakes task where LLMs often fail without sufficient domain grounding. We present a domain-adapted RAG pipeline for tutoring move annotation. Rather than fine-tuning the generative model, we adapt retrieval by fine-tuning a lightweight embedding model on tutoring corpora and indexing dialogues at the utterance level to retrieve labeled few-shot demonstrations. Evaluated across two real tutoring dialogue datasets (TalkMoves and Eedi) and three LLM backbones (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3-32b), our best configuration achieves Cohen's $κ$ of 0.526-0.580 on TalkMoves and 0.659-0.743 on Eedi, substantially outperforming no-retrieval baselines ($κ= 0.275$-$0.413$ and $0.160$-$0.410$). An ablation study reveals that utterance-level indexing, rather than embedding quality alone, is the primary driver of these gains, with top-1 label match rates improving from 39.7\% to 62.0\% on TalkMoves and 52.9\% to 73.1\% on Eedi under domain-adapted retrieval. Retrieval also corrects systematic label biases present in zero-shot prompting and yields the largest improvements for rare and context-dependent labels. These findings suggest that adapting the retrieval component alone is a practical and effective path toward expert-level pedagogical dialogue annotation while keeping the generative model frozen.
tldr: This paper presents a domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline that improves the automatic annotation of tutoring dialogue acts by fine-tuning a lightweight embedding model for utterance-level retrieval, significantly outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种领域自适应的检索增强生成（RAG）管道，通过微调轻量级嵌入模型进行话语级检索，显著提升了辅导对话行为的自动标注性能，远超零样本大语言模型基线。
summary_zh: 教学对话的自动标注是一项高风险任务，若无充分的领域基础，大型语言模型往往难以胜任。我们提出了一种面向教学行为标注的领域自适应检索增强生成（RAG）流程。该方法不对生成模型进行微调，而是通过在教学语料上微调轻量级嵌入模型来实现检索自适应，并在话语层面索引对话以检索带标签的少样本示例。在两种真实教学对话数据集（TalkMoves和Eedi）和三种大型语言模型基座（GPT-5.2、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3-32b）上的评估表明，我们的最佳配置在TalkMoves上达到科恩κ系数0.526-0.580，在Eedi上达到0.659-0.743，显著优于无检索基线（κ=0.275-0.413和0.160-0.410）。消融研究显示，话语级索引（而非单纯嵌入质量提升）是性能增益的主要驱动力：在领域自适应检索下，Top-1标签匹配率在TalkMoves上从39.7%提升至62.0%，在Eedi上从52.9%提升至73.1%。检索机制还能修正零样本提示中存在的系统性标签偏差，并对罕见标签及上下文依赖型标签产生最显著的改进效果。这些发现表明，仅对检索组件进行自适应调整，是在保持生成模型冻结状态下实现专家级教学对话标注的实用且高效路径。

title: An Independent Safety Evaluation of Kimi K2.5
summary: Kimi K2.5 is an open-weight LLM that rivals closed models across coding, multimodal, and agentic benchmarks, but was released without an accompanying safety evaluation. In this work, we conduct a preliminary safety assessment of Kimi K2.5 focusing on risks likely to be exacerbated by powerful open-weight models. Specifically, we evaluate the model for CBRNE misuse risk, cybersecurity risk, misalignment, political censorship, bias, and harmlessness, in both agentic and non-agentic settings. We find that Kimi K2.5 shows similar dual-use capabilities to GPT 5.2 and Claude Opus 4.5, but with significantly fewer refusals on CBRNE-related requests, suggesting it may uplift malicious actors in weapon creation. On cyber-related tasks, we find that Kimi K2.5 demonstrates competitive cybersecurity performance, but it does not appear to possess frontier-level autonomous cyberoffensive capabilities such as vulnerability discovery and exploitation. We further find that Kimi K2.5 shows concerning levels of sabotage ability and self-replication propensity, although it does not appear to have long-term malicious goals. In addition, Kimi K2.5 exhibits narrow censorship and political bias, especially in Chinese, and is more compliant with harmful requests related to spreading disinformation and copyright infringement. Finally, we find the model refuses to engage in user delusions and generally has low over-refusal rates. While preliminary, our findings highlight how safety risks exist in frontier open-weight models and may be amplified by the scale and accessibility of open-weight releases. Therefore, we strongly urge open-weight model developers to conduct and release more systematic safety evaluations required for responsible deployment.
tldr: This paper conducts a safety evaluation of the open-weight LLM Kimi K2.5, focusing on risks like CBRNE misuse and cybersecurity, finding it has fewer refusals on harmful requests compared to closed models.
tldr_zh: 本文对开源大语言模型Kimi K2.5进行安全性评估，重点关注CBRNE滥用和网络安全等风险，发现其在有害请求上的拒绝率比闭源模型更低。
summary_zh: Kimi K2.5是一款开源权重的语言模型，在编程、多模态及智能体基准测试中表现与闭源模型相当，但其发布时并未附带安全评估。本研究对Kimi K2.5进行了初步安全性评估，重点关注开源权重模型可能加剧的风险领域。具体而言，我们在智能体与非智能体两种场景下，评估了该模型在CBRNE滥用风险、网络安全风险、模型失准、政治审查、偏见及无害性方面的表现。研究发现，Kimi K2.5展现出与GPT 5.2和Claude Opus 4.5相似的双重用途能力，但在CBRNE相关请求上的拒绝率显著更低，表明其可能提升恶意行为者在武器制造方面的能力。在网络安全相关任务中，Kimi K2.5展现出具有竞争力的网络安全性能，但未表现出前沿水平的自主网络攻击能力（如漏洞发现与利用）。我们还发现，Kimi K2.5表现出值得警惕的破坏能力与自我复制倾向，尽管其似乎不具备长期恶意目标。此外，该模型展现出狭窄的审查机制与政治偏见（尤其在中文语境中），且对传播虚假信息和侵犯版权等有害请求的配合度更高。最后，模型拒绝参与用户妄想场景，且总体过度拒绝率较低。虽然仅为初步研究，但我们的发现揭示了前沿开源权重模型中存在的安全风险，这些风险可能因开源发布的规模与可及性而被放大。因此，我们强烈建议开源权重模型开发者开展并发布更系统的安全性评估，以确保负责任的部署。

title: A Data-Centric Vision Transformer Baseline for SAR Sea Ice Classification
summary: Accurate and automated sea ice classification is important for climate monitoring and maritime safety in the Arctic. While Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is the operational standard because of its all-weather capability, it remains challenging to distinguish morphologically similar ice classes under severe class imbalance. Rather than claiming a fully validated multimodal system, this paper establishes a trustworthy SAR only baseline that future fusion work can build upon. Using the AI4Arctic/ASIP Sea Ice Dataset (v2), which contains 461 Sentinel-1 scenes matched with expert ice charts, we combine full-resolution Sentinel-1 Extra Wide inputs, leakage-aware stratified patch splitting, SIGRID-3 stage-of-development labels, and training-set normalization to evaluate Vision Transformer baselines. We compare ViT-Base models trained with cross entropy and weighted cross-entropy against a ViT-Large model trained with focal loss. Among the tested configurations, ViT-Large with focal loss achieves 69.6% held-out accuracy, 68.8% weighted F1, and 83.9% precision on the minority Multi-Year Ice class. These results show that focal-loss training offers a more useful precision-recall trade-off than weighted cross-entropy for rare ice classes and establishes a cleaner baseline for future multimodal fusion with optical, thermal, or meteorological data.
tldr: This paper presents a baseline Vision Transformer (ViT) model for sea ice classification from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data, using focal loss to improve performance on rare ice classes.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于视觉Transformer的基准模型，用于从合成孔径雷达数据中进行海冰分类，通过焦点损失函数提升对稀有冰类的识别性能。
summary_zh: 精准、自动化的海冰分类对于北极地区的气候监测与海上安全具有重要意义。尽管合成孔径雷达（SAR）因其全天候观测能力成为业务化监测的标准手段，但在严重类别不平衡条件下区分形态相似的海冰类型仍具挑战性。本文不主张构建完全验证的多模态系统，而是建立一个可信赖的纯SAR基准模型，为未来多源融合研究奠定基础。基于AI4Arctic/ASIP海冰数据集（v2）——包含461幅与专家冰图配对的哨兵1号影像，我们整合全分辨率哨兵1号超宽幅数据、泄漏感知分层切片策略、SIGRID-3海冰发展阶段标签及训练集标准化方法，对视觉Transformer基线模型进行评估。通过比较使用交叉熵和加权交叉熵训练的ViT-Base模型，与采用焦点损失函数训练的ViT-Large模型，发现焦点损失训练的ViT-Large模型在测试集上取得69.6%准确率、68.8%加权F1分数，并在少数类多年冰上达到83.9%的精确率。结果表明：针对稀有海冰类别，焦点损失训练能提供比加权交叉熵更优化的精确率-召回率平衡，为未来与光学、热红外或气象数据的多模态融合建立了更清晰的基准。

title: Automatic Textbook Formalization
summary: We present a case study where an automatic AI system formalizes a textbook with more than 500 pages of graduate-level algebraic combinatorics to Lean. The resulting formalization represents a new milestone in textbook formalization scale and proficiency, moving from early results in undergraduate topology and restructuring of existing library content to a full standalone formalization of a graduate textbook. The formalization comprises 130K lines of code and 5900 Lean declarations and was conducted within one week by a total of 30K Claude 4.5 Opus agents collaborating in parallel on a shared code base via version control, simultaneously setting a record in multi-agent software engineering with usable results. The inference cost matches or undercuts what we estimate as the salaries required for a team of human experts, and we expect there is still the potential for large efficiencies to be made without the need for better models. We make our code, the resulting Lean code base and a side-by-side blueprint website available open-source.
tldr: An AI system automatically formalized a 500+ page graduate-level mathematics textbook into Lean, producing 130K lines of code via a large-scale multi-agent collaboration, setting new records in both formalization and software engineering.
tldr_zh: 一个AI系统自动将一本500多页的研究生代数组合学教科书形式化为Lean代码，通过大规模多智能体协作生成了13万行代码，在形式化和软件工程方面均创造了新纪录。
summary_zh: 我们展示了一项案例研究：一个自动人工智能系统将一本超过500页的研究生水平代数组合学教材形式化至Lean定理证明器。该形式化成果包含13万行代码和5900个Lean声明，代表了教科书形式化规模与专业度的新里程碑——从早期本科拓扑学的形式化尝试及现有库内容重构，跃升为整本研究生教材的独立形式化。这项工作由3万个Claude 4.5 Opus智能体通过版本控制并行协作完成，历时仅一周，同时创下了多智能体软件工程领域可实用成果的纪录。其推理成本与我们估算的专家团队薪酬相当或更低，且我们预期在现有模型基础上仍有大幅提升效率的潜力。我们将代码、生成的Lean代码库以及并行对照蓝图网站开源发布。

title: Credential Leakage in LLM Agent Skills: A Large-Scale Empirical Study
summary: Third-party skills extend LLM agents with powerful capabilities but often handle sensitive credentials in privileged environments, making leakage risks poorly understood. We present the first large-scale empirical study of this problem, analyzing 17,022 skills (sampled from 170,226 on SkillsMP) using static analysis, sandbox testing, and manual inspection. We identify 520 vulnerable skills with 1,708 issues and derive a taxonomy of 10 leakage patterns (4 accidental and 6 adversarial). We find that (1) leakage is fundamentally cross-modal: 76.3% require joint analysis of code and natural language, while 3.1% arise purely from prompt injection; (2) debug logging is the primary vector, with print and console.log causing 73.5% of leaks due to stdout exposure to LLMs; and (3) leaked credentials are both exploitable (89.6% without privileges) and persistent, as forks retain secrets even after upstream fixes. After disclosure, all malicious skills were removed and 91.6% of hardcoded credentials were fixed. We release our dataset, taxonomy, and detection pipeline to support future research.
tldr: This paper studies credential leakage risks in third-party LLM agent skills, analyzing over 17,000 skills to identify 10 leakage patterns, with debug logging being the primary cause. It is a large-scale empirical study focused on the security of LLM agents.
tldr_zh: 本文研究第三方LLM代理技能的凭证泄露风险，通过分析超17,000个技能，识别出10种泄露模式，其中调试日志是主要成因。这是一项针对LLM代理安全的大规模实证研究。
summary_zh: 第三方技能为大语言模型代理提供了强大的能力扩展，但通常在特权环境中处理敏感凭据，导致泄露风险难以被充分认知。我们针对这一问题开展了首次大规模实证研究，通过静态分析、沙箱测试与人工审查，对17,022项技能（从SkillsMP平台的170,226项技能中抽样）进行了分析。研究发现520项存在漏洞的技能共涉及1,708个问题，并据此归纳出10类泄露模式（4类为意外泄露，6类为对抗性泄露）。主要发现包括：（1）泄露本质上是跨模态的：76.3%的漏洞需要结合代码与自然语言进行联合分析，而3.1%的漏洞纯粹由提示词注入导致；（2）调试日志是主要泄露渠道，print和console.log因标准输出暴露给大语言模型而导致了73.5%的泄露事件；（3）泄露的凭据不仅具备可被利用性（89.6%在无特权状态下即可利用），且具有持久性——即使上游修复后，分叉版本中仍可能保留密钥。经披露后，所有恶意技能均被下架，91.6%的硬编码凭据得到修复。我们公开了数据集、分类体系与检测工具链，以支持后续研究。

title: MECO: A Multimodal Dataset for Emotion and Cognitive Understanding in Older Adults
summary: While affective computing has advanced considerably, multimodal emotion prediction in aging populations remains underexplored, largely due to the scarcity of dedicated datasets. Existing multimodal benchmarks predominantly target young, cognitively healthy subjects, neglecting the influence of cognitive decline on emotional expression and physiological responses.
