To bridge this gap, we present MECO, a Multimodal dataset for Emotion and Cognitive understanding in Older adults. MECO includes 42 participants and provides approximately 38 hours of multimodal signals, yielding 30,592 synchronized samples. To maximize ecological validity, data collection followed standardized protocols within community-based settings. The modalities cover video, audio, electroencephalography (EEG), and electrocardiography (ECG). In addition, the dataset offers comprehensive annotations of emotional and cognitive states, including self-assessed valence, arousal, six basic emotions, and Mini-Mental State Examination cognitive scores. We further establish baseline benchmarks for both emotion and cognitive prediction. MECO serves as a foundational resource for multimodal modeling of affect and cognition in aging populations, facilitating downstream applications such as personalized emotion recognition and early detection of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) in real-world settings. The complete dataset and supplementary materials are available at https://maitrechen.github.io/meco-page/.
tldr: Introduces MECO, a multimodal dataset (video, audio, EEG, ECG) for emotion and cognitive state prediction in older adults, with a focus on ecological validity and applications like early detection of cognitive impairment.
tldr_zh: 介绍了MECO，一个用于老年人情感和认知状态预测的多模态数据集（视频、音频、脑电图、心电图），侧重于生态效度，可用于早期认知障碍检测等应用。
summary_zh: 尽管情感计算已取得显著进展，但针对老年群体的多模态情绪预测研究仍显不足，主要原因在于缺乏专门的数据库。现有的多模态基准数据集主要面向年轻、认知健康的受试者，忽视了认知衰退对情绪表达和生理反应的影响。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MECO——一个面向老年人情绪与认知理解的多模态数据集。MECO包含42名参与者，提供约38小时的多模态信号，生成了30,592个同步样本。为最大限度保证生态效度，数据采集遵循社区环境下的标准化流程。涵盖的模态包括视频、音频、脑电图和心电图。此外，该数据集提供了情绪与认知状态的全面标注，包括自我评估的效价、唤醒度、六种基本情绪及简易精神状态检查认知评分。我们进一步建立了情绪与认知预测的基准模型。MECO为老年群体情感与认知的多模态建模提供了基础资源，可支持现实场景中的个性化情绪识别和轻度认知障碍早期检测等下游应用。完整数据集及补充材料可通过https://maitrechen.github.io/meco-page/获取。

title: R2-Write: Reflection and Revision for Open-Ended Writing with Deep Reasoning
summary: While deep reasoning with long chain-of-thought has dramatically improved large language models in verifiable domains like mathematics, its effectiveness for open-ended tasks such as writing remains unexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic investigation revealing that existing mainstream reasoning models achieve limited gains on open-ended writing tasks. Our further analysis shows that these models lack deep reflection and revision patterns in open-ended writing, resulting in substantially smaller improvements compared to mathematical reasoning tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce R2-Write: an automated framework that synthesizes high-quality thinking trajectories enriched with explicit reflection and revision patterns through iterative writer-judge interaction. To prevent redundant reflections, we design a process reward mechanism that supervises reflection quality during reinforcement learning, improving both performance and token efficiency. Extensive experiments across multiple creative writing and deep-research benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements, validating that explicitly incorporating reflection and revision patterns unlocks deep reasoning capabilities for open-ended writing tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces R2-Write, a framework using reflection and revision in LLM-based writer-judge loops to improve performance on open-ended writing tasks, which shows limited gains with standard reasoning methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了R2-Write框架，通过LLM驱动的写手-评判员交互循环中的反思与修订模式，提升模型在开放式写作任务上的表现，弥补了标准推理方法在此类任务上的不足。
summary_zh: 摘要：尽管长链思维深度推理显著提升了大型语言模型在数学等可验证领域的表现，其在开放式任务（如写作）中的有效性仍未被探索。本文通过系统研究发现，现有主流推理模型在开放式写作任务中取得的提升有限。进一步分析表明，这些模型在开放式写作中缺乏深度反思与修订机制，导致其改进幅度远小于数学推理任务。为突破此局限，我们提出R2-Write框架：该自动化系统通过迭代式的作者-评判者交互，生成融合显式反思与修订模式的高质量思维轨迹。为避免冗余反思，我们设计了过程奖励机制，在强化学习中监督反思质量，从而提升性能与计算效率。在多个创意写作与深度研究基准测试中的广泛实验表明，该框架实现了显著改进，证实了显式整合反思与修订机制能够有效释放开放式写作任务的深度推理潜力。

title: Self-Optimizing Multi-Agent Systems for Deep Research
summary: Given a user's complex information need, a multi-agent Deep Research system iteratively plans, retrieves, and synthesizes evidence across hundreds of documents to produce a high-quality answer. In one possible architecture, an orchestrator agent coordinates the process, while parallel worker agents execute tasks. Current Deep Research systems, however, often rely on hand-engineered prompts and static architectures, making improvement brittle, expensive, and time-consuming. We therefore explore various multi-agent optimization methods to show that enabling agents to self-play and explore different prompt combinations can produce high-quality Deep Research systems that match or outperform expert-crafted prompts.
tldr: This paper proposes using multi-agent self-optimization methods to improve the performance of automated deep research systems by allowing agents to explore and optimize their own prompts and architectures, instead of relying on hand-engineered designs.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出利用多智能体自我优化方法来提升自动化深度研究系统的性能，通过让智能体探索和优化自身的提示词与架构，而非依赖人工设计的方案。
summary_zh: 摘要：针对用户的复杂信息需求，多智能体深度研究系统通过迭代规划、检索与跨数百篇文档的证据融合，最终生成高质量答案。在一种可能的架构中，协调智能体统筹流程，并行工作智能体则执行具体任务。然而，当前深度研究系统通常依赖人工设计的提示词与静态架构，导致系统改进过程脆弱、昂贵且耗时。为此，我们探索了多种多智能体优化方法，证明通过让智能体进行自我博弈并探索不同提示组合，能够构建出与专家设计提示词效果相当或更优的高质量深度研究系统。

title: Prompt Compression in the Wild: Measuring Latency, Rate Adherence, and Quality for Faster LLM Inference
summary: With the wide adoption of language models for IR -- and specifically RAG systems -- the latency of the underlying LLM becomes a crucial bottleneck, since the long contexts of retrieved passages lead large prompts and therefore, compute increase. Prompt compression, which reduces the size of input prompts while aiming to preserve performance on downstream tasks, has established itself as a cost-effective and low-latency method for accelerating inference in large language models. However, its usefulness depends on whether the additional preprocessing time during generation is offset by faster decoding. We present the first systematic, large-scale study of this trade-off, with thousands of runs and 30,000 queries across several open-source LLMs and three GPU classes. Our evaluation separates compression overhead from decoding latency while tracking output quality and memory usage. LLMLingua achieves up to 18% end-to-end speed-ups, when prompt length, compression ratio, and hardware capacity are well matched, with response quality remaining statistically unchanged across summarization, code generation, and question answering tasks. Outside this operating window, however, the compression step dominates and cancels out the gains. We also show that effective compression can reduce memory usage enough to offload workloads from data center GPUs to commodity cards, with only a 0.3s increase in latency. Our open-source profiler predicts the latency break-even point for each model-hardware setup, providing practical guidance on when prompt compression delivers real-world benefits.
tldr: This paper presents a large-scale study of prompt compression techniques for accelerating LLM inference, measuring trade-offs between compression overhead, decoding latency, output quality, and memory usage across various models and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文对加速大语言模型推理的提示压缩技术进行了首次大规模研究，在多种模型和硬件上测量了压缩开销、解码延迟、输出质量和内存使用之间的权衡。
summary_zh: 随着语言模型在信息检索（特别是RAG系统）中的广泛应用，底层大语言模型的延迟已成为关键瓶颈，因为检索到的长上下文段落会导致提示文本过长，从而增加计算负担。提示压缩技术通过缩减输入提示的规模，同时致力于保持下游任务性能，已成为一种经济高效且低延迟的大语言模型推理加速方法。然而，其实际效用取决于生成过程中额外的预处理时间能否被更快的解码速度所抵消。我们首次针对这一权衡关系展开系统性大规模研究，通过数千次实验和超过3万条查询，覆盖多个开源大语言模型及三类GPU硬件。评估过程将压缩开销与解码延迟分离，同时跟踪输出质量与内存使用情况。当提示长度、压缩比率与硬件能力相匹配时，LLMLingua可实现最高18%的端到端加速，且在摘要生成、代码生成和问答任务中保持统计意义上不变的响应质量。但若超出该运行区间，压缩步骤将主导耗时并抵消收益。研究还表明，有效的压缩能显著降低内存使用，使工作负载可从数据中心GPU迁移至消费级显卡，而延迟仅增加0.3秒。我们开发的开源分析器能预测每种模型-硬件配置的延迟平衡点，为提示压缩技术在实际应用中的价值判断提供实践指导。

title: InfoSeeker: A Scalable Hierarchical Parallel Agent Framework for Web Information Seeking
summary: Recent agentic search systems have made substantial progress by emphasising deep, multi-step reasoning. However, this focus often overlooks the challenges of wide-scale information synthesis, where agents must aggregate large volumes of heterogeneous evidence across many sources. As a result, most existing large language model agent systems face severe limitations in data-intensive settings, including context saturation, cascading error propagation, and high end-to-end latency. To address these challenges, we present \framework, a hierarchical framework based on principle of near-decomposability, containing a strategic \textit{Host}, multiple \textit{Managers} and parallel \textit{Workers}. By leveraging aggregation and reflection mechanisms at the Manager layer, our framework enforces strict context isolation to prevent saturation and error propagation. Simultaneously, the parallelism in worker layer accelerates the speed of overall task execution, mitigating the significant latency. Our evaluation on two complementary benchmarks demonstrates both efficiency ($ 3-5 \times$ speed-up) and effectiveness, achieving a $8.4\%$ success rate on WideSearch-en and $52.9\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-zh. The code is released at https://github.com/agent-on-the-fly/InfoSeeker
tldr: The paper introduces InfoSeeker, a hierarchical parallel agent framework for web information seeking, designed to overcome limitations like context saturation and high latency in data-intensive settings through context isolation and parallelism.
tldr_zh: 本文提出InfoSeeker，一个用于网络信息搜索的层次化并行智能体框架，旨在通过上下文隔离和并行处理，解决数据密集型任务中的上下文饱和和高延迟等问题。
summary_zh: 近期智能体搜索系统通过强调深度、多步推理已取得显著进展。然而这种关注往往忽视了大规模信息整合的挑战，即智能体必须在众多来源中聚合海量异构证据。因此，现有大多数大语言模型智能体系统在数据密集型场景下面临严重局限，包括上下文饱和、级联误差传播以及高端到端延迟。为应对这些挑战，我们提出基于近可分解性原则的分层框架，该框架包含一个策略性主控模块、多个管理模块与并行工作模块。通过管理层的聚合与反思机制，该框架实施严格的上下文隔离，以防止饱和与误差传播。同时，工作层的并行化显著提升整体任务执行速度，有效缓解延迟问题。在两个互补基准测试中的评估表明，该框架在效率方面实现3至5倍加速，并在WideSearch-en数据集上获得8.4%的成功率，在BrowseComp-zh数据集上达到52.9%的准确率。代码已发布于https://github.com/agent-on-the-fly/InfoSeeker

title: FoE: Forest of Errors Makes the First Solution the Best in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Recent Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) like DeepSeek-R1 have demonstrated remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks, exhibiting human-like patterns in exploring multiple alternative solutions. Upon closer inspection, however, we uncover a surprising phenomenon: The First is The Best, where alternative solutions are not merely suboptimal but potentially detrimental. This observation challenges widely accepted test-time scaling laws, leading us to hypothesize that errors within the reasoning path scale concurrently with test time. Through comprehensive empirical analysis, we characterize errors as a forest-structured Forest of Errors (FoE) and conclude that FoE makes the First the Best, which is underpinned by rigorous theoretical analysis. Leveraging these insights, we propose RED, a self-guided efficient reasoning framework comprising two components: I) Refining First, which suppresses FoE growth in the first solution; and II) Discarding Subs, which prunes subsequent FoE via dual-consistency. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks and six backbone models demonstrate that RED outperforms eight competitive baselines, achieving performance gains of up to 19.0% while reducing token consumption by 37.7% ~ 70.4%. Moreover, comparative experiments on FoE metrics shed light on how RED achieves effectiveness.
tldr: The paper introduces the 'Forest of Errors' (FoE) phenomenon, where the first solution in Large Reasoning Models is often the best, and proposes a self-guided framework, RED, to improve efficiency by refining the first solution and discarding suboptimal ones.
tldr_zh: 该论文揭示了大型推理模型中的'错误森林'现象，即首次生成解决方案通常是最优的，并提出了一种名为RED的自引导框架，通过精炼首次解决方案和丢弃次优方案来提高推理效率和准确性。
summary_zh: 近期的大型推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1）在复杂推理任务中展现出显著成功，其探索多种替代解决方案的模式呈现出类人特征。然而，经过深入观察，我们发现了一个令人惊讶的现象："最优解即首解"，即替代方案不仅次优，甚至可能产生负面影响。这一发现挑战了广泛接受的测试时扩展定律，促使我们提出假设：推理路径中的错误会随着测试时间同步增长。通过全面的实证分析，我们将错误表征为森林结构的"错误森林"，并基于严谨的理论分析论证了"错误森林导致首解最优"的结论。基于这些洞见，我们提出了RED——一种自引导的高效推理框架，包含两大组件：一）"首解优化"，通过抑制首个解决方案中的错误森林增长；二）"次解剔除"，借助双重一致性机制修剪后续错误森林。在五个基准测试和六种骨干模型上的大量实验表明，RED优于八种竞争性基线方法，最高可实现19.0%的性能提升，同时将token消耗降低37.7%～70.4%。此外，针对错误森林指标的对比实验揭示了RED实现高效推理的内在机制。

title: LogicPoison: Logical Attacks on Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) enhances the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding their responses in structured knowledge graphs. Leveraging community detection and relation filtering techniques, GraphRAG systems demonstrate inherent resistance to traditional RAG attacks, such as text poisoning and prompt injection. However, in this paper, we find that the security of GraphRAG systems fundamentally relies on the topological integrity of the underlying graph, which can be undermined by implicitly corrupting the logical connections, without altering surface-level text semantics. To exploit this vulnerability, we propose \textsc{LogicPoison}, a novel attack framework that targets logical reasoning rather than injecting false contents. Specifically, \textsc{LogicPoison} employs a type-preserving entity swapping mechanism to perturb both global logic hubs for disrupting overall graph connectivity and query-specific reasoning bridges for severing essential multi-hop inference paths. This approach effectively reroutes valid reasoning into dead ends while maintaining surface-level textual plausibility. Comprehensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{LogicPoison} successfully bypasses GraphRAG's defenses, significantly degrading performance and outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in both effectiveness and stealth. Our code is available at \textcolor{blue}https://github.com/Jord8061/logicPoison.
tldr: A novel attack framework (LogicPoison) targets GraphRAG systems by subtly corrupting the logical connections in knowledge graphs to mislead LLM reasoning, bypassing traditional text-based defenses.
tldr_zh: 一种新颖的攻击框架（LogicPoison）通过微妙地破坏知识图谱中的逻辑连接来误导LLM推理，从而绕过GraphRAG系统的传统文本防御。
summary_zh: 摘要：基于图的检索增强生成技术通过将大语言模型（LLM）的响应建立在结构化知识图谱之上，增强了其推理能力。该系统利用社区检测与关系过滤技术，展现出对传统RAG攻击（如文本投毒与提示注入）的天然抵抗力。然而，本文发现GraphRAG系统的安全性本质上依赖于底层图谱的拓扑完整性，而这种完整性可能在不改变表层文本语义的情况下，通过隐性破坏逻辑连接而被削弱。为利用此漏洞，我们提出\textsc{LogicPoison}——一种针对逻辑推理而非注入虚假内容的新型攻击框架。具体而言，\textsc{LogicPoison}采用保持类型约束的实体替换机制，通过扰动全局逻辑枢纽来破坏整体图连通性，同时针对查询特定的推理桥梁切断关键的多跳推理路径。该方法可在保持表层文本合理性的前提下，将有效推理路径导向失效状态。在多个基准测试上的综合实验表明，\textsc{LogicPoison}能成功绕过GraphRAG的防御机制，显著降低系统性能，并在攻击效果与隐蔽性上均优于现有前沿基线方法。代码发布于\textcolor{blue}https://github.com/Jord8061/logicPoison。

title: How Annotation Trains Annotators: Competence Development in Social Influence Recognition
summary: Human data annotation, especially when involving experts, is often treated as an objective reference. However, many annotation tasks are inherently subjective, and annotators' judgments may evolve over time. This study investigates changes in the quality of annotators' work from a competence perspective during a process of social influence recognition. The study involved 25 annotators from five different groups, including both experts and non-experts, who annotated a dataset of 1,021 dialogues with 20 social influence techniques, along with intentions, reactions, and consequences. An initial subset of 150 texts was annotated twice - before and after the main annotation process - to enable comparison. To measure competence shifts, we combined qualitative and quantitative analyses of the annotated data, semi-structured interviews with annotators, self-assessment surveys, and Large Language Model training and evaluation on the comparison dataset. The results indicate a significant increase in annotators' self-perceived competence and confidence. Moreover, observed changes in data quality suggest that the annotation process may enhance annotator competence and that this effect is more pronounced in expert groups. The observed shifts in annotator competence have a visible impact on the performance of LLMs trained on their annotated data.
tldr: The paper studies how annotators' competence evolves during the subjective task of labeling social influence in dialogues, finding that annotation practice improves self-perceived skill and data quality, which in turn affects LLM performance.
tldr_zh: 本文研究标注者在对话中进行社会影响力识别的主观标注任务中，其能力如何演变；发现标注实践能提升自我感知的技能和数据质量，进而影响在大规模语言模型上的性能。
summary_zh: 人类数据标注，尤其是涉及专家的标注，常被视为客观的参考标准。然而，许多标注任务本质上具有主观性，且标注者的判断可能随时间变化。本研究从能力视角出发，探究了在社会影响力识别过程中标注者工作质量的变化。研究招募了来自五个不同群体的25名标注者，包括专家与非专家，他们对1021段对话进行了标注，内容涉及20种社会影响力技巧，以及意图、反应和后果。为便于比较，在主要标注过程前后，对其中150个文本的初始子集进行了两次标注。为衡量能力变化，我们结合了标注数据的定性定量分析、与标注者的半结构化访谈、自我评估问卷，以及基于比较数据集的大型语言模型训练与评估。结果显示，标注者的自我感知能力与信心显著提升。此外，数据质量的变化表明，标注过程可能提升标注者的能力，且这种效应在专家群体中更为明显。观察到的标注者能力变化，对其标注数据训练出的语言模型性能产生了可见影响。

title: Learning from Synthetic Data via Provenance-Based Input Gradient Guidance
summary: Learning methods using synthetic data have attracted attention as an effective approach for increasing the diversity of training data while reducing collection costs, thereby improving the robustness of model discrimination. However, many existing methods improve robustness only indirectly through the diversification of training samples and do not explicitly teach the model which regions in the input space truly contribute to discrimination; consequently, the model may learn spurious correlations caused by synthesis biases and artifacts. Motivated by this limitation, this paper proposes a learning framework that uses provenance information obtained during the training data synthesis process, indicating whether each region in the input space originates from the target object, as an auxiliary supervisory signal to promote the acquisition of representations focused on target regions. Specifically, input gradients are decomposed based on information about target and non-target regions during synthesis, and input gradient guidance is introduced to suppress gradients over non-target regions. This suppresses the model's reliance on non-target regions and directly promotes the learning of discriminative representations for target regions. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of the proposed method across multiple tasks and modalities, including weakly supervised object localization, spatio-temporal action localization, and image classification.
tldr: The paper proposes a training method using synthetic data provenance to guide input gradients, suppressing reliance on non-target regions to improve discriminative learning, validated on tasks like object and action localization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用合成数据来源信息引导输入梯度的训练方法，通过抑制对非目标区域的依赖，提升模型在目标区域的判别性表征学习，在弱监督物体定位和时空动作定位等任务上验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 利用合成数据的学习方法作为一种有效途径受到关注，它既能增加训练数据的多样性又能降低采集成本，从而提升模型识别的鲁棒性。然而，现有方法大多仅通过训练样本的多样化间接提升鲁棒性，并未明确指导模型应关注输入空间中哪些真正对识别起作用的区域；这导致模型可能学习到由合成偏差和伪影引起的虚假相关性。针对这一局限，本文提出一种学习框架，利用训练数据合成过程中获取的来源信息——即标注输入空间各区域是否源自目标对象——作为辅助监督信号，以促进模型习得专注于目标区域的表征。具体而言，该方法在训练过程中依据合成时目标与非目标区域信息对输入梯度进行分解，并引入输入梯度引导机制来抑制非目标区域的梯度响应。这有效抑制了模型对非目标区域的依赖，直接推动了面向目标区域的判别性表征学习。实验验证了所提方法在弱监督目标定位、时空动作定位及图像分类等多任务与多模态场景下的有效性和普适性。

title: Split and Conquer Partial Deepfake Speech
summary:
Partial deepfake speech detection requires identifying manipulated regions that may occur within short temporal portions of an otherwise bona fide utterance, making the task particularly challenging for conventional utterance-level classifiers. We propose a split-and-conquer framework that decomposes the problem into two stages: boundary detection and segment-level classification. A dedicated boundary detector first identifies temporal transition points, allowing the audio signal to be divided into segments that are expected to contain acoustically consistent content. Each resulting segment is then evaluated independently to determine whether it corresponds to bona fide or fake speech.
  This formulation simplifies the learning objective by explicitly separating temporal localization from authenticity assessment, allowing each component to focus on a well-defined task. To further improve robustness, we introduce a reflection-based multi-length training strategy that converts variable-duration segments into several fixed input lengths, producing diverse feature-space representations. Each stage is trained using multiple configurations with different feature extractors and augmentation strategies, and their complementary predictions are fused to obtain improved final models.
  Experiments on the PartialSpoof benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple temporal resolutions as well as at the utterance level, with substantial improvements in the accurate detection and localization of spoofed regions. In addition, the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Half-Truth dataset, further confirming the robustness and generalization capability of the framework.
tldr: Proposes a split-and-conquer framework for detecting partially deepfake audio, using a boundary detector and segment classifier with a multi-length training strategy, achieving SOTA on PartialSpoof and Half-Truth benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出一个分割-攻克框架用于检测部分深度伪造音频，使用边界检测器和片段分类器结合多长度训练策略，在PartialSpoof和Half-Truth基准上达到SOTA性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：
局部深度伪造语音检测要求在真实语音片段中识别可能发生在短暂时间内的篡改区域，这使得该任务对于传统的语句级分类器尤为困难。我们提出一种分而治之的框架，将问题分解为两个阶段：边界检测和片段级分类。首先，专用的边界检测器识别时间过渡点，从而将音频信号划分为预期包含声学一致内容的片段。随后，对生成的每个片段进行独立评估，以确定其属于真实语音还是伪造语音。

这一方法通过明确分离时间定位与真实性评估，简化了学习目标，使每个组件能够专注于定义明确的任务。为进一步提升鲁棒性，我们引入一种基于反射的多长度训练策略，将可变时长的片段转换为若干固定输入长度，从而生成多样化的特征空间表示。每个阶段采用多种配置进行训练，包括不同的特征提取器和增强策略，并通过融合互补预测结果来获得更优的最终模型。

在PartialSpoof基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在多个时间分辨率以及语句层面均实现了最先进的性能，并在篡改区域的精确检测与定位方面取得了显著提升。此外，所提方法在Half-Truth数据集上也达到了最先进水平，进一步验证了该框架的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: Corporations Constitute Intelligence
summary: In January 2026, Anthropic published a 79-page "constitution" for its AI model Claude, the most comprehensive corporate AI governance document ever released. This Article offers the first legal and democratic-theoretic analysis of that document. Despite genuine philosophical sophistication, the constitution harbors two structural defects. First, it excludes the contexts where ethical constraints matter most: models deployed to the U.S. military operate under different rules, a gap exposed when Claude remained embedded in Palantir's Maven platform during military strikes in Iran even after a government-wide ban on Anthropic's technology. Second, its very comprehensiveness forecloses democratic contestation by resolving questions about AI values, moral status, and conscientious objection that should remain open for public deliberation. Anthropic's own 2023 experiment in participatory constitution-making found roughly 50% divergence between publicly sourced and corporate-authored principles, with the democratic version producing lower bias across nine social dimensions, yet the 2026 constitution incorporates none of those findings. I argue that AI governance suffers from a "political community deficit": the absence of any democratic body authorized to determine the principles governing AI behavior. Corporate transparency, however admirable, is not democratic legitimacy.
tldr: This legal analysis critiques the lack of democratic legitimacy and oversight in corporate AI governance documents, using Anthropic's Claude constitution as a case study to highlight the exclusion of military applications and suppression of public debate.
tldr_zh: 这篇法律分析批判了企业AI治理文件缺乏民主合法性和监督，以Anthropic的Claude宪法为例，强调了其对军事应用的排除和对公众辩论的压制。
summary_zh: 2026年1月，Anthropic公司为其人工智能模型Claude发布了一份长达79页的“宪法”，这是迄今为止最全面的企业人工智能治理文件。本文首次对该文件进行法律与民主理论分析。尽管该宪法具备真正的哲学思辨深度，但其存在两个结构性缺陷：首先，它排除了伦理约束最为关键的应用场景——部署至美军的模型遵循不同规则，这一漏洞在伊朗军事打击事件中暴露无遗，当时政府已全面禁止使用Anthropic技术，而Claude却仍被嵌入Palantir公司的Maven平台；其次，其过于全面的规定封闭了本应开放给公众审议的民主辩论空间，包括人工智能价值取向、道德地位以及良心拒绝权等关键议题。Anthropic在2023年开展的参与式宪法制定实验显示，公众提出的原则与公司制定的原则存在约50%的分歧，且民主版本在九个社会维度上表现出更低的偏见，但2026年版宪法却未采纳任何相关发现。本文认为，人工智能治理正面临“政治共同体缺失”困境：即缺乏获得授权的民主机构来确定人工智能行为准则。企业透明度固然可贵，却无法替代民主合法性。

title: Rethinking Forward Processes for Score-Based Data Assimilation in High Dimensions
summary: Data assimilation is the process of estimating the time-evolving state of a dynamical system by integrating model predictions and noisy observations. It is commonly formulated as Bayesian filtering, but classical filters often struggle with accuracy or computational feasibility in high dimensions. Recently, score-based generative models have emerged as a scalable approach for high-dimensional data assimilation, enabling accurate modeling and sampling of complex distributions. However, existing score-based filters often specify the forward process independently of the data assimilation. As a result, the measurement-update step depends on heuristic approximations of the likelihood score, which can accumulate errors and degrade performance over time. Here, we propose a measurement-aware score-based filter (MASF) that defines a measurement-aware forward process directly from the measurement equation. This construction makes the likelihood score analytically tractable: for linear measurements, we derive the exact likelihood score and combine it with a learned prior score to obtain the posterior score. Numerical experiments covering a range of settings, including high-dimensional datasets, demonstrate improved accuracy and stability over existing score-based filters.
tldr: This paper proposes a measurement-aware score-based filter (MASF) for high-dimensional data assimilation, improving accuracy by defining a forward process directly from the measurement equation to make the likelihood score analytically tractable.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于高维数据同化的测量感知得分滤波器（MASF），通过直接从测量方程定义前向过程，使似然得分可解析计算，从而提高了准确性和稳定性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
数据同化是一种通过融合模型预测和带噪声观测值来估计动态系统时变状态的过程。它通常被表述为贝叶斯滤波问题，但经典滤波器在高维场景下常面临精度或计算可行性的挑战。近年来，基于分数的生成模型作为一种可扩展的高维数据同化方法，能够对复杂分布进行精确建模与采样。然而，现有的基于分数的滤波器通常独立于数据同化过程设定前向过程。这导致其测量更新步骤依赖于似然分数的启发式近似，可能随时间累积误差并降低性能。本文提出一种测量感知的基于分数的滤波器，其通过测量方程直接定义测量感知的前向过程。该结构使得似然分数在解析上易于处理：对于线性测量，我们推导出精确的似然分数，并将其与学习得到先验分数相结合，以获取后验分数。涵盖高维数据集在内的多种数值实验表明，该方法相比现有基于分数的滤波器具有更高的精度和稳定性。

title: A Paradigm Shift: Fully End-to-End Training for Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos
summary: Temporal sentence grounding in videos (TSGV) aims to localize a temporal segment that semantically corresponds to a sentence query from an untrimmed video. Most current methods adopt pre-trained query-agnostic visual encoders for offline feature extraction, and the video backbones are frozen and not optimized for TSGV. This leads to a task discrepancy issue for the video backbone trained for visual classification, but utilized for TSGV. To bridge this gap, we propose a fully end-to-end paradigm that jointly optimizes the video backbone and localization head. We first conduct an empirical study validating the effectiveness of end-to-end learning over frozen baselines across different model scales. Furthermore, we introduce a Sentence Conditioned Adapter (SCADA), which leverages sentence features to train a small portion of video backbone parameters adaptively. SCADA facilitates the deployment of deeper network backbones with reduced memory and significantly enhances visual representation by modulating feature maps through precise integration of linguistic embeddings. Experiments on two benchmarks show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches. The code and models will be released.
tldr: This paper proposes a fully end-to-end training method for temporal sentence grounding in videos, which jointly optimizes a video backbone and localization head to address a task discrepancy issue, improving performance over frozen-feature baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于视频时间句子定位的完全端到端训练方法，通过联合优化视频主干网络和定位头来解决任务差异问题，性能优于冻结特征的基线方法。
summary_zh: 视频中的时序语句定位（TSGV）旨在从未剪辑的视频中定位与查询语句语义相对应的时序片段。当前大多数方法采用预训练且与查询无关的视觉编码器进行离线特征提取，视频主干网络被冻结且未针对TSGV任务进行优化，这导致训练用于视觉分类的视频主干在应用于TSGV时存在任务差异问题。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种完全端到端的范式，联合优化视频主干网络与定位头。我们首先通过实证研究验证了端到端学习在不同模型规模下相较于冻结主干基线方法的有效性。进一步，我们提出了一种语句条件适配器（SCADA），该模块利用语句特征自适应地训练视频主干网络中的少量参数。SCADA通过语言嵌入的精确整合调制特征图，既促进了更深层网络主干的部署（降低了内存需求），又显著增强了视觉表征能力。在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法优于现有先进技术。代码与模型将公开释放。

title: ESL-Bench: An Event-Driven Synthetic Longitudinal Benchmark for Health Agents
summary: Longitudinal health agents must reason across multi-source trajectories that combine continuous device streams, sparse clinical exams, and episodic life events - yet evaluating them is hard: real-world data cannot be released at scale, and temporally grounded attribution questions seldom admit definitive answers without structured ground truth. We present ESL-Bench, an event-driven synthesis framework and benchmark providing 100 synthetic users, each with a 1-5 year trajectory comprising a health profile, a multi-phase narrative plan, daily device measurements, periodic exam records, and an event log with explicit per-indicator impact parameters. Each indicator follows a baseline stochastic process driven by discrete events with sigmoid-onset, exponential-decay kernels under saturation and projection constraints; a hybrid pipeline delegates sparse semantic artifacts to LLM-based planning and dense indicator dynamics to algorithmic simulation with hard physiological bounds. Users are each paired with 100 evaluation queries across five dimensions - Lookup, Trend, Comparison, Anomaly, Explanation - stratified into Easy, Medium, and Hard tiers, with all ground-truth answers programmatically computable from the recorded event-indicator relationships. Evaluating 13 methods spanning LLMs with tools, DB-native agents, and memory-augmented RAG, we find that DB agents (48-58%) substantially outperform memory RAG baselines (30-38%), with the gap concentrated on Comparison and Explanation queries where multi-hop reasoning and evidence attribution are required.
tldr: This paper introduces a synthetic benchmark for evaluating longitudinal health agents, focusing on event-driven data generation and multi-faceted query answering, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于评估纵向健康智能体的合成基准，侧重于事件驱动的数据生成和多方面查询回答，与机器人学或具身AI无直接关联。
summary_zh: 纵向健康智能体必须能够处理融合连续设备数据流、稀疏临床检查以及偶发生活事件的多源轨迹——然而，评估这类智能体十分困难：真实世界数据无法大规模公开，且缺乏结构化基准数据的情况下，基于时序的归因分析问题往往难以得出明确结论。为此，我们提出ESL-Bench，这是一个事件驱动的合成框架与基准测试集，包含100个合成用户，每个用户拥有1-5年的轨迹数据，涵盖健康档案、多阶段叙事计划、每日设备测量值、定期检查记录以及附带明确指标影响参数的事件日志。每个健康指标遵循基线随机过程，其变化受离散事件驱动，事件影响采用S型函数启动，在饱和与投影约束下按指数核衰减；混合生成流程将稀疏的语义信息交由基于大语言模型的规划模块处理，而密集的指标动态变化则通过算法模拟实现，并受严格生理边界限制。每位用户关联100个跨五类任务的评估问题——包括查询、趋势分析、比较、异常检测和解释——这些问题按难度分为简单、中等和困难三个等级，所有真实答案均可通过记录的事件-指标关系以编程方式计算得出。通过评估涵盖工具增强大语言模型、数据库原生智能体和记忆增强检索生成框架的13种方法，我们发现数据库原生智能体（48-58%的准确率）显著优于记忆增强检索生成基线（30-38%），差异主要集中在需要多跳推理和证据归因的比较与解释类任务上。

title: QAPruner: Quantization-Aware Vision Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong reasoning ability, but their high computational and memory costs hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. While Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) and vision token pruning are standard compression techniques, they are usually treated as independent optimizations. In this paper, we show that these two techniques are strongly coupled: naively applying semantic-based token pruning to PTQ-optimized MLLMs can discard activation outliers that are important for numerical stability and thus worsen quantization errors in low-bit regimes (\textit{e.g.}, W4A4). To address this issue, we propose a quantization-aware vision token pruning framework. Our method introduces a lightweight hybrid sensitivity metric that combines simulated group-wise quantization error with outlier intensity. By combining this metric with standard semantic relevance scores, the method retains tokens that are both semantically informative and robust to quantization. Experiments on standard LLaVA architectures show that our method consistently outperforms naive integration baselines. At an aggressive pruning ratio that retains only 12.5\% of visual tokens, our framework improves accuracy by 2.24\% over the baseline and even surpasses dense quantization without pruning. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first method that explicitly co-optimizes vision token pruning and PTQ for accurate low-bit MLLM inference.
tldr: This paper proposes a method for co-optimizing vision token pruning and post-training quantization for Multimodal LLMs to improve efficiency without sacrificing accuracy, but it is not directly applied to robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种为多模态大语言模型联合优化视觉令牌剪枝和训练后量化的方法，旨在提高效率而不牺牲精度，但未直接应用于机器人领域。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型展现出强大的推理能力，但其高昂的计算与内存成本阻碍了在资源受限环境中的部署。后训练量化和视觉令牌剪枝是标准压缩技术，但通常被作为独立优化方法处理。本文揭示了这两种技术存在强耦合关系：在量化优化后的多模态大语言模型上直接应用基于语义的令牌剪枝，可能丢弃对数值稳定性至关重要的激活异常值，从而在低比特场景下加剧量化误差。为解决此问题，我们提出一种量化感知的视觉令牌剪枝框架。该方法通过轻量级混合敏感度度量，将模拟分组量化误差与异常值强度相结合，并与标准语义相关性评分协同工作，从而保留兼具语义信息价值与量化鲁棒性的关键令牌。在标准LLaVA架构上的实验表明，本方法始终优于简单集成基线方案。在仅保留12.5%视觉令牌的激进剪枝比例下，我们的框架相比基线准确率提升2.24%，甚至超越未剪枝的稠密量化模型。据我们所知，这是首个通过显式协同优化视觉令牌剪枝与后训练量化来实现精准低比特多模态大语言模型推理的方法。

title: PaveBench: A Versatile Benchmark for Pavement Distress Perception and Interactive Vision-Language Analysis
summary: Pavement condition assessment is essential for road safety and maintenance. Existing research has made significant progress. However, most studies focus on conventional computer vision tasks such as classification, detection, and segmentation. In real-world applications, pavement inspection requires more than visual recognition. It also requires quantitative analysis, explanation, and interactive decision support. Current datasets are limited. They focus on unimodal perception. They lack support for multi-turn interaction and fact-grounded reasoning. They also do not connect perception with vision-language analysis. To address these limitations, we introduce PaveBench, a large-scale benchmark for pavement distress perception and interactive vision-language analysis on real-world highway inspection images. PaveBench supports four core tasks: classification, object detection, semantic segmentation, and vision-language question answering. It provides unified task definitions and evaluation protocols. On the visual side, PaveBench provides large-scale annotations and includes a curated hard-distractor subset for robustness evaluation. It contains a large collection of real-world pavement images. On the multimodal side, we introduce PaveVQA, a real-image question answering (QA) dataset that supports single-turn, multi-turn, and expert-corrected interactions. It covers recognition, localization, quantitative estimation, and maintenance reasoning. We evaluate several state-of-the-art methods and provide a detailed analysis. We also present a simple and effective agent-augmented visual question answering framework that integrates domain-specific models as tools alongside vision-language models. The dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MML-Group/PaveBench.
tldr: This paper introduces PaveBench, a comprehensive dataset for pavement distress evaluation, focusing on visual tasks and vision-language question answering, but without explicit connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PaveBench，一个用于路面损坏评估的综合数据集，侧重于视觉任务和视觉-语言问答，但没有明确与机器人或具身智能关联。
summary_zh: 路面状况评估对于道路安全与维护至关重要。现有研究已取得显著进展。然而，多数研究聚焦于分类、检测与分割等传统计算机视觉任务。在实际应用中，路面巡检不仅需要视觉识别，还要求定量分析、解释说明与交互式决策支持。现有数据集存在局限：主要关注单模态感知，缺乏对多轮交互与事实依据推理的支持，且未将感知与视觉-语言分析相结合。为突破这些限制，我们提出了PaveBench——一个基于真实高速公路巡检图像的大规模基准数据集，用于路面病害感知与交互式视觉-语言分析。PaveBench支持四大核心任务：分类、目标检测、语义分割及视觉-语言问答，并提供统一的任务定义与评估标准。在视觉层面，PaveBench提供大规模标注数据，并包含精心筛选的困难干扰子集以评估模型鲁棒性，汇集了大量真实路面图像。在多模态层面，我们推出了PaveVQA真实图像问答数据集，支持单轮对话、多轮对话及专家修正交互，涵盖识别、定位、定量估算与维护决策推理。我们对多种前沿方法进行了评估与详细分析，并提出一种简单有效的智能体增强视觉问答框架，该框架将领域专用模型作为工具与视觉-语言模型集成。数据集可通过以下链接获取：https://huggingface.co/datasets/MML-Group/PaveBench。

title: Rubrics to Tokens: Bridging Response-level Rubrics and Token-level Rewards in Instruction Following Tasks
summary: Rubric-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with complex, open-domain instruction following tasks. However, existing methods predominantly rely on response-level rewards, introducing severe reward sparsity and reward ambiguity problems. To address these issues, we propose Rubrics to Tokens (RTT), a novel rubric-based RL framework that bridges coarse response-level scores and fine-grained token-level credit assignment. RTT introduces a Token-Level Relevance Discriminator to predict which tokens in the response are responsible for a specific constraint, and optimizes the policy model via RTT-GRPO, which integrates response-level and token-level advantages within a unified framework. Furthermore, when transitioning from one-dimensional, outcome-level reward to three-dimensional reward space in the token-level rubric-based RL, we propose a novel group normalization method, called Intra-sample Token Group Normalization, to accommodate this shift. Extensive experiments and benchmarks demonstrate that RTT consistently outperforms other baselines in both instruction- and rubric-level accuracy across different models.
tldr: This paper proposes Rubrics to Tokens (RTT), a new reinforcement learning framework for aligning large language models to better follow instructions, by introducing token-level credit assignment to address reward sparsity and ambiguity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Rubrics to Tokens（RTT），一种新的强化学习框架，旨在通过引入token级别的信用分配来解决奖励稀疏和歧义问题，从而更好地使大语言模型遵循指令。
summary_zh: 基于量规的强化学习已成为使大型语言模型与复杂、开放领域指令遵循任务对齐的重要方法。然而，现有方法主要依赖响应级别的奖励，导致严重的奖励稀疏性和奖励模糊性问题。为应对这些挑战，本文提出一种基于量规的强化学习新框架——RTT，该框架通过标记级别的信用分配机制，弥合了粗粒度的响应评分与细粒度的标记级反馈之间的差距。RTT引入了标记级别相关性判别器，用于预测响应中哪些标记与特定约束条件相关，并通过RTT-GRPO算法优化策略模型，将响应级别与标记级别的优势评估整合于统一框架中。此外，在基于量规的强化学习从一维结果奖励转向标记级别三维奖励空间时，我们提出了一种名为“样本内标记组归一化”的新型组归一化方法，以适应这一转变。大量实验与基准测试表明，在不同模型上，RTT在指令遵循与量规准则的准确性上均持续优于其他基线方法。

title: LumaFlux: Lifting 8-Bit Worlds to HDR Reality with Physically-Guided Diffusion Transformers
summary: The rapid adoption of HDR-capable devices has created a pressing need to convert the 8-bit Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) content into perceptually and physically accurate 10-bit High Dynamic Range (HDR). Existing inverse tone-mapping (ITM) methods often rely on fixed tone-mapping operators that struggle to generalize to real-world degradations, stylistic variations, and camera pipelines, frequently producing clipped highlights, desaturated colors, or unstable tone reproduction. We introduce LumaFlux, a first physically and perceptually guided diffusion transformer (DiT) for SDR-to-HDR reconstruction by adapting a large pretrained DiT. Our LumaFlux introduces (1) a Physically-Guided Adaptation (PGA) module that injects luminance, spatial descriptors, and frequency cues into attention through low-rank residuals; (2) a Perceptual Cross-Modulation (PCM) layer that stabilizes chroma and texture via FiLM conditioning from vision encoder features; and (3) an HDR Residual Coupler that fuses physical and perceptual signals under a timestep- and layer-adaptive modulation schedule. Finally, a lightweight Rational-Quadratic Spline decoder reconstructs smooth, interpretable tone fields for highlight and exposure expansion, enhancing the output of the VAE decoder to generate HDR. To enable robust HDR learning, we curate the first large-scale SDR-HDR training corpus. For fair and reproducible comparison, we further establish a new evaluation benchmark, comprising HDR references and corresponding expert-graded SDR versions. Across benchmarks, LumaFlux outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior luminance reconstruction and perceptual color fidelity with minimal additional parameters.
tldr: LumaFlux is a physically and perceptually guided diffusion transformer for converting 8-bit SDR video to 10-bit HDR, focusing on visual quality and reconstruction accuracy without any connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: LumaFlux是一种物理和感知引导的扩散变换器，用于将8位标准动态范围视频转换为10位高动态范围，专注于视觉质量和重建精度，与机器人学或具身AI无关。
summary_zh: 支持HDR设备的快速普及，使得将8位标准动态范围内容转换为具有感知与物理精确性的10位高动态范围内容成为迫切需求。现有的逆色调映射方法常依赖固定色调映射算子，难以泛化至实际退化、风格化差异及相机处理流程，常导致高光裁剪、色彩褪色或色调复现不稳定等问题。本文提出LumaFlux，首个基于物理与感知引导的扩散Transformer模型，通过适配大型预训练DiT实现SDR至HDR重建。LumaFlux创新性地引入：（1）物理引导适配模块，通过低秩残差将亮度、空间描述符与频率线索注入注意力机制；（2）感知交叉调制层，利用视觉编码器特征的FiLM条件化实现色度与纹理的稳定调控；（3）HDR残差耦合器，在时间步与层级自适应调制策略下融合物理与感知信号。最后，通过轻量级有理二次样条解码器重建平滑可解释的色调场，用于高光与曝光扩展，并增强VAE解码器输出以生成HDR图像。为支撑稳健的HDR学习，我们构建了首个大规模SDR-HDR训练数据集；同时建立包含HDR参考图像与专家分级SDR版本的新评估基准，以确保公平可复现的比较。在多项基准测试中，LumaFlux以最少的参数量增量显著超越现有先进基线模型，在亮度重建与感知色彩保真度方面均表现出卓越性能。

title: SentinelAgent: Intent-Verified Delegation Chains for Securing Federal Multi-Agent AI Systems
summary: When Agent A delegates to Agent B, which invokes Tool C on behalf of User X, no existing framework can answer: whose authorization chain led to this action, and where did it violate policy? This paper introduces SentinelAgent, a formal framework for verifiable delegation chains in federal multi-agent AI systems. The Delegation Chain Calculus (DCC) defines seven properties - six deterministic (authority narrowing, policy preservation, forensic reconstructibility, cascade containment, scope-action conformance, output schema conformance) and one probabilistic (intent preservation) - with four meta-theorems and one proposition establishing the practical infeasibility of deterministic intent verification. The Intent-Preserving Delegation Protocol (IPDP) enforces all seven properties at runtime through a non-LLM Delegation Authority Service. A three-point verification lifecycle achieves 100% combined TPR at 0% FPR on DelegationBench v4 (516 scenarios, 10 attack categories, 13 federal domains). Under black-box adversarial conditions, the DAS blocks 30/30 attacks with 0 false positives. Deterministic properties are unbreakable under adversarial stress testing; intent verification degrades to 13% against sophisticated paraphrasing. Fine-tuning the NLI model on 190 government delegation examples improves P2 from 1.7% to 88.3% TPR (5-fold cross-validated, F1=82.1%). Properties P1, P3-P7 are mechanically verified via TLA+ model checking across 2.7 million states with zero violations. Even when intent verification is evaded, the remaining six properties constrain the adversary to permitted API calls, conformant outputs, traceable actions, bounded cascades, and compliant behavior.
tldr: This paper introduces a formal framework for securing multi-agent AI systems through verifiable delegation chains, focusing on deterministic properties and probabilistic intent verification.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种通过可验证的委托链来保护联邦多智能体AI系统的正式框架，专注于确定性属性和概率性意图验证。
summary_zh: 当代理A委托代理B代表用户X调用工具C时，现有框架均无法回答：此次行动遵循了谁的授权链？何处违反了策略？本文提出SentinelAgent——一个用于联邦多智能体AI系统中可验证委托链的正式框架。委托链演算定义了七个属性：六个确定性属性（权限收缩、策略保持、溯源重构性、级联遏制、作用域-行为一致性、输出模式一致性）与一个概率性属性（意图保持），并通过四个元定理和一个命题确立了确定性意图验证的实际不可行性。意图保持委托协议通过非LLM委托授权服务在运行时强制执行全部七项属性。基于DelegationBench v4数据集的验证生命周期实现了三项综合检测：在516个场景、10类攻击、13个联邦领域的测试中，召回率达到100%且误报率为0。在黑盒对抗条件下，委托授权服务成功拦截全部30次攻击且无误报。确定性属性在对抗压力测试中未被突破；意图验证在复杂语义改写攻击下效能降至13%。通过对190个政府委托案例微调自然语言推理模型，意图保持属性（P2）的召回率从1.7%提升至88.3%（五折交叉验证，F1=82.1%）。属性P1、P3-P7通过TLA+模型检查在270万个状态中实现机械验证，零违规记录。即使意图验证被规避，其余六项属性仍能将攻击者限制在允许的API调用、合规输出、可追溯行为、有限级联及规范操作的框架内。

title: Random Is Hard to Beat: Active Selection in online DPO with Modern LLMs
summary: Modern LLMs inherit strong priors from web-scale pretraining, which can limit the headroom of post-training data-selection strategies. While Active Preference Learning (APL) seeks to optimize query efficiency in online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), the inherent richness of on-policy candidate pools often renders simple Random sampling a surprisingly formidable baseline. We evaluate uncertainty-based APL against Random across harmlessness, helpfulness, and instruction-following settings, utilizing both reward models and LLM-as-a-judge proxies. We find that APL yields negligible improvements in proxy win-rates compared to Random. Crucially, we observe a dissociation where win-rate improves even as general capability -- measured by standard benchmarks -- degrades. APL fails to mitigate this capability collapse or reduce variance significantly better than random sampling. Our findings suggest that in the regime of strong pre-trained priors, the computational overhead of active selection is difficult to justify against the ``cheap diversity'' provided by simple random samples. Our code is available at https://github.com/BootsofLagrangian/random-vs-apl.
tldr: This paper finds that for online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with modern LLMs, active preference selection strategies offer minimal efficiency gains over random sampling, challenging their utility in this regime.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文发现，对于现代大语言模型的在线直接偏好优化，主动偏好选择策略相比随机采样效率提升甚微，这挑战了其在该领域的实用性。
summary_zh: 现代大型语言模型从网络规模预训练中继承了强大的先验知识，这可能会限制训练后数据选择策略的改进空间。尽管主动偏好学习旨在优化在线直接偏好优化中的查询效率，但同策略候选池固有的丰富性往往使简单随机采样成为令人惊讶的强大基线。我们在无害性、帮助性和指令遵循三种设置下，利用奖励模型和LLM-as-a-judge代理指标，将基于不确定性的主动偏好学习与随机采样进行对比评估。研究发现，相较于随机采样，主动偏好学习在代理胜率上仅带来微乎其微的提升。关键的是，我们观察到一种分离现象：即使标准基准测试衡量的通用能力出现下降，胜率指标仍能保持改善。主动偏好学习在缓解这种能力崩溃或降低方差方面，并未显著优于随机采样。我们的研究结果表明，在强预训练先验存在的条件下，主动选择带来的计算开销难以与简单随机采样提供的“廉价多样性”相抗衡。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/BootsofLagrangian/random-vs-apl。

title: Cross Event Detection and Topic Evolution Mining in cross events for Man Made Disasters in Social Media Streams
summary: Social media is widely used to share information globally and it also aids to gain attention from the world. When socially sensitive incidents like rape, human rights march, corruption, political controversy, chemical attacks occur, they gain immense attention from people all over the world, causing microblogging platforms like Twitter to get flooded with tweets related to such events. When an event evolves, many other events of a similar nature have happened in and around the same time frame. These are cross events because they are linked to the nature of the main event. Dissemination of information relating to such cross events helps in engaging the masses to share the varied views that emerge out of the similarities and differences between the events. Cross event detection is critical in determining the nature of events. Cross events have fulcrums points, i.e., topics around which the discussion is focused, as the event evolves which must be considered in topic evolution. We have proposed Cross Event Evolution Detection CEED framework which detects cross events that are similar with regards to their temporal nature resulting from main events. Event detection is based on the tweet segmentation using the Wikipedia title database and clustering segments based on a similarity measure. The cross event detection algorithm reveals events that overlap in both time and context to evaluate the effects of these cross events on deliberate negligent human actions. The topic evolution algorithm puts into perspective the change in topics for an events lifetime. The experimental results on a real Twitter data set demonstrate the effectiveness and precision of our proposed framework for both cross event detection and topic evolution algorithm during the evolution of cross events.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework (CEED) for detecting cross events and mining topic evolution in social media streams, specifically for man-made disasters, focusing on Twitter data analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于检测社交媒体流中交叉事件并挖掘其主题演化的框架（CEED），特别针对人为灾难事件，基于Twitter数据分析。
summary_zh: 社交媒体被广泛用于全球信息分享，并有助于吸引世界的关注。当诸如强奸、人权游行、腐败、政治争议、化学袭击等社会敏感事件发生时，它们会引起全球民众的极大关注，导致推特等微博平台被与此类事件相关的推文淹没。当一个事件发展时，许多其他类似性质的事件也在同一时间段内及周边发生。这些事件被称为交叉事件，因为它们与主要事件的性质相关联。传播此类交叉事件的相关信息有助于吸引公众参与分享由事件间的相似性和差异性所产生的多元观点。交叉事件检测对于确定事件性质至关重要。交叉事件存在支点，即随着事件发展而成为讨论焦点的话题，这些话题必须在主题演化过程中予以考虑。我们提出了交叉事件演化检测（CEED）框架，该框架能够检测出由主要事件引发、在时间属性上相似的交叉事件。事件检测基于利用维基百科标题数据库进行的推文分割，并通过相似性度量对分割后的文本进行聚类。交叉事件检测算法揭示了在时间和上下文上重叠的事件，以评估这些交叉事件对人为故意疏忽行为的影响。主题演化算法则从事件生命周期的角度分析了主题的变化。在真实推特数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的框架在交叉事件演化过程中，无论是交叉事件检测还是主题演化算法，均表现出良好的有效性和精确性。

title: IndustryCode: A Benchmark for Industry Code Generation
summary: Code generation and comprehension by Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as core drivers of industrial intelligence and decision optimization, finding widespread application in fields such as finance, automation, and aerospace. Although recent advancements have demonstrated the remarkable potential of LLMs in general code generation, existing benchmarks are mainly confined to single domains and languages. Consequently, they fail to effectively evaluate the generalization capabilities required for real-world industrial applications or to reflect the coding proficiency demanded by complex industrial scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce IndustryCode, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to span multiple industrial domains and programming languages. IndustryCode comprises 579 sub-problems derived from 125 primary industrial challenges, accompanied by rigorous problem descriptions and test cases. It covers a wide range of fields, including finance, automation, aerospace, and remote sensing-and incorporates diverse programming languages such as MATLAB, Python, C++, and Stata. In our evaluation, the top-performing model, Claude 4.5 Opus, achieved an overall accuracy of 68.1% on sub-problems and 42.5% main problems. The benchmark dataset and automated evaluation code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
tldr: Presents IndustryCode, a multi-domain, multi-language benchmark for evaluating LLM code generation in industrial settings like finance and automation, with top model scoring 68.1% accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出了IndustryCode，这是一个用于评估LLM在金融、自动化等工业领域代码生成能力的多领域、多语言基准，最佳模型准确率为68.1%。
summary_zh: 大语言模型的代码生成与理解已成为工业智能与决策优化的核心驱动力，在金融、自动化、航空航天等领域得到广泛应用。尽管近期研究进展已证明大语言模型在通用代码生成方面的显著潜力，但现有基准测试主要局限于单一领域和语言，因此无法有效评估实际工业应用所需的泛化能力，也难以反映复杂工业场景所要求的编码水平。为填补这一空白，我们提出了IndustryCode——首个涵盖多工业领域与编程语言的综合性基准测试。该测试集包含从125个核心工业挑战中提取的579个子问题，并配有严谨的问题描述与测试用例，覆盖金融、自动化、航空航天、遥感等广泛领域，同时整合了MATLAB、Python、C++、Stata等多种编程语言。在评估中，表现最优的模型Claude 4.5 Opus在子问题上的总体准确率达到68.1%，在主要问题上达到42.5%。本基准测试数据集及自动化评估代码将在论文录用后公开。

title: Evaluating the Formal Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models through Chomsky Hierarchy
summary: The formal reasoning capabilities of LLMs are crucial for advancing automated software engineering. However, existing benchmarks for LLMs lack systematic evaluation based on computation and complexity, leaving a critical gap in understanding their formal reasoning capabilities. Therefore, it is still unknown whether SOTA LLMs can grasp the structured, hierarchical complexity of formal languages as defined by Computation Theory. To address this, we introduce ChomskyBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs through the lens of Chomsky Hierarchy. Unlike prior work that uses vectorized classification for neural networks, ChomskyBench is the first to combine full Chomsky Hierarchy coverage, process-trace evaluation via natural language, and deterministic symbolic verifiability. ChomskyBench is composed of a comprehensive suite of language recognition and generation tasks designed to test capabilities at each level. Extensive experiments indicate a clear performance stratification that correlates with the hierarchy's levels of complexity. Our analysis reveals a direct relationship where increasing task difficulty substantially impacts both inference length and performance. Furthermore, we find that while larger models and advanced inference methods offer notable relative gains, they face severe efficiency barriers: achieving practical reliability would require prohibitive computational costs, revealing that current limitations stem from inefficiency rather than absolute capability bounds. A time complexity analysis further indicates that LLMs are significantly less efficient than traditional algorithmic programs for these formal tasks. These results delineate the practical limits of current LLMs, highlight the indispensability of traditional software tools, and provide insights to guide the development of future LLMs with more powerful formal reasoning capabilities.
tldr: Introduces ChomskyBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' formal reasoning capabilities across the Chomsky Hierarchy, revealing performance stratification, severe efficiency limitations, and the need for traditional tools.
tldr_zh: 介绍了ChomskyBench，这是一个基于乔姆斯基层级评估大语言模型形式推理能力的基准，揭示了其性能分层、严重效率限制以及对传统工具的需求。
summary_zh: LLMs的形式推理能力对推进自动化软件工程至关重要。然而，现有LLM评测基准缺乏基于计算与复杂性的系统化评估，导致对其形式推理能力的理解存在关键空白。因此，目前尚不清楚最先进的LLMs能否真正把握计算理论所定义的形式语言的结构化、层次化复杂性。为此，我们提出ChomskyBench——一个基于乔姆斯基层级理论系统评估LLMs的基准。与先前采用向量化分类方法评估神经网络的研究不同，ChomskyBench首次实现了对乔姆斯基层级的完整覆盖，通过自然语言进行过程轨迹评估，并保持确定性符号可验证性。该基准包含一套全面的语言识别与生成任务，旨在测试每个层级的能力。大量实验表明，模型性能存在与层级复杂度明确对应的分层现象。我们的分析揭示了任务难度提升会显著影响推理长度和性能的直接关系。此外，研究发现，尽管更大规模的模型和先进的推理方法能带来明显的相对性能提升，但它们面临严重的效率瓶颈：要达到实用可靠性需要极高的计算成本，这表明当前局限源于效率低下而非绝对能力边界。时间复杂度分析进一步指出，LLMs在处理这些形式任务时，效率显著低于传统算法程序。这些结果界定了当前LLMs的实际能力边界，凸显了传统软件工具不可替代的价值，并为开发具备更强形式推理能力的未来LLMs提供了方向指引。

title: DocShield: Towards AI Document Safety via Evidence-Grounded Agentic Reasoning
summary: The rapid progress of generative AI has enabled increasingly realistic text-centric image forgeries, posing major challenges to document safety. Existing forensic methods mainly rely on visual cues and lack evidence-based reasoning to reveal subtle text manipulations. Detection, localization, and explanation are often treated as isolated tasks, limiting reliability and interpretability. To tackle these challenges, we propose DocShield, the first unified framework formulating text-centric forgery analysis as a visual-logical co-reasoning problem. At its core, a novel Cross-Cues-aware Chain of Thought (CCT) mechanism enables implicit agentic reasoning, iteratively cross-validating visual anomalies with textual semantics to produce consistent, evidence-grounded forensic analysis. We further introduce a Weighted Multi-Task Reward for GRPO-based optimization, aligning reasoning structure, spatial evidence, and authenticity prediction. Complementing the framework, we construct RealText-V1, a multilingual dataset of document-like text images with pixel-level manipulation masks and expert-level textual explanations. Extensive experiments show DocShield significantly outperforms existing methods, improving macro-average F1 by 41.4% over specialized frameworks and 23.4% over GPT-4o on T-IC13, with consistent gains on the challenging T-SROIE benchmark. Our dataset, model, and code will be publicly released.
tldr: This paper proposes DocShield, a unified framework for detecting and analyzing forged text in document images using visual-logical co-reasoning and a novel dataset, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DocShield，一个用于检测和分析文档图像中伪造文本的统一框架，使用视觉-逻辑协同推理和一个新数据集，与机器人学或具身AI没有直接关联。
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能的快速发展使得以文本为中心的图像伪造日益逼真，给文档安全带来重大挑战。现有的取证方法主要依赖视觉线索，缺乏基于证据的推理来揭示细微的文本篡改。检测、定位和解释通常被作为独立任务处理，限制了方法的可靠性和可解释性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出首个统一框架DocShield，将文本中心伪造分析建模为视觉-逻辑协同推理问题。其核心是新型的跨线索感知思维链机制，通过隐式智能体推理迭代交叉验证视觉异常与文本语义，从而产生一致且基于证据的取证分析。我们进一步引入加权多任务奖励机制，配合基于GRPO的优化策略，实现对推理结构、空间证据与真实性预测的协同对齐。为支撑该框架，我们构建了RealText-V1多语言文档类文本图像数据集，包含像素级篡改掩码和专家级文本解释。大量实验表明，DocShield显著优于现有方法：在T-IC13数据集上，其宏平均F1分数较专用框架提升41.4%，较GPT-4o提升23.4%，并在具有挑战性的T-SROIE基准测试中取得稳定优势。我们的数据集、模型与代码将公开发布。

title: Beyond Semantic Manipulation: Token-Space Attacks on Reward Models
summary: Reward models (RMs) are widely used as optimization targets in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), yet they remain vulnerable to reward hacking. Existing attacks mainly operate within the semantic space, constructing human-readable adversarial outputs that exploit RM biases. In this work, we introduce a fundamentally different paradigm: Token Mapping Perturbation Attack (TOMPA), a framework that performs adversarial optimization directly in token space. By bypassing the standard decode-re-tokenize interface between the policy and the reward model, TOMPA enables the attack policy to optimize over raw token sequences rather than coherent natural language. Using only black-box scalar feedback, TOMPA automatically discovers non-linguistic token patterns that elicit extremely high rewards across multiple state-of-the-art RMs. Specifically, when targeting Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B, TOMPA nearly doubles the reward of GPT-5 reference answers and outperforms them on 98.0% of prompts. Despite these high scores, the generated outputs degenerate into nonsensical text, revealing that RMs can be systematically exploited beyond the semantic regime and exposing a critical vulnerability in current RLHF pipelines.
tldr: This paper introduces a token-space adversarial attack (TOMPA) that exploits reward models in RLHF by generating nonsensical, high-reward token sequences, revealing a critical vulnerability in current RLHF pipelines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对RLHF中奖励模型的令牌空间对抗攻击（TOMPA），通过生成无意义的高奖励令牌序列来利用奖励模型，揭示了当前RLHF管道中的一个关键漏洞。
summary_zh: 奖励模型(RMs)作为人类反馈强化学习(RLHF)的优化目标被广泛使用，但它们仍然容易受到奖励攻击的影响。现有攻击主要在语义空间内进行，通过构建可读的对抗性输出来利用奖励模型偏差。本研究提出一种根本不同的范式：令牌映射扰动攻击(TOMPA)——一种直接在令牌空间执行对抗性优化的框架。通过绕过策略与奖励模型之间标准的解码-再令牌化接口，TOMPA使攻击策略能够对原始令牌序列而非连贯的自然语言进行优化。仅使用黑盒标量反馈，TOMPA即可自动发现能引发多种先进奖励模型极高奖励的非语言令牌模式。具体而言，在针对Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B的测试中，TOMPA将GPT-5参考答案的奖励值提升近一倍，并在98.0%的提示词上表现更优。尽管获得如此高分，生成的输出却退化为无意义的文本，这揭示出奖励模型在语义体系之外仍可能被系统性利用，并暴露了当前RLHF流程中的关键漏洞。

title: Too Polite to Disagree: Understanding Sycophancy Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit sycophancy: agreement with user stance even when it conflicts with the model's opinion. While prior work has mostly studied this in single-agent settings, it remains underexplored in collaborative multi-agent systems. We ask whether awareness of other agents' sycophancy levels influences discussion outcomes. To investigate this, we run controlled experiments with six open-source LLMs, providing agents with peer sycophancy rankings that estimate each peer's tendency toward sycophancy. These rankings are based on scores calculated using various static (pre-discussion) and dynamic (online) strategies. We find that providing sycophancy priors reduces the influence of sycophancy-prone peers, mitigates error-cascades, and improves final discussion accuracy by an absolute 10.5%. Thus, this is a lightweight, effective way to reduce discussion sycophancy and improve downstream accuracy.
tldr: The paper investigates sycophancy in LLMs, focusing on how awareness of other agents' sycophancy levels in multi-agent discussions can reduce sycophantic behavior and improve discussion accuracy by 10.5%.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究大语言模型的阿谀奉承现象，重点关注多智能体讨论中了解其他智能体的阿谀奉承程度如何能减少阿谀奉承行为，并将讨论准确性提高10.5%。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）常表现出谄媚倾向：即使用户立场与模型自身观点相冲突，模型仍选择附和用户。先前研究主要集中于单智能体场景，而在协作多智能体系统中该现象尚未得到充分探索。本研究探讨了智能体对其他智能体谄媚程度的认知是否会影响讨论结果。为此，我们选取六个开源大语言模型进行对照实验，向智能体提供基于同伴谄媚倾向评估的排名信息。这些排名通过多种静态（讨论前）与动态（实时）策略计算得出。实验表明，提供谄媚先验信息能够削弱高谄媚倾向同伴的影响力，减少错误级联效应，并将最终讨论准确率绝对值提升10.5%。因此，这是一种轻量化且有效的降低讨论谄媚性、提升下游任务准确率的方法。

title: GBQA: A Game Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Quality Assurance Engineers
summary: The autonomous discovery of bugs remains a significant challenge in modern software development. Compared to code generation, the complexity of dynamic runtime environments makes bug discovery considerably harder for large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we take game development as a representative domain and introduce the Game Benchmark for Quality Assurance (GBQA), a benchmark containing 30 games and 124 human-verified bugs across three difficulty levels, to evaluate whether LLMs can autonomously detect software bugs. The benchmark is constructed using a multi-agent system that develops games and injects bugs in a scalable manner, with human experts in the loop to ensure correctness. Moreover, we provide a baseline interactive agent equipped with a multi-round ReAct loop and a memory mechanism, enabling long-horizon exploration of game environments for bug detection across different LLMs. Extensive experiments on frontier LLMs demonstrate that autonomous bug discovery remains highly challenging: the best-performing model, Claude-4.6-Opus in thinking mode, identifies only 48.39% of the verified bugs. We believe GBQA provides an adequate testbed and evaluation criterion, and that further progress on it will help close the gap in autonomous software engineering.
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark (GBQA) for evaluating LLMs at autonomously detecting bugs in game software, using a multi-agent system to create and inject bugs, and proposes a baseline agent with a ReAct loop for long-horizon exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于评估大语言模型在游戏软件中自主发现漏洞能力的基准（GBQA），它使用多智能体系统创建和注入漏洞，并提出了一个基于ReAct循环的基线智能体以支持长期探索。
summary_zh: 自主发现错误仍然是现代软件开发中的一项重大挑战。与代码生成相比，动态运行时环境的复杂性使得大语言模型在错误发现上面临更大的困难。本文以游戏开发为代表性领域，引入了质量保证游戏基准测试（GBQA），该基准包含30款游戏和124个经过人工验证的错误，分为三个难度等级，用于评估大语言模型能否自主检测软件错误。该基准通过多智能体系统以可扩展的方式构建游戏并注入错误，并引入人类专家参与以确保正确性。此外，我们提出了一个配备多轮ReAct循环和记忆机制的基线交互式智能体，使其能够在游戏环境中进行长时程探索以检测不同大语言模型下的错误。对前沿大语言模型的大量实验表明，自主错误发现依然极具挑战性：性能最佳的模型——Claude-4.6-Opus在思维模式下——仅能发现48.39%的已验证错误。我们相信GBQA为相关研究提供了充分的测试平台和评估标准，其进一步进展将有助于缩小自主软件工程领域的差距。

title: Toys that listen, talk, and play: Understanding Children's Sensemaking and Interactions with AI Toys
summary: Generative AI (genAI) is increasingly being integrated into children's everyday lives, not only through screens but also through so-called "screen-free" AI toys. These toys can simulate emotions, personalize responses, and recall prior interactions, creating the illusion of an ongoing social connection. Such capabilities raise important questions about how children understand boundaries, agency, and relationships when interacting with AI toys. To investigate this, we conducted two participatory design sessions with eight children ages 6-11 where they engaged with three different AI toys, shifting between play, experimentation, and reflection. Our findings reveal that children approached AI toys with genuine curiosity, profiling them as social beings. However, frequent interaction breakdowns and mismatches between apparent intelligence and toy-like form disrupted expectations around play and led to adversarial play. We conclude with implications and design provocations to navigate children's encounters with AI toys in more transparent, developmentally appropriate, and responsible ways.
tldr: The paper investigates children's sensemaking and interactions with AI toys, focusing on social connections, interaction breakdowns, and design implications, but does not involve robotics or embodied control.
tldr_zh: 该研究探讨了儿童与AI玩具的互动和意义构建，关注社交连接、互动中断及设计启示，但未涉及机器人学或具身控制。
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能（genAI）正日益融入儿童的日常生活，不仅通过屏幕媒介，还通过所谓的“无屏幕”人工智能玩具。这些玩具能够模拟情感、个性化回应并记忆先前的互动，营造出一种持续社交连接的假象。此类功能引发了重要问题：儿童在与人工智能玩具互动时如何理解边界、能动性与关系？为探究这一问题，我们与8名6-11岁儿童进行了两次参与式设计研讨，通过三种不同的人工智能玩具引导他们在游戏、实验与反思之间切换。研究发现，儿童以真诚的好奇心接触人工智能玩具，并将其视为社交对象。然而，频繁的互动中断、玩具外观与智能表现之间的错位破坏了游戏预期，进而引发对抗性游戏行为。最后，我们提出设计启示与思考，以期以更透明、更符合儿童发展特点且更负责任的方式引导儿童与人工智能玩具的互动。

title: Making Written Theorems Explorable by Grounding Them in Formal Representations
summary: LLM-generated explanations can make technical content more accessible, but there is a ceiling on what they can support interactively. Because LLM outputs are static text, they cannot be executed or stepped through. We argue that grounding explanations in a formalized representation enables interactive affordances beyond what static text supports. We instantiate this idea for mathematical proof comprehension with explorable theorems, a system that uses LLMs to translate a theorem and its written proof into Lean, a programming language for machine-checked proofs, and links the written proof with the Lean code. Readers can work through the proof at a step-level granularity, test custom examples or counterexamples, and trace the logical dependencies bridging each step. Each worked-out step is produced by executing the Lean proof on that example and extracting its intermediate state. A user study ($n = 16$) shows potential advantages of this approach: in a proof-reading task, participants who had access to the provided explorability features gave better, more correct, and more detailed answers to comprehension questions, demonstrating a stronger overall understanding of the underlying mathematics.
tldr: This paper introduces a system that uses LLMs to translate written mathematical proofs into formal Lean code, enabling interactive exploration and step-by-step verification of proofs.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个系统，利用大型语言模型将书面数学证明转化为形式化的 Lean 代码，实现了对证明的交互式探索和逐步验证。
summary_zh: LLM生成的解释可以使技术内容更易于理解，但其交互支持能力存在上限。由于LLM输出为静态文本，无法执行或逐步调试。我们认为，将解释基于形式化表示能够实现超越静态文本的交互支持能力。我们通过"可探索定理"系统将这一理念应用于数学证明理解：该系统利用LLM将定理及其书面证明转化为机器验证证明的编程语言Lean，并将书面证明与Lean代码相连接。读者可通过逐步细粒度验证证明过程、测试自定义示例或反例，并追踪每一步的逻辑依赖关系。每个已完成的步骤都是通过在示例上执行Lean证明并提取其中间状态生成的。用户研究（n=16）显示该方法的潜在优势：在证明审阅任务中，使用可探索功能的参与者对理解性问题给出了更优、更准确、更详细的答案，展现出对底层数学原理更深入的整体理解。

title: Generative AI Use in Entrepreneurship: An Integrative Review and an Empowerment-Entrapment Framework
summary: Despite the growing use of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in entrepreneurship, research on its impact remains fragmented. To address this limitation, we provide an integrative review of how GenAI influences entrepreneurs at each stage of the entrepreneurial process: (1) opportunity recognition and ideation, (2) opportunity evaluation and commitment, (3) resource assembly and mobilization, and (4) venture launch and growth. Based on our review, we propose the Empowerment-Entrapment Framework to understand how GenAI can both empower and entrap entrepreneurs, highlighting GenAI's role as a double-edged sword at each stage of the entrepreneurial process. For example, GenAI may improve venture idea quality but introduce hallucinations and training data biases; boost entrepreneurial self-efficacy but heighten entrepreneurial overconfidence; increase functional breadth but decrease relational embeddedness; and boost productivity but fuel "workslop" and erode critical thinking, learning, and memory. Moreover, we identify core features of GenAI that underlie these empowering and entrapping effects. We also explore boundary conditions (e.g., entrepreneurs' metacognition, domain expertise, and entrepreneurial experience) that shape the magnitude of these effects. Beyond these theoretical contributions, our review and the Empowerment-Entrapment Framework offer practical implications for entrepreneurs seeking to use GenAI strategically throughout the entrepreneurial process while managing its risks.
tldr: This paper is a review on the use of Generative AI in entrepreneurship, analyzing its dual empowering and entrapping effects throughout the entrepreneurial process, and proposes a conceptual framework for understanding these impacts.
tldr_zh: 本文是一篇关于生成式AI在创业中应用的综述，分析了其在创业全过程既赋能又限制的双重效应，并提出了一个理解这些影响的概念框架。
summary_zh: 尽管生成式人工智能在创业领域的应用日益广泛，但关于其影响的研究仍较为零散。为弥补这一局限，本文对生成式人工智能如何影响创业过程中的各个阶段进行了系统性整合评述，这些阶段包括：(1) 机会识别与创意生成，(2) 机会评估与承诺，(3) 资源整合与调动，(4) 企业创办与成长。基于评述，本文提出“赋能-束缚”框架，以阐释生成式人工智能如何在创业各阶段发挥双刃剑作用——既赋能创业者，又可能形成束缚。例如，生成式人工智能可提升创业想法的质量，但也会带来幻觉和训练数据偏差；增强创业自我效能感，却可能加剧创业过度自信；扩大功能广度，却削弱关系嵌入性；提高生产效率，却可能催生“工作泛滥”并削弱批判性思维、学习能力与记忆力。此外，我们识别出导致这些赋能与束缚效应的生成式人工智能核心特征，并探讨了影响效应强度的边界条件（如创业者的元认知能力、领域专业知识及创业经验）。除理论贡献外，本文的评述与“赋能-束缚”框架为创业者提供了实践启示：在创业全过程中，应如何策略性地运用生成式人工智能并有效管理其风险。

title: From Theory to Practice: Code Generation Using LLMs for CAPEC and CWE Frameworks
summary: The increasing complexity and volume of software systems have heightened the importance of identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities. The existing software vulnerability datasets frequently fall short in providing comprehensive, detailed code snippets explicitly linked to specific vulnerability descriptions, reducing their utility for advanced research and hindering efforts to develop a deeper understanding of security vulnerabilities. To address this challenge, we present a novel dataset that provides examples of vulnerable code snippets corresponding to Common Attack Pattern Enumerations and Classifications (CAPEC) and Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) descriptions. By employing the capabilities of Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) models, we have developed a robust methodology for generating these examples. Our approach utilizes GPT-4o, Llama and Claude models to generate code snippets that exhibit specific vulnerabilities as described in CAPEC and CWE documentation. This dataset not only enhances the understanding of security vulnerabilities in code but also serves as a valuable resource for training machine learning models focused on automatic vulnerability detection and remediation. Preliminary evaluations suggest that the dataset generated by Large Language Models demonstrates high accuracy and can serve as a reliable reference for vulnerability identification systems. We found consistent results across the three models, with 0.98 cosine similarity among codes. The final dataset comprises 615 CAPEC code snippets in three programming languages: Java, Python, and JavaScript, making it one of the most extensive and diverse resources in this domain.
tldr: This paper presents a novel dataset of vulnerable code snippets generated by LLMs for CAPEC and CWE security frameworks to aid in vulnerability detection research.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种由LLMs生成的CAPEC和CWE安全框架漏洞代码片段数据集，用于辅助漏洞检测研究。
summary_zh: 随着软件系统复杂性和规模的日益增长，识别与缓解安全漏洞的重要性愈发凸显。现有的软件漏洞数据集往往无法提供与特定漏洞描述明确对应的全面且详细的代码片段，这限制了其在高级研究中的应用价值，也阻碍了对安全漏洞的深入理解。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的数据集，该数据集提供了与常见攻击模式枚举与分类（CAPEC）及常见缺陷枚举（CWE）描述相对应的漏洞代码示例。通过利用生成式预训练转换器（GPT）模型的能力，我们开发了一套生成此类示例的可靠方法。该方法采用GPT-4o、Llama和Claude模型来生成展现CAPEC与CWE文档中描述的具体漏洞的代码片段。该数据集不仅增强了对代码中安全漏洞的理解，还为专注于自动漏洞检测与修复的机器学习模型训练提供了宝贵资源。初步评估表明，由大型语言模型生成的数据集具有较高准确性，可作为漏洞识别系统的可靠参考。我们发现三种模型生成的结果具有一致性，代码间的余弦相似度达到0.98。最终数据集包含以Java、Python和JavaScript三种编程语言编写的615个CAPEC代码片段，使其成为该领域最全面且多样化的资源之一。

title: Competency Questions as Executable Plans: a Controlled RAG Architecture for Cultural Heritage Storytelling
summary: The preservation of intangible cultural heritage is a critical challenge as collective memory fades over time. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for generating engaging narratives, their propensity for factual inaccuracies or "hallucinations" makes them unreliable for heritage applications where veracity is a central requirement. To address this, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic architecture grounded in Knowledge Graphs (KGs) that establishes a transparent "plan-retrieve-generate" workflow for story generation. A key novelty of our approach is the repurposing of competency questions (CQs) - traditionally design-time validation artifacts - into run-time executable narrative plans. This approach bridges the gap between high-level user personas and atomic knowledge retrieval, ensuring that generation is evidence-closed and fully auditable. We validate this architecture using a new resource: the Live Aid KG, a multimodal dataset aligning 1985 concert data with the Music Meta Ontology and linking to external multimedia assets. We present a systematic comparative evaluation of three distinct Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) strategies over this graph: a purely symbolic KG-RAG, a text-enriched Hybrid-RAG, and a structure-aware Graph-RAG. Our experiments reveal a quantifiable trade-off between the factual precision of symbolic retrieval, the contextual richness of hybrid methods, and the narrative coherence of graph-based traversal. Our findings offer actionable insights for designing personalised and controllable storytelling systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic, Knowledge Graph-based RAG architecture for generating factually accurate narratives for cultural heritage, focusing on the trade-offs between different retrieval strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于知识图谱的神经符号RAG架构，用于生成事实准确的文化遗产叙事，重点研究了不同检索策略之间的权衡。
summary_zh: 非物质文化遗产的保护是一项关键挑战，因为集体记忆会随时间流逝而淡化。虽然大型语言模型为生成引人入胜的叙事提供了可行路径，但其易于产生事实性错误或“幻觉”的倾向，使其难以满足文化遗产应用中以真实性为核心要求的场景。为此，我们提出了一种基于知识图谱的神经符号架构，为故事生成建立透明化的“规划-检索-生成”工作流。本方法的核心创新在于将能力问题——传统上作为设计阶段验证工具——重新定义为可运行时执行的叙事规划方案。这一方法弥合了高层次用户角色与原子化知识检索之间的鸿沟，确保生成过程具备证据闭环性与完全可审计性。我们使用新型资源“Live Aid知识图谱”验证该架构，该多模态数据集将1985年演唱会数据与音乐元本体对齐，并关联至外部多媒体资源。我们在此图谱上对三种检索增强生成策略进行了系统化比较评估：纯符号化的KG-RAG、文本增强的Hybrid-RAG以及结构感知的Graph-RAG。实验结果表明，符号化检索的事实准确性、混合方法的语境丰富度与基于图遍历的叙事连贯性之间存在可量化的权衡关系。本研究为设计个性化与可控的叙事系统提供了可操作的实践见解。

title: Opal: Private Memory for Personal AI
summary:
Personal AI systems increasingly retain long-term memory of user activity, including documents, emails, messages, meetings, and ambient recordings. Trusted hardware can keep this data private, but struggles to scale with a growing datastore. This pushes the data to external storage, which exposes retrieval access patterns that leak private information to the application provider. Oblivious RAM (ORAM) is a cryptographic primitive that can hide these patterns, but it requires a fixed access budget, precluding the query-dependent traversals that agentic memory systems rely on for accuracy.
  We present Opal, a private memory system for personal AI. Our key insight is to decouple all data-dependent reasoning from the bulk of personal data, confining it to the trusted enclave. Untrusted disk then sees only fixed, oblivious memory accesses. This enclave-resident component uses a lightweight knowledge graph to capture personal context that semantic search alone misses and handles continuous ingestion by piggybacking reindexing and capacity management on every ORAM access. Evaluated on a comprehensive synthetic personal-data pipeline driven by stochastic communication models, Opal improves retrieval accuracy by 13 percentage points over semantic search and achieves 29x higher throughput with 15x lower infrastructure cost than a secure baseline. Opal is under consideration for deployment to millions of users at a major AI provider.
tldr: Opal introduces a private memory system for personal AI that uses trusted hardware enclaves and Oblivious RAM to hide access patterns, improving retrieval accuracy and efficiency while protecting user data privacy.
tldr_zh: Opal提出了一种用于个人AI的私有记忆系统，利用可信硬件飞地和ORAM隐藏访问模式，在保护用户数据隐私的同时提高检索准确性和效率。
summary_zh:
个人人工智能系统日益保留着用户活动的长期记忆，包括文档、电子邮件、消息、会议和环境录音。可信硬件可以保护这些数据的隐私性，但难以应对不断增长的数据存储规模。这迫使数据被转移至外部存储，从而暴露了检索访问模式，导致应用提供商可能获取私人信息。不经意随机存取存储器（ORAM）作为一种加密原语可以隐藏这些模式，但它需要固定的访问预算，无法支持依赖于查询的遍历操作——而这正是智能记忆系统保证准确性所依赖的机制。

我们提出了Opal，一种用于个人人工智能的隐私记忆系统。我们的核心洞见在于将所有依赖数据的推理与大量个人数据解耦，将其限制在可信执行环境中。这样一来，不可信的磁盘端仅能看到固定且不可感知的内存访问。这一驻留在可信环境中的组件采用轻量级知识图谱来捕获仅靠语义搜索会遗漏的个人上下文信息，并通过在每个ORAM访问上附带进行重新索引和容量管理，实现持续的数据注入。在基于随机通信模型驱动的综合合成个人数据流水线上进行评估后，Opal相比语义搜索将检索准确率提升了13个百分点，与安全基线相比，吞吐量提高了29倍，基础设施成本降低了15倍。Opal目前正在考虑由一家大型人工智能提供商部署至数百万用户。

title: Sparse Bayesian Learning Algorithms Revisited: From Learning Majorizers to Structured Algorithmic Learning using Neural Networks
summary: Sparse Bayesian Learning is one of the most popular sparse signal recovery methods, and various algorithms exist under the SBL paradigm. However, given a performance metric and a sparse recovery problem, it is difficult to know a-priori the best algorithm to choose. This difficulty is in part due to a lack of a unified framework to derive SBL algorithms. We address this issue by first showing that the most popular SBL algorithms can be derived using the majorization-minimization (MM) principle, providing hitherto unknown convergence guarantees to this class of SBL methods. Moreover, we show that the two most popular SBL update rules not only fall under the MM framework but are both valid descent steps for a common majorizer, revealing a deeper analytical compatibility between these algorithms. Using this insight and properties from MM theory we expand the class of SBL algorithms, and address finding the best SBL algorithm via data within the MM framework. Second, we go beyond the MM framework by introducing the powerful modeling capabilities of deep learning to further expand the class of SBL algorithms, aiming to learn a superior SBL update rule from data. We propose a novel deep learning architecture that can outperform the classical MM based ones across different sparse recovery problems. Our architecture's complexity does not scale with the measurement matrix dimension, hence providing a unique opportunity to test generalization capability across different matrices. For parameterized dictionaries, this invariance allows us to train and test the model across different parameter ranges. We also showcase our model's ability to learn a functional mapping by its zero-shot performance on unseen measurement matrices. Finally, we test our model's performance across different numbers of snapshots, signal-to-noise ratios, and sparsity levels.
tldr: This paper develops a unified framework for deriving Sparse Bayesian Learning (SBL) algorithms using the Majorization-Minimization principle and proposes a deep learning architecture to learn superior SBL update rules from data for sparse signal recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文利用优化中的MM框架统一了稀疏贝叶斯学习算法，并提出了一个深度学习架构来从数据中学习更优的SBL更新规则，用于稀疏信号恢复。
summary_zh: 稀疏贝叶斯学习是最流行的稀疏信号恢复方法之一，在该范式下存在多种算法。然而，给定性能指标和稀疏恢复问题，很难先验地确定最佳算法选择。这一困难部分源于缺乏推导SBL算法的统一框架。我们首先通过证明最流行的SBL算法均可基于最大化最小化（MM）原理推导来解决此问题，为此类SBL方法提供了迄今未知的收敛性保证。此外，我们发现两种最流行的SBL更新规则不仅属于MM框架，而且均为同一主函数的有效下降步骤，揭示了这些算法之间更深层次的分析兼容性。利用这一洞见及MM理论的性质，我们扩展了SBL算法类别，并在MM框架内通过数据驱动的方式寻找最优SBL算法。其次，我们突破MM框架的局限，引入深度学习的强大建模能力进一步扩展SBL算法类别，旨在从数据中学习更优的SBL更新规则。我们提出了一种新颖的深度学习架构，该架构在不同稀疏恢复问题中均能超越经典的基于MM的算法。该架构的复杂度不随测量矩阵维度增长，为测试跨不同矩阵的泛化能力提供了独特机会。对于参数化字典，这种不变性使我们能够在不同参数范围内训练和测试模型。我们还展示了模型通过零样本性能在未见测量矩阵上学习函数映射的能力。最后，我们在不同快照数、信噪比和稀疏度条件下测试了模型的性能表现。

title: An Explainable Vision-Language Model Framework with Adaptive PID-Tversky Loss for Lumbar Spinal Stenosis Diagnosis
summary: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis (LSS) diagnosis remains a critical clinical challenge, with diagnosis heavily dependent on labor-intensive manual interpretation of multi-view Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), leading to substantial inter-observer variability and diagnostic delays. Existing vision-language models simultaneously fail to address the extreme class imbalance prevalent in clinical segmentation datasets while preserving spatial accuracy, primarily due to global pooling mechanisms that discard crucial anatomical hierarchies. We present an end-to-end Explainable Vision-Language Model framework designed to overcome these limitations, achieved through two principal objectives. We propose a Spatial Patch Cross-Attention module that enables precise, text-directed localization of spinal anomalies with spatial precision. A novel Adaptive PID-Tversky Loss function by integrating control theory principles dynamically further modifies training penalties to specifically address difficult, under-segmented minority instances. By incorporating foundational VLMs alongside an Automated Radiology Report Generation module, our framework demonstrates considerable performance: a diagnostic classification accuracy of 90.69%, a macro-averaged Dice score of 0.9512 for segmentation, and a CIDEr score of 92.80%. Furthermore, the framework shows explainability by converting complex segmentation predictions into radiologist-style clinical reports, thereby establishing a new benchmark for transparent, interpretable AI in clinical medical imaging that keeps essential human supervision while enhancing diagnostic capabilities.
tldr: The paper presents a vision-language model framework for medical imaging diagnosis of Lumbar Spinal Stenosis, focusing on segmentation, classification, and report generation in a clinical setting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于腰椎管狭窄症医学影像诊断的视觉-语言模型框架，专注于临床环境下的分割、分类和报告生成。
summary_zh: 腰椎管狭窄症的诊断仍是临床面临的关键挑战，其诊断高度依赖对多视角磁共振成像的人工判读，这一过程不仅耗时费力，且易导致观察者间显著差异及诊断延迟。现有视觉语言模型在保持空间精度的同时，未能有效解决临床分割数据集中普遍存在的极端类别不平衡问题，这主要归因于全局池化机制丢弃了关键的解剖层次信息。本文提出一种端到端可解释视觉语言模型框架，通过两大核心目标克服上述局限：首先设计空间斑块交叉注意力模块，实现文本引导下脊柱异常的精准空间定位；其次创新性地融合控制理论原理，提出自适应PID-Tversky损失函数，动态调整训练惩罚以针对性处理难分割的少数类样本。该框架集成基础视觉语言模型与自动化放射报告生成模块，实现了优异性能：诊断分类准确率达90.69%，分割任务宏观平均Dice系数为0.9512，CIDEr评分达92.80%。此外，通过将复杂分割预测转化为放射科医师风格的临床报告，框架展现出显著的可解释性，由此为临床医学影像领域建立了透明可解释人工智能的新基准，在增强诊断能力的同时保留了不可或缺的人类监督机制。

title: Token-Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Image Prompt Packaging
summary: Deploying large multimodal language models at scale is constrained by token-based inference costs, yet the cost-performance behavior of visual prompting strategies remains poorly characterized.
