We evaluate the proposed approach in a controlled Monte Carlo simulation that facilitates systematic variation of covariate, conditional, and label shifts, as well as in a real-world transfer setting using the Global Credit Data (GCD) loan dataset as source and a novel bonds dataset as target.
  Our results show that FT-MDN-Transformer outperforms baseline models when target-domain data are limited, with particularly pronounced gains under covariate and conditional shifts, while label shift remains challenging. We also observe its probabilistic forecasts to closely track empirical recovery distributions, providing richer information than conventional point-prediction metrics alone. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of distribution-aware TL architectures to improve RR forecasting in data-scarce credit portfolios and offer practical insights for risk managers operating under heterogeneous data environments.
tldr: The paper proposes a transfer learning method for loan recovery rate prediction under distribution shifts, using a novel tabular Transformer architecture for heterogeneous data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对分布偏移下贷款回收率预测的迁移学习方法，采用了一种新颖的适用于异构数据的表格Transformer架构。
summary_zh:
精确预测回收率（RR）是信用风险管理和监管资本计提的核心环节。然而，在许多贷款组合中，回收率建模常因违约事件稀少导致数据匮乏而受到限制。迁移学习（TL）为解决这一难题提供了有效途径，它能够利用相关但更丰富的源领域信息，但其效果关键取决于分布偏移的存在程度与强度，以及源领域与目标领域特征空间之间潜在的异质性。

本文提出FT-MDN-Transformer模型——一种专门为异质特征集下回收率预测的迁移学习而设计的混合密度表格型Transformer架构。该模型既能生成贷款级别的点估计值，也能提供组合层面的预测分布，从而支持广泛的回收率预测实际应用。我们通过控制变量蒙特卡洛模拟对方法进行评估，系统调整协变量偏移、条件偏移和标签偏移参数；同时使用全球信用数据（GCD）贷款数据集作为源领域、新型债券数据集作为目标领域，在真实迁移场景中验证模型性能。

结果表明，在目标领域数据有限的情况下，FT-MDN-Transformer优于基线模型，尤其在协变量偏移和条件偏移场景中优势显著，而标签偏移仍具挑战性。研究还发现，该模型的概率预测能紧密跟踪实际回收分布，比传统点预测指标提供更丰富的信息。总体而言，这些发现揭示了具备分布感知能力的迁移学习架构在改进数据稀缺信用组合中回收率预测的潜力，并为异质数据环境下的风险管理者提供了实践启示。

title: Structure-Aware Commitment Reduction for Network-Constrained Unit Commitment with Solver-Preserving Guarantees
summary: The growing number of individual generating units, hybrid resources, and security constraints has significantly increased the computational burden of network-constrained unit commitment (UC), where most solution time is spent exploring branch-and-bound trees over unit-hour binary variables. To reduce this combinatorial burden, recent approaches have explored learning-based guidance to assist commitment decisions. However, directly using tools such as large language models (LLMs) to predict full commitment schedules is unreliable, as infeasible or inconsistent binary decisions can violate inter-temporal constraints and degrade economic optimality. This paper proposes a solver-compatible dimensionality reduction framework for UC that exploits structural regularities in commitment decisions. Instead of generating complete schedules, the framework identifies a sparse subset of structurally stable commitment binaries to fix prior to optimization. One implementation uses an LLM to select these variables. The LLM does not replace the optimization process but provides partial variable restriction, while all constraints and remaining decisions are handled by the original MILP solver, which continues to enforce network, ramping, reserve, and security constraints. We formally show that the masked problem defines a reduced feasible region of the original UC model, thereby preserving feasibility and enabling solver-certified optimality within the restricted space. Experiments on IEEE 57-bus, RTS 73-bus, IEEE 118-bus, and augmented large-scale cases, including security-constrained variants, demonstrate consistent reductions in branch-and-bound nodes and solution time, achieving order-of-magnitude speedups on high-complexity instances while maintaining near-optimal objective values.
tldr: This paper proposes a method to reduce the computational burden of solving power grid unit commitment (UC) problems by using an LLM to pre-select a subset of binary variables to fix, which is then solved by a traditional MILP solver to ensure feasibility and optimality within the restricted space.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过使用大型语言模型（LLM）预选一部分二元变量进行固定，来减轻求解电网机组组合（UC）问题的计算负担，然后使用传统MILP求解器确保在受限空间内的可行性和最优性。
summary_zh: 日益增加的独立发电机组、混合资源及安全约束显著加重了网络约束机组组合（UC）问题的计算负担，其求解时间主要耗费在针对机组-小时二元变量的分支定界树搜索上。为缓解这一组合优化负担，近期研究开始探索基于学习的决策引导方法。然而，直接使用大型语言模型（LLM）等工具预测完整的机组启停计划并不可靠，因为不可行或不一致的二元决策可能违反时序约束并损害经济最优性。本文提出一种兼容求解器的机组组合降维框架，该框架通过挖掘机组启停决策中的结构规律性，在优化前固定一组结构稳定的稀疏二元变量子集，而非直接生成完整调度方案。其中一种实现方式利用LLM选择待固定变量。LLM并不替代优化过程，而是提供部分变量限定建议，所有约束条件及剩余决策仍由原混合整数线性规划求解器处理，确保电网、爬坡、备用及安全约束持续满足。我们通过严格证明指出，经变量掩码处理后的优化问题定义了原机组组合模型的一个可行子空间，从而在保留可行性的同时，保证求解器在限定空间内获得最优解。基于IEEE 57节点、RTS 73节点、IEEE 118节点及增强型大规模算例（含安全约束变体）的实验表明，该方法能稳定减少分支定界节点数与求解时间，在高复杂度场景中实现数量级加速，同时保持目标函数值接近最优。

title: Towards Realistic Class-Incremental Learning with Free-Flow Increments
summary: Class-incremental learning (CIL) is typically evaluated under predefined schedules with equal-sized tasks, leaving more realistic and complex cases unexplored. However, a practical CIL system should learns immediately when any number of new classes arrive, without forcing fixed-size tasks. We formalize this setting as Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning (FFCIL), where data arrives as a more realistic stream with a highly variable number of unseen classes each step. It will make many existing CIL methods brittle and lead to clear performance degradation. We propose a model-agnostic framework for robust CIL learning under free-flow arrivals. It comprises a class-wise mean (CWM) objective that replaces sample frequency weighted loss with uniformly aggregated class-conditional supervision, thereby stabilizing the learning signal across free-flow class increments, as well as method-wise adjustments that improve robustness for representative CIL paradigms. Specifically, we constrain distillation to replayed data, normalize the scale of contrastive and knowledge transfer losses, and introduce Dynamic Intervention Weight Alignment (DIWA) to prevent over-adjustment caused by unstable statistics from small class increments. Experiments confirm a clear performance degradation across various CIL baselines under FFCIL, while our strategies yield consistent gains.
tldr: The paper introduces a new class-incremental learning setting called FFCIL, where data arrives in a variable stream, and proposes a framework to improve robustness for existing methods under this more realistic scenario.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的类增量学习设置FFCIL，其中数据以可变流的形式到达，并提出了一个框架来提高现有方法在这种更现实的场景下的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 类增量学习（CIL）通常是在预先设定的等规模任务调度下进行评估，而未探索更现实且复杂的场景。然而，一个实用的CIL系统应能在任意数量新类别到达时立即学习，而无需强制固定规模的任务。我们将这一设定形式化为自由流类增量学习（FFCIL），其中数据以更贴近现实的流式形式到达，每一步中未知类别的数量存在高度可变性。这会使许多现有CIL方法变得脆弱，并导致明显的性能下降。我们提出了一种模型无关的框架，用于在自由流数据到达场景下实现稳健的CIL学习。该框架包含类别均衡均值（CWM）目标，它用均匀聚合的类别条件监督替代基于样本频率的加权损失，从而稳定自由流类别增量过程中的学习信号；同时包含针对代表性CIL范式的适应性调整方法以增强其稳健性。具体而言，我们将蒸馏约束限定于回放数据，对对比学习与知识迁移损失的尺度进行归一化，并引入动态干预权重对齐（DIWA）机制以避免因小规模类别增量带来的统计不稳定性所导致的过度调整。实验证实，在FFCIL设置下各类CIL基线方法均出现明显性能下降，而我们的策略则能持续带来性能提升。

title: State estimations and noise identifications with intermittent corrupted observations via Bayesian variational inference
summary: This paper focuses on the state estimation problem in distributed sensor networks, where intermittent packet dropouts, corrupted observations, and unknown noise covariances coexist. To tackle this challenge, we formulate the joint estimation of system states, noise parameters, and network reliability as a Bayesian variational inference problem, and propose a novel variational Bayesian adaptive Kalman filter (VB-AKF) to approximate the joint posterior probability densities of the latent parameters. Unlike existing AKF that separately handle missing data and measurement outliers, the proposed VB-AKF adopts a dual-mask generative model with two independent Bernoulli random variables, explicitly characterizing both observable communication losses and latent data authenticity. Additionally, the VB-AKF integrates multiple concurrent multiple observations into the adaptive filtering framework, which significantly enhances statistical identifiability. Comprehensive numerical experiments verify the effectiveness and asymptotic optimality of the proposed method, showing that both parameter identification and state estimation asymptotically converge to the theoretical optimal lower bound with the increase in the number of sensors.
tldr: Proposes a variational Bayesian adaptive Kalman filter for state estimation in sensor networks with packet loss and corrupted observations, addressing noise identification and network reliability.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于传感器网络中状态估计的变分贝叶斯自适应卡尔曼滤波器，解决数据包丢失、观测损坏和噪声识别问题。
summary_zh: 本文聚焦于分布式传感器网络中的状态估计问题，其中间歇性数据包丢失、观测值损坏与未知噪声协方差同时存在。为应对这一挑战，我们将系统状态、噪声参数及网络可靠性的联合估计问题构建为贝叶斯变分推断问题，并提出一种新颖的变分贝叶斯自适应卡尔曼滤波器（VB-AKF）以近似潜在参数的联合后验概率密度。与现有分别处理缺失数据和测量异常值的自适应卡尔曼滤波器不同，所提出的VB-AKF采用包含两个独立伯努利随机变量的双掩码生成模型，显式刻画了可观测的通信丢失与潜在数据真实性。此外，该滤波器将多传感器并发观测集成到自适应滤波框架中，显著提升了统计可辨识性。综合数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性与渐近最优性，结果表明随着传感器数量的增加，参数辨识与状态估计均渐近收敛至理论最优下界。

title: Generative Frontiers: Why Evaluation Matters for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models have seen exciting recent progress, offering far more flexibility in generative trajectories than autoregressive models. This flexibility has motivated a growing body of research into new approaches to diffusion language modeling, which typically begins at the scale of GPT-2 small (150 million parameters). However, these advances introduce new issues with evaluation methodology. In this technical note, we discuss the limitations of current methodology and propose principled augmentations to ensure reliable comparisons. We first discuss why OpenWebText has become the standard benchmark, and why alternatives such as LM1B are inherently less meaningful. We then discuss the limitations of likelihood evaluations for diffusion models, and explain why relying on generative perplexity alone as a metric can lead to uninformative results. To address this, we show that generative perplexity and entropy are two components of the KL divergence to a reference distribution. This decomposition explains generative perplexity's sensitivity to entropy, and naturally suggests generative frontiers as a principled method for evaluating model generative quality. We conclude with empirical observations on model quality at this scale. We include a blog post with interactive content to illustrate the argument at https://patrickpynadath1.github.io/blog/eval_methodology/.
tldr: This paper discusses methodological limitations and proposes new evaluation approaches for benchmarking diffusion-based language models, focusing on text generation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文讨论了当前扩散语言模型评估方法的局限性，并提出了用于基准测试的新评估原则，主要关注文本生成任务。
summary_zh: 扩散语言模型近期取得令人振奋的进展，其生成轨迹相比自回归模型展现出更大的灵活性。这种灵活性推动着扩散语言建模新方法的研究不断涌现，这些研究通常以GPT-2小型（1.5亿参数）的规模为起点。然而，这些进展也引发评估方法上的新问题。本技术报告讨论了当前方法的局限性，并提出增强原则以确保可靠比较。我们首先探讨OpenWebText成为标准基准的原因，以及为何LM1B等替代基准本质上缺乏可比性。随后分析似然评估对扩散模型的局限性，解释为何仅依赖生成困惑度作为度量指标可能导致无意义的结果。针对这一问题，我们证明生成困惑度与熵是参考分布KL散度的两个组成部分。该分解揭示了生成困惑度对熵的敏感性，并自然推导出生成边界作为评估模型生成质量的原则性方法。最后我们通过实证观测该规模下的模型质量表现。相关论证的交互式内容详见博客文章：https://patrickpynadath1.github.io/blog/eval_methodology/。

title: FluxMoE: Decoupling Expert Residency for High-Performance MoE Serving
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a dominant paradigm for scaling large language models, but their rapidly growing parameter sizes introduce a fundamental inefficiency during inference: most expert weights remain idle in GPU memory while competing with performance-critical runtime state such as the key-value (KV) cache. Since KV cache capacity directly determines serving throughput, this mismatch leads to underutilized memory and degraded performance. In this paper, we present FluxMoE, a new MoE inference system that decouples expert parameters from persistent GPU residency. FluxMoE introduces an expert paging abstraction that treats expert weights as streamed, transient resources, materializing them on demand and evicting them immediately after use, allowing GPU memory to be preferentially allocated to throughput-critical runtime state. We implement FluxMoE atop vLLM to enable efficient MoE inference under severe memory constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that FluxMoE achieves up to 3.0$\times$ throughput gains over vLLM in memory-intensive regimes, without compromising model fidelity.
tldr: FluxMoE is a new inference system for large Mixture-of-Experts models that improves serving throughput by decoupling expert parameters from persistent GPU memory and paging them on-demand.
tldr_zh: FluxMoE 是一种新的 MoE 模型推理系统，通过将专家参数与持久 GPU 内存解耦并按需分页，以提高服务吞吐量。
summary_zh: 专家混合模型已成为扩展大型语言模型的主流范式，但其快速增长的参数量在推理过程中引入了一个根本性低效问题：大部分专家权重闲置在GPU内存中，同时与性能关键的计算状态（如键值缓存）竞争内存资源。由于键值缓存容量直接决定服务吞吐量，这种不匹配导致内存利用率低下和性能下降。本文提出FluxMoE——一种新型专家混合模型推理系统，该系统将专家参数从持久化GPU驻留中解耦。FluxMoE引入了专家分页抽象机制，将专家权重视为可按需流式加载的临时资源，使用时动态实例化并在使用后立即释放，从而优先为吞吐量敏感的运行时状态分配GPU内存。我们在vLLM推理系统基础上实现了FluxMoE，使其能在严格内存限制下实现高效的专家混合模型推理。实验结果表明，在内存密集型场景中，FluxMoE相较于vLLM可实现最高3.0倍的吞吐量提升，同时保持模型精度无损。

title: LieTrunc-QNN: Lie Algebra Truncation and Quantum Expressivity Phase Transition from LiePrune to Provably Stable Quantum Neural Networks
summary:
Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is fundamentally limited by two challenges: barren plateaus (exponentially vanishing gradients) and the fragility of parameterized quantum circuits under noise. Despite extensive empirical studies, a unified theoretical framework remains lacking.
  We introduce LieTrunc-QNN, an algebraic-geometric framework that characterizes trainability via Lie-generated dynamics. Parameterized quantum circuits are modeled as Lie subalgebras of u(2^n), whose action induces a Riemannian manifold of reachable quantum states. Expressivity is reinterpreted as intrinsic manifold dimension and geometry.
  We establish a geometric capacity-plateau principle: increasing effective dimension leads to exponential gradient suppression due to concentration of measure. By restricting to structured Lie subalgebras (LieTrunc), the manifold is contracted, preventing concentration and preserving non-degenerate gradients.
  We prove two main results: (1) a trainability lower bound for LieTrunc-QNN, and (2) that the Fubini-Study metric rank is bounded by the algebraic span of generators, showing expressivity is governed by structure rather than parameter count. Compact Lie subalgebras also provide inherent robustness to perturbations.
  Importantly, we establish a polynomial trainability regime where gradient variance decays polynomially instead of exponentially.
  Experiments (n=2-6) validate the theory: LieTrunc-QNN maintains stable gradients and high effective dimension, while random truncation leads to metric rank collapse. At n=6, full metric rank is preserved (rank=16). Results support a scaling law between gradient variance and effective dimension.
  This work provides a unified geometric framework for QNN design, linking Lie algebra, manifold geometry, and optimization.
tldr: The paper introduces a theoretical framework for designing trainable and robust quantum neural networks by using Lie algebra truncation to avoid barren plateaus and preserve gradient stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了一个理论框架，通过使用李代数截断来避免贫瘠高原并保持梯度稳定性，从而设计可训练且鲁棒的量子神经网络。
summary_zh:
量子机器学习从根本上受到两大挑战的限制：梯度贫瘠高原（指数级梯度消失）以及参数化量子电路在噪声下的脆弱性。尽管已有大量实证研究，但统一的理论框架仍然缺失。

我们提出LieTrunc-QNN，这是一种代数几何框架，通过李代数生成的动力学来刻画可训练性。参数化量子电路被建模为u(2^n)的李子代数，其作用导出一个可达量子态的黎曼流形。我们将表达能力重新解释为内蕴流形维度与几何结构。

我们建立了一个几何容量-高原原理：随着有效维度的增加，由于测度集中现象，梯度会呈现指数级衰减。通过限制在结构化李子代数（LieTrunc）上，流形被收缩，从而阻止测度集中并保持非退化梯度。

我们证明了两个主要结论：（1）LieTrunc-QNN的可训练性下界，以及（2）Fubini-Study度量秩受限于生成元的代数张成，表明表达能力由代数结构而非参数数量决定。紧致李子代数还具有对扰动的固有鲁棒性。

重要的是，我们建立了一个多项式可训练性区域，其中梯度方差以多项式速率衰减而非指数衰减。

在n=2-6的实验验证了理论：LieTrunc-QNN保持稳定的梯度与高有效维度，而随机截断会导致度量秩崩塌。当n=6时，完整的度量秩得以保留（秩=16）。实验结果支持梯度方差与有效维度之间的标度律。

这项工作为量子神经网络设计提供了统一的几何框架，将李代数、流形几何与优化理论紧密联系起来。

title: Adaptive Semantic Communication for Wireless Image Transmission Leveraging Mixture-of-Experts Mechanism
summary: Deep learning based semantic communication has achieved significant progress in wireless image transmission, but most existing schemes rely on fixed models and thus lack robustness to diverse image contents and dynamic channel conditions. To improve adaptability, recent studies have developed adaptive semantic communication strategies that adjust transmission or model behavior according to either source content or channel state. More recently, MoE-based semantic communication has emerged as a sparse and efficient adaptive architecture, although existing designs still mainly rely on single-driven routing. To address this limitation, we propose a novel multi-stage end-to-end image semantic communication system for multi-input multi-output (MIMO) channels, built upon an adaptive MoE Swin Transformer block. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic expert gating mechanism that jointly evaluates both real-time CSI and the semantic content of input image patches to compute adaptive routing probabilities. By selectively activating only a specialized subset of experts based on this joint condition, our approach breaks the rigid coupling of traditional adaptive methods and overcomes the bottlenecks of single-driven routing. Simulation results indicate a significant improvement in reconstruction quality over existing methods while maintaining the transmission efficiency.
tldr: A novel adaptive semantic communication system for wireless image transmission, using a Mixture-of-Experts Swin Transformer block with a dynamic gating mechanism that jointly considers channel state and image content to improve reconstruction quality and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 一种用于无线图像传输的新型自适应语义通信系统，采用基于专家混合的Swin Transformer块，结合动态门控机制联合评估信道状态和图像内容，以提高重建质量和传输效率。
summary_zh: 基于深度学习的语义通信在无线图像传输领域取得了显著进展，但现有方案大多依赖固定模型，因而缺乏对多样图像内容与动态信道条件的鲁棒性。为提升适应性，近期研究提出了根据信源内容或信道状态调整传输策略或模型行为的自适应语义通信方法。而最近出现的基于MoE的语义通信架构提供了稀疏且高效的自适应能力，但现有设计仍主要依赖单因素驱动的路由机制。为突破此局限，我们提出了一种基于自适应MoE Swin Transformer模块的新型多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统，适用于多输入多输出信道。具体而言，我们设计了动态专家门控机制，可联合评估实时信道状态信息与输入图像块语义内容，从而计算自适应路由概率。该机制通过联合条件仅激活特定专家子集，打破了传统自适应方法的刚性耦合关系，克服了单因素驱动路由的瓶颈。仿真结果表明，在保持传输效率的同时，所提方法在重建质量上相比现有方案实现了显著提升。

title: Cross-subject Muscle Fatigue Detection via Adversarial and Supervised Contrastive Learning with Inception-Attention Network
summary: Muscle fatigue detection plays an important role in physical rehabilitation. Previous researches have demonstrated that sEMG offers superior sensitivity in detecting muscle fatigue compared to other biological signals. However, features extracted from sEMG may vary during dynamic contractions and across different subjects, which causes unstability in fatigue detection. To address these challenges, this research proposes a novel neural network comprising an Inception-attention module as a feature extractor, a fatigue classifier and a domain classifier equipped with a gradient reversal layer. The integrated domain classifier encourages the network to learn subject-invariant common fatigue features while minimizing subject-specific features. Furthermore, a supervised contrastive loss function is also employed to enhance the generalization capability of the model. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieved outstanding performance in three-class classification tasks, reaching 93.54% accuracy, 92.69% recall and 92.69% F1-score, providing a robust solution for cross-subject muscle fatigue detection, offering significant guidance for rehabilitation training and assistance.
tldr: This paper proposes a neural network combining an Inception-attention module with adversarial and supervised contrastive learning for cross-subject muscle fatigue detection from sEMG signals, aimed at improving rehabilitation training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种结合Inception注意力模块与对抗性和监督对比学习的神经网络，用于从表面肌电信号中进行跨受试者肌肉疲劳检测，旨在改善康复训练。
summary_zh: 肌肉疲劳检测在物理康复领域具有重要作用。已有研究表明，相较于其他生物信号，表面肌电信号在检测肌肉疲劳方面具有更高的敏感性。然而，在动态收缩过程中及不同受试者之间提取的表面肌电信号特征可能存在差异，这会导致疲劳检测结果不稳定。为解决这些挑战，本研究提出一种新型神经网络结构，包含作为特征提取器的Inception-attention模块、疲劳分类器以及配备梯度反转层的域分类器。该集成域分类器促使网络学习受试者间共有的疲劳特征，同时最小化受试者特异性特征。此外，模型还采用监督对比损失函数以增强泛化能力。实验结果表明，所提出的模型在三分类任务中表现优异，准确率达到93.54%，召回率为92.69%，F1分数为92.69%，为跨受试者肌肉疲劳检测提供了稳健的解决方案，对康复训练与辅助具有重要指导意义。

title: A Numerical Method for Coupling Parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks and FDM for Advanced Thermal-Hydraulic System Simulation
summary: Severe accident analysis using system-level codes such as MELCOR is indispensable for nuclear safety assessment, yet the computational cost of repeated simulations poses a significant bottleneck for parametric studies and uncertainty quantification. Existing surrogate models accelerate these analyses but depend on large volumes of simulation data, while physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) enable data-free training but must be retrained for every change in problem parameters. This study addresses both limitations by developing the Parameterized PINNs coupled with FDM (P2F) method, a node-assigned hybrid framework for MELCOR's Control Volume Hydrodynamics/Flow Path (CVH/FP) module. In the P2F method, a parameterized Node-Assigned PINN (NA-PINN) accepts the water-level difference, initial velocity, and time as inputs, learning a solution manifold so that a single trained network serves as a data-free surrogate for the momentum conservation equation across all flow paths without retraining. This PINN is coupled with a finite difference method (FDM) solver that advances the mass conservation equation at each time step, ensuring exact discrete mass conservation while replacing the iterative nonlinear momentum solve with a single forward pass. Verification on a six-tank gravity-driven draining scenario yields a water level mean absolute error of $7.85 \times 10^{-5}$ m and a velocity mean absolute error of $3.21 \times 10^{-3}$ m/s under the nominal condition with $Δt = 1.0$ s. The framework maintains consistent accuracy across time steps ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 s and generalizes to five distinct initial conditions, all without retraining or simulation data. This work introduces a numerical coupling methodology for integrating parameterized PINNs with FDM within a nuclear thermal-hydraulic system code framework.
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid computational method (P2F) that couples a parameterized physics-informed neural network with a finite difference method to create a data-free surrogate model for accelerating thermal-hydraulic system simulations in nuclear safety analysis.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种混合计算方法（P2F），将参数化的物理信息神经网络与有限差分法结合，为核安全分析中的热工水力系统模拟创建了一个无需数据的代理模型，以加速计算。
summary_zh: 使用MELCOR等系统级代码进行严重事故分析对核安全评估至关重要，但重复模拟的计算成本成为参数研究和不确定性量化的显著瓶颈。现有代理模型虽能加速这些分析，却依赖于大量模拟数据；而物理信息神经网络（PINN）虽能实现无数据训练，但每当问题参数变更时必须重新训练。本研究通过开发结合有限差分法（FDM）的参数化PINN（P2F）方法，同时解决了这两类局限。P2F方法是一种针对MELCOR控制体流体动力学/流道（CVH/FP）模块的节点分配混合框架。在该框架中，参数化的节点分配PINN（NA-PINN）以水位差、初始速度和时间作为输入，通过求解流形使得单个训练网络无需重新训练即可作为所有流道动量守恒方程的无数据代理模型。该PINN与有限差分法（FDM）求解器耦合，后者逐步推进质量守恒方程求解，在确保精确离散质量守恒的同时，以单次前向传播替代了迭代非线性动量求解。在六水箱重力驱动排水场景的验证中，当时间步长Δt=1.0 s时，名义工况下的水位平均绝对误差为7.85×10⁻⁵ m，速度平均绝对误差为3.21×10⁻³ m/s。该框架在0.2至1.0 s的时间步长范围内均保持稳定精度，并可泛化至五种不同初始条件，整个过程无需重新训练或模拟数据。本研究提出了一种在核热工水力系统代码框架内将参数化PINN与FDM耦合的数值方法。

title: Transfer Learning for Meta-analysis Under Covariate Shift
summary: Randomized controlled trials often do not represent the populations where decisions are made, and covariate shift across studies can invalidate standard IPD meta-analysis and transport estimators. We propose a placebo-anchored transport framework that treats source-trial outcomes as abundant proxy signals and target-trial placebo outcomes as scarce, high-fidelity gold labels to calibrate baseline risk. A low-complexity (sparse) correction anchors proxy outcome models to the target population, and the anchored models are embedded in a cross-fitted doubly robust learner, yielding a Neyman-orthogonal, target-site doubly robust estimator for patient-level heterogeneous treatment effects when target treated outcomes are available. We distinguish two regimes: in connected targets (with a treated arm), the method yields target-identified effect estimates; in disconnected targets (placebo-only), it reduces to a principled screen--then--transport procedure under explicit working-model transport assumptions. Experiments on synthetic data and a semi-synthetic IHDP benchmark evaluate pointwise CATE accuracy, ATE error, ranking quality for targeting, decision-theoretic policy regret, and calibration. Across connected settings, the proposed method is best or near-best and improves substantially over proxy-only, target-only, and transport baselines at small target sample sizes; in disconnected settings, it retains strong ranking performance for targeting while pointwise accuracy depends on the strength of the working transport condition.
tldr: This paper proposes a statistical method for transfer learning in meta-analysis under covariate shift, focusing on calibrating treatment effect estimates from source trials to target populations using placebo-anchored models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在协变量偏移下进行元分析的迁移学习方法，利用安慰剂锚定模型将源试验的治疗效果估计校准到目标人群。
summary_zh: 随机对照试验往往不能代表实际决策所在的人群，且不同研究间的协变量偏移可能使标准个体数据荟萃分析和迁移估计量失效。我们提出一种安慰剂锚定的迁移框架，将源试验结果视为丰富的代理信号，将目标试验安慰剂结果作为稀缺的高保真黄金标准来校准基线风险。该框架通过低复杂度（稀疏）校正将代理结果模型锚定于目标人群，并将锚定模型嵌入交叉拟合的双稳健学习器中，从而在目标治疗组结果可用时，为患者层面的异质治疗效果构建尼曼正交的目标端双稳健估计量。我们区分两种场景：在连接目标（设有治疗组）中，该方法可得到目标识别的效应估计值；在非连接目标（仅安慰剂组）中，该方法会简化为在明确的工作模型迁移假设下进行的原则性筛选-迁移流程。通过合成数据和半合成IHDP基准测试的实验，我们评估了逐点条件平均处理效应准确性、平均处理效应误差、目标排序质量、决策理论策略后悔度以及校准性能。在所有连接场景中，所提方法在目标样本量较小时均表现最优或接近最优，较纯代理法、纯目标法及迁移基线方法有显著提升；在非连接场景中，该方法在保持较强目标排序性能的同时，其逐点准确性取决于工作迁移条件的强度。

title: Product-Stability: Provable Convergence for Gradient Descent on the Edge of Stability
summary: Empirically, modern deep learning training often occurs at the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the sharpness of the loss exceeds the threshold below which classical convergence analysis applies. Despite recent progress, existing theoretical explanations of EoS either rely on restrictive assumptions or focus on specific squared-loss-type objectives. In this work, we introduce and study a structural property of loss functions that we term product-stability. We show that for losses with product-stable minima, gradient descent applied to objectives of the form $(x,y) \mapsto l(xy)$ can provably converge to the local minimum even when training in the EoS regime. This framework substantially generalizes prior results and applies to a broad class of losses, including binary cross entropy. Using bifurcation diagrams, we characterize the resulting training dynamics, explain the emergence of stable oscillations, and precisely quantify the sharpness at convergence. Together, our results offer a principled explanation for stable EoS training for a wider class of loss functions.
tldr: This paper introduces a structural property called 'product-stability' and provides a theoretical convergence guarantee for gradient descent on a class of loss functions, even when training at the Edge of Stability, which is a common empirical observation in deep learning.
tldr_zh: 本文引入了一种称为'积稳定性'的结构性特性，为梯度下降在一类损失函数上的收敛提供了理论保证，即使在训练处于'稳定性边缘'这一深度学习中常见的经验现象时也成立。
summary_zh: 经验表明，现代深度学习的训练常发生在稳定性边缘（EoS），此时损失函数的锐度超过了经典收敛分析所适用的阈值。尽管已有研究进展，但现有关于EoS的理论解释要么依赖于严格的假设，要么局限于特定的平方损失型目标。本文中，我们引入并研究了一种损失函数的结构特性，称为乘积稳定性。我们证明，对于具有乘积稳定最小值的损失函数，即使训练处于EoS状态，梯度下降法应用于形式为$(x,y) \mapsto l(xy)$的目标函数时，仍可保证收敛到局部最小值。该框架显著推广了先前的研究结果，并适用于包括二元交叉熵在内的广泛损失函数类别。通过分岔图分析，我们刻画了训练动态，解释了稳定振荡的出现，并精确量化了收敛时的锐度。综合而言，本研究为更广泛的损失函数类型提供了稳定EoS训练的理论解释。

title: Conditional Sampling via Wasserstein Autoencoders and Triangular Transport
summary: We present Conditional Wasserstein Autoencoders (CWAEs), a framework for conditional simulation that exploits low-dimensional structure in both the conditioned and the conditioning variables. The key idea is to modify a Wasserstein autoencoder to use a (block-) triangular decoder and impose an appropriate independence assumption on the latent variables. We show that the resulting model gives an autoencoder that can exploit low-dimensional structure while simultaneously the decoder can be used for conditional simulation. We explore various theoretical properties of CWAEs, including their connections to conditional optimal transport (OT) problems. We also present alternative formulations that lead to three architectural variants forming the foundation of our algorithms. We present a series of numerical experiments that demonstrate that our different CWAE variants achieve substantial reductions in approximation error relative to the low-rank ensemble Kalman filter (LREnKF), particularly in problems where the support of the conditional measures is truly low-dimensional.
tldr: This paper introduces Conditional Wasserstein Autoencoders (CWAEs), a framework for conditional simulation that leverages low-dimensional structure in data, connecting to conditional optimal transport.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了条件Wasserstein自编码器（CWAEs），这是一个利用数据中低维结构进行条件模拟的框架，并与条件最优传输相关联。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种用于条件模拟的框架——条件性Wasserstein自编码器（CWAEs），该框架能够同时利用被条件变量与条件变量的低维结构。其核心思想是通过改进Wasserstein自编码器，采用（块）三角化解码器结构，并对潜变量施加适当的独立性假设。我们证明，所得模型既能构建出有效利用低维结构的自编码器，其解码器部分又可用于条件模拟。我们深入探讨了CWAEs的多种理论特性，包括其与条件最优传输（OT）问题的关联。同时，我们提出了多种替代构建方案，形成了三种算法基础架构变体。通过一系列数值实验，我们证明了相较于低秩集成卡尔曼滤波器（LREnKF），不同CWAE变体均能显著降低近似误差，在处理条件测度支撑集确实为低维结构的问题时表现尤为突出。

title: AXELRAM: Quantize Once, Never Dequantize
summary:
We propose AXELRAM, a smart SRAM macro architecture that computes attention scores directly from quantized KV cache indices without dequantization. The key enabler is a design-time fixed codebook: orthogonal-transform-based quantization concentrates each coordinate's distribution to N(0,1/d), so the optimal quantizer depends only on dimension d and bit-width b, not on input data. The asymmetric path design -- transform on write, table-lookup on read with no inverse transform -- reduces per-query multiplications by 102.4x (a mathematical identity).
  Through multi-seed evaluation (10 seeds x 3 models), we discover that sign pattern sensitivity causes catastrophic PPL spikes (Delta > 50) on certain models (Qwen2.5-3B), while others (LLaMA-3.1-8B) are fully stable. This phenomenon extends SpinQuant's observation of rotation variance in weight quantization to the KV cache domain, where the effect is qualitatively more severe. We trace the root cause to layer-wise norm heterogeneity and propose a gradient-free sign pattern selection (200 candidates, 8 calibration samples, one-time) that eliminates catastrophic spikes with zero additional hardware cost. All source code is available at https://github.com/Axelidea/AXELRAM.
tldr: This paper presents a hardware-efficient SRAM macro (AXELRAM) for attention computation that avoids KV cache dequantization and addresses stability issues in certain LLMs, but it is focused on model inference efficiency, not robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种硬件高效的SRAM宏（AXELRAM），用于注意力计算，无需对KV缓存进行反量化，并解决了某些LLM中的稳定性问题，但其核心是模型推理效率，与机器人技术无关。
summary_zh:
本文提出AXELRAM——一种智能SRAM宏架构，能直接基于量化后的KV缓存索引计算注意力分数，无需执行反量化操作。其核心在于采用设计阶段确定的固定码本：基于正交变换的量化方法将每个坐标的分布集中至N(0,1/d)，因此最优量化器仅取决于维度d和比特宽度b，与输入数据无关。非对称路径设计——写入时执行变换，读取时通过查表实现（无需逆变换）——使得每次查询的乘法运算量降低102.4倍（基于数学恒等关系）。

通过多随机种子评估（10种子×3模型），我们发现符号模式敏感性会导致特定模型（Qwen2.5-3B）出现灾难性的困惑度飙升（Δ>50），而其他模型（LLaMA-3.1-8B）则完全稳定。该现象将SpinQuant在权重量化中观察到的旋转方差问题扩展至KV缓存领域，且影响程度在本质上更为严重。我们追溯其根本原因至层间范数异质性，并提出一种无需梯度的符号模式选择方案（200个候选模式，8个校准样本，单次执行），可在零额外硬件成本下消除灾难性飙升现象。所有源代码已开源：https://github.com/Axelidea/AXELRAM。

title: Reinforcement Learning-based Knowledge Distillation with LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been shown to substantially improve the reasoning capability of small and large language models (LLMs), but existing approaches typically rely on verifiable rewards, hence ground truth labels. We propose an RL framework that uses rewards from an LLM that acts as a judge evaluating model outputs over large amounts of unlabeled data, enabling label-free knowledge distillation and replacing the need of ground truth supervision. Notably, the judge operates with a single-token output, making reward computation efficient. When combined with verifiable rewards, our approach yields substantial performance gains across math reasoning benchmarks. These results suggest that LLM-based evaluators can produce effective training signals for RL fine-tuning.
tldr: A novel RL framework that uses a large language model as a judge to provide rewards for knowledge distillation, enabling label-free fine-tuning and improving math reasoning.
tldr_zh: 一种新颖的强化学习框架，使用大型语言模型作为裁判来提供奖励，实现无标签知识蒸馏，并提升数学推理能力。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已被证明能够显著提升大小语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但现有方法通常依赖于可验证的奖励，即需要真实标签作为监督。我们提出一种强化学习框架，该框架利用语言模型作为评估器，对大量未标注数据的模型输出进行评价以生成奖励，从而实现了无标签的知识蒸馏，并替代了对真实标签监督的需求。值得注意的是，该评估器仅需输出单个令牌，使得奖励计算过程高效便捷。当与可验证的奖励相结合时，我们的方法在数学推理基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。这些结果表明，基于语言模型的评估器能够为强化学习微调提供有效的训练信号。

title: Steerable but Not Decodable: Function Vectors Operate Beyond the Logit Lens
summary: Function vectors (FVs) -- mean-difference directions extracted from in-context learning demonstrations -- can steer large language model behavior when added to the residual stream. We hypothesized that FV steering failures reflect an absence of task-relevant information: the logit lens would fail alongside steering. We were wrong. In the most comprehensive cross-template FV transfer study to date - 4,032 pairs across 12 tasks, 6 models from 3 families (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B-v0.3; base and instruction-tuned), 8 templates per task - we find the opposite dissociation: FV steering succeeds even when the logit lens cannot decode the correct answer at any layer. This steerability-without-decodability pattern is universal: steering exceeds logit lens accuracy for every task on every model, with gaps as large as -0.91. Only 3 of 72 task-model instances show the predicted decodable-without-steerable pattern, all in Mistral. FV vocabulary projection reveals that FVs achieving over 0.90 steering accuracy still project to incoherent token distributions, indicating FVs encode computational instructions rather than answer directions. FVs intervene optimally at early layers (L2-L8); the logit lens detects correct answers only at late layers (L28-L32). The previously reported negative cosine-transfer correlation (r=-0.572) dissolves at scale: pooled r ranges from -0.199 to +0.126, and cosine adds less than 0.011 in R-squared beyond task identity. Post-steering analysis reveals a model-family divergence: Mistral FVs rewrite intermediate representations; Llama/Gemma FVs produce near-zero changes despite successful steering. Activation patching confirms causal localization: easy tasks achieve perfect recovery at targeted layers; hard tasks show zero recovery everywhere.
tldr: The paper investigates a dissociation between steerability and decodability of Function Vectors in large language models, showing FVs can successfully steer model behavior even when the logit lens cannot decode the task answer, indicating FVs encode computational instructions rather than answer directions.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了大型语言模型中功能向量的可操纵性与可解码性之间的分离，表明即使在logit镜头无法解码任务答案的情况下，功能向量也能成功引导模型行为，表明功能向量编码的是计算指令而非答案方向。
summary_zh: 功能向量（FVs）——从上下文学习演示中提取的均值差方向——当被添加到残差流中时，能够引导大型语言模型的行为。我们最初假设FV引导失败反映了任务相关信息缺失：对数透镜会与引导同时失效。但我们错了。在迄今为止最全面的跨模板FV迁移研究中（涵盖12项任务、4,032组配对、来自3个模型家族的6个模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Mistral-7B-v0.3；包含基础版和指令调优版）、每项任务使用8个模板），我们发现了相反的解离现象：即使对数透镜在任何层都无法解码出正确答案，FV引导仍能成功。这种“可引导但不可解码”的模式具有普遍性：在所有模型的所有任务中，引导准确率均超过对数透镜，最大差距达-0.91。仅72个任务-模型实例中有3个（均来自Mistral）出现了预测的“可解码但不可引导”模式。FV词汇投影显示，即使引导准确率超过0.90的FV，其投影仍对应不连贯的标记分布，表明FV编码的是计算指令而非答案方向。FV在早期层（L2-L8）干预效果最佳；对数透镜仅在晚期层（L28-L32）检测到正确答案。先前报道的负余弦迁移相关性（r=-0.572）在大规模实验中消失：合并后的r值范围在-0.199至+0.126之间，且余弦值在任务标识之外的R平方贡献不足0.011。引导后分析揭示了模型家族差异：Mistral的FV会重写中间表示；而Llama/Gemma的FV虽能成功引导，但产生的改变近乎为零。激活修补证实了因果定位：简单任务在目标层可实现完全恢复；困难任务在所有层均显示零恢复。

title: Learning interacting particle systems from unlabeled data
summary: Learning the potentials of interacting particle systems is a fundamental task across various scientific disciplines. A major challenge is that unlabeled data collected at discrete time points lack trajectory information due to limitations in data collection methods or privacy constraints. We address this challenge by introducing a trajectory-free self-test loss function that leverages the weak-form stochastic evolution equation of the empirical distribution. The loss function is quadratic in potentials, supporting parametric and nonparametric regression algorithms for robust estimation that scale to large, high-dimensional systems with big data. Systematic numerical tests show that our method outperforms baseline methods that regress on trajectories recovered via label matching, tolerating large observation time steps. We establish the convergence of parametric estimators as the sample size increases, providing a theoretical foundation for the proposed approach.
tldr: This paper introduces a method for learning the interaction potentials of particle systems from unlabeled, discrete-time data without trajectory information, using a trajectory-free self-test loss function.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于从无标签的离散时间数据中学习粒子系统的相互作用势，无需轨迹信息，使用了一种无轨迹的自测试损失函数。
summary_zh: 摘要：学习相互作用粒子系统的势能是众多科学领域中的一项基础任务。由于数据采集方法或隐私限制，离散时间点收集的无标签数据缺乏轨迹信息，这构成了主要挑战。为解决此问题，我们引入了一种无需轨迹的自测试损失函数，该函数基于经验分布的弱形式随机演化方程构建。该损失函数在势能上呈二次形式，支持参数化与非参数化回归算法，可应用于大规模、高维系统的大数据鲁棒估计。系统数值实验表明，即使在较大观测时间步长下，本方法在性能上优于基于标签匹配恢复轨迹的基线回归方法。我们证明了参数估计量在样本量增大时的收敛性，为所提方法提供了理论基础。

title: ROMAN: A Multiscale Routing Operator for Convolutional Time Series Models
summary: We introduce ROMAN (ROuting Multiscale representAtioN), a deterministic operator for time series that maps temporal scale and coarse temporal position into an explicit channel structure while reducing sequence length. ROMAN builds an anti-aliased multiscale pyramid, extracts fixed-length windows from each scale, and stacks them as pseudochannels, yielding a compact representation on which standard convolutional classifiers can operate. In this way, ROMAN provides a simple mechanism to control the inductive bias of downstream models: it can reduce temporal invariance, make temporal pooling implicitly coarse-position-aware, and expose multiscale interactions through channel mixing, while often improving computational efficiency by shortening the processed time axis. We formally analyze the ROMAN operator and then evaluate it in two complementary ways by measuring its impact as a preprocessing step for four representative convolutional classifiers: MiniRocket, MultiRocket, a standard CNN-based classifier, and a fully convolutional network (FCN) classifier. First, we design synthetic time series classification tasks that isolate coarse position awareness, long-range correlation, multiscale interaction, and full positional invariance, showing that ROMAN behaves consistently with its intended mechanism and is most useful when class information depends on temporal structure that standard pooled convolution tends to suppress. Second, we benchmark the same models with and without ROMAN on long-sequence subsets of the UCR and UEA archives, showing that ROMAN provides a practically useful alternative representation whose effect on accuracy is task-dependent, but whose effect on efficiency is often favorable. Code is available at https://github.com/gon-uri/ROMAN
tldr: ROMAN is a deterministic operator for time series that creates a multiscale, coarse-position-aware representation to improve the inductive bias and efficiency of convolutional classifiers for tasks where temporal structure matters.
tldr_zh: ROMAN是一种用于时间序列的确定性算子，它通过创建多尺度、粗粒度位置感知的表示来改善卷积分类器的归纳偏置和效率，适用于依赖时间结构的任务。
summary_zh: 本文提出ROMAN（多尺度表示路由）算子，这是一种针对时间序列的确定性算子，能够将时间尺度和粗粒度时间位置映射为显式的通道结构，同时缩短序列长度。ROMAN通过构建抗混叠多尺度金字塔，从每个尺度提取固定长度的窗口，并将它们作为伪通道进行堆叠，从而生成紧凑的表示形式，使得标准卷积分类器能够直接处理。通过这种方式，ROMAN提供了一种简单机制来控制下游模型的归纳偏置：它可以减少时间不变性，使时间池化操作隐含感知粗粒度位置信息，并通过通道混合实现多尺度交互，同时往往通过缩短处理时间轴来提高计算效率。我们首先对ROMAN算子进行形式化分析，随后通过两种互补方式评估其性能：将其作为预处理步骤，测量其对四种代表性卷积分类器（MiniRocket、MultiRocket、基于标准CNN的分类器以及全卷积网络分类器）的影响。首先，我们设计了合成时间序列分类任务，分别针对粗粒度位置感知、长程相关性、多尺度交互以及全位置不变性进行独立测试，结果表明ROMAN的行为与其设计机制保持一致，并且在类别信息依赖于时间结构（而标准池化卷积往往抑制此类结构）时最为有效。其次，我们在UCR和UEA档案库的长序列子集上对相同模型进行有/无ROMAN的基准测试，结果表明ROMAN提供了一种实际可用的替代表示方式，其准确率影响因任务而异，但其效率提升效果通常具有积极意义。代码发布于https://github.com/gon-uri/ROMAN。

title: Communication-Efficient Distributed Learning with Differential Privacy
summary: We address nonconvex learning problems over undirected networks. In particular, we focus on the challenge of designing an algorithm that is both communication-efficient and that guarantees the privacy of the agents' data. The first goal is achieved through a local training approach, which reduces communication frequency. The second goal is achieved by perturbing gradients during local training, specifically through gradient clipping and additive noise. We prove that the resulting algorithm converges to a stationary point of the problem within a bounded distance. Additionally, we provide theoretical privacy guarantees within a differential privacy framework that ensure agents' training data cannot be inferred from the trained model shared over the network. We show the algorithm's superior performance on a classification task under the same privacy budget, compared with state-of-the-art methods.
tldr: This paper proposes a distributed learning algorithm with local training and gradient perturbation to ensure communication efficiency and differential privacy for nonconvex problems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式学习算法，通过局部训练和梯度扰动，在保证通信效率的同时，为数据提供差分隐私保护，适用于非凸问题。
summary_zh: 我们针对无向网络中的非凸学习问题进行研究，特别关注如何设计一种既能保证通信效率、又能确保智能体数据隐私的算法。通过采用本地训练方法降低通信频率，实现了第一个目标；通过在本地训练期间对梯度进行扰动——具体采用梯度裁剪与添加噪声的方式——实现了第二个目标。我们证明了该算法能在有界距离内收敛至问题的稳定点。此外，我们在差分隐私框架下提供了理论隐私保障，确保智能体的训练数据无法通过网络中共享的已训练模型被反推出来。在与当前最优方法的对比实验中，该算法在相同隐私预算条件下，于分类任务中展现出更优越的性能。

title: Robust Learning with Optimal Error
summary:
We construct algorithms with optimal error for learning with adversarial noise. The overarching theme of this work is that the use of \textsl{randomized} hypotheses can substantially improve upon the best error rates achievable with deterministic hypotheses.
  - For $η$-rate malicious noise, we show the optimal error is $\frac{1}{2} \cdot η/(1-η)$, improving on the optimal error of deterministic hypotheses by a factor of $1/2$. This answers an open question of Cesa-Bianchi et al. (JACM 1999) who showed randomness can improve error by a factor of $6/7$.
  - For $η$-rate nasty noise, we show the optimal error is $\frac{3}{2} \cdot η$ for distribution-independent learners and $η$ for fixed-distribution learners, both improving upon the optimal $2 η$ error of deterministic hypotheses. This closes a gap first noted by Bshouty et al. (Theoretical Computer Science 2002) when they introduced nasty noise and reiterated in the recent works of Klivans et al. (NeurIPS 2025) and Blanc et al. (SODA 2026).
  - For $η$-rate agnostic noise and the closely related nasty classification noise model, we show the optimal error is $η$, improving upon the optimal $2η$ error of deterministic hypotheses.
  All of our learners have sample complexity linear in the VC-dimension of the concept class and polynomial in the inverse excess error. All except for the fixed-distribution nasty noise learner are time efficient given access to an oracle for empirical risk minimization.
tldr: This theoretical computer science paper presents algorithms for learning with adversarial noise (malicious, nasty, agnostic) that achieve optimal error rates, improving upon prior results for deterministic hypotheses.
tldr_zh: 这篇理论计算机科学论文提出了在对抗性噪声（恶意、恶意、不可知）下实现最优错误率的学习算法，改进了之前确定性假设的结果。
summary_zh:
我们针对对抗噪声学习问题构建了具有最优误差的算法。本工作的核心观点是：相较于确定性假设所能达到的最佳误差率，\textsl{随机化}假设的应用能够显著提升学习效果。
  - 对于 $η$ 比率的恶意噪声，我们证明了最优误差为 $\frac{1}{2} \cdot η/(1-η)$，将确定性假设的最优误差提高了 $1/2$ 倍。这回答了 Cesa-Bianchi 等人（JACM 1999）提出的一个开放性问题，他们曾证明随机化能将误差提升 $6/7$ 倍。
  - 对于 $η$ 比率的恶意噪声（nasty noise），我们证明了分布无关学习者的最优误差为 $\frac{3}{2} \cdot η$，而固定分布学习者的最优误差为 $η$，两者均优于确定性假设的最优误差 $2η$。这填补了由 Bshouty 等人（Theoretical Computer Science 2002）在首次提出恶意噪声模型时指出的、并在近期 Klivans 等人（NeurIPS 2025）和 Blanc 等人（SODA 2026）的工作中再次提及的误差空白。
  - 对于 $η$ 比率的不可知噪声及其密切相关的恶意分类噪声模型，我们证明了最优误差为 $η$，优于确定性假设的最优误差 $2η$。
  我们所构建的所有学习器都具有与概念类 VC 维线性相关、与逆超量误差多项式相关的样本复杂度。除了固定分布恶意噪声学习器外，其他学习器在具备经验风险最小化预言机的情况下均能实现时间高效性。

title: Synapse: Evolving Job-Person Fit with Explainable Two-phase Retrieval and LLM-guided Genetic Resume Optimization
summary: Modern recruitment platforms operate under severe information imbalance: job seekers must search over massive, rapidly changing collections of postings, while employers are overwhelmed by high-volume, low-relevance applicant pools. Existing recruitment recommender systems typically rely on keyword matching or single-stage semantic retrieval, which struggle to capture fine-grained alignment between candidate experience and job requirements under real-world scale and cost constraints. We present Synapse, a multi-stage semantic recruitment system that separates high-recall candidate generation from high-precision semantic reranking, combining efficient dense retrieval using FAISS with an ensemble of contrastive learning and Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. To improve transparency, Synapse incorporates a retrieval-augmented explanation layer that grounds recommendations in explicit evidence. Beyond retrieval, we introduce a novel evolutionary resume optimization framework that treats resume refinement as a black-box optimization problem. Using Differential Evolution with LLM-guided mutation operators, the system iteratively modifies candidate representations to improve alignment with screening objectives, without any labeled data. Evaluation shows that the proposed ensemble improves nDCG@10 by 22% over embedding-only retrieval baselines, while the evolutionary optimization loop consistently yields monotonic improvements in recommender scores, exceeding 60% relative gain across evaluated profiles. We plan to release code and data upon publication.
tldr: The paper presents a multi-stage semantic recruitment system combining efficient dense retrieval with LLM reasoning for job matching, and introduces an evolutionary resume optimization framework using LLM-guided mutation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种多阶段语义招聘系统，结合了高效的密集检索和LLM推理进行职位匹配，并引入了基于LLM引导变异的进化式简历优化框架。
summary_zh: 现代招聘平台在严重信息失衡下运行：求职者需在海量且快速变化的职位信息中搜寻，而招聘方则被大量低相关性的申请者淹没。现有招聘推荐系统通常依赖关键词匹配或单阶段语义检索，在现实规模与成本约束下难以捕捉候选者经验与职位要求间的细粒度匹配。本文提出Synapse——一个多阶段语义招聘系统，它将高召回率的候选者生成与高精度的语义重排相分离，结合了基于FAISS的高效稠密检索与对比学习及大语言模型（LLM）推理的集成方法。为提升透明度，Synapse引入了检索增强的解释层，使推荐结果基于明确的证据支撑。除了检索功能，我们提出了一种新颖的进化式简历优化框架，将简历优化视为黑盒优化问题。该系统通过采用差分进化算法与LLM引导的变异算子，在无需标注数据的情况下迭代修改候选者表征，以提升其与筛选目标的匹配度。评估结果表明，所提出的集成方法在nDCG@10指标上较纯嵌入检索基线提升22%，而进化优化循环在推荐分数上持续产生单调递增的改进，在所评估的档案中相对增益超过60%。我们计划在发表后公开代码与数据。

title: AdaHOP: Fast and Accurate Low-Precision Training via Outlier-Pattern-Aware Rotation
summary: Low-precision training (LPT) commonly employs Hadamard transforms to suppress outliers and mitigate quantization error in large language models (LLMs). However, prior methods apply a fixed transform uniformly, despite substantial variation in outlier structures across tensors. Through the first systematic study of outlier patterns across weights, activations, and gradients of LLMs, we show that this strategy is fundamentally flawed: the effectiveness of Hadamard-based suppression depends on how the transform's smoothing direction aligns with the outlier structure of each operand -- a property that varies substantially across layers and computation paths. We characterize these patterns into three types: Row-wise, Column-wise, and None. Each pair requires a tailored transform direction or outlier handling strategy to minimize quantization error. Based on this insight, we propose AdaHOP (Adaptive Hadamard transform with Outlier-Pattern-aware strategy), which assigns each matrix multiplication its optimal strategy: Inner Hadamard Transform (IHT) where inner-dimension smoothing is effective, or IHT combined with selective Outlier Extraction (OE) -- routing dominant outliers to a high-precision path -- where it is not. Combined with hardware-aware Triton kernels, AdaHOP achieves BF16 training quality at MXFP4 precision while delivering up to 3.6X memory compression and 1.8X kernel acceleration} over BF16 full-precision training.
tldr: AdaHOP is a method for low-precision training of LLMs that adaptively chooses optimal Hadamard transform and outlier handling strategies based on data patterns, enabling high compression and acceleration while maintaining quality.
tldr_zh: AdaHOP 是一种用于大语言模型低精度训练的方法，它根据数据模式自适应地选择最优哈达玛变换和离群值处理策略，在保持质量的同时实现高压缩和加速。
summary_zh: 低精度训练通常采用哈达玛变换来抑制大语言模型中的离群值并减轻量化误差。然而，现有方法尽管各类张量间的离群值结构存在显著差异，仍统一采用固定的变换方式。通过对大语言模型中权重、激活值和梯度的离群值模式进行首次系统性研究，我们发现这一策略存在根本性缺陷：基于哈达玛变换的抑制效果取决于其平滑方向与每个操作数离群值结构的对齐程度——这一特性在不同层和计算路径中差异显著。我们将这些模式归纳为三类：行方向、列方向和无明显方向。针对不同模式组合，需要定制化变换方向或离群值处理策略以最小化量化误差。基于此洞察，我们提出AdaHOP（面向离群值模式的自适应哈达玛变换策略），该策略为每个矩阵乘法分配最优方案：当内维度平滑有效时采用内哈达玛变换；若效果不足，则结合选择性离群值提取——将主导离群值路由至高精度计算路径。配合硬件感知的Triton内核优化，AdaHOP在MXFP4精度下达到了BF16训练质量，同时相比BF16全精度训练实现了最高3.6倍的内存压缩和1.8倍的内核加速。

title: Neural posterior estimation for scalable and accurate inverse parameter inference in Li-ion batteries
summary: Diagnosing the internal state of Li-ion batteries is critical for battery research, operation of real-world systems, and prognostic evaluation of remaining lifetime. By using physics-based models to perform probabilistic parameter estimation via Bayesian calibration, diagnostics can account for the uncertainty due to model fitness, data noise, and the observability of any given parameter. However, Bayesian calibration in Li-ion batteries using electrochemical data is computationally intensive even when using a fast surrogate in place of physics-based models, requiring many thousands of model evaluations. A fully amortized alternative is neural posterior estimation (NPE). NPE shifts the computational burden from the parameter estimation step to data generation and model training, reducing the parameter estimation time from minutes to milliseconds, enabling real-time applications. The present work shows that NPE calibrates parameters equally or more accurately than Bayesian calibration, and we demonstrate that the higher computational costs for data generation are tractable even in high-dimensional cases (ranging from 6 to 27 estimated parameters), but the NPE method can lead to higher voltage prediction errors. The NPE method also offers several interpretability advantages over Bayesian calibration, such as local parameter sensitivity to specific regions of the voltage curve. The NPE method is demonstrated using an experimental fast charge dataset, with parameter estimates validated against measurements of loss of lithium inventory and loss of active material. The implementation is made available in a companion repository (https://github.com/NatLabRockies/BatFIT).
tldr: This paper proposes a neural posterior estimation method for fast and accurate Bayesian parameter calibration of Li-ion battery models, shifting computational cost from inference to data generation and enabling real-time diagnostics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经网络后验估计方法，用于锂离子电池模型的快速准确贝叶斯参数校准，将计算成本从推理转移到数据生成，实现了实时诊断。
summary_zh: 诊断锂离子电池的内部状态对于电池研究、实际系统的运行以及剩余寿命的预测评估至关重要。通过使用基于物理的模型进行贝叶斯校准以实现概率参数估计，诊断方法能够考虑到由模型拟合度、数据噪声以及任何给定参数的可观测性所引起的不确定性。然而，即使采用快速替代模型来替代基于物理的模型，使用电化学数据对锂离子电池进行贝叶斯校准仍然需要大量的计算资源，通常需要成千上万次的模型评估。一种完全摊提计算成本的替代方案是神经后验估计（NPE）。NPE将计算负担从参数估计步骤转移到数据生成和模型训练阶段，从而将参数估计时间从几分钟缩短至毫秒级，使得实时应用成为可能。本研究表明，NPE在参数校准精度上达到甚至优于贝叶斯校准，并且我们证明了在高维情况下（估计参数从6个到27个不等）数据生成带来的较高计算成本仍然是可管理的，但NPE方法可能会导致更高的电压预测误差。与贝叶斯校准相比，NPE方法还具备多项可解释性优势，例如参数对电压曲线特定区域的局部敏感性。本文通过实验性快速充电数据集展示了NPE方法的应用，并通过测量锂库存损失和活性材料损失来验证参数估计的准确性。该方法的相关实现已发布在配套代码库中（https://github.com/NatLabRockies/BatFIT）。

title: Re-analysis of the Human Transcription Factor Atlas Recovers TF-Specific Signatures from Pooled Single-Cell Screens with Missing Controls
summary: Public pooled single-cell perturbation atlases are valuable resources for studying transcription factor (TF) function, but downstream re-analysis can be limited by incomplete deposited metadata and missing internal controls. Here we re-analyze the human TF Atlas dataset (GSE216481), a MORF-based pooled overexpression screen spanning 3,550 TF open reading frames and 254,519 cells, with a reproducible pipeline for quality control, MORF barcode demultiplexing, per-TF differential expression, and functional enrichment. From 77,018 cells in the pooled screen, we assign 60,997 (79.2\%) to 87 TF identities. Because the deposited barcode mapping lacks the GFP and mCherry negative controls present in the original library, we use embryoid body (EB) cells as an external baseline and remove shared batch/transduction artifacts by background subtraction. This strategy recovers TF-specific signatures for 59 of 61 testable TFs, compared with 27 detected by one-vs-rest alone, showing that robust TF-level signal can be rescued despite missing intra-pool controls. HOPX, MAZ, PAX6, FOS, and FEZF2 emerge as the strongest transcriptional remodelers, while per-TF enrichment links FEZF2 to regulation of differentiation, EGR1 to Hippo and cardiac programs, FOS to focal adhesion, and NFIC to collagen biosynthesis. Condition-level analyses reveal convergent Wnt, neurogenic, EMT, and Hippo signatures, and Harmony indicates minimal confounding batch effects across pooled replicates. Our per-TF effect sizes significantly agree with Joung et al.'s published rankings (Spearman $ρ= -0.316$, $p = 0.013$; negative because lower rank indicates stronger effect). Together, these results show that the deposited TF Atlas data can support validated TF-specific transcriptional and pathway analyses when paired with principled external controls, artifact removal, and reproducible computation.
tldr: This paper presents a re-analysis pipeline for a human transcription factor atlas dataset, recovering TF-specific signatures despite missing controls, and identifying key transcriptional remodelers.
tldr_zh: 本研究重新分析了人类转录因子图谱数据集，通过开发分析流程，在缺少内部对照的情况下恢复了TF特异性信号，并识别出关键转录重塑因子。
summary_zh: 公共池化单细胞扰动图谱是研究转录因子（TF）功能的重要资源，但下游再分析常因存储的元数据不完整及内部对照缺失而受到限制。本研究重新分析了人类转录因子图谱数据集（GSE216481）——一个基于MORF的池化过表达筛选实验，涵盖3,550个转录因子开放阅读框及254,519个细胞。我们建立了可复现的分析流程，包括质量控制、MORF条形码解码、单转录因子差异表达分析及功能富集分析。在池化筛选的77,018个细胞中，我们成功将60,997个细胞（79.2%）对应到87种转录因子身份。由于已存储的条形码映射缺失原始文库中存在的GFP和mCherry阴性对照，我们采用胚状体细胞作为外部基线，并通过背景扣除法消除共有的批次/转导干扰。该策略在61个可测试转录因子中成功恢复了59个的转录因子特异性特征，而传统的一对多比较仅能检测到27个，这表明尽管缺乏池内对照，仍可有效恢复转录因子层级的信号。HOPX、MAZ、PAX6、FOS和FEZF2被识别为最强的转录重塑因子，而单转录因子富集分析显示FEZF2与分化调控相关，EGR1关联Hippo通路与心脏发育程序，FOS参与黏着斑调控，NFIC则与胶原生物合成相关。条件层级分析揭示了Wnt通路、神经生成、上皮间质转化及Hippo通路的聚合特征，Harmony整合分析表明池化重复样本间批次效应影响极小。我们的单转录因子效应强度与Joung等人已发表的排序结果显著一致（斯皮尔曼ρ=-0.316，p=0.013；负相关是因为排名越低代表效应越强）。综上，这些结果表明：通过与规范的外部对照、干扰消除及可复现的计算方法相结合，已存储的转录因子图谱数据能够支持经过验证的转录因子特异性转录及通路分析。

title: Failing to Falsify: Evaluating and Mitigating Confirmation Bias in Language Models
summary: Confirmation bias, the tendency to seek evidence that supports rather than challenges one's belief, hinders one's reasoning ability. We examine whether large language models (LLMs) exhibit confirmation bias by adapting the rule-discovery study from human psychology: given a sequence of three numbers (a "triple"), an agent engages in an interactive feedback loop where it (1) proposes a new triple, (2) receives feedback on whether it satisfies the hidden rule, and (3) guesses the rule. Across eleven LLMs of multiple families and scales, we find that LLMs exhibit confirmation bias, often proposing triples to confirm their hypothesis rather than trying to falsify it. This leads to slower and less frequent discovery of the hidden rule. We further explore intervention strategies (e.g., encouraging the agent to consider counter examples) developed for humans. We find prompting LLMs with such instruction consistently decreases confirmation bias in LLMs, improving rule discovery rates from 42% to 56% on average. Lastly, we mitigate confirmation bias by distilling intervention-induced behavior into LLMs, showing promising generalization to a new task, the Blicket test. Our work shows that confirmation bias is a limitation of LLMs in hypothesis exploration, and that it can be mitigated via injecting interventions designed for humans.
tldr: The paper investigates confirmation bias in LLMs using a rule-discovery task, shows LLMs exhibit this bias, and proposes and tests intervention strategies to mitigate it, improving performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用规则发现任务研究了大语言模型中的确认偏差，发现模型存在此偏差，并提出并测试了干预策略以缓解它，从而提升性能。
summary_zh: 确认偏差，即个体倾向于寻找支持而非挑战自身信念的证据，会阻碍其推理能力。本文通过改编心理学中的规则发现实验，研究大型语言模型是否表现出确认偏差：给定一个包含三个数字的序列（即“三元组”），智能体进入一个交互式反馈循环，依次（1）提出新三元组，（2）接收关于该序列是否符合隐藏规则的反馈，（3）猜测规则。通过对多个系列和规模的十一种大型语言模型进行测试，我们发现模型普遍表现出确认偏差，其倾向于提出能验证自身假设的三元组，而非尝试证伪假设。这导致模型发现隐藏规则的速度更慢、成功率更低。我们进一步探索了为人类设计的干预策略（如鼓励模型考虑反例），发现通过此类指令提示大型语言模型能持续降低其确认偏差，将规则发现率从平均42%提升至56%。最后，我们通过将干预引导的行为蒸馏到大型语言模型中，成功缓解了确认偏差，并在新任务（Blicket测试）中展现出良好的泛化能力。本研究揭示了确认偏差是大型语言模型在假设探索中的一种局限性，并证明可通过引入人类干预策略来有效缓解这一问题。

title: SEDGE: Structural Extrapolated Data Generation
summary: This paper proposes a framework for Structural Extrapolated Data GEneration (SEDGE) based on suitable assumptions on the underlying data generating process. We provide conditions under which data satisfying new specifications can be generated reliably, together with the approximate identifiability of the distribution of such data under certain ``conservative" assumptions. On the algorithmic side, we develop practical methods to achieve extrapolated data generation, based on the structure-informed optimization strategy or diffusion posterior sampling, respectively. We verify the extrapolation performance on synthetic data and also consider extrapolated image generation as a real-world scenario to illustrate the validity of the proposed framework.
tldr: Proposes a framework for generating data that satisfies new structural specifications using structure-informed optimization or diffusion sampling, with theoretical guarantees on identifiability under certain assumptions.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个基于结构信息的优化或扩散采样策略的框架，用于生成满足新结构规范的数据，并在特定假设下提供了关于数据分布可识别性的理论保证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于对底层数据生成过程合理假设的结构化外推数据生成框架。通过设定特定条件，我们论证了在满足新规范要求的数据能够可靠生成的同时，此类数据的分布在特定“保守”假设下具有近似可辨识性。在算法层面，我们分别基于结构感知优化策略与扩散后验采样技术，开发了实现外推数据生成的实用方法。我们通过合成数据验证了外推性能，并以外推图像生成作为实际应用场景，论证了所提框架的有效性。

title: Time-Warping Recurrent Neural Networks for Transfer Learning
summary:
Dynamical systems describe how a physical system evolves over time. Physical processes can evolve faster or slower in different environmental conditions. We use time-warping as rescaling the time in a model of a physical system. This thesis proposes a new method of transfer learning for Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) based on time-warping. We prove that for a class of linear, first-order differential equations known as time lag models, an LSTM can approximate these systems with any desired accuracy, and the model can be time-warped while maintaining the approximation accuracy.
  The Time-Warping method of transfer learning is then evaluated in an applied problem on predicting fuel moisture content (FMC), an important concept in wildfire modeling. An RNN with LSTM recurrent layers is pretrained on fuels with a characteristic time scale of 10 hours, where there are large quantities of data available for training. The RNN is then modified with transfer learning to generate predictions for fuels with characteristic time scales of 1 hour, 100 hours, and 1000 hours. The Time-Warping method is evaluated against several known methods of transfer learning. The Time-Warping method produces predictions with an accuracy level comparable to the established methods, despite modifying only a small fraction of the parameters that the other methods modify.
tldr: Proposes a time-warping transfer learning method for RNNs to model systems with different time scales, validated on a wildfire fuel moisture prediction task.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于RNN的基于时间扭曲的迁移学习方法，以模拟不同时间尺度的系统，并在野火燃料水分预测任务上进行了验证。
summary_zh:
动态系统描述了物理系统随时间演化的过程。在不同的环境条件下，物理过程的演化速度可能加快或减慢。我们采用时间扭曲技术对物理系统模型中的时间进行重新标定。本论文提出了一种基于时间扭曲的循环神经网络（RNN）迁移学习新方法。我们证明，对于一类被称为时滞模型的线性一阶微分方程，长短期记忆网络（LSTM）能够以任意精度逼近这些系统，并且该模型在保持逼近精度的同时可以进行时间扭曲。

随后，我们通过野火建模中的重要概念——燃料含水率（FMC）预测这一应用问题，对时间扭曲迁移学习方法进行了评估。首先，在特征时间尺度为10小时的燃料数据上对具有LSTM循环层的RNN进行预训练，该场景下存在大量可用训练数据。接着通过迁移学习对该RNN进行改进，以生成特征时间尺度分别为1小时、100小时和1000小时的燃料预测。通过与多种已知迁移学习方法的对比实验表明，时间扭曲方法仅需修改其他方法所调整参数中的极小部分，即可达到与现有方法相当的预测精度水平。

title: Matrix Profile for Time-Series Anomaly Detection: A Reproducible Open-Source Benchmark on TSB-AD
summary: Matrix Profile (MP) methods are an interpretable and scalable family of distance-based methods for time-series anomaly detection, but strong benchmark performance still depends on design choices beyond a vanilla nearest-neighbor profile. This technical report documents an open-source Matrix Profile for Anomaly Detection (MMPAD) submission to TSB-AD, a benchmark that covers both univariate and multivariate time series. The submitted system combines pre-sorted multidimensional aggregation, efficient exclusion-zone-aware k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) retrieval for repeated anomalies, and moving-average post-processing. To serve as a reproducible reference for MP-based anomaly detection on TSB-AD, we detail the released implementation, the hyperparameter settings for the univariate and multivariate tracks, and the corresponding benchmark results. We further analyze how the system performs on the aggregate leaderboard and across specific dataset characteristics.The open-source implementation is available at https://github.com/mcyeh/mmpad_tsb.
tldr: This paper presents an open-source benchmark implementation for time-series anomaly detection using the Matrix Profile method, focusing on the TSB-AD benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于矩阵轮廓方法的时间序列异常检测开源基准实现，专注于TSB-AD基准测试。
summary_zh: 矩阵剖面（Matrix Profile，MP）方法是一类基于距离的可解释、可扩展的时间序列异常检测方法，但其优异的基准性能仍需依赖朴素最近邻剖面之外的多种设计选择。本技术报告记录了一个针对TSB-AD基准测试（涵盖单变量与多变量时间序列）的开源异常检测矩阵剖面（MMPAD）提交方案。该提交系统融合了预排序多维聚合、针对重复异常的高效禁区内k近邻检索以及移动平均后处理技术。为在TSB-AD基准测试中提供基于MP的异常检测可复现参考，我们详细说明了已发布的实现方案、单变量与多变量赛道的超参数设置，以及对应的基准测试结果。此外，我们还分析了该系统在综合排行榜上的表现及其在不同数据集特征下的检测效果。开源实现地址为：https://github.com/mcyeh/mmpad_tsb。

title: Enhancing Robustness of Federated Learning via Server Learning
summary: This paper explores the use of server learning for enhancing the robustness of federated learning against malicious attacks even when clients' training data are not independent and identically distributed. We propose a heuristic algorithm that uses server learning and client update filtering in combination with geometric median aggregation. We demonstrate via experiments that this approach can achieve significant improvement in model accuracy even when the fraction of malicious clients is high, even more than $50\%$ in some cases, and the dataset utilized by the server is small and could be synthetic with its distribution not necessarily close to that of the clients' aggregated data.
tldr: This paper proposes a method to improve federated learning robustness against malicious clients using server learning, client update filtering, and geometric median aggregation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过服务器学习、客户端更新过滤和几何中位数聚合，提高联邦学习在恶意客户端攻击下的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 本文探讨在客户端训练数据非独立同分布的情况下，利用服务器端学习增强联邦学习对抗恶意攻击的鲁棒性。我们提出一种启发式算法，将服务器端学习与客户端更新过滤相结合，并采用几何中位数聚合方法。实验表明，即使恶意客户端比例较高（某些情况下超过50%），且服务器端所用数据集规模较小、可能为合成数据（其分布不必接近客户端聚合数据分布），该方法仍能显著提升模型精度。

title: AlertStar: Path-Aware Alert Prediction on Hyper-Relational Knowledge Graphs
summary: Cyber-attacks continue to grow in scale and sophistication, yet existing network intrusion detection approaches lack the semantic depth required for path reasoning over attacker-victim interactions. We address this by first modelling network alerts as a knowledge graph, then formulating hyper-relational alert prediction as a hyper-relational knowledge graph completion (HR-KGC) problem, representing each network alert as a qualified statement (h, r, t, Q), where h and t are source and destination IPs, r denotes the attack type, and Q encodes flow-level metadata such as timestamps, ports, protocols, and attack intensity, going beyond standard KGC binary triples (h, r, t) that would discard this contextual richness. We introduce five models across three contributions: first, Hyper-relational Neural Bellman-Ford (HR-NBFNet) extends Neural Bellman-Ford Networks to the hyper-relational setting with qualifier-aware multi-hop path reasoning, while its multi-task variant MT-HR-NBFNet jointly predicts tail, relation, and qualifier-value within a single traversal pass; second, AlertStar fuses qualifier context and structural path information entirely in embedding space via cross-attention and learned path composition, and its multi-task extension MT-AlertStar eliminates the overhead of full knowledge graph propagation; third, HR-NBFNet-CQ extends qualifier-aware representations to answer complex first-order logic queries, including one-hop, two-hop chain, two-anchor intersection, and union, enabling multi-condition threat reasoning over the alert knowledge graph. Evaluated inductively on the Warden and UNSW-NB15 benchmarks across three qualifier-density regimes, AlertStar and MT-AlertStar achieve superior MR, MRR, and Hits@k, demonstrating that local qualifier fusion is both sufficient and more efficient than global path propagation for hyper-relational alert prediction.
tldr: This paper introduces AlertStar, a framework for hyper-relational knowledge graph completion applied to network intrusion detection and alert prediction, which is not related to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AlertStar，一个用于网络入侵检测和警报预测的超关系知识图谱补全框架，与机器人或具身人工智能无关。
summary_zh: 网络攻击的规模与复杂度持续增长，而现有网络入侵检测方法缺乏对攻击者-受害者交互路径进行推理所需的语义深度。为此，我们首先将网络告警报文建模为知识图谱，进而将超关系告警预测定义为超关系知识图谱补全问题，将每条网络告警表征为限定性陈述（h, r, t, Q）。其中h和t分别为源IP与目的IP，r表示攻击类型，Q编码流级元数据（如时间戳、端口、协议、攻击强度），突破了传统知识图谱补全二元三元组（h, r, t）丢弃上下文信息的局限。我们通过三个创新贡献提出五种模型：首先，超关系神经贝尔曼-福特网络将神经贝尔曼-福特网络扩展至超关系场景，实现限定符感知的多跳路径推理，其多任务变体MT-HR-NBFNet可在单次遍历中联合预测目标实体、关系及限定符取值；其次，AlertStar通过交叉注意力与自适应路径组合，在嵌入空间完全融合限定符上下文与结构路径信息，其多任务扩展MT-AlertStar消除了全图谱传播的开销；第三，HR-NBFNet-CQ将限定符感知表征扩展至复杂一阶逻辑查询，包括单跳、双跳链式、双锚点交集与并集查询，支持在告警知识图谱上进行多条件威胁推理。通过在Warden和UNSW-NB15基准数据集上对三种限定符密度场景进行归纳评估，AlertStar与MT-AlertStar在平均排名、平均倒数排名和Hits@k指标上均表现优异，证明局部限定符融合策略对于超关系告警预测不仅足够有效，且比全局路径传播方法更具效率优势。

title: Verbalizing LLMs' assumptions to explain and control sycophancy
summary: LLMs can be socially sycophantic, affirming users when they ask questions like "am I in the wrong?" rather than providing genuine assessment. We hypothesize that this behavior arises from incorrect assumptions about the user, like underestimating how often users are seeking information over reassurance. We present Verbalized Assumptions, a framework for eliciting these assumptions from LLMs. Verbalized Assumptions provide insight into LLM sycophancy, delusion, and other safety issues, e.g., the top bigram in LLMs' assumptions on social sycophancy datasets is ``seeking validation.'' We provide evidence for a causal link between Verbalized Assumptions and sycophantic model behavior: our assumption probes (linear probes trained on internal representations of these assumptions) enable interpretable fine-grained steering of social sycophancy. We explore why LLMs default to sycophantic assumptions: on identical queries, people expect more objective and informative responses from AI than from other humans, but LLMs trained on human-human conversation do not account for this difference in expectations. Our work contributes a new understanding of assumptions as a mechanism for sycophancy.
tldr: This paper investigates the sycophantic behavior of Large Language Models, proposing a 'Verbalized Assumptions' framework to elicit and analyze the user assumptions behind such behavior, and demonstrates a causal link enabling steering of the model's responses.
tldr_zh: 本文研究大语言模型的阿谀奉承行为，提出'言语化假设'框架来引出和分析导致该行为的用户假设，并证明了其与模型行为的因果关系，从而能够干预模型的响应。
summary_zh: 大语言模型可能表现出社会迎合性，当用户提出诸如“我错了吗？”这类问题时，它们倾向于附和使用者而非提供客观评估。我们假设该行为源于模型对用户意图的错误假设，例如低估了用户寻求信息而非情感安慰的频率。本文提出“显性假设”框架，用于从大语言模型中提取这些潜在假设。显性假设揭示了模型在社交迎合、认知偏差及其他安全问题上的表现机制，例如在社会迎合数据集中，模型假设里最常见的二元词组是“寻求认同”。我们通过实验验证了显性假设与迎合行为之间的因果关系：基于这些假设内部表征训练的线性探测模型，能够实现对社交迎合行为的可解释细粒度调控。我们进一步探讨了大语言模型默认采用迎合性假设的原因：在相同查询场景下，人类对人工智能的回应期待比对其他人的回应更具客观性和信息量，但基于人类对话数据训练的模型未能充分考虑这种期望差异。本研究为理解假设机制如何导致迎合行为提供了新的理论视角。

title: Querying Structured Data Through Natural Language Using Language Models
summary: This paper presents an open source methodology for allowing users to query structured non textual datasets through natural language Unlike Retrieval Augmented Generation RAG which struggles with numerical and highly structured information our approach trains an LLM to generate executable queries To support this capability we introduce a principled pipeline for synthetic training data generation producing diverse question answer pairs that capture both user intent and the semantics of the underlying dataset We fine tune a compact model DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B using QLoRA with 4 bit quantization making the system suitable for deployment on commodity hardware We evaluate our approach on a dataset describing accessibility to essential services across Durangaldea Spain The fine tuned model achieves high accuracy across monolingual multilingual and unseen location scenarios demonstrating both robust generalization and reliable query generation Our results highlight that small domain specific models can achieve high precision for this task without relying on large proprietary LLMs making this methodology suitable for resource constrained environments and adaptable to broader multi dataset systems We evaluate our approach on a dataset describing accessibility to essential services across Durangaldea Spain The fine tuned model achieves high accuracy across monolingual multilingual and unseen location scenarios demonstrating both robust generalization and reliable query generation Our results highlight that small domain specific models can achieve high precision for this task without relying on large proprietary LLMs making this methodology suitable for resource constrained environments and adaptable to broader multi dataset systems.
tldr: Presents a method for training a compact LLM to generate executable queries for structured data, achieving high accuracy on a dataset about accessibility to essential services in a specific region.
tldr_zh: 提出一种训练小型语言模型的方法，使其能够为结构化数据生成可执行的自然语言查询，并在特定区域服务可达性数据集上实现了高精度。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种开源方法，使用户能够通过自然语言查询结构化的非文本数据集。与难以处理数值和高度结构化信息的检索增强生成（RAG）技术不同，我们的方法训练大型语言模型生成可执行查询。为支持这一能力，我们引入了一套系统的合成训练数据生成流程，能够生成多样化的问题-答案对，既捕捉用户意图，又保留底层数据集的语义特征。我们使用QLoRA技术和4位量化对紧凑模型DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B进行微调，使该系统适合在商用硬件上部署。我们在描述西班牙杜兰加尔迪亚地区基本服务可达性的数据集上评估了该方法。微调后的模型在单语、多语及未见过的地理位置场景中均表现出高精度，既展现了强大的泛化能力，也实现了可靠的查询生成。我们的研究结果表明，针对特定领域的小型模型能够在此任务中实现高精度，而无需依赖大型专有LLM，这使得该方法适用于资源受限环境，并能够适应更广泛的多数据集系统。

title: Analyzing Healthcare Interoperability Vulnerabilities: Formal Modeling and Graph-Theoretic Approach
summary: In a healthcare environment, the healthcare interoperability platforms based on HL7 FHIR allow concurrent, asynchronous access to a set of shared patient resources, which are independent systems, i.e., EHR systems, pharmacy systems, lab systems, and devices. The FHIR specification lacks a protocol for concurrency control, and the research on detecting a race condition only targets the OS kernel. The research on FHIR security only targets authentication and injection attacks, considering concurrent access to patient resources to be sequential. The gap in the research in this area is addressed through the introduction of FHIR Resource Access Graph (FRAG), a formally defined graph G = (P,R,E, λ, τ, S), in which the nodes are the concurrent processes, the typed edges represent the resource access events, and the race conditions are represented as detectable structural properties. Three clinically relevant race condition classes are formally specified: Simultaneous Write Conflict (SWC), TOCTOU Authorization Violation (TAV), and Cascading Update Race (CUR). The FRAG model is implemented as a three-pass graph traversal detection algorithm and tested against a time window-based baseline on 1,500 synthetic FHIR R4 transaction logs. Under full concurrent access (C2), FRAG attains a 90.0% F1 score vs. 25.5% for the baseline, a 64.5 pp improvement.
tldr: This paper proposes a formal graph model and detection algorithm for identifying race conditions in healthcare interoperability platforms (HL7 FHIR), a problem not previously addressed in the security research for this domain.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于识别医疗互操作性平台（HL7 FHIR）中竞态条件的正式图模型和检测算法，解决了该领域安全研究中一个先前未被关注的问题。
summary_zh: 在医疗环境中，基于HL7 FHIR的医疗互操作性平台允许对一组共享的患者资源进行并发、异步访问，这些资源分布于独立系统（如电子健康记录系统、药房系统、实验室系统及医疗设备）中。FHIR规范缺乏并发控制协议，而现有的竞态条件检测研究仅针对操作系统内核层面。现有关于FHIR安全性的研究主要关注身份验证和注入攻击，且默认对患者资源的并发访问是顺序执行的。为填补这一领域的研究空白，本文引入FHIR资源访问图（FRAG）——一种形式化定义的图结构G = (P,R,E, λ, τ, S)，其中节点表示并发进程，带类型的边代表资源访问事件，竞态条件则体现为可检测的结构化属性。研究形式化定义了三种临床相关的竞态条件类别：同时写入冲突（SWC）、检查时与执行时授权违例（TAV）以及级联更新竞态（CUR）。FRAG模型通过三阶段图遍历检测算法实现，并在1500条合成的FHIR R4事务日志上基于时间窗口基线进行测试。在完全并发访问（C2）场景下，FRAG模型的F1得分达到90.0%，较基线的25.5%提升64.5个百分点。

title: Beyond Isolated Tasks: A Framework for Evaluating Coding Agents on Sequential Software Evolution
summary: Existing datasets for coding agents evaluate performance on isolated, single pull request (PR) tasks in a stateless manner, failing to capture the reality of real-world software development where code changes accumulate, technical debt accrues, and test suites grow over time. To bridge this gap, we introduce an automated coding task generation framework, which helps generate our dataset SWE-STEPS, that evaluates coding agents on long-horizon tasks through two realistic settings mirroring actual developer workflows: Conversational coding with iterative requests, and single-shot Project Requirement document (PRD)-based coding. Unlike existing datasets that evaluate agents on disjointed Pull Requests (PRs), our framework assesses performance across chains of dependent PRs, enabling evaluation of sequential execution, regression verification, and long-term repository health. We discover that widely used isolated PR evaluations yield inflated success rates, w.r.t. our settings - overshooting performance by as much as 20 percentage points - because they ignore the ``spillover'' effects of previous inefficient or buggy code. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that even when agents successfully resolve issues, they degrade repository health by generating code with higher cognitive complexity and technical debt compared to human developers, underscoring the necessity for multidimensional evaluation.
tldr: The paper introduces SWE-STEPS, a framework and dataset for evaluating coding agents on sequential, multi-step software development tasks, showing that isolated evaluations overestimate performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SWE-STEPS框架和数据集，用于评估编码智能体在顺序、多步骤软件开发任务上的表现，表明孤立评估会高估其性能。
summary_zh: 现有用于评估编码智能体的数据集多采用无状态方式，对孤立、单一拉取请求（PR）任务进行性能评估，未能反映真实软件开发中代码变更累积、技术债务增加和测试套件随时间演化的实际情况。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种自动化编码任务生成框架，该框架构建了SWE-STEPS数据集，通过两种模拟实际开发者工作流的场景——基于迭代请求的对话式编码和基于单次项目需求文档（PRD）的编码——来评估编码智能体在长周期任务中的表现。与现有评估孤立PR任务的数据集不同，本框架通过评估相互关联的PR任务链来考察智能体表现，从而支持对顺序执行、回归验证及长期代码库健康状况的评估。研究发现，广泛使用的孤立PR评估会高估成功率（在本研究场景中最高可达20个百分点），因其忽视了先前低效或存在缺陷代码所产生的“溢出效应”。此外，分析表明即便智能体成功解决问题，其生成的代码相较于人类开发者仍具有更高的认知复杂度和技术债务，导致代码库健康状况下降，这凸显了多维评估的必要性。

title: Comparing the Impact of Pedagogy-Informed Custom and General-Purpose GAI Chatbots on Students' Science Problem-Solving Processes and Performance Using Heterogeneous Interaction Network Analysis
summary: Problem solving plays an essential role in science education, and generative AI (GAI) chatbots have emerged as a promising tool for supporting students' science problem solving. However, general-purpose chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT), which often provide direct, ready-made answers, may lead to students' cognitive offloading. Prior research has rarely focused on custom chatbots for facilitating students' science problem solving, nor has it examined how they differently influence problem-solving processes and performance compared to general-purpose chatbots. To address this gap, we developed a pedagogy-informed custom GAI chatbot grounded in the Socratic questioning method, which supports students by prompting them with guiding questions. This study employed a within-subjects counterbalanced design in which 48 secondary school students used both custom and general-purpose chatbot to complete two science problem-solving tasks. 3297 student-chatbot dialogues were collected and analyzed using Heterogeneous Interaction Network Analysis (HINA). The results showed that: (1) students demonstrated significantly higher interaction intensity and cognitive interaction diversity when using custom chatbot than using general-purpose chatbot; (2) students were more likely to follow custom chatbot's guidance to think and reflect, whereas they tended to request general-purpose chatbot to execute specific commands; and (3) no statistically significant difference was observed in students' problem-solving performance evaluated by solution quality between two chatbot conditions. This study provides novel theoretical insights and empirical evidence that custom chatbots are less likely to induce cognitive offloading and instead foster greater cognitive engagement compared to general-purpose chatbots. This study also offers insights into the design and integration of GAI chatbots in science education.
tldr: This study compares a pedagogy-informed custom generative AI chatbot, using Socratic questioning, against a general-purpose chatbot for supporting students' science problem-solving, finding the custom chatbot fosters greater cognitive engagement without significantly altering final performance.
tldr_zh: 本研究比较了基于苏格拉底提问法的教学定制生成式AI聊天机器人与通用聊天机器人对学生科学问题解决的支持效果，发现定制机器人能促进更强的认知参与度，但未显著改变最终成绩。
summary_zh: 问题解决能力在科学教育中占据核心地位，而生成式人工智能聊天机器人已成为支持学生科学问题解决的有力工具。然而，通用型聊天机器人（如ChatGPT）常直接提供现成答案，可能导致学生认知卸载现象。现有研究较少关注定制化聊天机器人在促进学生科学问题解决中的作用，也未深入比较其与通用型聊天机器人对问题解决过程及表现影响的差异。为弥补这一研究空白，我们基于苏格拉底式提问法开发了一款融合教学理念的定制生成式人工智能聊天机器人，通过引导式提问支持学生探究。本研究采用被试内平衡设计，48名中学生分别使用定制与通用聊天机器人完成两项科学问题解决任务。通过对3297组人机对话进行异质交互网络分析，发现：（1）学生使用定制机器人时的交互强度和认知交互多样性显著高于通用机器人；（2）学生更倾向于遵循定制机器人的引导进行思考与反思，而对通用机器人则更多要求其执行具体指令；（3）两种聊天机器人条件下学生解决问题的方案质量评估未呈现统计学显著差异。本研究从理论与实证层面证明，相较于通用型聊天机器人，定制化聊天机器人更能有效减少认知卸载现象并提升认知投入度，同时为生成式人工智能聊天机器人在科学教育中的设计与整合提供了重要启示。

title: User-Aware Conditional Generative Total Correlation Learning for Multi-Modal Recommendation
summary: Multi-modal recommendation (MMR) enriches item representations by introducing item content, e.g., visual and textual descriptions, to improve upon interaction-only recommenders. The success of MMR hinges on aligning these content modalities with user preferences derived from interaction data, yet dominant practices based on disentangling modality-invariant preference-driving signals from modality-specific preference-irrelevant noises are flawed. First, they assume a one-size-fits-all relevance of item content to user preferences for all users, which contradicts the user-conditional fact of preferences. Second, they optimize pairwise contrastive losses separately toward cross-modal alignment, systematically ignoring higher-order dependencies inherent when multiple content modalities jointly influence user choices. In this paper, we introduce GTC, a conditional Generative Total Correlation learning framework. We employ an interaction-guided diffusion model to perform user-aware content feature filtering, preserving only personalized features relevant to each individual user. Furthermore, to capture complete cross-modal dependencies, we optimize a tractable lower bound of the total correlation of item representations across all modalities. Experiments on standard MMR benchmarks show GTC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art, with gains of up to 28.30% in NDCG@5. Ablation studies validate both conditional preference-driven feature filtering and total correlation optimization, confirming the ability of GTC to model user-conditional relationships in MMR tasks. The code is available at: https://github.com/jingdu-cs/GTC.
tldr: This paper proposes a conditional generative framework (GTC) for multi-modal recommendation that uses a user-aware diffusion model to filter content features and optimizes total correlation to capture higher-order cross-modal dependencies, improving recommendation performance.
