These findings highlight Fact-Hash as a promising solution to improve feature grid representation, address memory constraints, and improve quality in various applications. Project page: https://facthash.github.io/
tldr: The paper presents Fact-Hash, a memory-efficient parameter-encoding method using Tensor Factorization and Hash-encoding for training Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) on edge devices, improving memory usage and energy consumption.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Fact-Hash的内存高效参数编码方法，结合张量分解和哈希编码，用于在边缘设备上训练神经辐射场（NeRF），改善了内存使用和能耗。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了Fact-Hash，一种用于训练端侧神经辐射场的新型参数编码方法。神经辐射场（NeRF）已被证明在三维表示中具有关键作用，但其应用因庞大的计算资源需求而受限。端侧训练能够开辟广阔的应用领域，在通信受限、隐私保护需求以及对快速变化场景的即时适应方面具有优势。然而，有限资源（如GPU内存、存储空间和功耗）等挑战阻碍了其实际部署。为此，我们提出Fact-Hash——一种融合张量分解与哈希编码技术的新型参数编码方法。该集成方案具有两大优势：利用丰富的高分辨率特征和实现少样本鲁棒性。在Fact-Hash中，我们将三维坐标投影至多个低维形式（二维或一维），再应用哈希函数将其聚合为单一特征。与前沿方法的对比实验表明，Fact-Hash在保持重建质量和渲染速度的同时，具有卓越的内存效率。相较于现有编码方法，Fact-Hash在保持峰值信噪比不变的情况下可节省超过三分之一的内存使用量。端侧实验验证了Fact-Hash在计算效率和能耗方面优于其他位置编码方法。这些发现表明，Fact-Hash作为一种前景广阔的解决方案，能有效提升特征网格表示能力，突破内存限制，并在多种应用中提高重建质量。项目页面：https://facthash.github.io/

title: MMPhysVideo: Scaling Physical Plausibility in Video Generation via Joint Multimodal Modeling
summary: Despite advancements in generating visually stunning content, video diffusion models (VDMs) often yield physically inconsistent results due to pixel-only reconstruction. To address this, we propose MMPhysVideo, the first framework to scale physical plausibility in video generation through joint multimodal modeling. We recast perceptual cues, specifically semantics, geometry, and spatio-temporal trajectory, into a unified pseudo-RGB format, enabling VDMs to directly capture complex physical dynamics. To mitigate cross-modal interference, we propose a Bidirectionally Controlled Teacher architecture, which utilizes parallel branches to fully decouple RGB and perception processing and adopts two zero-initialized control links to gradually learn pixel-wise consistency. For inference efficiency, the teacher's physical prior is distilled into a single-stream student model via representation alignment. Furthermore, we present MMPhysPipe, a scalable data curation and annotation pipeline tailored for constructing physics-rich multimodal datasets. MMPhysPipe employs a vision-language model (VLM) guided by a chain-of-visual-evidence rule to pinpoint physical subjects, enabling expert models to extract multi-granular perceptual information. Without additional inference costs, MMPhysVideo consistently improves physical plausibility and visual quality over advanced models across various benchmarks and achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods.
tldr: This paper proposes a multimodal video generation framework that improves physical plausibility by jointly modeling semantic, geometric, and trajectory cues, but focuses on general video generation, not robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个多模态视频生成框架，通过联合建模语义、几何和轨迹线索来提高物理合理性，但其重点在于通用视频生成，而非机器人或具身AI。
summary_zh: 尽管视频扩散模型在生成视觉震撼内容方面取得了进展，但基于纯像素的重建方法常导致物理不一致的结果。为此，我们提出MMPhysVideo——首个通过联合多模态建模实现规模化物理可信视频生成的框架。我们将语义、几何与时空轨迹等感知线索统一重构为伪RGB格式，使视频扩散模型能直接捕捉复杂的物理动态。为降低跨模态干扰，我们设计了双向控制教师架构：该架构采用并行分支完全解耦RGB与感知信息的处理，并通过两个零初始化的控制链接逐步学习像素级一致性。为提升推理效率，教师模型的物理先验知识通过表示对齐蒸馏至单流学生模型中。此外，我们开发了MMPhysPipe——一个可扩展的、专为构建富含物理信息的多模态数据集而设计的数据处理与标注流程。该流程基于视觉证据链规则引导视觉语言模型精准定位物理主体，并借助专家模型提取多粒度感知信息。在不增加额外推理成本的情况下，MMPhysVideo在多项基准测试中持续超越先进模型，显著提升了物理合理性与视觉质量，相较现有方法实现了最优性能。

title: A Unified Perspective on Adversarial Membership Manipulation in Vision Models
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether a specific data point was part of a model's training set, serving as effective tools for evaluating privacy leakage of vision models. However, existing MIAs implicitly assume honest query inputs, and their adversarial robustness remains unexplored. We show that MIAs for vision models expose a previously overlooked adversarial surface: adversarial membership manipulation, where imperceptible perturbations can reliably push non-member images into the "member" region of state-of-the-art MIAs. In this paper, we provide the first unified perspective on this phenomenon by analyzing its mechanism and implications. We begin by demonstrating that adversarial membership fabrication is consistently effective across diverse architectures and datasets. We then reveal a distinctive geometric signature - a characteristic gradient-norm collapse trajectory - that reliably separates fabricated from true members despite their nearly identical semantic representations. Building on this insight, we introduce a principled detection strategy grounded in gradient-geometry signals and develop a robust inference framework that substantially mitigates adversarial manipulation. Extensive experiments show that fabrication is broadly effective, while our detection and robust inference strategies significantly enhance resilience. This work establishes the first comprehensive framework for adversarial membership manipulation in vision models.
tldr: The paper investigates adversarial membership manipulation in vision models, showing how imperceptible perturbations can fool membership inference attacks, and proposes a detection and robust inference framework.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了视觉模型中的对抗性成员操纵，展示了如何通过不易察觉的扰动欺骗成员推断攻击，并提出了一个检测和鲁棒推断框架。
summary_zh: 成员推断攻击旨在判定特定数据点是否属于模型训练集，是评估视觉模型隐私泄露的有效工具。然而现有方法默认查询输入为良性样本，其对抗鲁棒性尚未得到充分探索。本文发现视觉模型的成员推断暴露出一个长期被忽视的对抗面：通过添加不可感知的扰动，攻击者能稳定地将非成员图像推入先进成员推断方法的"成员区域"，实现对抗性成员操纵。我们首次通过机制分析与影响评估为该现象建立统一理论框架：首先论证对抗性成员伪造在不同架构与数据集上均持续有效；随后揭示其独特的几何特征——梯度范数坍缩轨迹，该特征能在语义表征近乎一致的条件下有效区分伪造成员与真实成员；基于此发现，我们提出基于梯度几何信号的理论检测机制，构建能显著抵御对抗操纵的鲁棒推断框架。大量实验表明，伪造攻击具有广泛有效性，而我们的检测与鲁棒推断策略能显著提升防御能力。本研究为视觉模型中的对抗性成员操纵建立了首个完整理论框架。

title: Differentiable Stroke Planning with Dual Parameterization for Efficient and High-Fidelity Painting Creation
summary: In stroke-based rendering, search methods often get trapped in local minima due to discrete stroke placement, while differentiable optimizers lack structural awareness and produce unstructured layouts. To bridge this gap, we propose a dual representation that couples discrete polylines with continuous Bézier control points via a bidirectional mapping mechanism. This enables collaborative optimization: local gradients refine global stroke structures, while content-aware stroke proposals help escape poor local optima. Our representation further supports Gaussian-splatting-inspired initialization, enabling highly parallel stroke optimization across the image. Experiments show that our approach reduces the number of strokes by 30-50%, achieves more structurally coherent layouts, and improves reconstruction quality, while cutting optimization time by 30-40% compared to existing differentiable vectorization methods.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel method for stroke-based rendering that uses a dual representation (polylines and Bézier control points) and collaborative optimization to improve the efficiency, structure, and quality of creating vector art from images.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于笔触的渲染方法，它使用双重表示（折线和贝塞尔控制点）和协作优化来提高从图像创建矢量艺术的效率、结构和质量。
summary_zh: 在基于笔画的渲染中，离散笔画排布常使搜索方法陷入局部极小值，而可微优化器缺乏结构意识，导致布局杂乱无章。为弥合这一差距，我们提出一种通过双向映射机制将离散折线与连续贝塞尔控制点耦合的双重表示方法。该表示支持协同优化：局部梯度可细化全局笔画结构，而内容感知的笔画提案有助于跳出局部次优解。我们的方法进一步支持受高斯泼溅启发的初始化机制，实现了图像中笔画的高度并行化优化。实验表明，相比现有可微分矢量化方法，本方法将笔画数量减少30-50%，获得更具结构一致性的布局，在提升重建质量的同时，将优化时间缩短30-40%。

title: Visual Instruction-Finetuned Language Model for Versatile Brain MR Image Tasks
summary: LLMs have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in linguistic reasoning and are increasingly adept at vision-language tasks. The integration of image tokens into transformers has enabled direct visual input and output, advancing research from image-to-text descriptions to text-to-image generation. However, simple text-to-image generation holds limited clinical utility. In medical imaging, tasks such as image segmentation for localizing pathologies or image translation for reconstructing missing sequences have much greater clinical importance. Despite this, integrating these diverse, clinically relevant tasks within a single, versatile language model remains unexplored. Our method, LLaBIT (Large Language Model for Brain Image Translation), extends the visual reasoning of LLMs to these clinically meaningful tasks in the brain MRI domain. To mitigate the spatial information loss inherent in image tokenization, we incorporate a mechanism to reuse feature maps from the image encoder, minimizing data degradation. We also generate text data using LLMs with strict predefined instructions to augment limited image-text paired data in brain MRI. We comprehensively evaluated our method on five brain MRI datasets across four distinct tasks: report generation, visual question answering, image segmentation, and image translation. Our model not only demonstrated superior performance across all tasks but also outperformed specialized, task-specific models in direct comparisons, highlighting its efficacy and versatility
tldr: The paper presents LLaBIT, a large language model adapted to handle multiple brain MRI tasks, including image segmentation and translation, but focuses solely on medical imaging with no connection to robotics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了LLaBIT，一种用于处理脑部MRI图像分割、翻译等多种任务的大型语言模型，但仅专注于医学影像，与机器人学无关。
summary_zh:
摘要：
大语言模型在语言推理方面展现出卓越能力，并日益擅长处理视觉语言任务。通过将图像标记融入变换器架构，实现了直接视觉输入与输出，推动研究从图像到文本描述向文本到图像生成发展。然而，简单的文本到图像生成在临床应用中价值有限。在医学影像领域，针对病灶定位的图像分割或重建缺失序列的图像转换等任务具有更重要的临床意义。尽管相关研究不断推进，如何将这些多样化的临床任务整合至统一的多功能语言模型中仍属空白。本研究提出的LLaBIT（脑部图像转换大语言模型）将大语言模型的视觉推理能力扩展至脑部MRI领域具有临床意义的具体任务中。为缓解图像标记化过程中固有的空间信息丢失，我们引入重用图像编码器特征图的机制，最大限度减少数据质量衰减。同时利用大语言模型按照严格预定义指令生成文本数据，以增强脑部MRI领域有限的图像-文本配对数据。我们在五个脑部MRI数据集上对模型进行了四项任务的全面评估：报告生成、视觉问答、图像分割和图像转换。实验结果表明，该模型不仅在所有任务中均表现出卓越性能，更在直接对比中超越各项专用任务模型，彰显其高效性与多场景适应性。

title: Parser-Oriented Structural Refinement for a Stable Layout Interface in Document Parsing
summary: Accurate document parsing requires both robust content recognition and a stable parser interface. In explicit Document Layout Analysis (DLA) pipelines, downstream parsers do not consume the full detector output. Instead, they operate on a retained and serialized set of layout instances. However, on dense pages with overlapping regions and ambiguous boundaries, unstable layout hypotheses can make the retained instance set inconsistent with its parser input order, leading to severe downstream parsing errors. To address this issue, we introduce a lightweight structural refinement stage between a DETR-style detector and the parser to stabilize the parser interface. Treating raw detector outputs as a compact hypothesis pool, the proposed module performs set-level reasoning over query features, semantic cues, box geometry, and visual evidence. From a shared refined structural state, it jointly determines instance retention, refines box localization, and predicts parser input order before handoff. We further introduce retention-oriented supervision and a difficulty-aware ordering objective to better align the retained instance set and its order with the final parser input, especially on structurally complex pages. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks show that our method consistently improves page-level layout quality. When integrated into a standard end-to-end parsing pipeline, the stabilized parser interface also substantially reduces sequence mismatch, achieving a Reading Order Edit of 0.024 on OmniDocBench.
tldr: This paper introduces a structural refinement module for document layout analysis pipelines to stabilize the interface between a layout detector and downstream parser, improving parsing accuracy on complex documents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种文档布局分析的结构优化模块，用于稳定布局检测器与下游解析器之间的接口，从而提高复杂文档的解析准确率。
summary_zh: 准确的文档解析需要稳健的内容识别与稳定的解析器接口。在显式文档布局分析流程中，下游解析器并不直接使用检测器的全部输出，而是基于一组经过筛选并序列化的布局实例进行操作。然而，在密集页面中，当区域重叠且边界模糊时，不稳定的布局假设会导致保留的实例集与其解析器输入顺序不一致，从而引发严重的下游解析错误。为解决这一问题，我们在DETR风格检测器与解析器之间引入了一个轻量级结构化优化阶段，以稳定解析器接口。该方法将原始检测器输出视作紧凑的假设集合，通过对查询特征、语义线索、框体几何信息和视觉证据进行集合级推理，从共享的优化结构状态中同步确定实例保留、优化框体定位，并在移交前预测解析器输入顺序。我们进一步引入了面向保留的监督机制和难度感知的排序目标，以更好地将保留的实例集及其顺序与最终解析器输入对齐，尤其是在结构复杂的页面上。在公开基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的方法能持续提升页面级布局质量。当集成到标准端到端解析流程中时，经稳定的解析器接口还显著减少了序列错配问题，在OmniDocBench上实现了0.024的阅读顺序编辑距离。

title: Unlocking Multi-Site Clinical Data: A Federated Approach to Privacy-First Child Autism Behavior Analysis
summary: Automated recognition of autistic behaviors in children is essential for early intervention and objective clinical assessment. However, the development of robust models is severely hindered by strict privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and the sensitive nature of pediatric data, which prevents the centralized aggregation of clinical datasets. Furthermore, individual clinical sites often suffer from data scarcity, making it difficult to learn generalized behavior patterns or tailor models to site-specific patient distributions. To address these challenges, we observe that Federated Learning (FL) can decouple model training from raw data access, enabling multi-site collaboration while maintaining strict data residency. In this paper, we present the first study exploring Federated Learning for pose-based child autism behavior recognition. Our framework employs a two-layer privacy protection mechanism: utilizing human skeletal abstraction to remove identifiable visual information from the raw RGB videos and FL to ensure sensitive pose data remains within the clinic. This approach leverages distributed clinical data to learn generalized representations while providing the flexibility for site-specific personalization. Experimental results on the MMASD benchmark demonstrate that our framework achieves high recognition accuracy, outperforming traditional federated baselines and providing a robust, privacy-first solution for multi-site clinical analysis.
tldr: This paper introduces a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for recognizing autistic behaviors in children using pose data from clinical videos, addressing data privacy and scarcity issues in multi-site medical analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于儿童自闭症行为识别的隐私保护联邦学习框架，利用临床视频中的姿态数据，解决多站点医疗分析中的数据隐私和稀缺性问题。
summary_zh: 儿童自闭症行为的自动识别对于早期干预和客观临床评估至关重要。然而，严格的隐私法规（如HIPAA）以及儿科数据的敏感性，使得临床数据集无法进行集中整合，这严重阻碍了稳健模型的发展。此外，单个临床站点常面临数据稀缺问题，难以学习泛化的行为模式或根据特定站点的患者分布调整模型。为应对这些挑战，我们注意到联邦学习（FL）能够将模型训练与原始数据访问分离，在保持严格数据驻留的同时实现多站点协作。本文首次研究了基于姿态的儿童自闭症行为识别中的联邦学习应用。我们的框架采用双层隐私保护机制：利用人体骨骼抽象技术从原始RGB视频中移除可识别的视觉信息，并通过联邦学习确保敏感的姿态数据仅保留在诊所内部。该方法通过分布式临床数据学习泛化表征，同时为站点特定个性化提供灵活性。在MMASD基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的框架实现了高识别准确率，优于传统联邦基线方法，为多站点临床分析提供了一种稳健、隐私优先的解决方案。

title: Why Invariance is Not Enough for Biomedical Domain Generalization and How to Fix It
summary: We present DropGen, a simple and theoretically-grounded approach for domain generalization in 3D biomedical image segmentation. Modern segmentation models degrade sharply under shifts in modality, disease severity, clinical sites, and other factors, creating brittle models that limit reliable deployment. Existing domain generalization methods rely on extreme augmentations, mixing domain statistics, or architectural redesigns, yet incur significant implementation overhead and yield inconsistent performance across biomedical settings. DropGen instead proposes a principled learning strategy with minimal overhead that leverages both source-domain image intensities and domain-stable foundation model representations to train robust segmentation models. As a result, DropGen achieves strong gains in both fully supervised and few-shot segmentation across a broad range of shifts in biomedical studies. Unlike prior approaches, DropGen is architecture- and loss-agnostic, compatible with standard augmentation pipelines, computationally lightweight, and tackles arbitrary anatomical regions. Our implementation is freely available at https://github.com/sebodiaz/DropGen.
tldr: Proposes DropGen, a simple method for domain generalization in 3D biomedical image segmentation, using source-domain images and domain-stable foundation model features to improve robustness.
tldr_zh: 提出DropGen，一种用于3D生物医学图像分割的领域泛化方法，它利用源域图像和领域稳定的基础模型特征来提高模型鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 我们提出DropGen，一种理论基础坚实的简单方法，用于三维生物医学图像分割中的领域泛化。现代分割模型在模态、疾病严重程度、临床中心等因素变化时性能急剧下降，导致模型脆弱性，限制了其可靠部署。现有的领域泛化方法依赖于极端数据增强、混合领域统计特性或架构重构，但实施成本高昂且在生物医学场景中表现不稳定。DropGen提出了一种基于原则的学习策略，以最小化开销同时利用源域图像强度和领域稳定的基础模型表示，训练出鲁棒的分割模型。该方法在生物医学研究中各类数据分布变化场景下，实现了全监督和小样本分割性能的显著提升。与现有方法不同，DropGen不依赖特定架构或损失函数，兼容标准数据增强流程，计算开销小，并能处理任意解剖区域。我们的实现代码已开源：https://github.com/sebodiaz/DropGen。

title: Rapidly deploying on-device eye tracking by distilling visual foundation models
summary: Eye tracking (ET) plays a critical role in augmented and virtual reality applications. However, rapidly deploying high-accuracy, on-device gaze estimation for new products remains challenging because hardware configurations (e.g., camera placement, camera pose, and illumination) often change across device generations. Visual foundation models (VFMs) are a promising direction for rapid training and deployment, and they excel on natural-image benchmarks; yet we find that off-the-shelf VFMs still struggle to achieve high accuracy on specialized near-eye infrared imagery. To address this gap, we introduce DistillGaze, a framework that distills a foundation model by leveraging labeled synthetic data and unlabeled real data for rapid and high-performance on-device gaze estimation. DistillGaze proceeds in two stages. First, we adapt a VFM into a domain-specialized teacher using self-supervised learning on labeled synthetic and unlabeled real images. Synthetic data provides scalable, high-quality gaze supervision, while unlabeled real data helps bridge the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Second, we train an on-device student using both teacher guidance and self-training. Evaluated on a large-scale, crowd-sourced dataset spanning over 2,000 participants, DistillGaze reduces median gaze error by 58.62% relative to synthetic-only baselines while maintaining a lightweight 256K-parameter model suitable for real-time on-device deployment. Overall, DistillGaze provides an efficient pathway for training and deploying ET models that adapt to hardware changes, and offers a recipe for combining synthetic supervision with unlabeled real data in on-device regression tasks.
tldr: This paper presents DistillGaze, a framework for efficient on-device gaze estimation by distilling visual foundation models using synthetic data and unlabeled real images, targeting AR/VR applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DistillGaze框架，通过使用合成数据和未标记的真实图像，蒸馏视觉基础模型，以实现高效、轻量的设备端视线估计，主要面向AR/VR应用。
summary_zh: 眼动追踪在增强现实和虚拟现实应用中起着关键作用。然而，由于硬件配置（如摄像头位置、摄像头姿态和照明条件）在不同代设备间经常变化，为新设备快速部署高精度、本地化视线估计仍面临挑战。视觉基础模型为实现快速训练和部署提供了可行方向，并在自然图像基准测试中表现出色；但我们发现，现成的视觉基础模型在专门的近眼红外图像上仍难以实现高精度。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了DistillGaze框架，该框架通过利用标注合成数据和未标注真实数据来蒸馏基础模型，以实现快速、高性能的本地化视线估计。DistillGaze包含两个阶段：首先，通过在有标注合成图像和未标注真实图像上进行自监督学习，我们将视觉基础模型适应为领域专用教师模型。合成数据提供可扩展的高质量视线监督，而未标注真实数据则有助于弥合合成到真实领域的差距。其次，我们结合教师模型指导和自训练方法，训练一个轻量级本地化学生模型。在涵盖超过2000名参与者的大规模众包数据集上的评估表明，相较于仅使用合成数据的基线方法，DistillGaze将视线中位误差降低了58.62%，同时保持了仅25.6万参数的轻量级模型，适合实时本地化部署。总体而言，DistillGaze为适应硬件变化的眼动追踪模型训练和部署提供了高效路径，并为在本地化回归任务中结合合成数据监督与未标注真实数据提供了系统化方案。

title: Street-Legal Physical-World Adversarial Rim for License Plates
summary: Automatic license plate reader (ALPR) systems are widely deployed to identify and track vehicles. While prior work has demonstrated vulnerabilities in ALPR systems, far less attention has been paid to their legality and physical-world practicality. We investigate whether low-resourced threat actors can engineer a successful adversarial attack against a modern open-source ALPR system. We introduce the Street-legal Physical Adversarial Rim (SPAR), a physically realizable white-box attack against the popular ALPR system fast-alpr. SPAR requires no access to ALPR infrastructure during attack deployment and does not alter or obscure the attacker's license plate. Based on prior legislation and case law, we argue that SPAR is street-legal in the state of Texas. Under optimal conditions, SPAR reduces ALPR accuracy by 60% and achieves an 18% targeted impersonation rate. SPAR can be produced for under $100, and it was implemented entirely by commercial agentic coding assistants. These results highlight practical vulnerabilities in modern ALPR systems under realistic physical-world conditions and suggest new directions for both attack and defense.
tldr: This paper introduces a physically realizable, street-legal adversarial attack against Automatic License Plate Reader (ALPR) systems, demonstrating its effectiveness in reducing accuracy and enabling targeted impersonation at low cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种物理上可实现、符合道路法规的对抗性攻击，针对自动车牌识别系统，展示了其能有效降低识别精度并实现低成本的目标伪装。
summary_zh: 自动车牌识别系统被广泛部署用于车辆识别与追踪。尽管已有研究揭示了该系统的安全漏洞，但其合法性与现实物理世界的可行性却鲜有关注。本研究探讨了资源有限的威胁行为者是否能够针对现代开源自动车牌识别系统实施有效的对抗性攻击。我们提出了街道合法物理对抗性轮辋——一种针对主流车牌识别系统fast-alpr的可物理实现的白盒攻击方法。该攻击在部署过程中无需访问车牌识别基础设施，且不改变或遮蔽攻击者车辆的真实车牌。基于现有立法与判例，我们认为该攻击在得克萨斯州具有街道合法性。在最优条件下，该攻击可使车牌识别准确率下降60%，并实现18%的定向冒充成功率。攻击成本低于100美元，且完全通过商业化智能编码助手实现。这些结果凸显了现代自动车牌识别系统在现实物理条件下存在的实际脆弱性，并为攻防双方的研究提供了新的方向。

title: PRISM: LLM-Guided Semantic Clustering for High-Precision Topics
summary: In this paper, we propose Precision-Informed Semantic Modeling (PRISM), a structured topic modeling framework combining the benefits of rich representations captured by LLMs with the low cost and interpretability of latent semantic clustering methods. PRISM fine-tunes a sentence encoding model using a sparse set of LLM- provided labels on samples drawn from some corpus of interest. We segment this embedding space with thresholded clustering, yielding clusters that separate closely related topics within some narrow domain. Across multiple corpora, PRISM improves topic separability over state-of-the-art local topic models and even over clustering on large, frontier embedding models while requiring only a small number of LLM queries to train. This work contributes to several research streams by providing (i) a student-teacher pipeline to distill sparse LLM supervision into a lightweight model for topic discovery; (ii) an analysis of the efficacy of sampling strategies to improve local geometry for cluster separability; and (iii) an effective approach for web-scale text analysis, enabling researchers and practitioners to track nuanced claims and subtopics online with an interpretable, locally deployable framework.
tldr: PRISM is a topic modeling method that uses a few LLM-generated labels to fine-tune a smaller sentence encoder, enabling precise, low-cost clustering of text on specialized topics.
tldr_zh: PRISM是一种主题建模方法，它使用少量LLM生成的标签来微调一个较小的句子编码器，从而实现低成本、高精度的专业文本主题聚类。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种精确信息语义建模（PRISM）框架，这是一种结合了大型语言模型（LLM）所捕获的丰富表征优势与潜在语义聚类方法的低成本、高可解释性的结构化主题建模框架。PRISM首先在目标语料库中抽取样本，利用少量LLM生成的标签对句子编码模型进行微调。通过设定阈值的聚类方法对嵌入空间进行划分，该框架能够在特定狭窄领域内分离高度相关的主题。在多个语料库的测试中，PRISM相较于最先进的局部主题模型，甚至相较于基于前沿大型嵌入模型的聚类方法，均实现了更优的主题分离效果，且仅需少量LLM查询即可完成训练。本研究的贡献包括：（1）提出一种师生蒸馏框架，将稀疏的LLM监督知识提炼为轻量级主题发现模型；（2）分析了采样策略对提升局部几何结构以增强聚类分离度的有效性；（3）提供了一套适用于网络规模文本分析的高效方案，使研究者和实践者能够通过可解释、可本地部署的框架在线追踪细微观点与子主题。

title: Characterization of Gaussian Universality Breakdown in High-Dimensional Empirical Risk Minimization
summary: We study high-dimensional convex empirical risk minimization (ERM) under general non-Gaussian data designs. By heuristically extending the Convex Gaussian Min-Max Theorem (CGMT) to non-Gaussian settings, we derive an asymptotic min-max characterization of key statistics, enabling approximation of the mean $μ_{\hatθ}$ and covariance $C_{\hatθ}$ of the ERM estimator $\hatθ$. Specifically, under a concentration assumption on the data matrix and standard regularity conditions on the loss and regularizer, we show that for a test covariate $x$ independent of the training data, the projection $\hatθ^\top x$ approximately follows the convolution of the (generally non-Gaussian) distribution of $μ_{\hatθ}^\top x$ with an independent centered Gaussian variable of variance $\text{Tr}(C_{\hatθ}\mathbb{E}[xx^\top])$. This result clarifies the scope and limits of Gaussian universality for ERMs. Additionally, we prove that any $\mathcal{C}^2$ regularizer is asymptotically equivalent to a quadratic form determined solely by its Hessian at zero and gradient at $μ_{\hatθ}$. Numerical simulations across diverse losses and models are provided to validate our theoretical predictions and qualitative insights.
tldr: This paper theoretically analyzes the breakdown of Gaussian universality in high-dimensional convex empirical risk minimization (ERM), deriving an asymptotic characterization of estimator statistics for non-Gaussian data designs.
tldr_zh: 本文理论分析了高维凸经验风险最小化中高斯普适性失效的情况，在非高斯数据设计下推导了估计量统计量的渐近特征。
summary_zh: 本文研究一般非高斯数据设计下的高维凸经验风险最小化问题。通过启发式地将凸高斯极小极大定理拓展至非高斯设定，我们推导出关键统计量的渐近极小极大刻画，从而实现对经验风险最小化估计量$\hatθ$的均值$μ_{\hatθ}$与协方差$C_{\hatθ}$的近似。具体而言，在数据矩阵满足集中性假设且损失函数与正则项满足标准正则性条件下，我们证明：对于独立于训练数据的测试协变量$x$，其投影$\hatθ^\top x$近似服从$μ_{\hatθ}^\top x$（通常为非高斯分布）与方差为$\text{Tr}(C_{\hatθ}\mathbb{E}[xx^\top])$的独立中心高斯变量的卷积分布。该结果明确了经验风险最小化中高斯普适性的适用范围与局限性。此外，我们证明任意二阶连续可微正则项均渐近等价于仅由其零点的海森矩阵和在$μ_{\hatθ}$处的梯度所确定的二次型。通过多种损失函数与模型的数值模拟，验证了理论预测与定性结论的有效性。

title: Self-Distilled RLVR
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a popular training paradigm in the LLM community. This paradigm selects a larger model as the teacher to provide dense, fine-grained signals for each sampled trajectory, in contrast to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), which only obtains sparse signals from verifiable outcomes in the environment. Recently, the community has explored on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where the same model serves as both teacher and student, with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as reference answers to enable self-evolution. This paper demonstrates that learning signals solely derived from the privileged teacher result in severe information leakage and unstable long-term training. Accordingly, we identify the optimal niche for self-distillation and propose \textbf{RLSD} (\textbf{RL}VR with \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{D}istillation). Specifically, we leverage self-distillation to obtain token-level policy differences for determining fine-grained update magnitudes, while continuing to use RLVR to derive reliable update directions from environmental feedback (e.g., response correctness). This enables RLSD to simultaneously harness the strengths of both RLVR and OPSD, achieving a higher convergence ceiling and superior training stability.
tldr: This paper proposes RLSD, a method that combines self-distillation with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards to improve training stability and convergence for language models, but it does not explicitly address robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为RLSD的方法，将自我蒸馏与基于可验证奖励的强化学习相结合，以提升语言模型的训练稳定性和收敛性，但未明确涉及机器人或具身人工智能。
summary_zh: 策略蒸馏已成为大语言模型领域一种主流的训练范式。与依靠可验证奖励的强化学习仅从环境中的可验证结果获取稀疏信号不同，该范式选取一个更大的模型作为教师，为每个采样轨迹提供密集的细粒度信号。最近，学界探索了策略自蒸馏方法，即同一模型同时扮演教师和学生的角色，其中教师模型获得额外特权信息（如参考答案）以实现自我进化。本文指出，仅从特权教师模型导出的学习信号会导致严重的信息泄露和长期训练的不稳定性。为此，我们确定了自蒸馏的最佳应用场景，并提出了 \textbf{RLSD}（基于自蒸馏的强化学习验证奖励）。具体而言，我们利用自蒸馏获取词元级的策略差异以确定细粒度的更新幅度，同时继续使用强化学习验证奖励从环境反馈（如回答正确性）中获取可靠的更新方向。这使得 RLSD 能够同时结合强化学习验证奖励和策略自蒸馏的优势，达到更高的收敛上限和更优的训练稳定性。

title: SkillRT: Compiling Skills for Efficient Execution Everywhere
summary:
LLM agents increasingly adopt skills as a reusable unit of composition. While skills are shared across diverse agent platforms, current systems treat them as raw context, causing the same skill to behave inconsistently for different agents. This fragility undermines skill portability and execution efficiency.
  To address this challenge, we analyze 118,000 skills and draw inspiration from traditional compiler design. We treat skills as code and LLMs as heterogeneous processors. To make portability actionable, we decompose a skill's requirements into a set of primitive capabilities, and measure how well each model-harness pair supports them. Based on these capability profiles, we propose SkillRT, a compilation and runtime system designed for portable and efficient skill execution. At compile time, SkillRT performs capability-based compilation, environment binding, and concurrency extraction. At runtime, SkillRT applies JIT code solidification and adaptive recompilation for performance optimization.
  We evaluate SkillRT across eight LLMs of varying scales and three agent harnesses, covering SkillsBench and representative skill tasks. Results demonstrate that SkillRT significantly improves task completion rates across different models and environments while reducing token consumption by up to 40%. In terms of performance, SkillRT achieves up to 3.2x speedup with enhanced parallelism, and 19-50x latency reduction through code solidification.
tldr: SkillRT is a compilation and runtime system that treats LLM-based agent skills as code, compiling them for portable and efficient execution across different models and environments, improving completion rates and reducing token usage.
tldr_zh: SkillRT是一个将LLM智能体技能视为代码的编译和运行时系统，旨在跨不同模型和环境实现可移植且高效的技能执行，提高了任务完成率并减少了令牌消耗。
summary_zh:
LLM智能体越来越多地将技能视为可复用的组合单元。尽管技能在不同智能体平台间共享，现有系统却将其视为原始上下文处理，导致同一技能在不同智能体上表现不一致。这种脆弱性损害了技能的可移植性和执行效率。

为解决这一挑战，我们分析了118,000个技能，并从传统编译器设计中获得启发。我们将技能视为代码，将LLM视为异构处理器。为实现可移植性，我们将技能需求解构为一组基础能力，并评估每种模型-架构组合对这些能力的支持程度。基于这些能力画像，我们提出了SkillRT——一个专为可移植、高效技能执行设计的编译与运行时系统。在编译阶段，SkillRT执行基于能力的编译、环境绑定和并发提取；在运行时，则通过即时代码固化与自适应重编译实现性能优化。

我们在八种不同规模的LLM和三种智能体架构上评估SkillRT，覆盖SkillsBench和代表性技能任务。实验结果表明，SkillRT能显著提升不同模型和环境下的任务完成率，同时降低高达40%的令牌消耗。在性能方面，SkillRT通过增强并行性实现了最高3.2倍的加速，并通过代码固化将延迟降低19-50倍。

title: A semicontinuous relaxation of Saito's criterion and freeness as angular minimization
summary:
We introduce a nonnegative functional on the space of line arrangements in $\mathbb{P}^2$ that vanishes precisely on free arrangements, obtained as a semicontinuous relaxation of Saito's criterion for freeness. Given an arrangement $\mathcal{A}$ of $n$ lines with candidate exponents $(d_1, d_2)$, we parameterize the spaces of logarithmic derivations of degrees $d_1$ and $d_2$ via the null spaces of the associated derivation matrices and express the Saito determinant as a bilinear map into the space of degree $n$ polynomials. The functional then admits a natural geometric interpretation: it measures the squared sine of the angle between the image of this bilinear map and the direction of the defining polynomial $Q(\mathcal{A})$ in coefficient space, and equals zero if and only if its image contains the line spanned by $Q(\mathcal{A})$. This provides a computable measure of how far a given arrangement is from admitting a free basis of logarithmic derivations of the expected degrees.
  Using this functional as a reward signal, we develop a sequential construction procedure in which lines are added one at a time so as to minimize the angular distance to freeness, implemented via reinforcement learning with an adaptive curriculum over arrangement sizes and exponent types.
  Our results suggest that semicontinuous relaxation techniques, grounded in the geometry of polynomial coefficient spaces, offer a viable approach to the computational exploration of freeness in the theory of line arrangements.
tldr: This paper introduces a nonnegative functional on line arrangements in projective space that measures deviation from freeness, interpreted as minimizing an angle in coefficient space, and uses reinforcement learning to sequentially construct arrangements that minimize this angle.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了一个在投影空间中线排列上的非负函数，用于衡量偏离自由度的情况，可解释为在系数空间中最小化一个角度，并利用强化学习来顺序构建最小化该角度的排列。
summary_zh:
我们在射影平面 $\mathbb{P}^2$ 的直线构型空间上引入一个非负泛函，该泛函恰好为零时对应于自由构型，它是通过半连续松弛Saito自由性准则而得到的。给定一个由 $n$ 条直线构成的构型 $\mathcal{A}$，其候选指数为 $(d_1, d_2)$，我们通过相关导数矩阵的零空间参数化了 $d_1$ 和 $d_2$ 次数的对数导子空间，并将Saito行列式表示为到 $n$ 次多项式空间的双线性映射。该泛函由此获得一个自然的几何解释：它测量了该双线性映射的像与系数空间中由定义多项式 $Q(\mathcal{A})$ 张成的直线方向之间的夹角的正弦平方值，当且仅当该像包含 $Q(\mathcal{A})$ 张成的直线时，该泛函为零。这为度量给定构型距离存在预期次数的对数导子自由基有多远，提供了一个可计算的指标。

以该泛函作为奖励信号，我们开发了一种顺序构造方法，每次添加一条直线，以最小化与自由性之间的角度距离。该方法通过强化学习实现，并针对构型规模与指数类型设计了自适应课程。

我们的结果表明，基于多项式系数空间几何的半连续松弛技术，为直线构型理论中自由性的计算探索提供了一种可行的途径。

title: Explainable Machine Learning Reveals 12-Fold Ucp1 Upregulation and Thermogenic Reprogramming in Female Mouse White Adipose Tissue After 37 Days of Microgravity: First AI/ML Analysis of NASA OSD-970
summary: Microgravity induces profound metabolic adaptations in mammalian physiology, yet the molecular mechanisms governing thermogenesis in female white adipose tissue (WAT) remain poorly characterized. This paper presents the first machine learning (ML) analysis of NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) dataset OSD-970, derived from the Rodent Research-1 (RR-1) mission. Using RT-qPCR data from 89 adipogenesis and thermogenesis pathway genes in gonadal WAT of 16 female C57BL/6J mice (8 flight, 8 ground control) following 37 days aboard the International Space Station (ISS), we applied differential expression analysis, multiple ML classifiers with Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV), and Explainable AI via SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). The most striking finding is a dramatic 12.21-fold upregulation of Ucp1 (Delta-Delta-Ct = -3.61, p = 0.0167) in microgravity-exposed WAT, accompanied by significant activation of the thermogenesis pathway (mean pathway fold-change = 3.24). The best-performing model (Random Forest with top-20 features) achieved AUC = 0.922, Accuracy = 0.812, and F1 = 0.824 via LOO-CV. SHAP analysis consistently ranked Ucp1 among the top predictive features, while Angpt2, Irs2, Jun, and Klf-family transcription factors emerged as dominant consensus classifiers. Principal component analysis (PCA) revealed clear separation between flight and ground samples, with PC1 explaining 69.1% of variance. These results suggest rapid thermogenic reprogramming in female WAT as a compensatory response to microgravity. This study demonstrates the power of explainable AI for re-analysis of newly released NASA space biology datasets, with direct implications for female astronaut health on long-duration missions and for Earth-based obesity and metabolic disease research.
tldr: This paper presents a machine learning analysis of NASA space biology data, revealing a 12-fold upregulation of the Ucp1 gene and thermogenic reprogramming in female mouse white adipose tissue after 37 days of microgravity. It uses explainable AI to identify key biomarkers, with direct implications for astronaut health and metabolic disease research, but has no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文对NASA太空生物学数据进行了机器学习分析，揭示了雌性小鼠白色脂肪组织在37天微重力暴露后Ucp1基因上调12倍及产热重编程现象。研究使用可解释AI识别关键生物标志物，对航天员健康和代谢疾病研究有直接意义，但与机器人学或具身AI无关。
summary_zh: 微重力环境会引发哺乳动物生理的深刻代谢适应，然而关于雌性白色脂肪组织（WAT）中产热作用的分子机制仍知之甚少。本研究首次利用机器学习（ML）方法对来自“啮齿动物研究-1”（RR-1）任务的NASA开放科学数据仓库（OSDR）数据集OSD-970进行了分析。基于国际空间站（ISS）上37天生活后16只雌性C57BL/6J小鼠（8只飞行组，8只地面对照组）性腺WAT中89个脂肪生成及产热通路基因的RT-qPCR数据，我们采用了差异表达分析、结合留一交叉验证（LOO-CV）的多种ML分类器以及通过SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）的可解释人工智能方法。最显著的发现是：暴露于微重力的WAT中Ucp1基因表达量出现12.21倍的剧烈上调（ΔΔCt = -3.61，p = 0.0167），同时产热通路被显著激活（通路平均倍数变化=3.24）。性能最优的模型（基于前20个特征的随机森林）通过LOO-CV实现了AUC = 0.922、准确率 = 0.812和F1分数 = 0.824。SHAP分析一致将Ucp1列为最具预测性的特征之一，而Angpt2、Irs2、Jun及Klf家族转录因子则成为主导性的共识分类特征。主成分分析（PCA）显示飞行组与地面样本存在明显分离，其中第一主成分（PC1）解释了69.1%的方差。这些结果表明雌性WAT中存在快速的产热重编程现象，这是对微重力环境的代偿性反应。本研究证明了可解释人工智能在重新分析新发布的NASA空间生物学数据集方面的强大能力，对长期航天任务中女性宇航员的健康以及地面肥胖与代谢疾病研究具有直接意义。

title: Towards Near-Real-Time Telemetry-Aware Routing with Neural Routing Algorithms
summary: Routing algorithms are crucial for efficient computer network operations, and in many settings they must be able to react to traffic bursts within milliseconds. Live telemetry data can provide informative signals to routing algorithms, and recent work has trained neural networks to exploit such signals for traffic-aware routing. Yet, aggregating network-wide information is subject to communication delays, and existing neural approaches either assume unrealistic delay-free global states, or restrict routers to purely local telemetry. This leaves their deployability in real-world environments unclear. We cast telemetry-aware routing as a delay-aware closed-loop control problem and introduce a framework that trains and evaluates neural routing algorithms, while explicitly modeling communication and inference delays. On top of this framework, we propose LOGGIA, a scalable graph neural routing algorithm that predicts log-space link weights from attributed topology-and-telemetry graphs. It utilizes a data-driven pre-training stage, followed by on-policy Reinforcement Learning. Across synthetic and real network topologies, and unseen mixed TCP/UDP traffic sequences, LOGGIA consistently outperforms shortest-path baselines, whereas neural baselines fail once realistic delays are enforced. Our experiments further suggest that neural routing algorithms like LOGGIA perform best when deployed fully locally, i.e., observing network states and inferring actions at every router individually, as opposed to centralized decision making.
tldr: This paper proposes LOGGIA, a neural network-based routing algorithm for computer networks, using a data-driven pre-training and on-policy Reinforcement Learning framework to handle network telemetry with realistic communication delays.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LOGGIA，一种基于神经网络的计算机网络路由算法，它使用数据驱动的预训练和在线策略强化学习框架来处理具有实际通信延迟的网络遥测数据。
summary_zh: 路由算法对计算机网络的效率至关重要，在许多应用场景中，它们必须能够在毫秒级内应对突发流量。实时遥测数据能够为路由算法提供有效信号，近期研究已通过训练神经网络来利用此类信号实现流量感知路由。然而，全网信息的汇聚存在通信延迟问题，现有神经路由方法要么假设不切实际的零延迟全局状态，要么将路由器局限于纯本地遥测数据，这导致其在真实环境中的部署可行性存疑。本文将遥测感知路由建模为延迟感知的闭环控制问题，提出了一个在显式建模通信与推理延迟条件下训练和评估神经路由算法的框架。基于此框架，我们提出LOGGIA——一种可扩展的图神经路由算法，该算法能够从带属性的拓扑-遥测图中预测对数空间链路权重。它采用数据驱动的预训练阶段，继而通过策略强化学习进行优化。在合成与真实网络拓扑结构及未见的混合TCP/UDP流量序列测试中，LOGGIA始终优于最短路径基准算法，而其他神经基准算法在引入真实延迟约束后均失效。我们的实验进一步表明，像LOGGIA这样的神经路由算法在全本地部署模式下表现最佳——即在每个路由器上独立观测网络状态并执行推理决策，而非采用集中式决策机制。

title: Efficient Logistic Regression with Mixture of Sigmoids
summary: This paper studies the Exponential Weights (EW) algorithm with an isotropic Gaussian prior for online logistic regression. We show that the near-optimal worst-case regret bound $O(d\log(Bn))$ for EW, established by Kakade and Ng (2005) against the best linear predictor of norm at most $B$, can be achieved with total worst-case computational complexity $O(B^3 n^5)$. This substantially improves on the $O(B^{18}n^{37})$ complexity of prior work achieving the same guarantee (Foster et al., 2018). Beyond efficiency, we analyze the large-$B$ regime under linear separability: after rescaling by $B$, the EW posterior converges as $B\to\infty$ to a standard Gaussian truncated to the version cone. Accordingly, the predictor converges to a solid-angle vote over separating directions and, on every fixed-margin slice of this cone, the mode of the corresponding truncated Gaussian is aligned with the hard-margin SVM direction. Using this geometry, we derive non-asymptotic regret bounds showing that once $B$ exceeds a margin-dependent threshold, the regret becomes independent of $B$ and grows only logarithmically with the inverse margin. Overall, our results show that EW can be both computationally tractable and geometrically adaptive in online classification.
tldr: This paper presents a more efficient algorithm for online logistic regression, achieving near-optimal regret bounds with significantly lower computational complexity and providing geometric insights into the Exponential Weights algorithm under linear separability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种更高效的在线逻辑回归算法，以显著降低的计算复杂度实现了接近最优的遗憾界，并在线性可分条件下对指数权重算法的几何性质提供了深入分析。
summary_zh: 本文研究了各向同性高斯先验下的指数加权（EW）算法在在线逻辑回归中的应用。我们证明，EW算法针对范数至多为$B$的最优线性预测器，能够达到接近最优的最坏情况遗憾界$O(d\log(Bn))$（Kakade与Ng于2005年建立），且其总最坏情况计算复杂度为$O(B^3 n^5)$。这显著改进了先前实现相同性能保证（Foster等，2018）所需的$O(B^{18}n^{37})$复杂度。除效率提升外，我们在线性可分条件下分析了EW在$B$较大时的行为：经过$B$的尺度缩放后，当$B\to\infty$时，EW的后验分布收敛到被版本锥截断的标准高斯分布。相应地，预测器会收敛为对分离方向的立体角投票，且在该锥的每个固定边际切片上，对应截断高斯分布的众数均与硬边际支持向量机方向对齐。基于此几何结构，我们推导出非渐近遗憾界，表明当$B$超过依赖边际的阈值后，遗憾将与$B$无关，并仅随边际倒数的对数增长。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，EW算法在在线分类任务中既能保持计算可行性，又能实现几何自适应性。

title: Toward an Operational GNN-Based Multimesh Surrogate for Fast Flood Forecasting
summary: Operational flood forecasting still relies on high-fidelity two-dimensional hydraulic solvers, but their runtime can be prohibitive for rapid decision support on large urban floodplains. In parallel, AI-based surrogate models have shown strong potential in several areas of computational physics for accelerating otherwise expensive high-fidelity simulations. We address this issue on the lower Têt River (France), starting from a production-grade Telemac2D model defined on a high-resolution unstructured finite-element mesh with more than $4\times 10^5$ nodes. From this setup, we build a learning-ready database of synthetic but operationally grounded flood events covering several representative hydrograph families and peak discharges. On top of this database, we develop a graph-neural surrogate based on projected meshes and multimesh connectivity. The projected-mesh strategy keeps training tractable while preserving high-fidelity supervision from the original Telemac simulations, and the multimesh construction enlarges the effective spatial receptive field without increasing network depth. We further study the effect of an explicit discharge feature $Q(t)$ and of pushforward training for long autoregressive rollouts. The experiments show that conditioning on $Q(t)$ is essential in this boundary-driven setting, that multimesh connectivity brings additional gains once the model is properly conditioned, and that pushforward further improves rollout stability. Among the tested configurations, the combination of $Q(t)$, multimesh connectivity, and pushforward provides the best overall results. These gains are observed both on hydraulic variables over the surrogate mesh and on inundation maps interpolated onto a common $25\,\mathrm{m}$ regular grid and compared against the original high-resolution Telemac solution. On the studied case, the learned surrogate produces 6-hour predictions in about $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, compared with about $180\,\mathrm{min}$ on 56 CPU cores for the reference simulation. These results support graph-based surrogates as practical complements to industrial hydraulic solvers for operational flood mapping.
tldr: This paper proposes a graph neural network (GNN) surrogate model to accelerate high-fidelity flood forecasting simulations, focusing on a specific river case study with performance comparisons against a traditional solver.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的代理模型，用于加速高保真度洪水预测模拟，以一个特定河流案例研究为重点，并与传统求解器进行了性能对比。
summary_zh:
摘要：
业务化洪水预报仍依赖于高精度二维水力学求解器，但其运行时间对于大型城市洪泛区的快速决策支持而言往往过长。与此同时，基于人工智能的代理模型在计算物理学的多个领域已展现出加速昂贵高精度模拟的巨大潜力。本研究以法国下泰特河为案例，从一个生产级Telemac2D模型出发，该模型构建于包含超过$4\times 10^5$个节点的高分辨率非结构化有限元网格上。基于此框架，我们构建了一个涵盖多种典型水文过程线类型及峰值流量的合成洪水事件数据库，这些数据既具可学习性又立足于业务实际。在此基础上，我们开发了一种基于投影网格与多网格连接结构的图神经网络代理模型。投影网格策略在保持原始Telemac模拟高精度监督的同时确保了训练可行性，而多网格结构则在不增加网络深度的前提下扩展了有效空间感受野。我们进一步研究了显式流量特征$Q(t)$及前推训练对长期自回归推演的影响。实验表明：在此边界驱动场景中，流量特征$Q(t)$的条件化至关重要；模型经过适当条件化后，多网格连接能带来额外增益；而前推训练则可进一步提升推演稳定性。在测试配置中，结合$Q(t)$、多网格连接与前推训练的方案取得了最佳综合性能。这些优势既体现在代理网格的水力变量上，也反映在插值至通用$25\,\mathrm{m}$规则网格的淹没图与原始高分辨率Telemac解的对比中。在本研究案例中，训练完成的代理模型在单张NVIDIA A100 GPU上仅需约$0.4\,\mathrm{s}$即可生成6小时预测，而同等条件下参考模拟在56个CPU核心上需耗时约$180\,\mathrm{min}$。这些结果证实了基于图的代理模型可作为工业水力学求解器在业务化洪水制图中的实用补充工具。

title: Understanding Latent Diffusability via Fisher Geometry
summary: Diffusion models often degrade when trained in latent spaces (e.g., VAEs), yet the formal causes remain poorly understood. We quantify latent-space diffusability through the rate of change of the Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) along the diffusion trajectory. Our framework decomposes this MMSE rate into contributions from Fisher Information (FI) and Fisher Information Rate (FIR). We demonstrate that while global isometry ensures FI alignment, FIR is governed by the encoder's local geometric properties. Our analysis explicitly decouples latent geometric distortion into three measurable penalties: dimensional compression, tangential distortion, and curvature injection. We derive theoretical conditions for FIR preservation across spaces, ensuring maintained diffusability. Experiments across diverse autoencoding architectures validate our framework and establish these efficient FI and FIR metrics as a robust diagnostic suite for identifying and mitigating latent diffusion failure.
tldr: This paper analyzes why diffusion models perform poorly in latent spaces, introducing a framework using Fisher Information metrics to measure and decompose geometric distortions that cause degradation.
tldr_zh: 本文分析扩散模型在潜在空间中表现不佳的原因，引入一个使用费舍尔信息度量的框架，以衡量和分解导致性能下降的几何失真。
summary_zh: 扩散模型在潜在空间（如变分自编码器）中训练时性能往往下降，但其根本原因尚未得到充分理解。我们通过最小均方误差沿扩散轨迹的变化率来量化潜在空间的可扩散性。该框架将最小均方误差变化率分解为费希尔信息与费希尔信息变化率的贡献。研究表明，虽然全局等距性确保了费希尔信息对齐，但费希尔信息变化率由编码器的局部几何特性决定。我们的分析将潜在空间几何畸变显式解耦为三个可量化的惩罚项：维度压缩、切向畸变与曲率注入。我们推导了跨空间保持费希尔信息变化率的理论条件，从而确保可扩散性不变。在不同自编码架构上的实验验证了该框架的有效性，并证明这些高效的费希尔信息与费希尔信息变化率指标可作为识别与缓解潜在扩散失效的稳健诊断工具集。

title: Structure-Preserving Multi-View Embedding Using Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport
summary: Multi-view data analysis seeks to integrate multiple representations of the same samples in order to recover a coherent low-dimensional structure. Classical approaches often rely on feature concatenation or explicit alignment assumptions, which become restrictive under heterogeneous geometries or nonlinear distortions. In this work, we propose two geometry-aware multi-view embedding strategies grounded in Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) optimal transport. The first, termed Mean-GWMDS, aggregates view-specific relational information by averaging distance matrices and applying GW-based multidimensional scaling to obtain a representative embedding. The second strategy, referred to as Multi-GWMDS, adopts a selection-based paradigm in which multiple geometry-consistent candidate embeddings are generated via GW-based alignment and a representative embedding is selected. Experiments on synthetic manifolds and real-world datasets show that the proposed methods effectively preserve intrinsic relational structure across views. These results highlight GW-based approaches as a flexible and principled framework for multi-view representation learning.
tldr: This paper proposes two multi-view embedding methods based on Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport for integrating heterogeneous data representations while preserving intrinsic relational structure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了两种基于Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输的多视图嵌入方法，用于整合异构数据表示并保持其内在的关联结构。
summary_zh:
摘要：
多视图数据分析旨在整合同一样本的多种表示形式，以恢复一致的低维结构。传统方法通常依赖于特征拼接或显式对齐假设，这在异构几何或非线性失真条件下具有局限性。本研究基于格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦最优传输理论，提出了两种几何感知的多视图嵌入策略。第一种策略称为Mean-GWMDS，通过平均距离矩阵聚合视图特定的关系信息，并应用基于GW的多维标度分析来获得代表性嵌入。第二种策略命名为Multi-GWMDS，采用基于选择的范式：通过GW对齐生成多个几何一致的候选嵌入，进而选取代表性嵌入。在合成流形和真实数据集上的实验表明，所提方法能有效保持跨视图的内在关系结构。这些结果验证了基于GW的方法可作为多视图表示学习中灵活且具有理论依据的框架。

title: WGFINNs: Weak formulation-based GENERIC formalism informed neural networks'
summary: Data-driven discovery of governing equations from noisy observations remains a fundamental challenge in scientific machine learning. While GENERIC formalism informed neural networks (GFINNs) provide a principled framework that enforces the laws of thermodynamics by construction, their reliance on strong-form loss formulations makes them highly sensitive to measurement noise. To address this limitation, we propose weak formulation-based GENERIC formalism informed neural networks (WGFINNs), which integrate the weak formulation of dynamical systems with the structure-preserving architecture of GFINNs. WGFINNs significantly enhance robustness to noisy data while retaining exact satisfaction of GENERIC degeneracy and symmetry conditions. We further incorporate a state-wise weighted loss and a residual-based attention mechanism to mitigate scale imbalance across state variables. Theoretical analysis contrasts quantitative differences between the strong-form and the weak-form estimators. Mainly, the strong-form estimator diverges as the time step decreases in the presence of noise, while the weak-form estimator can be accurate even with noisy data if test functions satisfy certain conditions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that WGFINNs consistently outperform GFINNs at varying noise levels, achieving more accurate predictions and reliable recovery of physical quantities.
tldr: This paper introduces a weak-formulation-based neural network method (WGFINNs) to robustly learn thermodynamic governing equations from noisy data, improving upon a prior strong-form method.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于弱形式表述的神经网络方法（WGFINNs），用于从噪声数据中鲁棒地学习热力学控制方程，改进了先前的强形式方法。
summary_zh: 基于噪声观测数据从数据驱动角度发现控制方程是科学机器学习领域的根本性挑战。尽管基于热力学基本方程形式（GENERIC）框架的神经网络（GFINNs）通过构造方式强制满足热力学定律，提供了具有理论依据的建模框架，但其对强形式损失函数的依赖导致模型对测量噪声极为敏感。为克服这一局限性，我们提出了基于弱形式表达的GENERIC框架神经网络（WGFINNs），该方法将动力学系统的弱形式表述与GFINNs的结构保持特性相结合。WGFINNs在保持精确满足GENERIC退化条件和对称条件的同时，显著增强了对噪声数据的鲁棒性。我们进一步引入状态变量加权损失函数和基于残差的注意力机制，以缓解不同状态变量间的尺度不平衡问题。理论分析对比了强形式估计量与弱形式估计量的量化差异：在噪声存在的情况下，强形式估计量会随时间步长的减小而发散，而弱形式估计量在测试函数满足特定条件时，即使面对噪声数据仍能保持准确性。数值实验表明，在不同噪声水平下，WGFINNs始终优于GFINNs，能够实现更精准的预测和更可靠的物理量恢复。

title: Financial Anomaly Detection for the Canadian Market
summary: In this work we evaluate the performance of three classes of methods for detecting financial anomalies: topological data analysis (TDA), principal component analyis (PCA), and Neural Network-based approaches. We apply these methods to the TSX-60 data to identify major financial stress events in the Canadian stock market. We show how neural network-based methods (such as GlocalKD and One-Shot GIN(E)) and TDA methods achieve the strongest performance. The effectiveness of TDA in detecting financial anomalies suggests that global topological properties are meaningful in distinguishing financial stress events.
tldr: This paper applies topological data analysis, principal component analysis, and neural network methods to detect financial anomalies in the Canadian stock market, finding that neural network and TDA approaches perform best.
tldr_zh: 本文应用拓扑数据分析、主成分分析和神经网络方法检测加拿大股市的金融异常，发现神经网络和TDA方法效果最好。
summary_zh: 本研究评估了三类金融异常检测方法的性能：拓扑数据分析（TDA）、主成分分析（PCA）以及基于神经网络的方法。我们将这些方法应用于TSX-60数据，以识别加拿大股票市场的主要金融压力事件。结果表明，基于神经网络的方法（如GlocalKD和One-Shot GIN(E)）与TDA方法均展现出最优异的检测性能。TDA在金融异常检测中的有效性表明，全局拓扑属性对于区分金融压力事件具有显著意义。

title: A Spectral Framework for Multi-Scale Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction
summary: Dimensionality reduction (DR) is characterized by two longstanding trade-offs. First, there is a global-local preservation tension: methods such as t-SNE and UMAP prioritize local neighborhood preservation, yet may distort global manifold structure, while methods such as Laplacian Eigenmaps preserve global geometry but often yield limited local separation. Second, there is a gap between expressiveness and analytical transparency: many nonlinear DR methods produce embeddings without an explicit connection to the underlying high-dimensional structure, limiting insight into the embedding process. In this paper, we introduce a spectral framework for nonlinear DR that addresses these challenges. Our approach embeds high-dimensional data using a spectral basis combined with cross-entropy optimization, enabling multi-scale representations that bridge global and local structure. Leveraging linear spectral decomposition, the framework further supports analysis of embeddings through a graph-frequency perspective, enabling examination of how spectral modes influence the resulting embedding. We complement this analysis with glyph-based scatterplot augmentations for visual exploration. Quantitative evaluations and case studies demonstrate that our framework improves manifold continuity while enabling deeper analysis of embedding structure through spectral mode contributions.
tldr: This paper introduces a spectral framework for nonlinear dimensionality reduction that aims to bridge the global-local preservation trade-off and provide analytical transparency through a graph-frequency perspective.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种非线性降维的谱框架，旨在通过图频视角解决全局-局部保持的权衡，并提供分析透明度。
summary_zh: 降维技术始终面临两个长期存在的权衡问题。首先，全局与局部结构保持存在张力：以t-SNE和UMAP为代表的方法侧重局部邻域结构的保持，但可能扭曲全局流形结构；而拉普拉斯特征映射等方法虽能保持全局几何特征，却往往导致局部结构分离度不足。其次，表达能力与分析透明度之间存在鸿沟：许多非线性降维方法生成的嵌入表示与高维原始结构缺乏显式关联，限制了对嵌入过程的深入理解。本文提出一种面向非线性降维的谱框架以应对这些挑战。该方法通过谱基与交叉熵优化相结合的方式嵌入高维数据，构建出衔接全局与局部结构的跨尺度表征。借助线性谱分解特性，该框架进一步支持通过图频视角分析嵌入表示，从而能够考察不同谱模态对最终嵌入结果的影响。我们还辅以基于符号的散点图增强技术以支持可视化探索。定量评估与案例研究表明，该框架在提升流形连续性的同时，通过谱模态贡献分析实现了对嵌入结构更深入的解析。

title: AQVolt26: High-Temperature r$^2$SCAN Halide Dataset for Universal ML Potentials and Solid-State Batteries
summary: The demand for safe, high-energy-density batteries has spotlighted halide solid-state electrolytes, which offer the potential for enhanced ionic mobility, electrochemical stability, and interfacial deformability. Accelerating their discovery requires extensive molecular dynamics, which has been increasingly enabled by universal machine learning interatomic potentials trained on foundational datasets. However, the dynamic softness of halides poses a stringent test of whether general-purpose models can reliably replace first-principles calculations under the highly distorted, elevated-temperature regimes necessary to probe ion transport. Here, we present AQVolt26, a dataset of 322,656 r$^2$SCAN single-point calculations for lithium halides, generated via high-temperature configurational sampling across $\sim$5K structures. We demonstrate that foundational datasets provide a strong baseline for stable halide chemistries and transfer local forces well, however absolute energy predictions degrade in distorted higher-temperature regimes. Co-training with AQVolt26 resolves this blind spot. Furthermore, incorporating Materials Project relaxation data improves near-equilibrium performance but degrades extreme-strain robustness without enhancing high-temperature force accuracy. These results demonstrate that domain-specific configurational sampling is essential for the reliable dynamic screening of halide electrolytes. Furthermore, our findings suggest that while foundational models provide a robust base, they are most effective for dynamically soft solid-state chemistries when augmented with targeted, high-temperature data. Finally, we show that near-equilibrium relaxation data serves as a task-specific complement rather than a universally beneficial addition.
tldr: The paper introduces AQVolt26, a high-temperature dataset for machine learning interatomic potentials to accelerate the discovery of halide solid-state electrolytes for batteries. It demonstrates that domain-specific data is essential for accurate dynamic screening of these materials, especially under extreme conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AQVolt26数据集，用于机器学习原子间势能，以加速固态卤化物电解质电池的发现。研究表明，在极端条件下，领域特定的数据对于材料的动态筛选至关重要。
summary_zh: 对安全、高能量密度电池的需求，使卤化物固态电解质备受关注，因其具有提升离子迁移率、电化学稳定性和界面可变形性的潜力。加速其发现过程需要广泛依赖分子动力学模拟，而基于基础数据集训练的通用机器学习原子间势能模型正日益成为实现这一目标的关键工具。然而，卤化物体系的动态软性对这一方法提出了严峻考验：在探究离子输运所必需的高畸变、高温条件下，通用模型能否可靠地替代第一性原理计算？本研究构建了AQVolt26数据集，包含通过对约5K种结构进行高温构型采样获得的322,656个r$^2$SCAN单点计算结果，涵盖多种锂卤化物。研究发现，基础数据集为稳定卤化物体系提供了可靠的基准，并能较好预测局部作用力，但在畸变的高温条件下其绝对能量预测精度显著下降。通过与AQVolt26数据进行联合训练，可有效弥补这一缺陷。此外，引入Materials Project弛豫数据虽能提升近平衡态性能，却会削弱极端应变下的鲁棒性，且无法改善高温条件下的力场预测精度。这些结果表明，针对特定领域的构型采样对卤化物电解质的可靠动态筛选至关重要。研究进一步指出，基础模型虽能提供坚实基础，但只有在融合针对性高温数据后，才能在对动态软性固态化学体系的模拟中发挥最大效能。最后，我们证明近平衡态弛豫数据应作为特定任务的补充，而非普遍适用的增效手段。

title: Optimal Projection-Free Adaptive SGD for Matrix Optimization
summary: Recently, Jiang et al. [2026] developed Leon, a practical variant of One-sided Shampoo [Xie et al., 2025a, An et al., 2025] algorithm for online convex optimization, which does not require computing a costly quadratic projection at each iteration. Unfortunately, according to the existing analysis, Leon requires tuning an additional hyperparameter in its preconditioner and cannot achieve dimension-independent convergence guarantees for convex optimization problems beyond the bounded gradients assumption. In this paper, we resolve this issue by proving certain stability properties of Leon's preconditioner. Using our improved analysis, we show that tuning the extra hyperparameter can be avoided and, more importantly, develop the first practical variant of One-sided Shampoo with Nesterov acceleration, which does not require computing projections at each iteration. As a side contribution, we obtain improved dimension-independent rates in the non-smooth non-convex setting and develop a unified analysis of the proposed algorithm, which yields accelerated projection-free adaptive SGD with (block-)diagonal preconditioners.
tldr: This paper proposes a new, practical, and projection-free adaptive SGD algorithm for matrix optimization with improved convergence guarantees and Nesterov acceleration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的、实用的、无投影的自适应SGD算法，用于矩阵优化，具有改进的收敛性保证和Nesterov加速。
summary_zh: 近期，江等人[2026]开发了Leon算法，这是一种针对在线凸优化问题的One-sided Shampoo[Xie等人，2025a；An等人，2025]算法的实用变体，其无需在每次迭代中计算代价高昂的二次投影。然而，根据现有分析，Leon算法仍需在其预处理器中调整一个额外的超参数，且在超出有界梯度假设的凸优化问题中，无法获得与维度无关的收敛性保证。本文通过证明Leon预处理器具备的稳定性，解决了上述问题。利用改进后的分析，我们证明可以避免调整这一额外超参数，并进一步提出了首个结合Nesterov加速的One-sided Shampoo实用变体，该变体同样无需在每次迭代中计算投影。作为一项附带贡献，我们在非光滑非凸设定中获得了改进的与维度无关的收敛速率，并提出了对所提算法的统一分析框架，从而推导出具有（块）对角预处理器的加速无投影自适应随机梯度下降方法。

title: Causal-Audit: A Framework for Risk Assessment of Assumption Violations in Time-Series Causal Discovery
summary: Time-series causal discovery methods rely on assumptions such as stationarity, regular sampling, and bounded temporal dependence. When these assumptions are violated, structure learning can produce confident but misleading causal graphs without warning. We introduce Causal-Audit, a framework that formalizes assumption validation as calibrated risk assessment. The framework computes effect-size diagnostics across five assumption families (stationarity, irregularity, persistence, nonlinearity, and confounding proxies), aggregates them into four calibrated risk scores with uncertainty intervals, and applies an abstention-aware decision policy that recommends methods (e.g., PCMCI+, VAR-based Granger causality) only when evidence supports reliable inference. The semi-automatic diagnostic stage can also be used independently for structured assumption auditing in individual studies. Evaluation on a synthetic atlas of 500 data-generating processes (DGPs) spanning 10 violation families demonstrates well-calibrated risk scores (AUROC > 0.95), a 62% false positive reduction among recommended datasets, and 78% abstention on severe-violation cases. On 21 external evaluations from TimeGraph (18 categories) and CausalTime (3 domains), recommend-or-abstain decisions are consistent with benchmark specifications in all cases. An open-source implementation of our framework is available.
tldr: This paper presents a framework for assessing the risk of assumption violations in time-series causal discovery, offering calibrated diagnostics and recommendations for inference methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于评估时间序列因果发现中假设违反风险的框架，提供校准的诊断和对推理方法的推荐。
summary_zh: 时间序列因果发现方法依赖于平稳性、规则采样和时间依赖性有界等假设。当这些假设被违反时，结构学习可能产生自信但具有误导性的因果图，且不会发出警告。我们提出Causal-Audit框架，该框架将假设验证形式化为校准风险评估。该框架计算涵盖五大假设类别（平稳性、非规则性、持续性、非线性及混杂代理变量）的效应量诊断指标，将其聚合为四个带有不确定性区间的校准风险评分，并应用基于弃权感知的决策策略——仅在证据支持可靠推断时推荐相应方法（如PCMCI+、基于VAR的格兰杰因果检验）。其半自动诊断阶段也可独立用于单个研究中的结构化假设审核。在涵盖10类违反假设的500种数据生成过程合成图谱上的评估显示：该框架实现了良好校准的风险评分（AUROC>0.95），在推荐数据集上减少62%的假阳性结果，并对严重违反假设的情况保持78%的弃权率。在TimeGraph（18个类别）和CausalTime（3个领域）的21项外部评估中，推荐或弃权决策与所有案例的基准规范保持一致。本框架已提供开源实现。

title: VALOR: Value-Aware Revenue Uplift Modeling with Treatment-Gated Representation for B2B Sales
summary: B2B sales organizations must identify "persuadable" accounts within zero-inflated revenue distributions to optimize expensive human resource allocation. Standard uplift frameworks struggle with treatment signal collapse in high-dimensional spaces and a misalignment between regression calibration and the ranking of high-value "whales." We introduce VALOR (Value Aware Learning of Optimized (B2B) Revenue), a unified framework featuring a Treatment-Gated Sparse-Revenue Network that uses bilinear interaction to prevent causal signal collapse. The framework is optimized via a novel Cost-Sensitive Focal-ZILN objective that combines a focal mechanism for distributional robustness with a value-weighted ranking loss that scales penalties based on financial magnitude. To provide interpretability for high-touch sales programs, we further derive Robust ZILN-GBDT, a tree based variant utilizing a custom splitting criterion for uplift heterogeneity. Extensive evaluations confirm VALOR's dominance, achieving a 20% improvement in rankability over state-of-the-art methods on public benchmarks and delivering a validated 2.7x increase in incremental revenue per account in a rigorous 4-month production A/B test.
tldr: A novel method for B2B sales uplift modeling, combining a treatment-gated network and a value-weighted loss to better identify high-value, persuadable accounts.
tldr_zh: 一种用于B2B销售提升建模的新方法，结合了治疗门控网络和价值加权损失，以更好地识别高价值、可说服的客户。
summary_zh: B2B销售组织必须在零膨胀收入分布中识别"可说服"客户，以优化昂贵的人力资源配置。传统的增益模型在高维空间中面临处理信号崩溃问题，且回归校准与高价值"鲸鱼客户"的排序之间存在错位。我们提出VALOR（价值感知的优化收入学习）统一框架，其核心是采用双线性交互防止因果信号崩溃的处理门控稀疏收入网络。该框架通过新颖的成本敏感焦点零膨胀对数正态损失函数进行优化，该函数结合了用于分布鲁棒性的焦点机制与基于财务规模调整惩罚力度的价值加权排序损失。为提升高接触度销售项目的可解释性，我们进一步推导出鲁棒ZILN-GBDT——基于定制化分割准则以捕捉增益异质性的树模型变体。大量评估证实了VALOR的优越性，在公开基准测试中相比前沿方法的可排序性提升20%，并在为期四个月的严格生产环境A/B测试中实现单客户增量收入经验证的2.7倍增长。

title: Photonic convolutional neural network with pre-trained in-situ training
summary: Photonic computing is a computing paradigm which have great potential to overcome the energy bottlenecks of electronic von Neumann architecture. Throughput and power consumption are fundamental limitations of Complementary-metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) chips, therefore convolutional neural network (CNN) is revolutionising machine learning, computer vision and other image based applications. In this work, we propose and validate a fully photonic convolutional neural network (PCNN) that performs MNIST image classification entirely in the optical domain, achieving 94 percent test accuracy. Unlike existing architectures that rely on frequent in-between conversions from optical to electrical and back to optical (O/E/O), our system maintains coherent processing utilizing Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) meshes, wavelength-division multiplexed (WDM) pooling, and microring resonator-based nonlinearities. The max pooling unit is fully implemented on silicon photonics, which does not require opto-electrical or electrical conversions. To overcome the challenges of training physical phase shifter parameters, we introduce a hybrid training methodology deploying a mathematically exact differentiable digital twin for ex-situ backpropagation, followed by in-situ fine-tuning via Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (SPSA) algorithm. Our evaluation demonstrates significant robustness to thermal crosstalk (only 0.43 percent accuracy degradation at severe coupling) and achieves 100 to 242 times better energy efficiency than state-of-the-art electronic GPUs for single-image inference.
tldr: This paper proposes a fully photonic convolutional neural network (PCNN) for optical-domain MNIST image classification, using a hybrid training method for robustness and energy efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种全光子卷积神经网络，用于在光学域进行MNIST图像分类，采用混合训练方法，具有高鲁棒性和能效。
summary_zh: 光子计算是一种极具潜力的计算范式，能够有效克服传统电子冯·诺依曼架构的能耗瓶颈。互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）芯片的吞吐量与功耗存在根本性限制，而卷积神经网络（CNN）正深刻改变着机器学习、计算机视觉及其他图像应用的格局。本研究提出并验证了一种全光子卷积神经网络（PCNN），可在纯光学域内完成MNIST图像分类任务，测试准确率达到94%。与现有依赖频繁光电-电光（O/E/O）转换的架构不同，本系统基于马赫-曾德尔干涉仪（MZI）网络、波分复用（WDM）池化及微环谐振器非线性元件，实现了全相干光处理。其中最大池化单元完全通过硅基光子学实现，无需任何光电或电学转换。为克服物理移相器参数训练的难题，我们提出混合训练方法：通过数学可微数字孪生模型进行异位反向传播，再结合同步扰动随机逼近（SPSA）算法进行原位微调。实验评估表明，该系统对热串扰具有显著鲁棒性（强耦合条件下精度仅下降0.43%），且单图像推理能效比最先进的电子GPU提升100至242倍。

title: Understanding the Role of Hallucination in Reinforcement Post-Training of Multimodal Reasoning Models
summary: The recent success of reinforcement learning (RL) in large reasoning models has inspired the growing adoption of RL for post-training Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to enhance their visual reasoning capabilities. Although many studies have reported improved performance, it remains unclear whether RL training truly enables models to learn from visual information. In this work, we propose the Hallucination-as-Cue Framework, an analytical framework designed to investigate the effects of RL-based post-training on multimodal reasoning models from the perspective of model hallucination. Specifically, we introduce hallucination-inductive, modality-specific corruptions that remove or replace essential information required to derive correct answers, thereby forcing the model to reason by hallucination. By applying these corruptions during both training and evaluation, our framework provides a unique perspective for diagnosing RL training dynamics and understanding the intrinsic properties of datasets. Through extensive experiments and analyses across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks, we reveal that the role of model hallucination for RL-training is more significant than previously recognized. For instance, we find that RL post-training under purely hallucination-inductive settings can still significantly improve models' reasoning performance, and in some cases even outperform standard training. These findings challenge prevailing assumptions about MLLM reasoning training and motivate the development of more modality-aware RL-based training designs.
summary_zh: 近期强化学习在大型推理模型中的成功，推动了其越来越多地用于多模态大语言模型的训练后微调，以增强其视觉推理能力。尽管许多研究报道了性能提升，但强化学习训练是否真的促使模型从视觉信息中学习，这一点尚不明确。本研究提出了“幻觉作为线索”分析框架，旨在从模型幻觉的角度探究基于强化学习的训练后微调对多模态推理模型的影响。具体而言，我们引入了诱导幻觉的、特定模态的干扰方法，这些方法移除或替换了推导正确答案所需的关键信息，从而迫使模型依赖幻觉进行推理。通过在训练和评估阶段应用这些干扰，本框架为诊断强化学习训练动态和理解数据集的内在特性提供了独特视角。通过在多个多模态推理基准上的广泛实验和分析，我们揭示了模型幻觉在强化学习训练中的作用比以往认识到的更为显著。例如，我们发现纯诱导幻觉设定下的强化学习训练后微调仍能显著提升模型的推理性能，在某些情况下甚至优于标准训练。这些发现挑战了当前关于多模态大语言模型推理训练的主流假设，并激励了更具模态感知能力的强化学习训练设计的进一步发展。
